ADM-001.titulo_en: Application to Initiate an Administrative Procedure
ADM-001.descricao_en: Generates a formal application addressed to a public body to initiate an administrative procedure, setting out the applicant's identification, the facts, the legal basis and the specific request, in accordance with the Code of Administrative Procedure (CPA).

ADM-002.titulo_en: Exercise of the Right to a Prior Hearing (Audiência Prévia)
ADM-002.descricao_en: Generates the interested party's written submission in the prior hearing (audiência prévia), a mandatory stage before any unfavourable administrative decision, identifying the defects in the draft decision, rebutting it on the facts and the law, and requesting its amendment or the closure of the procedure.

ADM-003.descricao_en: Generates an administrative complaint (reclamação) addressed to the very body that issued the act, setting out its defects, the legal grounds and a request for revocation or amendment, as a non-judicial means of challenge (impugnação graciosa) before a hierarchical appeal or court proceedings.

ADM-004.descricao_en: Generates a hierarchical appeal (recurso hierárquico) addressed to the hierarchical superior of the body that issued the harmful act, identifying the act appealed against, the defects invoked, the legal grounds and a request for revocation or amendment, under Articles 193 and 194 of the CPA.

ADM-005.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Administrative Action Challenging an Administrative Act
ADM-005.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the special administrative action challenging an administrative act before the administrative courts, covering the court addressed, standing, timeliness, the facts, the grounds of invalidity and a request for annulment or a declaration of nullity, under the CPTA.

ADM-006.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Administrative Action for an Order to Perform a Legally Due Act
ADM-006.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the administrative action seeking an order requiring the Administration to perform an administrative act that it has unlawfully omitted or refused, setting out the duty to act, the legal basis of the duty to decide and a request for an order to perform the due act (condenação à prática de ato devido), under Articles 66 et seq. of the CPTA.

ADM-007.titulo_en: Application for a Court Order to Provide Information, Allow Inspection of Files or Issue Certificates
ADM-007.descricao_en: Generates the application for a court order (intimação) to the administrative court compelling the Administration to provide information, allow inspection of administrative files or issue certificates, under Articles 104 to 108 of the CPTA, where the out-of-court route has been refused or ignored.

ADM-008.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure Suspending the Effects of an Administrative Act
ADM-008.descricao_en: Generates the application for an interim measure suspending the effects of an administrative act, demonstrating fumus boni iuris (prima facie appearance of the right), periculum in mora (risk of serious harm that is difficult to repair) and the balancing of interests, under Articles 112 et seq. of the CPTA.

ADM-009.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Non-Contractual Civil Liability of the State
ADM-009.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action for non-contractual civil liability of the State and other public bodies, identifying the unlawful act, fault, damage and causal link, and claiming compensation, under Law No. 67/2007 of 31 December (RRCEE).

ADM-010.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation for an Unlawful Act of the Administration
ADM-010.descricao_en: Analyses and quantifies the compensable damage in cases of non-contractual civil liability of the State, itemising actual loss (danos emergentes), loss of profits (lucros cessantes) and non-pecuniary damage, on the basis of the RRCEE and the Civil Code applied subsidiarily, and presents a detailed compensation table.

ADM-011.titulo_en: Complaint in a Public Procurement Procedure
ADM-011.descricao_en: Generates the complaint addressed to the contracting authority in a public procurement procedure, challenging acts of the evaluation committee (júri) or of the contracting authority (procurement documents, exclusion decisions, evaluation of tenders), under the Public Contracts Code (CCP) and the European procurement directives.

ADM-012.titulo_en: Administrative Challenge to the Tender Documents
ADM-012.descricao_en: Generates an administrative challenge addressed to the contracting authority contesting procurement documents (tender programme (programa do concurso), specifications (caderno de encargos), invitation) that contain unlawful, discriminatory or anti-competitive clauses, under Articles 55 et seq. of the CCP.

ADM-013.titulo_en: Appeal against an Award Decision or the Exclusion of a Tender
ADM-013.descricao_en: Generates the administrative appeal addressed to the contracting authority contesting the award of the contract to a third party or the exclusion of the appellant's own tender, identifying the unlawful aspects of the evaluation, the legal grounds and a request for annulment and a new award, under the CCP.

ADM-014.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in Pre-Contractual Litigation
ADM-014.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in pre-contractual litigation (contencioso pré-contratual) before the administrative courts, seeking annulment of acts adopted in public contract award procedures (exclusion, award, unlawful procurement documents), as a particularly urgent procedure, under Articles 100 to 103 of the CPTA.

ADM-015.titulo_en: Analysis of the Tender Programme and Specifications
ADM-015.descricao_en: Critically analyses the tender programme (programa do concurso) and specifications (caderno de encargos) of a public procurement procedure, identifying unlawful, discriminatory, disproportionate or anti-competitive clauses, and makes recommendations before a tender is submitted or a challenge is brought.

ADM-016.titulo_en: Complaint against Acts of the Public Tender Evaluation Committee
ADM-016.descricao_en: Generates the complaint addressed to the evaluation committee (júri) or the contracting authority contesting acts of the committee during the evaluation of tenders — preliminary report, partial exclusion decisions, scoring errors or omissions in the criteria — under the CCP and in the prior hearing (audiência prévia) stage.

ADM-017.titulo_en: Statement of Claim on the Validity and Performance of an Administrative Contract
ADM-017.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action on the validity or performance of an administrative contract, either to have it declared null/invalid or to enforce the Administration's contractual obligations, under the CPTA and the CCP (Part III — performance of contracts).

ADM-018.titulo_en: Application for Expropriation by Agreement (Expropriação Amigável)
ADM-018.descricao_en: Generates the expropriated party's application to open negotiations for an amicable agreement in expropriation proceedings, with a reasoned compensation proposal, under the Expropriations Code (CE) approved by Law No. 168/99 of 18 September.

ADM-019.titulo_en: Challenge to a Declaration of Public Utility or a Resolution to Expropriate
ADM-019.descricao_en: Generates the claim for judicial review of the declaration of public utility (DUP) or of the resolution to expropriate, contesting the legal conditions for expropriation, the public need or the proportionality of the measure, under the Expropriations Code and the CPTA.

ADM-020.titulo_en: Appeal against the Arbitral Decision Fixing Expropriation Compensation
ADM-020.descricao_en: Generates the appeal against the arbitral decision that fixed the expropriation compensation, contesting the valuation and the criteria used by the arbitrators and seeking a higher amount (by the expropriated party) or a lower amount (by the expropriating entity), under Article 52 of the Expropriations Code.

ADM-021.titulo_en: Objection to the Valuation in Expropriation Proceedings
ADM-021.descricao_en: Generates the expropriated party's objection to the valuation carried out by the experts in expropriation proceedings, contesting the methodology, criteria or values applied and submitting a reasoned counter-valuation, under the Expropriations Code.

ADM-022.titulo_en: Submission in Administrative Offence (Contraordenação) Proceedings Brought by an Administrative Body
ADM-022.descricao_en: Generates the written defence in administrative offence proceedings (contraordenação) brought by an administrative body (municipal council, regulatory authority, Food and Economic Safety Authority (ASAE), National Civil Aviation Authority (ANAC), etc.), contesting the facts alleged, challenging the lawfulness of the proceedings and seeking their closure or a reduction of the fine, under the General Regime of Administrative Offences (RGCO — Decree-Law No. 433/82).

ADM-023.titulo_en: Request for Access to Administrative Documents (CADA)
ADM-023.descricao_en: Generates the request for access to administrative documents addressed to the body holding them, under the Law on Access to Administrative Documents (LADA — Law No. 26/2016 of 22 August) and the Commission for Access to Administrative Documents (CADA), requesting inspection, a copy or a certificate.

ADM-024.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Nullity and Voidability of an Administrative Act
ADM-024.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing the defects of an administrative act and classifying each one as a ground of nullity (Article 161 CPA) or of voidability (Article 163 CPA), with the practical consequences for a challenge, namely the time limits and the legal effects of invalidity.

ADM-025.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Recognition of a Right or Legally Protected Interest
ADM-025.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the administrative action for recognition of a right or legally protected interest, asking the court to declare the existence of the claimant's right and to order the Administration to respect it, under Article 37 and Articles 67 et seq. of the CPTA.

ADM-026.titulo_en: Challenge to a Disciplinary Sanction Imposed on a Public-Sector Employee
ADM-026.descricao_en: Generates the defence and the subsequent hierarchical appeal or judicial challenge against a disciplinary sanction imposed on a public-sector employee, identifying the defects in the disciplinary procedure and the grounds for challenging the sanction, under the General Law on Employment in Public Functions (LTFP — Law No. 35/2014 of 20 June).

ADM-027.titulo_en: Application for Revocation or Administrative Annulment of an Act
ADM-027.descricao_en: Generates the application to the competent body seeking revocation on the merits, or administrative annulment on grounds of unlawfulness, of an administrative act, under Articles 165 to 172 of the CPA, without having to go to court.

ADM-028.titulo_en: Appeal to the Central Administrative Court
ADM-028.descricao_en: Generates the appeal submissions (alegações) to the Central Administrative Court (TCA), challenging the first-instance judgment and identifying errors of law and/or fact, under Articles 140 et seq. of the CPTA and the Code of Civil Procedure (CPC) applied subsidiarily.

ADM-029.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Lawfulness of an Administrative Regulation
ADM-029.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing the lawfulness of an administrative regulation (municipal, ministerial or issued by a regulatory authority), checking the requirements of competence, form, procedure and content, under Articles 135 et seq. of the CPA.

ADM-030.titulo_en: Statement of Claim Challenging a Regulatory Provision
ADM-030.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the administrative action challenging a regulatory provision, seeking a declaration that the provision is unlawful and inapplicable to the specific case, under Articles 72 et seq. of the CPTA.

ADM-031.titulo_en: Application for Enforcement of a Judgment against the Administration
ADM-031.descricao_en: Generates the application for enforcement of a judgment against the Administration that has not been complied with voluntarily, asking the court to order enforcement measures and to impose periodic penalty payments (sanções pecuniárias compulsórias), under Articles 157 et seq. of the CPTA.

ADM-032.titulo_en: Compliance Checklist for a Public Procurement Procedure
ADM-032.descricao_en: Generates a structured legal compliance checklist for a public procurement procedure, checking every CCP requirement from the decision to contract through to the conclusion of the contract and identifying points of risk or non-compliance, under the CCP and the European Directives.

ADM-033.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Time Bar of the Right to Bring an Administrative Action (Calculation of Time Limits)
ADM-033.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on calculating the time limits for challenges in administrative litigation, checking whether the right of action still exists or has lapsed (caducidade), with an analysis of the different applicable time limits (action to challenge an act, action for an order to act, pre-contractual litigation, civil liability) and of the events that start, suspend or interrupt them.

ADM-034.titulo_en: Application for an Administrative Licence and Response to a Refusal
ADM-034.descricao_en: Generates the initial application for an administrative licence or authorisation and, in the event of total or partial refusal, prepares a reasoned response — either through an administrative complaint (reclamação graciosa) or a prior hearing (audiência prévia) in the same procedure — analysing the grounds for refusal, identifying procedural and substantive defects and putting forward new arguments, under the Code of Administrative Procedure (CPA) and the applicable sector-specific legislation.

ADM-035.titulo_en: Challenge to an Award Decision under the CCP (Urgent Pre-Contractual Litigation)
ADM-035.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim in urgent pre-contractual litigation (contencioso pré-contratual) to challenge an award decision, under Articles 100 to 103-A of the CPTA and Articles 164 to 277 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 of 29 January, republished by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017), alleging defects in the evaluation of the tender, breach of the award criteria or failure to observe essential formalities.

ADM-036.titulo_en: Order for the Protection of Rights, Freedoms and Guarantees (Intimação, Article 109 CPTA)
ADM-036.descricao_en: Drafts an application for an order for the protection of rights, freedoms and guarantees (intimação) under Article 109 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), an urgent procedure designed to obtain a swift court decision where fundamental rights are threatened or violated by an act or omission of the Public Administration.

ADM-037.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure Suspending Effects with Reversal of the Main Action (Inversão do Contencioso) (CPTA)
ADM-037.descricao_en: Drafts an application for an interim measure with a request for reversal of the burden to bring the main action (inversão do contencioso) under Articles 112 to 134 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), a procedural tool that anticipates the effects of final relief and may make the interim measure granted definitive if the respondent does not bring the main action within the time limit set.

ADM-038.titulo_en: Licença Zero / Prior Notification Application (RJUE and Licença Zero)
ADM-038.descricao_en: Drafts a prior notification with a time limit (comunicação prévia com prazo) and a 'zero licence' (licença zero) application for low-risk economic activities, under Decree-Law No. 10/2015 (RJAELA), the RJUE (Decree-Law No. 555/99 as currently worded) and Decree-Law No. 48/2011 (licença zero), including the response to a notice of non-acceptance or of defects.

ADM-039.titulo_en: Common Administrative Action for an Order against the Administration to Pay a Sum Certain
ADM-039.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a common administrative action seeking an order requiring a public body to pay a sum certain (compensation, contractual claims or refunds), under Articles 37 and 38 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015) and the regime of non-contractual civil liability of the State (Law No. 67/2007 of 31 December).

ADM-040.descricao_en: Drafts and analyses inter-administrative contracts concluded between two or more public bodies, under Articles 336 to 342 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017) and Article 202 of the CPA (Decree-Law No. 4/2015), including contracts for the delegation of powers, associations of municipalities, inter-ministerial cooperation and the joint implementation of public policies.

ADM-041.titulo_en: Application for Price Revision in a Public Works Contract
ADM-041.descricao_en: Drafts an application for price revision in a public works contract, under Decree-Law No. 6/2004 (price revision regime for public works contracts) and Articles 282 to 286 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008), including the calculation of the revision formulae and a challenge to the decision of the project owner (dono da obra) fixing the amount.

ADM-042.titulo_en: Unilateral Modification of an Administrative Contract (Article 313 CCP) — Contractor's Response
ADM-042.descricao_en: Drafts the contractor's (co-contratante) response to an order for unilateral modification of the administrative contract issued by the contracting authority under Article 313 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017), including the claim for financial compensation and, where appropriate, a challenge to the modification for exceeding the legal limits.

ADM-043.titulo_en: Disciplinary Procedure in the Public Service — Statement of Charges and Final Decision (LTFP)
ADM-043.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of charges (nota de culpa) and the final decision in disciplinary proceedings against a public-sector employee, under the General Law on Employment in Public Functions (LTFP, Law No. 35/2014 of 20 June) and the Disciplinary Statute for Public Service Employees (EDTFP, Law No. 58/2008 of 9 September, as amended by the LTFP), with the legal requirements for investigation, defence and proportionality of the sanction.

ADM-044.titulo_en: Request for Access to Administrative Documents via CADA — Challenging a Refusal
ADM-044.descricao_en: Drafts a request for access to administrative documents under Law No. 26/2016 (LADA) and the Regulation on Access to Administrative Documents (RADA), and the subsequent complaint to the Commission for Access to Administrative Documents (CADA) if the body holding them refuses or remains silent, under Articles 15 to 18 of the LADA.

ADM-045.titulo_en: Appeal to the Supreme Administrative Court — Appeal on Points of Law (Recurso de Revista, Article 150 CPTA)
ADM-045.descricao_en: Drafts the submissions for an appeal on points of law (recurso de revista) to the Supreme Administrative Court (STA) under Article 150 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), an exceptional appeal admissible where the judgment under appeal conflicts with another judgment of the STA or of the TCA, or where the question is of fundamental legal importance.

ADM-046.titulo_en: Termination of an Administrative Contract for the Contractor's Breach (Article 333 CCP)
ADM-046.descricao_en: Drafts the notice terminating an administrative contract for breach by the contractor (co-contratante) under Article 333 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017), including the declaration of termination, the calling-in of the performance bond (caução) and the claim for compensation for the damage caused to the public body.

ADM-047.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Duty to State Reasons for an Administrative Act and the Consequences of Failure (Article 152 CPA)
ADM-047.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the duty to state reasons for an administrative act, under Articles 152 to 154 of the CPA (Decree-Law No. 4/2015 of 7 January), analysing whether the reasons given meet the legal standard and the legal consequences of insufficient reasoning or of reasoning per relationem.

ADM-048.titulo_en: Delegation and Sub-Delegation of Powers — Drafting the Order and Assessing Validity (Article 44 CPA)
ADM-048.descricao_en: Drafts an order (despacho) delegating and sub-delegating administrative powers under Articles 44 to 50 of the CPA (Decree-Law No. 4/2015) and assesses the validity of acts performed under a delegation, including the limits, the publication requirement and the consequences of breaching the delegation rules.

ADM-049.titulo_en: Direct Award with Consultation of Three Entities — Drafting the Invitation and Analysing the Grounds (Article 112 CCP)
ADM-049.descricao_en: Drafts the invitation for a simplified direct award (ajuste direto) with consultation of three entities under Articles 112 to 129 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017), including the reasoning for the direct-award ground, the procedure programme, the award criteria and the documents to be submitted by the invited entities.

ADM-050.titulo_en: Application for Enforcement of an Annulment Judgment against the Administration (Article 173 CPTA)
ADM-050.descricao_en: Drafts an application for enforcement of a judgment annulling an administrative act, under Articles 173 to 179 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), where the public body fails to comply with the annulment judgment within the legal time limit, including a request for a periodic penalty payment (sanção pecuniária compulsória) and, if necessary, the substitution of the defaulting body.

ADM-051.titulo_en: Public Service Concession Contract — Analysis and Drafting of Essential Clauses
ADM-051.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts the essential clauses of public service concession contracts under Articles 407 to 433 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017) and Directives 2014/23/EU (concessions) and 2014/25/EU (special sectors), including the financial balance regime and the reversion and termination of the concession.

ADM-052.titulo_en: Challenge to a Tacit Refusal — Formation of Administrative Silence (Article 130 CPA)
ADM-052.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an administrative action challenging the tacit refusal (indeferimento tácito) arising from the Administration's silence, under Article 130 of the CPA (Decree-Law No. 4/2015) and Articles 58 and 66 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), once the time limits for a decision have expired without a response from the body.

ADM-053.titulo_en: Expropriation for Public Utility — Arbitration and Challenge to Compensation (Expropriations Code)
ADM-053.descricao_en: Drafts the application to set up an arbitral tribunal to fix the expropriation compensation and, where appropriate, challenges the arbitral decision before the District Court (Tribunal de Comarca), under the Expropriations Code (CE, Law No. 168/99 of 18 September, as amended by Law No. 56/2008) and Articles 38 to 59 of the CE, including an analysis of the market value of the expropriated property and a critique of the expert report.

ADM-054.titulo_en: Administrative Complaint and Hierarchical Appeal against an Unfavourable Administrative Act (Articles 191 to 199 CPA)
ADM-054.descricao_en: Drafts an administrative complaint (reclamação graciosa) and a hierarchical appeal (recurso hierárquico) against an unfavourable administrative act, under Articles 191 to 199 of the CPA (Decree-Law No. 4/2015 of 7 January), including an analysis of the time limit, the defects of the act and the administrative challenge strategy before turning to the courts.

ADM-055.titulo_en: State Liability for a Lawful Act — Special and Abnormal Damage (Article 16 of Law No. 67/2007)
ADM-055.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an administrative action for civil liability of the State for a lawful act causing special and abnormal damage to a private party, under Article 16 of Law No. 67/2007 (RRCEE, of 31 December) and Article 2 of the Constitution of the Portuguese Republic, where administrative action — although lawful — imposes on the private party a disproportionate sacrifice in breach of the principle of equality of citizens before public burdens.

ADM-056.titulo_en: Provisional and Final Acceptance Records for Public Works — Drafting and Challenging Defects (Articles 394 to 400 CCP)
ADM-056.descricao_en: Drafts the provisional and final acceptance record (auto de receção) for public works, analyses the regime for defects in public works contracts under Articles 394 to 400 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017) and drafts the notices reporting defects, requesting their remedy and, if necessary, terminating the contract for defects that have not been remedied.

ADM-057.titulo_en: Application for Restoration of Financial Balance for an Act of the Sovereign (Facto do Príncipe) in an Administrative Contract (Article 282 CCP)
ADM-057.descricao_en: Drafts an application to restore the financial balance of an administrative contract on the grounds of an act of the sovereign (facto do príncipe) or an abnormal and unforeseeable change of circumstances, under Articles 282 to 286 of the CCP (Decree-Law No. 18/2008 as amended by Decree-Law No. 111-B/2017) and Article 437 of the Civil Code applied subsidiarily, including quantification of the damage and of the additional costs caused by the public body's conduct.

ADM-058.titulo_en: Application to Set Up an Administrative Arbitral Tribunal under the Voluntary Arbitration Law (Law No. 63/2011)
ADM-058.descricao_en: Drafts the application to set up an arbitral tribunal to resolve disputes arising from administrative contracts or from the Administration's civil liability, under the Voluntary Arbitration Law (LAV, Law No. 63/2011 of 14 December) and Articles 180 to 187 of the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), including reliance on the arbitration agreement, the appointment of arbitrators and the subject matter of the dispute.

ADM-059.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Jurisdiction Ratione Materiae and Ratione Loci of the Administrative and Tax Courts (ETAF)
ADM-059.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the subject-matter and territorial jurisdiction of the administrative and tax courts to hear a given dispute, under the Statute of the Administrative and Tax Courts (ETAF, Law No. 13/2002 of 19 February, as amended by Law No. 114/2019) and the CPTA (Decree-Law No. 214-G/2015), identifying the competent court, the risks of lack of jurisdiction and the procedural consequences of filing in the wrong forum.

ADM-060.titulo_en: Defence before the Health Regulatory Authority (ERS) — Response to a Notice of Non-Compliance and Appeal against a Sanctioning Decision
ADM-060.descricao_en: Drafts the response to a notice of non-compliance issued by the Health Regulatory Authority (ERS) and, where appropriate, the appeal against the sanctioning decision, under the Legal Regime for the Activity of Healthcare Establishments (RJAES, Decree-Law No. 279/2009 of 6 October), the ERS Statute (Decree-Law No. 126/2014 of 22 August) and the General Regime of Administrative Offences (RGCO, Decree-Law No. 433/82), including the defence in administrative offence proceedings for breaches of health legislation.

BAN-001.titulo_en: Review of a Home Loan Agreement
BAN-001.descricao_en: Thoroughly reviews a home loan (crédito à habitação) agreement — interest rates (TAN/TAEG, i.e. nominal annual rate and APR), spread, reference index (Euribor), fees, ancillary charges, associated insurance, early repayment clauses and security —, identifying unfair terms and irregularities under the RGICSF (Legal Framework of Credit Institutions and Financial Companies) and Decree-Law No. 74-A/2017, and suggesting negotiation or a challenge.

BAN-002.titulo_en: Letter of Complaint to the Bank of Portugal
BAN-002.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint to the Bank of Portugal (Banco de Portugal) through the Bank Customer Portal (Portal do Cliente Bancário), setting out the irregularity committed by the credit institution (bank, financial company or payment service provider), with legal grounds appropriate to the RGICSF, the prudential rules and the Bank of Portugal's conduct rules.

BAN-003.titulo_en: Complaint to the Credit Institution's Customer Ombudsman
BAN-003.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint to the Customer Ombudsman (Provedor do Cliente) of the bank or financial institution, using the mandatory internal alternative dispute resolution mechanism, with technical grounds, a specific request and an enforceable response deadline, under Bank of Portugal Notice (Aviso) No. 5/2013 and the RGICSF conduct rules.

BAN-004.titulo_en: Letter Requesting Renegotiation of a Home Loan (PARI / PERSI)
BAN-004.descricao_en: Drafts a letter requesting renegotiation of a home loan under PARI (Action Plan for Default Risk) and PERSI (out-of-court procedure for regularising defaults), pursuant to Decree-Law No. 227/2012, exploring all available support measures — capital grace period, reduction of the term, interest rate subsidy or supplementary financing.

BAN-005.descricao_en: Prepares a reasoned legal opinion on the borrower's rights under PERSI (out-of-court procedure for regularising defaults), pursuant to Decree-Law No. 227/2012, assessing whether the bank complied with its legal duties of activation, negotiation and information, and whether there are grounds to challenge insufficient proposals or an irregular refusal within the procedure.

BAN-006.titulo_en: Review of Unfair Terms in a Banking Contract
BAN-006.descricao_en: Reviews the terms of banking contracts — credit, bank account, card, deposit — identifying void, prohibited or potentially unfair terms under the standard contract terms regime (cláusulas contratuais gerais, Decree-Law No. 446/85), the RGICSF and the applicable sector legislation, with a precise legal framework and a recommended route for challenge.

BAN-007.titulo_en: Bank Loan Agreement (Review of the Bank's Draft)
BAN-007.descricao_en: Reviews the draft bank loan agreement (mútuo bancário) presented by the credit institution, identifying unbalanced terms, unilateral amendment mechanisms, excessive security, hidden fees and provisions contrary to the RGICSF, Decree-Law No. 446/85 and the legislation applicable to the type of credit, with specific suggestions for negotiation or amendment.

BAN-008.descricao_en: Drafts or reviews independent bank guarantee agreements (first demand), analysing the essential elements — independence from the underlying contract, beneficiary, instructing party, conditions for calling and exception clauses —, under the URDG 758 (ICC), the Civil Code (Articles 627 et seq.) and Portuguese banking practice.

BAN-009.descricao_en: Drafts or reviews commercial or financial pledge agreements — pledges over shareholdings, receivables, bank accounts and financial instruments —, under the Civil Code (Articles 666 et seq.), the Commercial Code, Decree-Law No. 105/2004 (financial collateral) and the provisions of the Securities Code (Código dos Valores Mobiliários), identifying risks and essential clauses.

BAN-010.descricao_en: Reviews the draft mortgage (hipoteca) presented by the bank for property financing, analyses the essential elements — secured amount, ranking, mortgaged property, scope of the mortgage, acceleration clauses and registration —, identifies problematic clauses and issues instructions for the notarial act creating the mortgage, under the Civil Code (Articles 686 et seq.) and the Notarial Code (Código do Notariado).

BAN-011.titulo_en: Suretyship Agreement and Analysis of the Guarantor's Liability
BAN-011.descricao_en: Drafts bank suretyship (fiança) agreements or analyses the guarantor's liability under contracts already concluded, clarifying the scope of the guarantee — joint and several liability, benefit of prior exhaustion of the debtor's assets (benefício da excussão prévia), extension to accessory obligations and any changes to the principal contract —, under the Civil Code (Articles 627 et seq.) and the case law of the Portuguese higher courts.

BAN-012.titulo_en: Letter Opposing the Enforcement of a Guarantee
BAN-012.descricao_en: Drafts an out-of-court notice opposing the enforcement of a bank guarantee (suretyship, independent guarantee, pledge or mortgage), identifying the legal grounds for opposition — manifest fraud, extinction of the suretyship, excessive amount, limitation or failure to meet the conditions for calling —, under the Civil Code, the CPC (Code of Civil Procedure) and the applicable contractual terms.

BAN-013.titulo_en: Review of an Insurance Contract and its General and Specific Conditions
BAN-013.descricao_en: Reviews the insurance contract — general, special and specific conditions — identifying the cover included and relevant exclusions, checking whether the policy suits the policyholder's needs and detecting unfair terms or terms not properly communicated, under the LCS (Insurance Contract Law — Law No. 72/2008) and Decree-Law No. 446/85.

BAN-014.titulo_en: Letter Notifying a Loss and Complaint to the Insurer
BAN-014.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter notifying the insurer of a loss (participação de sinistro), meeting the requirements of the Insurance Contract Law (LCS — Law No. 72/2008), with a precise description of the incident, a list of the damage, the documents to attach and a request for payment of the indemnity within a set period. Includes a complaint where the notification seeks to challenge a previous response from the insurer.

BAN-015.titulo_en: Letter Challenging an Insurer's Refusal to Pay Compensation
BAN-015.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter challenging the insurer's refusal to pay compensation, identifying the legal and contractual grounds showing that the refusal is unfounded, contesting exclusions for lack of communication or because they do not apply to the case, under the LCS (Law No. 72/2008) and Decree-Law No. 446/85, and formally escalating the dispute.

BAN-016.titulo_en: Statement of Claim against an Insurer for Breach of the Insurance Contract
BAN-016.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim (petição inicial) in an action for breach of contract against an insurer, seeking an order to pay the compensation due plus default interest, under the LCS (Law No. 72/2008), the Civil Code and the CPC, structured for filing in a court of law or in arbitration.

BAN-017.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation under Motor Insurance
BAN-017.descricao_en: Analyses and calculates the compensation due on a motor insurance claim — own damage and motor third-party liability (RC) —, checking the vehicle's market value, repairable damage vs. total loss, personal injury, loss of use and other heads of damage, under Decree-Law No. 291/2007 (motor third-party liability), the LCS (Law No. 72/2008) and the INE/ANSR table for personal injury [VERIFICAR: tables in force].

BAN-018.titulo_en: Claim to the Motor Guarantee Fund
BAN-018.descricao_en: Drafts a compensation claim to the Motor Guarantee Fund (Fundo de Garantia Automóvel, FGA), managed by the Occupational Accidents Fund (Fundo de Acidentes de Trabalho, FAT) through the ASF, in cases of accidents caused by an unidentified vehicle, an uninsured vehicle or a vehicle insured with an insolvent company, under Decree-Law No. 291/2007 and the Decree-Law governing the FGA [VERIFICAR: legislation in force].

BAN-019.titulo_en: Opinion on Policy Cover in a Specific Case
BAN-019.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on whether a specific loss is covered by the policy, analysing the scope of cover, the applicable exclusions and their validity, the insurer's duties of communication and the policyholder's legal position under the policy in force, under the LCS (Law No. 72/2008) and Decree-Law No. 446/85.

BAN-020.titulo_en: Review of a Credit-Linked Life Insurance Contract
BAN-020.descricao_en: Reviews the life insurance contract linked to a home loan or personal loan, checking the cover taken out (death, disability, unemployment), whether the sum insured matches the outstanding balance, the freedom to choose the insurer, the conditions for triggering cover and the exclusions, under the LCS (Law No. 72/2008) and Decree-Law No. 74-A/2017.

BAN-021.titulo_en: Letter of Complaint for Mis-Selling of a Financial Product
BAN-021.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint for mis-selling (comercialização inadequada) of a financial product — investment fund, structured product, interest rate swaps, term deposit without a capital guarantee — identifying the breach of the suitability and information duties imposed by the CSMVM, Decree-Law No. 357-A/2007 (MiFID) and the rules of the Portuguese Securities Market Commission (CMVM), and requesting repayment of the losses suffered.

BAN-022.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Mis-Selling of a Complex Financial Product
BAN-022.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a civil liability action against a financial intermediary for mis-selling a complex financial product (structured product, high-risk fund, swap, subordinated bond), seeking compensation for the losses suffered, based on the CVM (Securities Code), the transposed MiFID regime and the Civil Code.

BAN-023.titulo_en: Review of a Bank Account Agreement and Fees
BAN-023.descricao_en: Reviews the bank account opening agreement (current account, savings account, business current account), identifying the fees charged, their legal basis, the limits set by the Bank of Portugal and the RGICSF, clauses allowing unilateral changes to the conditions and the basic banking services (serviços mínimos bancários) to which the customer may be entitled, under Decree-Law No. 27-C/2000 (basic banking services) and the RGICSF conduct rules.

BAN-024.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint to the bank about unauthorised payment transactions resulting from fraud (phishing, vishing, smishing, SIM swapping), demanding a refund of the amounts debited on the basis of the payment services regime (Decree-Law No. 317/2009 and the transposed PSD2 Directive), clearly identifying the payment service user's rights against the provider.

BAN-025.titulo_en: Letter Disputing Liability for an Unauthorised Payment Transaction
BAN-025.descricao_en: Drafts a letter to a bank that has refused a refund for an unauthorised payment transaction, technically disputing the allegation of gross negligence by the customer, invoking the payment service provider's obligations under Decree-Law No. 91/2018 (PSD2) and escalating to the Bank of Portugal and to court if necessary.

BAN-026.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the lawfulness of bank fees charged by a credit institution, identifying fees prohibited by Bank of Portugal notice, fees without a contractual basis, fees resulting from unilateral amendment and fees that constitute unfair terms, with a calculation of the refundable amount and the routes for recovery.

BAN-027.descricao_en: Drafts or reviews finance lease (locação financeira) agreements for movable and immovable property, analysing the essential elements — subject matter, rentals, purchase option, residual value, lessee's risks, early termination clauses and mandatory insurance —, under Decree-Law No. 149/95 (finance leasing) and the Civil Code.

BAN-028.descricao_en: Drafts or reviews factoring (cessão financeira) agreements, analysing the essential elements — assignment of receivables, advance payment, collection service, fees, recourse vs. non-recourse factoring, notice to the assigned debtor and exclusivity clauses —, under Decree-Law No. 171/95 (factoring) and the Civil Code.

BAN-029.descricao_en: Prepares a detailed compliance checklist for preventing and combating money laundering and terrorist financing (AML/CFT), under Law No. 83/2017 (transposing the 4th AML Directive) and Decree-Law No. 144/2019 (5th AML Directive), applicable to financial institutions, lawyers, accountants and other obliged entities, identifying the legal obligations and the procedures to implement.

BAN-030.titulo_en: Opinion on the Credit Institution's Pre-Contractual Information Duty
BAN-030.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the credit institution's compliance with its pre-contractual information duties, assessing whether the ESIS (European Standardised Information Sheet — FINE), information on the APR (TAEG), fees, associated insurance and alternatives were provided and properly explained, under Decree-Law No. 74-A/2017, Decree-Law No. 133/2009 and the RGICSF, with an assessment of the consequences of non-compliance for the contractual relationship.

BAN-031.titulo_en: Mortgage Enforcement — Opposition and Defence of the Mortgage Debtor
BAN-031.descricao_en: Prepares the debtor's defence in enforcement proceedings in which the creditor bank enforces the mortgage to recover a home loan or other mortgage-secured credit, under the RGICSF (Decree-Law 298/92) and the Code of Civil Procedure, invoking procedural nullities, excessive enforcement, lack of prior formal demand under Decree-Law 74-A/2017 and any unfair terms.

BAN-032.titulo_en: Blank Promissory Note — Challenging Abusive Completion
BAN-032.descricao_en: Prepares an opposition based on the instrument or an opposition to enforcement (embargos de executado) contesting the abusive completion of a promissory note (livrança) issued in blank as security for a credit or account-opening agreement, under the Uniform Law on Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes (LULL) and the rules on immediate relations (Art. 10 LULL), invoking the completion agreement (pacto de preenchimento) and completion in breach of what was agreed.

BAN-033.titulo_en: PPR — Early Redemption and Dispute with the Management Company
BAN-033.descricao_en: Prepares a formal communication or court pleading to demand redemption of a Retirement Savings Plan (Plano Poupança Reforma, PPR) outside the normal conditions, challenge a refusal by the management company or insurer, or recover tax benefits wrongly reclaimed, under the EBF (Tax Benefits Statute), Decree-Law 158/2002 (PPR funds), the LCS (Insurance Contract Law, Decree-Law 72/2008) and the Legal Regime for the Management of Pension Funds.

BAN-034.titulo_en: Consumer Credit — Defence in Default and Right of Withdrawal (Decree-Law 133/2009)
BAN-034.descricao_en: Reviews consumer credit agreements and prepares the consumer's defence in a default situation, checking compliance with the pre-contractual and contractual information duties, the lawfulness of the APR (TAEG), the 14-day right of withdrawal (revogação) and the consequences of default, under Decree-Law 133/2009 (transposing Directive 2008/48/EC) and the RGICSF.

BAN-035.titulo_en: Independent Bank Guarantee — Unjustified Call and Interim Measure
BAN-035.descricao_en: Prepares an opposition to the call on an independent first-demand bank guarantee, invoking abuse of rights, manifest fraud or the exceptio doli (excepção dolosa), and applies for an interim measure (providência cautelar) suspending payment under the Civil Code and the Code of Civil Procedure, taking into account the higher courts' case law on the principle of independence and the exceptions to immediate payment.

BAN-036.titulo_en: Financial Intermediation — Mis-Selling and MiFID II Duties
BAN-036.descricao_en: Prepares an opinion or statement of claim to hold the financial institution civilly liable for breach of the duties of information, suitability and appropriateness in selling complex financial instruments (subordinated bonds, investment funds, derivatives, structured products), under the Securities Code (CVM, Decree-Law 486/99), Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/565 (MiFID II) and Directive 2014/65/EU as transposed by Decree-Law 63-A/2013.

BAN-037.titulo_en: Payment Services and PSD2 (DSP2) — Unauthorised Transaction and PSP Liability
BAN-037.descricao_en: Analyses disputes over unauthorised payment transactions (phishing, pharming, SIM swap, fraudulent transfers) and prepares a complaint or court pleading to hold the payment service provider (PSP) liable, under the Legal Regime for Payment Services and Electronic Money (RJSPME, Decree-Law 91/2018, transposing PSD2/DSP2), especially as regards strong customer authentication and the liability regime.

BAN-038.titulo_en: Structured Deposits and Complex Financial Products — Analysis and Complaint
BAN-038.descricao_en: Analyses structured deposits, dual deposits and other complex financial products sold by credit institutions, checking compliance with the information duties imposed by Bank of Portugal Notice No. 4/2009 and the Legal Regime for Complex Financial Products (Decree-Law 211-A/2008, as amended by Decree-Law 63-A/2013), and prepares a complaint for insufficient information or a product unsuited to the customer's profile.

BAN-039.titulo_en: Bank Resolution and Resolution Measures — Rights of Creditors and Shareholders
BAN-039.descricao_en: Prepares an opinion or court pleading defending the rights of creditors, bondholders and shareholders affected by resolution measures applied by the Bank of Portugal under the Legal Framework of Credit Institutions and Financial Companies (RGICSF) and Decree-Law No. 31-A/2012 (transposing the BRRD), including challenges to the asset valuation, claims against the bridge bank and State liability.

BAN-040.titulo_en: Comfort Letters and Atypical Personal Guarantees — Analysis and Enforcement
BAN-040.descricao_en: Analyses comfort letters, letters of support and other atypical personal guarantees issued in a banking and corporate context, characterising them legally (obligation of means vs. obligation of result, suretyship vs. undertaking of honour), determining whether they are enforceable and preparing a letter calling on them or an enforcement request, under the Portuguese Civil Code and the principles of banking law.

BAN-041.titulo_en: Early Termination of a Home Loan and Portability
BAN-041.descricao_en: Prepares a communication and legal analysis for exercising the right to full or partial early repayment of a home loan, calculating the maximum compensation due to the bank and checking the conditions for portability (transfer of the loan to another institution), under Decree-Law 74-A/2017 and the Bank of Portugal's guidance on residential mortgage credit.

BAN-042.titulo_en: Anti-Money Laundering — KYC/AML: Institution's Duties and Defence of the Blocked Customer
BAN-042.descricao_en: Prepares an AML compliance checklist for financial institutions and, on the customer's side, a letter challenging an account freeze or refusal of service based on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing procedures, under Law No. 83/2017 (transposing AMLD4) and the amendments made by Law No. 58/2020 (AMLD5), as well as Bank of Portugal regulations.

BAN-043.titulo_en: Finance Leasing — Termination for Default and Return of the Asset
BAN-043.descricao_en: Prepares a legal analysis and court pleadings where the lessee defaults under a finance lease (leasing), including termination of the contract by the lessor, calculation of the rentals owed, return of the asset, compensation and the lessee's challenge to the termination conditions, under Decree-Law 149/95 (legal regime of leasing).

BAN-044.titulo_en: Factoring — Assignment of Receivables and Disputes between Factor, Assignor and Debtor
BAN-044.descricao_en: Analyses factoring (cessão financeira) agreements and prepares court pleadings for disputes between the factoring company (factor), the assignor of the receivables and the assigned debtor, in particular on notice to the debtor, validity of the assignment, receivables wrongly assigned and liability for defects, under Decree-Law 171/95 (factoring regime) and the Civil Code (Articles 577 et seq. — assignment of claims).

BAN-045.titulo_en: Credit-Linked Life Insurance — Refusal of Cover and Claim
BAN-045.descricao_en: Prepares a letter claiming under the life or payment protection insurance linked to a home or consumer loan agreement, challenges the insurer's refusal to pay based on exclusions or undeclared pre-existing conditions, and analyses the rights of the beneficiary (bank or borrower) under the LCS (Insurance Contract Law, Decree-Law 72/2008) and the regulations of the Insurance and Pension Funds Supervisory Authority (ASF).

BAN-046.titulo_en: Non-Resident Bank Account and Right to a Basic Payment Account
BAN-046.descricao_en: Prepares a legal analysis and formal complaint where a credit institution refuses to open a bank account for a foreign national resident in Portugal or resident in another EU Member State, invoking the right to a basic payment account under Decree-Law 107/2017 and Directive 2014/92/EU (Payment Accounts Directive, PAD), and for cases of unilateral account closure on discriminatory grounds.

BAN-047.titulo_en: Financial Pledge — Creation, Enforcement and Challenge (Decree-Law 105/2004)
BAN-047.descricao_en: Analyses financial pledge agreements (pledges of shares, fund units, bonds and other financial instruments) and prepares a legal analysis of their creation, out-of-court enforcement and challenge in litigation, under Decree-Law 105/2004 (transposing Directive 2002/47/EC on financial collateral arrangements) and the Civil Code.

BAN-048.titulo_en: Current Account Credit Facility Agreement — Review and Business Dispute
BAN-048.descricao_en: Analyses current account credit facility agreements (revolving credit lines), checks the lawfulness of conditions changed unilaterally by the bank, and prepares the business customer's defence where the credit line is unilaterally reduced or cancelled, under the Civil Code, the RGICSF and the principles of contractual good faith.

BAN-049.titulo_en: Deposit Guarantee Fund — Calling on the Fund and Claiming Unavailable Deposits
BAN-049.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and formal letter to call on the Deposit Guarantee Fund (Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos, FGD) where bank deposits become unavailable, checking the scope of cover (up to €100,000 per depositor and per institution), claiming temporarily protected deposits above the limit and explaining the payment process, under Articles 166 et seq. of the RGICSF and Directive 2014/49/EU (DGS).

BAN-050.titulo_en: Bank Fees — Legality Review and Complaint
BAN-050.descricao_en: Analyses the fees charged by credit institutions on deposit accounts, credit and payment services, checking their compliance with Bank of Portugal rules (Notice 8/2009 et seq.), the RGICSF and the rules on prohibited fees, and prepares a formal complaint for the refund of unlawfully charged fees.

BAN-051.titulo_en: Syndicated Loan — Participation, Default and Disputes between Lenders
BAN-051.descricao_en: Analyses the legal structure of syndicated loan agreements and the rights and obligations of the agent bank and the participating banks, and prepares a dispute analysis where the borrower defaults or the participating lenders disagree, under the Portuguese Civil Code, the RGICSF and the principles of international banking law applicable in Portugal.

BAN-052.titulo_en: Complaint to the ASF — Insurance and Disputes with an Insurer (Formal Procedure)
BAN-052.descricao_en: Prepares a formal complaint to the Insurance and Pension Funds Supervisory Authority (Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões, ASF), covering life and non-life insurance, pension funds and insurance mediation, for breach of information duties, refusal of cover, failure to meet response deadlines or unfair commercial practices, under the LCS (Decree-Law 72/2008), the Regime for Access to and Exercise of Insurance Activity (Decree-Law 2/2009) and Decree-Law 176/95.

BAN-053.titulo_en: Corporate Loan Agreement — Covenant Review and Renegotiation
BAN-053.descricao_en: Reviews bank loan agreements for corporate financing, analyses the financial covenant clauses (DSCR, leverage, liquidity ratios), prepares a response to a notice of covenant breach and leads the renegotiation strategy (waiver or amendment), under the Portuguese Civil Code and the principles of banking law.

BAN-054.titulo_en: Securitisation of Receivables — Rights of the Assigned Debtor and Challenge
BAN-054.descricao_en: Analyses the legal position of a debtor whose debts have been securitised (sold to a securitisation fund), checks the validity of the assignment and the notice to the debtor, prepares a challenge to excessive collection by credit servicers and analyses the debtor's rights against the securitisation fund, under Decree-Law 453/99 (Legal Regime for the Securitisation of Receivables) and the Civil Code.

BAN-055.titulo_en: Professional Indemnity Insurance — Intermediaries and Financial Advisers
BAN-055.descricao_en: Analyses the compulsory professional indemnity insurance (RC Profissional) contracts of insurance intermediaries, asset managers, investment advisers and credit agents, checking whether cover, limits and exclusions are adequate, and prepares a claim notification or a challenge to a refusal, under Law 7/2019 (insurance distribution), Decree-Law 148/2006 (credit intermediaries) and the regulations of the ASF and the CMVM.

BAN-056.titulo_en: Mortgage — Extinction, Cancellation and Disputes after Repayment of the Loan
BAN-056.descricao_en: Sets out the legal procedure for extinguishing and cancelling the mortgage after the mortgage loan has been repaid, challenges the bank's refusal to issue the release (declaração de distrate), and analyses disputes over uncancelled mortgages that obstruct property transactions, under the Civil Code (Articles 686 et seq.), the Land Registry Code (Código do Registo Predial) and Decree-Law 74-A/2017.

BAN-057.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Corporate Debt Restructuring Agreement — Negotiation and Documentation
BAN-057.descricao_en: Prepares the structure and documentation of an out-of-court debt restructuring agreement between a company in difficulty and its bank creditors, including a standstill agreement, term sheet, subordination agreement and restructuring agreement, as an alternative to the court-based PER (Special Revitalisation Process — Processo Especial de Revitalização), under the Civil Code and the RGICSF.

BAN-058.titulo_en: Credit and Debit Cards — Refunds, Chargebacks and Issuer Liability
BAN-058.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and formal complaint for chargeback (estorno) requests on credit or debit card transactions for goods not delivered, services not provided, fraud or duplicate charges, and challenges the issuing bank's refusal to process the chargeback, under the RJSPME (Decree-Law 91/2018), the Visa/Mastercard schemes and the Bank of Portugal's dispute resolution rules.

BAN-059.titulo_en: Banks' Reporting and Information Obligations to the Bank of Portugal — Framework and Defence in Sanctioning Proceedings
BAN-059.descricao_en: Analyses credit institutions' reporting and information obligations to the Bank of Portugal (COREP, FINREP, STE, ILTIS, large exposure limits, money laundering), identifies failures and prepares a defence in supervisory or administrative offence (contraordenação) proceedings for non-compliance, under the RGICSF (Decree-Law 298/92) and the EBA Implementing Regulations.

BAN-060.titulo_en: Pre-Contractual Information Duties in Lending — Analysis and Complaint
BAN-060.descricao_en: Analyses compliance with pre-contractual information duties in bank lending (home, consumer and business credit), checks delivery of the standardised information sheets (FINE, FIN, FIP) and prepares a complaint for breach of information duties under Decree-Law 74-A/2017 (home loans), Decree-Law 133/2009 (consumer credit), the RGICSF and Bank of Portugal regulations (Instruction 15/2013 et seq.).

CIV-001.titulo_en: Contract for the Sale of Movable Property
CIV-001.descricao_en: Generates a contract for the sale of movable property (vehicle, equipment, furniture, goods or another specific movable item) with comprehensive clauses on identification of the parties, subject matter, price, method of payment, delivery, warranty and liability — in accordance with the Portuguese Civil Code (Código Civil, CC).

CIV-002.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive services agreement (contrato de prestação de serviços) between service provider and client, setting out the subject matter, term, price, payment terms, intellectual property in the deliverables, confidentiality, grounds for termination and competent jurisdiction — under Articles 1154 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-003.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive construction contract (contrato de empreitada) for building, refurbishment, installation or other specified works, with clauses on subject matter, term, lump-sum or measured price, liability for defects, supervision, termination and guarantees — under Articles 1207 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-004.descricao_en: Generates a loan agreement (mútuo — a loan of money or other fungible things) between private individuals, with clauses on the principal lent, repayment term, contractual and default interest, guarantees and the consequences of default — under Articles 1142 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-005.descricao_en: Generates a gift agreement for movable or immovable property, with identification of the parties, the gifted property, reversion clauses, reservation of usufruct (where applicable), express acceptance by the donee and warnings on the mandatory legal formalities — under Articles 940 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-006.descricao_en: Generates a gratuitous loan for use agreement (comodato) for movable or immovable property, with identification of the item lent, permitted purposes of use, return date, the borrower's obligations, liability for deterioration and conditions for early return — under Articles 1129 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-007.titulo_en: Mandate Agreement with Powers of Representation
CIV-007.descricao_en: Generates a mandate agreement with powers of representation (internal power of attorney) or a mandate instrument with defined powers to perform legal acts in the name and on behalf of the principal — under Articles 1157 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-008.descricao_en: Generates a promissory contract of sale for real estate or high-value property, with precise identification of the property, price and deposit (sinal), the deadline for executing the final contract, the consequences of breach (forfeiture of the deposit / return of double the deposit) and specific performance clauses — under Articles 410 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-009.titulo_en: Assignment of Claims Agreement (Cessão de Créditos)
CIV-009.descricao_en: Generates an assignment of claims agreement between assignor and assignee, with precise identification of the claim assigned, the price or gratuitous nature of the assignment, conditions of validity (notice to the assigned debtor), warranties and the assignor's liability — under Articles 577 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-010.descricao_en: Generates an agreement for the assignment of contractual position whereby a party (assignor) transfers its position in a contract to a third party (assignee), with the consent of the counterparty (assigned party) — under Articles 424 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-011.titulo_en: Acknowledgement of Debt and Payment Plan Agreement
CIV-011.descricao_en: Generates an acknowledgement of debt agreement (confissão de dívida) with an instalment payment plan, an acceleration clause in the event of default, default interest and, optionally, a personal guarantee (fiança) or promissory note (livrança) — constituting an enforceable title under Article 703 of the Portuguese Code of Civil Procedure (CPC).

CIV-012.titulo_en: Acknowledgement of Debt with Blank Promissory Note and Filling Agreement
CIV-012.descricao_en: Generates an acknowledgement of debt accompanied by a filling agreement (pacto de preenchimento) for a blank promissory note, setting the conditions and limits for its completion by the holder (creditor) — combining the enforceability of the promissory note as a negotiable instrument with the documentary security of the acknowledgement of debt, under the Uniform Law on Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes (LULL) and the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-013.titulo_en: Clause-by-Clause Review and Opinion on a Draft Contract Received
CIV-013.descricao_en: Analyses, clause by clause, a draft contract received from the counterparty, identifies unbalanced, unfair or unlawful clauses, flags risks for the client and suggests alternative wording for each problematic clause — grounded in the articles of the Portuguese Civil Code and, where applicable, the standard contract terms regime (Decree-Law No. 446/85).

CIV-014.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Notice to Perform an Obligation (Interpelação Admonitória)
CIV-014.descricao_en: Generates a formal notice to perform (interpelação admonitória) requiring the debtor to perform the obligation within a set time limit, with an express warning that failure to do so will lead to termination of the contract or legal proceedings — being the act that places the debtor in default and sets the deadline for termination (Articles 808 and 809 of the Portuguese Civil Code).

CIV-015.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of a Contract for Definitive Non-Performance
CIV-015.descricao_en: Generates a letter terminating a contract (resolução) for definitive non-performance by the counterparty, with a formal declaration of termination, identification of its consequences (restitution, damages, release from obligations) and a full reservation of rights — under Articles 801 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-016.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of a Continuing-Performance Contract (Denúncia)
CIV-016.descricao_en: Generates a letter terminating by notice (denúncia) a continuing-performance or open-ended contract (services, supply, distribution, retainer, lease), stating the notice period, termination date and consequences of termination — under Articles 1167(d) and 406 of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-017.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Non-Contractual (Tort) Liability
CIV-017.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of claim (petição inicial) in an action for non-contractual (Aquilian) civil liability, with a narrative of the facts, identification of the requirements (unlawful act, fault, damage, causal link), legal grounds and a claim for compensation for the pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage suffered — under Articles 483 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-018.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Performance of a Contractual Obligation
CIV-018.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim in a declaratory action seeking an order for performance of a contractual obligation — payment of a sum, delivery of a thing or performance of an act — with a narrative of the facts, legal grounds and the order sought, under Articles 817 et seq. of the Civil Code and Articles 552 et seq. of the Portuguese Code of Civil Procedure.

CIV-019.titulo_en: Calculation of Damages for Pecuniary and Non-Pecuniary Loss
CIV-019.descricao_en: Generates a detailed calculation statement (memória de cálculo) of the compensation claimed, distinguishing actual loss (dano emergente), loss of profit (lucro cessante) and non-pecuniary damage, with reasoned quantification and reference to the disability tables and the equitable criterion applied by the Portuguese courts — under Articles 562 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-020.titulo_en: Calculation of Default Interest (Civil and Commercial) with Calculation Statement
CIV-020.descricao_en: Generates a detailed calculation statement of the default interest due on monetary obligations, distinguishing the civil regime (statutory rate set by ministerial order — Portaria) from the commercial regime (Decree-Law No. 62/2013 — commercial transactions), with computation for each period of the applicable rate — under Articles 806 and 559 of the Civil Code and Decree-Law No. 62/2013.

CIV-021.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Annulment of a Legal Transaction for Defective Consent (Mistake, Fraud, Duress)
CIV-021.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim seeking annulment of a legal transaction on the ground of defective consent — mistake, fraud (dolo) or moral duress — with analysis of the legal requirements, a narrative of the facts giving rise to the defect, legal grounds and a claim for annulment with restitution of what was performed — under Articles 251 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-022.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for a Declaration of Nullity of a Contract
CIV-022.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim seeking a declaration that a contract is void for breach of a mandatory rule, unlawful subject matter, lack of the legally required form or another ground of nullity — with legal analysis, a narrative of the facts and a claim for a declaration of nullity and restitution of what was performed — under Articles 280 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-023.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Unjust Enrichment
CIV-023.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for unjust enrichment (condictio), demonstrating the defendant's enrichment, the corresponding impoverishment of the claimant, the absence of legal cause and the subsidiary nature of the remedy — under Articles 473 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-024.titulo_en: Penalty Clause and Liquidated Contractual Damages
CIV-024.descricao_en: Drafts penalty clauses for contracts — compensatory (replacing proof of loss) and coercive (encouraging performance through a per diem amount) — with analysis of the risk of judicial reduction on equitable grounds, based on Articles 810 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-025.titulo_en: Agreement to Terminate a Contract by Mutual Consent (Distrate)
CIV-025.descricao_en: Generates an agreement terminating a contract by mutual consent (revogação / distrate), extinguishing future obligations, setting the conditions for restitution of what was performed (in full or in part), settling outstanding amounts and providing for a mutual waiver of any rights arising from the terminated contract — under Article 406(1) of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-026.titulo_en: Litigation Power of Attorney and Power of Attorney with Special Powers
CIV-026.descricao_en: Generates a litigation power of attorney (procuração forense) for representation in court proceedings and/or a power of attorney with special powers to perform specific legal acts (sell, mortgage, settle, admit a claim, withdraw, receive) — under Articles 262 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code and Article 43 of the Code of Civil Procedure.

CIV-027.titulo_en: Discharge Statement / Payment Receipt with Release Effect
CIV-027.descricao_en: Generates a full discharge statement (quitação) or payment receipt with release effect, extinguishing an obligation in whole or in part and declaring the creditor satisfied as to the amount received — under Articles 769 and 770 of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-028.titulo_en: Opinion on Limitation and Expiry of a Right (with Computation of Time Limits)
CIV-028.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive legal opinion on the limitation (prescrição) or expiry (caducidade) of a right, with a detailed computation of the time limits, identification of grounds for suspension or interruption, and a recommendation on urgency — under Articles 296 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-029.titulo_en: Formal Notice to Accept or Reject a Contractual Offer
CIV-029.descricao_en: Generates a formal notice requiring the addressee to accept or reject a contractual offer within a set time limit, stating the consequences of silence and of rejection — under Articles 228 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-030.titulo_en: Agreement Creating a Surface Right (Direito de Superfície)
CIV-030.descricao_en: Generates an agreement creating a surface right whereby the landowner (fundeiro) grants the surface right holder (superficiário) the right to build or keep a structure or plantation on another's land, with the term, surface rent (cânone superficiário) and consequences of extinction — under Articles 1524 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-031.descricao_en: Generates an agreement creating a usufruct over immovable or movable property, with identification of the property, the usufructuary's powers, maintenance obligations, liability for charges and conditions of extinction (death, expiry of term or waiver) — under Articles 1439 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-032.titulo_en: Notice for the Exercise of a Preemption Right
CIV-032.descricao_en: Generates a notice to the holder of a preemption right (direito de preferência) to exercise or waive that right within the statutory time limit, stating the terms of the proposed transaction — under Articles 416 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

CIV-033.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Preemption Action (Ação de Preferência)
CIV-033.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim in a preemption action whereby the holder of a preemption right takes the place of the purchaser on the terms of a transaction concluded without prior notice to the holder — under Article 1410 of the Portuguese Civil Code and Article 1091 CC (tenant's preemption right).

CIV-034.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Recovery of Property (Ação de Reivindicação)
CIV-034.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim in an action for recovery of property, whereby the owner demands that a third party hand over the thing and recognise the owner's right — under Article 1311 of the Portuguese Civil Code. Includes grounds for the title of ownership, proof of the defendant's unlawful possession and claims for delivery and compensation for the fruits received.

CIV-035.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Boundary Demarcation
CIV-035.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action for demarcation of adjoining properties, whereby the owner asks the court to fix the limits and dividing line between two contiguous properties whose boundary is uncertain or disputed — under Articles 1353 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code and the special procedure in the Code of Civil Procedure.

CIV-036.titulo_en: Agreement Creating a Right of Way Easement
CIV-036.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the voluntary creation of a right of way easement (servidão de passagem) between owners of landlocked or partially landlocked properties, setting the route, width, hours of use, financial consideration and maintenance obligations — under Articles 1543 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code. Includes clauses on registration and possible extinction.

CIV-037.titulo_en: Due Diligence Checklist for a Disputed Contractual Relationship
CIV-037.descricao_en: Produces a structured legal due diligence checklist for analysing a contractual relationship already in dispute or about to become contentious — checking the validity and effectiveness of the contract, performance of obligations, limitation and expiry periods, the available evidence and the viability of the claims the lawyer intends to bring. Covers the Portuguese Civil Code and Code of Civil Procedure.

CIV-038.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Medical Liability (Private Sector)
CIV-038.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim against a doctor or private clinic for medical error, based on Articles 487, 798 and 799 of the Civil Code (CC) and on the distinction between an obligation of means and an obligation of result. Sets out adequate causation (Article 563 CC) and the recoverable pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage (Articles 564 and 496 CC).

CIV-039.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Notice for Protection of Personality and Image Rights
CIV-039.descricao_en: Drafts an out-of-court notice demanding that an infringement of personality rights cease, notably the right to one's image, name, privacy and good name, under Articles 70 to 81 of the Civil Code. Grounds the request for removal of content and compensation on Articles 70(2) and 496 CC, in conjunction with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR / RGPD) where applicable.

CIV-040.titulo_en: Landlord's Notice of Termination of a Residential Urban Lease (NRAU)
CIV-040.descricao_en: Drafts the landlord's formal notice of termination (denúncia) of a residential urban lease, under Articles 1097 and 1098 of the Civil Code and the New Urban Lease Regime (NRAU, Law No. 6/2006 of 27 February, as amended). Identifies the mandatory notice periods and the legal grounds for termination at will or for justified cause.

CIV-041.titulo_en: Opinion on Preemption Rights in the Sale of Real Estate (Co-Owner and Tenant)
CIV-041.descricao_en: Analyses and substantiates the statutory preemption right of the co-owner (Article 1409 CC) and of the tenant (Article 1091 CC) in a sale of real estate, including the chain of mandatory notices, the time limits for exercise and the consequences of non-compliance (preemption action). Also draws on the distinction between real preemption rights (enforceable against third parties) and contractual preemption rights.

CIV-042.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Acquisitive Prescription (Judicial Justification of Ownership)
CIV-042.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action based on acquisitive prescription (usucapião) for the original acquisition of ownership of real estate through public, peaceful possession, in good or bad faith, for the periods laid down in Articles 1294 to 1296 of the Civil Code. The action is brought in the district court (tribunal de comarca) where the property is located and seeks a judgment that will serve as the basis for definitive registration of the acquisition.

CIV-043.titulo_en: Agreement Creating an Easement of View and Analysis of Legal Limits
CIV-043.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the voluntary creation of an easement of view (servidão de vistas) between adjoining properties, under Articles 1360 to 1368 of the Civil Code, precisely identifying the minimum statutory distance restrictions (1.5 m for perpendicular windows and 0.6 m for oblique windows) and the possibility of creation by acquisitive prescription or by implied grant from a common owner (destinação do pai de família). Links with the Legal Regime for Urbanisation and Building (RJUE).

CIV-044.titulo_en: Co-Ownership Regulation Agreement and Claim for Division of Jointly Owned Property
CIV-044.descricao_en: Drafts an out-of-court agreement regulating the use of co-owned property (Article 1405 CC) and, alternatively, the statement of claim in an action for division of jointly owned property (Article 1412 CC), for cases where the co-owners cannot agree on its use or wish to end the state of undivided ownership. Based on Articles 1403 to 1413 of the Civil Code.

CIV-045.titulo_en: Opinion on the Validity and Effectiveness of a Suretyship Agreement (Clause Analysis and Guarantor's Liability)
CIV-045.descricao_en: Analyses the formal and substantive validity of a suretyship agreement (fiança) under Articles 627 to 655 of the Civil Code, including verification of the written form requirement, the accessory nature of the suretyship, the benefits of prior discussion (excussão prévia) and of division, and the extent of the guarantor's liability. Identifies any unfair clauses under Decree-Law No. 446/85 of 25 October.

CIV-046.titulo_en: Opinion on a Gift with a Reversion Clause and Implications for Collation in Succession
CIV-046.descricao_en: Analyses the validity of a gift with a reversion clause (Article 960 CC), the imputation of the gift to the disposable portion or to the forced-heirship share (quota legitimária) of the donee heir, and the rules on mandatory collation (Articles 2104 to 2118 CC). Warns of the limits on abatement of inofficious gifts where the gift exceeds the donor's disposable portion.

CIV-047.titulo_en: Suretyship Agreement for an Urban Lease with Guarantor Protection Clauses
CIV-047.descricao_en: Drafts a suretyship agreement securing the tenant's obligations, with balanced clauses protecting the guarantor under Articles 627 to 655 of the Civil Code and Law No. 6/2006 (NRAU). Includes a cap on liability at [N] years' rent, a right to terminate the guarantee, mandatory notice by the creditor in the event of default, and a clause automatically extinguishing the guarantee on expiry of the lease.

CIV-048.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Notice of Assignment of Claims to the Assigned Debtor (Art. 583 CC)
CIV-048.descricao_en: Drafts the notice of assignment of claims to the assigned debtor, meeting the requirement of Article 583 of the Civil Code for the assignment to be effective against the debtor and enforceable against third parties. Includes analysis of the effects of the notice (discharge of a debtor who pays the assignor before being notified) and of the assigned debtor's position (retention of defences — Article 585 CC).

CIV-049.titulo_en: Opinion on Unjust Enrichment — Requirements and Litigation Strategy
CIV-049.descricao_en: Analyses the requirements for an unjust enrichment action (Articles 473 to 482 CC): enrichment of the defendant, impoverishment of the claimant, a link between the two and the absence of justifying cause. Distinguishes unjust enrichment from civil liability and from undue payment (condictio indebiti), and assesses the viability of the action in light of the limitation period (Article 482 CC).

CIV-050.titulo_en: Analysis of Unfair Terms in a Standard-Form Contract (Decree-Law No. 446/85)
CIV-050.descricao_en: Systematically analyses the clauses of a standard-form contract (contrato de adesão) under Decree-Law No. 446/85 of 25 October (Standard Contract Terms Regime — RCCG), identifying absolutely prohibited clauses (Article 21) and relatively prohibited clauses (Article 22), and assessing compliance with the duty to communicate (Article 5) and to inform (Article 6). Proposes the removal or replacement of void clauses (Article 12 RCCG).

CIV-051.titulo_en: Private Construction Contract with Warranty and Acceptance Clauses
CIV-051.descricao_en: Drafts a construction contract (empreitada) for private works (a dwelling or small building) under Articles 1207 to 1230 of the Civil Code, with clauses on the completion period, method of payment, warranty against defects (Article 1218 CC), period for final acceptance, a penalty clause for delay, and the distinction between apparent and latent defects for the purposes of the time limits for claims (Articles 1220 to 1224 CC).

CIV-052.titulo_en: Real Estate Brokerage Agreement — Clause Review and Analysis for the Client (Principal or Owner)
CIV-052.descricao_en: Analyses the real estate brokerage agreement entered into with a brokerage firm under Law No. 15/2013 of 8 February (legal regime for real estate brokerage — RJAMI), identifying the rights of the selling owner or of the buyer, the conditions for payment of the commission, exclusivity and its duration, and the grounds for termination without payment of commission.

CIV-053.titulo_en: Civil Loan Agreement with Security (between Private Individuals) and Usury Analysis
CIV-053.descricao_en: Drafts a civil loan agreement between private individuals (Articles 1142 to 1151 CC), setting conventional interest within the statutory limits (Article 1146 CC), a personal (suretyship) or real (mortgage or pledge) security clause, and the method of repayment of the principal. Includes a usury analysis (Article 1146(2) CC) and a warning on the need for a public deed where the amount exceeds €25,000 (Article 1143 CC).
