CIV-054.titulo_en: Opinion on Civil Liability for a Road Traffic Accident — Personal Injury and Non-Pecuniary Damage
CIV-054.descricao_en: Analyses and quantifies the damage sustained in a road traffic accident, distinguishing pecuniary damage (actual loss, loss of profit, biological damage) from non-pecuniary damage (suffering, disfigurement, loss of quality of life), under Articles 483, 562 to 566 and 496 of the Civil Code, with reference to the compensation payable under compulsory motor third-party liability insurance (Decree-Law No. 291/2007 of 21 August).

CIV-055.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Agreement for the Division of Real Estate under the Horizontal Property Regime
CIV-055.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement establishing or amending the constitutive title of horizontal property (propriedade horizontal, i.e. condominium ownership) (Articles 1414 to 1438-A CC), identifying the autonomous units, common parts and participation coefficients. Includes analysis of the legal requirements and of the need for a public deed, land registration and municipal approval where required.

CIV-056.titulo_en: Opinion on the Horizontal Property Regime — Works in a Unit and Liability for Defects in Common Parts
CIV-056.descricao_en: Analyses the rights and duties of condominium owners regarding works in autonomous units (Article 1422 CC) and in the common parts (Article 1427 CC), the liability of the administrator and of the owners' meeting, and the remedies available to an owner harmed by leaks or structural defects originating in the common parts or in a neighbour's unit.

CIV-057.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Reduction of an Excessive Penalty Clause (Art. 812 CC)
CIV-057.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim or application for the equitable reduction of a manifestly excessive penalty clause under Article 812 of the Civil Code, analysing the equity criteria applied in case law (degree of fault, loss actually suffered, nature of the obligation) and the distinction between a coercive penalty clause (penalty for delay) and a compensatory one (replacing damages).

CIV-058.titulo_en: Legal Review Checklist for an Urban Lease — NRAU (Residential and Non-Residential)
CIV-058.descricao_en: Systematically analyses an urban lease under the NRAU (Law No. 6/2006 and Articles 1022 to 1120 of the Civil Code), checking mandatory and prohibited clauses, term and renewal, rent and rent updates, obligations of the parties, termination for cause, termination by notice and any unfair clauses under Decree-Law No. 446/85. Produces a report with a traffic-light rating (green/amber/red) for each clause.

CIV-059.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of a Lease for Non-Payment of Rent and Application to the BNA
CIV-059.descricao_en: Drafts the notice terminating an urban lease for non-payment of rent (Article 1083(3) CC) and prepares the initial application to the National Lease Office (Balcão Nacional do Arrendamento — BNA), under Decree-Law No. 1/2013 of 7 January. Calculates the rent arrears, the compensation due and default interest (Article 1041 CC).

CIV-060.titulo_en: Opinion on Liability for Defective Products (Decree-Law No. 383/89)
CIV-060.descricao_en: Analyses the producer's liability for damage caused by defective products under Decree-Law No. 383/89 of 6 November (transposing Directive 85/374/EEC), identifying the concept of defect (Article 4), the grounds for exclusion of liability (Article 5), the 3-year limitation period and the 10-year expiry period, and the interplay with the seller's contractual liability.

COM-001.titulo_en: Articles of Association of a Private Limited Company (Lda.)
COM-001.descricao_en: Generates complete articles of association (pacto social) for the incorporation of a private limited company (sociedade por quotas, Lda.), in accordance with the Commercial Companies Code (CSC), ready for registration at the Commercial Registry Office (Conservatória do Registo Comercial) or submission through the Empresa Online portal.

COM-002.titulo_en: Articles of Association of a Single-Member Private Limited Company
COM-002.descricao_en: Generates the articles of association (pacto social) of a single-member private limited company (sociedade unipessoal por quotas), in accordance with Articles 270-A to 270-G CSC, covering all the specific features of the regime — notably the formal requirements for transactions between the company and its sole member and the prohibition on incorporation by another single-member company.

COM-003.titulo_en: Articles of Association of a Public Limited Company (S.A.)
COM-003.descricao_en: Generates the complete articles of association (estatutos) of a Portuguese public limited company (sociedade anónima, S.A.), in accordance with Articles 271 to 464 CSC, including the governance structure (Board of Directors, Audit Board (Conselho Fiscal) or the German two-tier model), the share regime, transferability and general meetings.

COM-004.descricao_en: Drafts a shareholders' agreement (acordo parassocial) between quotaholders or shareholders, governing matters not covered by the public articles of association — notably pre-emption rights, tag-along/drag-along, lock-up, private governance, financing and dispute resolution mechanisms, in accordance with Article 17 CSC.

COM-005.titulo_en: Minutes of a General Meeting of Members
COM-005.descricao_en: Generates complete minutes of a general meeting of quotaholders (Lda.) or shareholders (S.A.), with opening, attendance, agenda, resolutions, grounds and closing, in accordance with Articles 246, 248 and 383 CSC and other applicable provisions.

COM-006.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice convening a general meeting of quotaholders (Lda.) or shareholders (S.A.), stating the date, time, venue, full agenda and legal references, in compliance with the mandatory notice periods under the CSC.

COM-007.titulo_en: Minutes of a Resolution on the Distribution of Profits
COM-007.descricao_en: Drafts the minutes of the general meeting resolving on the appropriation of the financial year's results, including the creation or increase of mandatory and optional reserves, the distribution of dividends or profits, and the carrying forward of retained earnings, in accordance with Articles 33, 217 and 294 CSC.

COM-008.titulo_en: Minutes of the Appointment and Removal of a Manager / Director
COM-008.descricao_en: Drafts the minutes of a general meeting resolving on the appointment of a new manager (gerente) or director (administrador) or the removal of the incumbent, with the full legal rationale, including the consequences of removal with and without just cause and the mandatory commercial registration requirements.

COM-009.descricao_en: Drafts the quota transfer agreement (cessão de quotas) for a private limited company (Lda.), identifying the transferor and transferee, the quota concerned, the price, conditions precedent or subsequent, the transferor's warranties and registration at the Commercial Registry Office, in accordance with Articles 228 to 235 CSC.

COM-010.descricao_en: Drafts a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) for the sale of shares in a public limited company (S.A.), with the seller's representations and warranties, price adjustment mechanisms, conditions precedent, indemnities and buyer-protection clauses, in accordance with the CSC and the Portuguese Civil Code.

COM-011.descricao_en: Drafts the resolution to increase share capital, the minutes of the general meeting and the necessary supporting documents (subscription forms, declaration of payment of contributions), in accordance with Articles 85 to 93 CSC (general rules), 201 and 202 (Lda.) and 456 et seq. (S.A.).

COM-012.descricao_en: Drafts the resolution and documentation for a reduction of share capital, covering the methods of offsetting losses, repayment to members and cancellation of holdings, with the creditor-protection safeguards required by the CSC.

COM-013.descricao_en: Drafts the shareholder loan agreement (suprimentos — loans from members to the company) or the supplementary contributions agreement (prestações suplementares — non-reimbursable contributions with no corresponding share capital), clarifying the statutory subordination of shareholder loan claims in the event of insolvency and the repayment conditions, in accordance with Articles 243 to 245-A CSC.

COM-014.titulo_en: Agreement for the Transfer of a Business Establishment (Trespasse)
COM-014.descricao_en: Drafts the agreement for the transfer of a business establishment (trespasse), including the identification of its constituent elements (goodwill (aviamento), clientele, tangible and intangible assets, contracts and liabilities to be assumed), the transferor's warranties and compliance with the statutory duties to notify employees and creditors, in accordance with the Commercial Code and the Labour Code.

COM-015.descricao_en: Drafts the commercial agency agreement between principal and agent, defining the territorial scope, products/services, commissions, exclusivity, duration and the goodwill indemnity (indemnização de clientela) owed to the agent on termination, in accordance with Decree-Law No. 178/86 (Agency Law) and Directive 86/653/EEC.

COM-016.descricao_en: Drafts an exclusive or selective distribution agreement between supplier/manufacturer and distributor, defining territory, products, minimum purchase obligations, resale conditions, the passive-export prohibition and compliance with EU competition law (Vertical Block Exemption Regulation — VBER, RECV in Portuguese).

COM-017.descricao_en: Drafts the franchise agreement between franchisor and franchisee, covering the licence of the business system (trade mark, know-how, training, support), initial fees and royalties, territorial exclusivity obligations, operating standards and termination conditions, in accordance with Portuguese law and the guidelines of the European Franchise Federation (EFF).

COM-018.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the continuous or periodic supply of goods or services, defining specifications, minimum volumes, prices, delivery terms, quality control, late-delivery penalties and liability for defects, in accordance with the Portuguese Civil Code and commercial law.

COM-019.descricao_en: Drafts the consortium agreement between two or more undertakings for the joint performance of a project or activity without creating a legal entity, defining leadership, the allocation of responsibilities and revenue, coordination and relations with third parties, in accordance with Decree-Law No. 231/81 (legal regime for consortia and subcontracts in joint undertakings).

COM-020.descricao_en: Drafts the profit-sharing association agreement (associação em participação) between the principal party (associante), who runs the business, and the participating party (associado), who contributes capital, governing participation in profits and/or losses, the associante's autonomy, the information owed to the associado and the termination conditions, in accordance with Articles 21 to 29 of the Portuguese Commercial Code.

COM-021.descricao_en: Drafts a joint venture (JV) agreement between two or more partners to set up a joint entity or for structured collaboration on a project, defining governance, each party's contribution, the sharing of results, conflict management and exit conditions.

COM-022.titulo_en: Letter of Intent (LOI) and Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)
COM-022.descricao_en: Drafts a letter of intent (carta de intenções) or memorandum of understanding (memorando de entendimento) setting out the essential terms of a transaction (M&A, JV, partnership) before the definitive agreement is negotiated, distinguishing binding from non-binding clauses.

COM-023.descricao_en: Drafts a one-way or mutual non-disclosure agreement (acordo de confidencialidade) protecting technical, commercial, financial and strategic information shared between the parties, with a precise definition of confidential information, confidentiality obligations, exceptions and the consequences of breach.

COM-024.titulo_en: Draft Terms of Merger (Projeto de Fusão)
COM-024.descricao_en: Drafts the draft terms of merger (projeto de fusão) of companies (by absorption or by formation of a new company), with all the mandatory elements of Article 98 CSC, including the share exchange ratio, the merger balance sheet and the procedural timetable.

COM-025.titulo_en: Draft Terms of Demerger (Projeto de Cisão)
COM-025.descricao_en: Drafts the draft terms of demerger (projeto de cisão) of a company (total or partial), documenting the separation of its assets into autonomous blocks and their transfer to new entities or existing companies, with the mandatory elements of Article 122 CSC and the creditor-protection procedure.

COM-026.titulo_en: Resolution on the Conversion of a Company (Transformação)
COM-026.descricao_en: Drafts the resolution converting a company's legal form (transformação; e.g. from Lda. to S.A. or vice versa), with the documents required for registration, in accordance with Articles 130 to 137 CSC.

COM-027.titulo_en: Resolution on the Dissolution and Liquidation of a Company
COM-027.descricao_en: Drafts the resolution for the voluntary dissolution of a company, the process of liquidating its assets and liabilities, and the documents required to register the closure and distribute the remaining assets among the members, in accordance with Articles 141 to 163 CSC.

COM-028.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive legal due diligence checklist for M&A transactions, covering corporate, contractual, employment, tax, real estate, litigation, intellectual property and environmental matters, distinguishing vendor due diligence (preparation by the seller) from buyer due diligence (review by the purchaser).

COM-029.descricao_en: Generates a complete, structured legal due diligence report, with a summary of findings by area, risk identification (red/amber/green), recommendations and the estimated impact on the price or on the warranties in the share purchase agreement (SPA).

COM-030.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Civil Liability of Managers and Directors
COM-030.descricao_en: Drafts a reasoned legal opinion on the civil liability of managers and directors of commercial companies — liability towards the company, towards the members and towards third-party creditors — under Articles 72 to 79 CSC.

COM-031.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Liability Action against Directors
COM-031.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim (petição inicial) for a civil liability action against managers or directors of commercial companies, based on Articles 72 to 79 CSC, seeking compensation for the damage caused to the company, the members or third-party creditors.

COM-032.titulo_en: Action to Annul a Company Resolution
COM-032.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for an action to annul, or to declare null and void, a resolution of the members or of the general meeting, on the grounds set out in Articles 55 to 62 CSC, including challenges for formal defects, breach of the law or of the articles of association, or abuse of majority.

COM-033.titulo_en: Action for the Judicial Removal of a Manager
COM-033.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for an action seeking the judicial removal of a manager (gerente) of a private limited company for just cause under Article 257 CSC, including identification of the facts constituting just cause and the request for removal by the court.

COM-034.titulo_en: Action for the Expulsion of a Member (Exclusão de Sócio)
COM-034.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for an action seeking the judicial expulsion of a member of a private limited company for just cause, under Articles 241 and 242 CSC, where the expulsion cannot be resolved by the members for lack of a majority or because the member to be expelled holds the majority quota.

COM-035.titulo_en: Action for the Withdrawal of a Member (Exoneração de Sócio)
COM-035.descricao_en: Generates a request to exercise a member's right of withdrawal (exoneração) from a private limited company, based on a legitimate ground for withdrawal under Article 240 CSC (amendment of the articles of association, change of corporate object, extension of the company's duration, among others), and a statement of claim where the company refuses to recognise the right.

COM-036.descricao_en: Drafts a co-venture agreement (contrato de empreendimento conjunto) or an investment agreement to finance a specific project, governing each party's contributions, the sharing of results, project governance and exit conditions, without necessarily creating a new company.

COM-037.titulo_en: Pre-emption Agreement and Tag-Along / Drag-Along Rights
COM-037.descricao_en: Drafts contractual clauses or a standalone document governing the pre-emption agreement (pacto de preferência) on the transfer of quotas or shares, the tag-along right (direito de acompanhamento) and the drag-along right (direito de arrasto), for inclusion in the articles of association (pacto social or estatutos) or in a shareholders' agreement.

COM-038.titulo_en: Minutes of Approval of the Annual Accounts
COM-038.descricao_en: Generates the minutes of the annual general meeting approving the accounts, including approval of the management report and the financial statements, the resolution on the appropriation of the year's results and the assessment of the conduct of the corporate bodies, in accordance with Articles 65 and 376 CSC.

COM-039.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on a Member's Conflict of Interest in a Resolution
COM-039.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on whether a member has a conflict of interest in a company resolution, the duty to abstain from voting, the consequences of a vote cast in conflict of interest and the voidability of the resolution, under Articles 251 and 384 CSC.

COM-040.titulo_en: Formation of an Individual Limited Liability Establishment (EIRL)
COM-040.descricao_en: Drafts the instrument of formation of an individual limited liability establishment (Estabelecimento Individual de Responsabilidade Limitada, EIRL), in accordance with Decree-Law No. 248/86 of 25 August, including the allocation of capital to the establishment, the business purpose and the elements subject to mandatory registration, with guidance on the alternative of a single-member private limited company (SUQ).

COM-041.titulo_en: Blank Promissory Note and Completion Agreement
COM-041.descricao_en: Drafts a blank promissory note (livrança em branco) and the corresponding completion agreement (pacto de preenchimento) to secure commercial obligations, under the Uniform Law on Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes (LULL, approved by Decree-Law No. 23721 of 29 March 1934) and the aval regime (Articles 30 to 32 LULL), with clauses defining the terms on which the creditor may complete the note and the rights of the guarantor (avalista).

COM-042.descricao_en: Prepares the beneficial ownership declaration and supports the mandatory registration in the Central Register of Beneficial Owners (RCBE), under Law No. 89/2017 of 21 August and Decree-Law No. 186/2019 of 13 December, which transpose Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5th Anti-Money Laundering Directive). It identifies the company's beneficial owners, checks the control thresholds (25% + 1 of the holdings or voting rights) and generates the supporting documentation.

COM-043.titulo_en: Pledge of Quotas and Pledge of Shares
COM-043.descricao_en: Creates a pledge over quotas in a private limited company or over shares in a public limited company, as security for an obligation of a third party or of the company itself, under Articles 222 to 225 CSC (pledge of quotas), Article 328 CSC (pledge of shares) and Articles 666 et seq. of the Civil Code (pledge). It includes registration at the Commercial Registry Office under the Commercial Registry Code (CRCom).

COM-044.titulo_en: Shareholders' Agreement for a Public Limited Company
COM-044.descricao_en: Drafts a shareholders' agreement for a public limited company (S.A.), governing the rights and obligations between shareholders beyond what is set out in the articles of association, under Article 17 CSC (shareholders' agreements — acordos parassociais) and Articles 271 et seq. CSC. It covers lock-up, tag-along, drag-along, come-along, pre-emption rights, anti-dilution, governance and deadlock resolution mechanisms.

COM-045.titulo_en: Managers' Liability for Tax and Social Security Debts
COM-045.descricao_en: Analyses and prepares the defence against, or the grounds for, the secondary (subsidiary) liability of managers and directors for the company's tax and social security contribution debts, under Article 24 of the General Tax Law (LGT) and Article 8 of the General Regime for Tax Offences (RGIT), in conjunction with the civil regime of Article 78 CSC and the case law of the Administrative and Tax Courts.

COM-046.titulo_en: Ancillary and Supplementary Contributions — Resolution and Agreement
COM-046.descricao_en: Prepares the company resolution and the agreement on ancillary contributions (prestações acessórias, Articles 209 to 212 CSC) or supplementary contributions (prestações suplementares, Articles 210 to 213 CSC) in a private limited company, distinguishing the two regimes, setting the conditions for calling, remunerating and repaying them, and linking them with the shareholder loan regime (suprimentos, Article 243 CSC) and the tax implications (treatment as equity or debt).

COM-047.descricao_en: Drafts a commercial concession agreement (exclusive distribution on the distributor's own account), governing the relationship between grantor and concessionaire under the Commercial Code (Articles 230 et seq. CCom) and Portuguese doctrine and case law on exclusive distribution, distinguishing it from the agency agreement (Decree-Law No. 178/86) and the franchise agreement, with clauses on territorial exclusivity, minimum purchases, brand image and compensation on termination.

COM-048.titulo_en: Notice to Exercise the Right of Pre-emption on a Quota Transfer
COM-048.descricao_en: Prepares the mandatory notice for the exercise of the right of pre-emption on a quota transfer (Article 228 CSC) and the reply (exercise or waiver), together with the resulting deed of transfer or judicial pre-emption action (Article 1410 CC applied by analogy), ensuring compliance with the formalities required for the transfer to be valid and its registration at the Commercial Registry Office.

COM-049.titulo_en: Resolution on Plural Management — Powers and Conflicts of Interest
COM-049.descricao_en: Governs the exercise of functions under a plural management arrangement (gerência plural), defining each manager's individual and joint powers under Articles 252 to 261 CSC, and prepares the declaration or resolution on the recusal/abstention of a manager with a conflict of interest (Article 254 CSC), including notice to interested parties and registration of the acts at the Commercial Registry Office.

COM-050.titulo_en: Capital Increase by Capitalisation of Reserves
COM-050.descricao_en: Prepares the resolution and documentation required to increase the share capital of a private or public limited company by capitalising free reserves, legal reserves (to the extent permitted by law) or retained earnings, under Articles 91 to 95 CSC (general regime for capital increases), Article 218 CSC (Lda.) and Article 456 CSC (S.A.), with no injection of new funds and with effects only on the equity accounts.

COM-051.descricao_en: Drafts a commercial mandate agreement with or without powers of representation, under Articles 1157 et seq. of the Civil Code (CC) and Articles 231 et seq. of the Commercial Code (CCom), distinguishing the civil mandate from the commercial mandate and from the agency agreement (Decree-Law No. 178/86), with clauses on the powers conferred, remuneration, rendering of accounts, the mandatary's liability and termination.

COM-052.titulo_en: Written Resolution without a Meeting (Written Vote)
COM-052.descricao_en: Prepares a written resolution of the members without the need for a physical meeting, under Article 247 CSC for private limited companies and Article 377 CSC for public limited companies, including the written proposal to be circulated to the quotaholders/shareholders, the votes to be returned and the minutes recording the result, checking the unanimity or majority requirements.

COM-053.titulo_en: Transfer of a Business — Procedure and Documentation
COM-053.descricao_en: Supports the transfer of a commercial establishment or business as a going concern, distinguishing the trespasse (voluntary transfer of the establishment — Article 1112 CC and Articles 115 et seq. RAU/NRAU) from the transfer of quotas/shares (transfer of ownership of the company), and prepares the due diligence documentation, the deed or agreement, and the mandatory notices to employees (Article 285 of the Labour Code, CT), creditors and the tax authorities.

COM-054.titulo_en: Corporate GDPR — Compliance for a Commercial Company
COM-054.descricao_en: Structures the GDPR (RGPD) compliance programme of a Portuguese commercial company under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Law No. 58/2019 of 8 August (the Portuguese implementing law) and the guidance of the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD), covering the record of processing activities (Article 30 GDPR), the lawful bases (Article 6 GDPR), contracts with processors (Article 28 GDPR) and specific corporate obligations (processing of data of customers, suppliers, employees and business partners).

COM-055.titulo_en: Commercial Agency Agreement — Termination and Goodwill Indemnity
COM-055.descricao_en: Prepares the notice of termination of the agency agreement and calculates the goodwill indemnity (indemnização de clientela) and the compensation for damage owed to the agent, under Decree-Law No. 178/86 of 3 July (agency agreement), with particular attention to Articles 28 (notice period), 33 (goodwill indemnity) and 34 (compensation for damage), and to Portuguese case law on the method for calculating the indemnity.

COM-056.titulo_en: Judicial Expulsion of a Member — Procedure and Statement of Claim
COM-056.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for the judicial expulsion of a member of a private limited company under Articles 241 and 242 CSC, setting out the conduct constituting just cause for expulsion and seeking the valuation of the quota and its repayment, with an analysis of the procedural requirements and of the time limit (caducidade) for exercising the right.

COM-057.titulo_en: Withdrawal of a Member — Grounds and Claim
COM-057.descricao_en: Prepares a member's request for withdrawal (exoneração) from a private limited company (compelled exit at the member's own request), under Article 240 CSC, identifying the legal grounds (change of corporate object, transfer of the registered office abroad, extension of the company's duration, conversion that worsens the member's position), calculating the redemption value of the quota and preparing the formal notice to the company.

COM-058.descricao_en: Drafts a standstill and commercial debt restructuring agreement between companies, under which the creditors undertake not to enforce their claims for a defined period so that a restructuring plan can be negotiated, under Articles 405 and 406 CC (freedom of contract) and in conjunction with the Out-of-Court Business Recovery Regime (RERE — Decree-Law No. 79/2017 of 30 June) and the Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER, Articles 17-A et seq. CIRE).

COM-059.titulo_en: Conversion of a Private Limited Company into a Public Limited Company
COM-059.descricao_en: Prepares the resolution, the conversion report and the full documentation for converting a private limited company (Lda.) into a public limited company (S.A.), under Articles 130 to 136 CSC (general conversion regime), Article 271 CSC (S.A. requirements) and the registration formalities at the Commercial Registry Office, including the issue of shares and the right of withdrawal of dissenting members.

COM-060.titulo_en: Profit-Sharing Association Agreement — Formation and Liquidation
COM-060.descricao_en: Drafts the profit-sharing association agreement (associação em participação) under Article 21 of the Commercial Code (CCom) and Articles 1 et seq. of Decree-Law No. 231/81 of 28 July, governing the participating party's (associado) share in the results of a commercial activity carried on by the principal party (associante), without creating a legal person, with clauses on management, information, distribution of results and liquidation of the association.

CON-001.titulo_en: Complaint to the Competition Authority about a Restrictive Practice
CON-001.descricao_en: Generates a formal submission/complaint addressed to the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) about a restrictive practice — cartel, price fixing, market sharing, boycott agreements or other conduct prohibited by Article 9 of Law No. 19/2012 and Article 101 TFEU — identifying the parties, describing the facts, setting out the legal characterisation and requesting the opening of an investigation.

CON-002.titulo_en: Response to a Request for Information from the Competition Authority
CON-002.descricao_en: Generates a formal, strategically calibrated response to a request for information issued by the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) under Article 18 of Law No. 19/2012, managing the risk of self-incrimination, carefully selecting the material to be disclosed and stating the grounds for any legally permissible refusals.

CON-003.titulo_en: Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings for Restrictive Practices
CON-003.descricao_en: Generates a defence submission (reply to the statement of objections (nota de ilicitude) or final submissions) in administrative offence proceedings brought by the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) for infringement of Article 9 of Law No. 19/2012 and/or Article 101 TFEU, with factual rebuttal, legal challenge and arguments for mitigating the fine.

CON-004.titulo_en: Request to Enter the Settlement Procedure (Transação)
CON-004.descricao_en: Generates a formal request to join the settlement procedure (transação) before the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC), with a calibrated acknowledgement of the infringement, a proposed reduction of the fine and conditions for the negotiated closure of the administrative offence proceedings.

CON-005.descricao_en: Generates a leniency application (clemência) addressed to the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) under the immunity or fine-reduction programme, setting out the essential elements of the infringement, the participants and the available evidence, for an undertaking seeking to be the first (full immunity) or a subsequent (reduction of the fine) party to cooperate.

CON-006.titulo_en: Prior Notification of a Concentration to the Competition Authority
CON-006.descricao_en: Generates the prior notification form for a concentration (merger, acquisition or creation of a joint venture) to the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC), under Articles 37 et seq. of Law No. 19/2012, identifying the parties, describing the transaction, analysing the affected markets and assessing the competitive impact.

CON-007.titulo_en: Analysis of Whether a Transaction Is Subject to Merger Control
CON-007.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether a merger, acquisition or creation of a joint venture is subject to mandatory prior notification, identifying the applicable thresholds (Law No. 19/2012 vs. Regulation (EC) No 139/2004), the concept of concentration and the suspensive effect.

CON-008.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Compatibility of an Agreement with Competition Law
CON-008.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether an agreement between undertakings (distribution contract, licence, partnership, consortium, cooperation agreement) is compatible with Portuguese and EU competition law, assessing the applicability of the prohibitions in Article 9 of Law 19/2012 and Article 101 TFEU and the exemptions available.

CON-009.titulo_en: Analysis of Non-Compete Clauses in a Commercial Contract
CON-009.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the validity and compliance of non-compete clauses in a commercial contract — sale of a business, distribution, franchising, agency or company agreement — under Portuguese and EU competition law, assessing the limits on duration, scope and proportionality.

CON-010.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Damages for Infringement of Competition Law (Private Enforcement)
CON-010.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for damages (private enforcement) for harm caused by an infringement of competition law — price cartel, abuse of a dominant position or restrictive practice — under Law No. 23/2018 (transposing Directive 2014/104/EU), claiming compensation for the overcharge or other harm suffered.

CON-011.descricao_en: Generates a model for calculating and quantifying the harm suffered as a result of an infringement of competition law (typically a price cartel or an abuse of a dominant position), selecting the appropriate economic methodology, identifying the data required and structuring the reasoning for an expert report or a quantification note in court proceedings.

CON-012.titulo_en: Appeal against a Competition Authority Decision to the Competition Court
CON-012.descricao_en: Generates an appeal against a final decision of the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) to the Competition, Regulation and Supervision Court (TCRS), under Articles 84 et seq. of Law No. 19/2012, on grounds of unlawfulness, procedural defects and error in legal characterisation, and challenging the fine.

CON-013.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Abuse of a Dominant Position (Specific Case)
CON-013.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether conduct by an undertaking in a dominant position constitutes a prohibited abuse under Article 11 of Law No. 19/2012 and/or Article 102 TFEU — refusal to supply, excessive pricing, predatory pricing, loyalty schemes, discrimination or margin squeeze — analysing both the dominant position and the conduct.

CON-014.titulo_en: Competition Compliance Programme for a Company
CON-014.descricao_en: Generates a competition compliance programme tailored to a company — with policies, procedures, training, whistleblowing mechanisms and monitoring — appropriate to its size, sector and competition risk profile, in line with the guidance of the Portuguese Competition Authority and the European Commission.

CON-015.titulo_en: Good Practice Manual for Contacts with Competitors
CON-015.descricao_en: Generates a practical code-of-conduct manual for a company's employees and managers on contacts with competitors — meetings, trade fairs, business associations, social media and informal conversations — with concrete examples of prohibited and permitted behaviour.

CON-016.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Distribution Agreements and Vertical Restraints
CON-016.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether a distribution agreement — exclusive, selective or franchise — complies with competition law, analysing vertical restraints under Regulation (EU) 2022/720 (VBER) and the European Commission's Guidelines on vertical restraints.

CON-017.titulo_en: State Aid Analysis and Duty to Notify the European Commission
CON-017.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether a public support measure (subsidy, guarantee, loan on favourable terms, tax benefit, free land or other) constitutes State aid within the meaning of Article 107 TFEU, analysing the exemptions available and the obligation of prior notification to the European Commission.

CON-018.titulo_en: Complaint to the European Commission about Unlawful State Aid
CON-018.descricao_en: Generates a formal complaint to the European Commission about the grant of unlawful State aid (not notified, or granted in breach of a Commission decision), under Article 24 of Regulation (EU) 2015/1589, identifying the measure, setting out its legal characterisation and requesting the opening of a formal investigation.

CON-019.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Individual Restrictive Trading Practices (Resale Prices, Refusal to Sell)
CON-019.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on individual restrictive trading practices under Decree-Law No. 370/93 (legal regime for individual restrictive trading practices) and competition law — imposition of resale prices, refusal to sell, tied selling and abusive practices by one trader towards another.

CON-020.titulo_en: Response to a Competition Authority Inspection (Dawn Raid)
CON-020.descricao_en: Generates a protocol for responding to a surprise inspection (dawn raid) carried out by the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC) or the European Commission, with procedures for the day of the inspection, handling of the inspectors, protection of lawyer-client privilege and post-inspection record-keeping.

CON-021.titulo_en: Competition Compliance Checklist for a Business Association
CON-021.descricao_en: Generates a structured competition compliance checklist for business associations and their member companies, covering articles of association, decision-making processes, data collection, communications and meetings, based on Law No. 19/2012 and the European Commission's guidance on trade organisations and professional associations.

CON-022.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Joint Purchasing and Horizontal Cooperation Agreements
CON-022.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the compatibility with Portuguese and EU competition law of horizontal cooperation agreements between competing undertakings — joint purchasing, joint production agreements, infrastructure sharing, joint R&D and standardisation agreements — under the European Commission's Guidelines on horizontal cooperation agreements.

CON-023.descricao_en: Prepares the formal application for immunity under the leniency programme of the Portuguese Competition Authority (AdC), pursuant to Articles 75 to 84 of Law No. 19/2012 of 8 May (NRJC), seeking full immunity for the first applicant that discloses an unknown cartel or provides sufficient evidence for a search.

CON-024.titulo_en: Leniency Application — Reduction of the Fine (Second/Third Applicant)
CON-024.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a reduction of the fine under the AdC leniency programme for undertakings that are not the first to apply for immunity, pursuant to Articles 76 to 84 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), assessing the added value of the available evidence in order to obtain the maximum applicable reduction.

CON-025.titulo_en: Legal Assistance during an AdC Search and Seizure (Dawn Raid)
CON-025.descricao_en: Guides the lawyer and the company during an unannounced inspection (search and seizure) by the Portuguese Competition Authority, under Articles 18 to 20 and 55 to 60 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), ensuring the exercise of the rights of defence without unlawfully obstructing the inspection.

CON-026.descricao_en: Prepares the prior notification of a concentration to the Portuguese Competition Authority using the simplified form, under Article 38 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and the AdC Regulation on the Notification of Concentrations, for transactions that raise no evident competition concerns.

CON-027.titulo_en: Gun Jumping — Legal Opinion and Preventive Measures
CON-027.descricao_en: Assesses the risk of gun jumping in an ongoing concentration, identifying the conduct that amounts to prohibited early implementation before AdC clearance, under Article 36(2) and Article 67 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), and proposes separation (hold-separate) measures for the standstill period.

CON-028.titulo_en: Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings for Abuse of a Dominant Position
CON-028.descricao_en: Structures a company's defence in administrative offence proceedings brought by the AdC for abuse of a dominant position, under Articles 11 and 69 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 102 TFEU, contesting the definition of the relevant market, the dominant position and/or the abusive nature of the conduct.

CON-029.titulo_en: Complaint about Abuse of a Dominant Position (Injured Party's Perspective)
CON-029.descricao_en: Prepares a formal complaint or report to the AdC about abusive practices by an undertaking in a dominant position, under Articles 11 and 27 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 102 TFEU, setting out the factual and legal grounds needed to trigger an investigation or the opening of administrative offence proceedings.

CON-030.titulo_en: Vertical Agreements — Legal Opinion on Selective and Exclusive Distribution (VBER)
CON-030.descricao_en: Assesses the compatibility of a selective or exclusive distribution agreement with European and Portuguese competition law, under Regulation (EU) 2022/720 (VBER — Vertical Block Exemption Regulation), the European Commission's Guidelines on Vertical Restraints and Articles 9 and 10 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), identifying hardcore restrictions and the conditions for exemption.

CON-031.titulo_en: Resale Price Maintenance (RPM) — Assessment and Defence
CON-031.descricao_en: Assesses the legal risk of resale price-fixing clauses in a distribution contract and structures the defence or the redrafting of the clauses, under Article 4(a) of Regulation (EU) 2022/720 (VBER), Articles 9 and 10 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 101 TFEU.

CON-032.titulo_en: Access to the AdC File and Protection of Confidential Information
CON-032.descricao_en: Handles requests for access to the Portuguese Competition Authority's file by the accused party (arguido) and by third parties, and ensures the protection of the company's confidential information in administrative offence proceedings, under Articles 32 to 34 and 85 to 87 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-033.titulo_en: Damages Action for a Competition Infringement — Follow-on (Private Enforcement)
CON-033.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim for damages for harm caused by an infringement of competition law (cartel or abuse of a dominant position), as a follow-on action (after a final decision of the AdC or the Commission), under Law No. 23/2018 of 5 June (transposing Directive 2014/104/EU), Article 483 of the Civil Code and Articles 101/102 TFEU.

CON-034.titulo_en: Passing-On Defence — Raising It and Responding
CON-034.descricao_en: Structures the raising of the defence that the overcharge was passed on (passing-on defence) by the defendant infringer, or the claimant's response to it, under Articles 14 and 15 of Law No. 23/2018 of 5 June, in actions for damages for infringement of competition law.

CON-035.descricao_en: Prepares the request to open settlement (transação) and the settlement proposal with the Portuguese Competition Authority in administrative offence proceedings, under Articles 22 to 30 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), with a view to obtaining a fine reduction of up to 10% in exchange for acknowledging the infringement and simplifying the proceedings.

CON-036.titulo_en: Commitments in Merger or Abuse Proceedings
CON-036.descricao_en: Prepares a proposal for commitments designed to remove the competition concerns identified by the AdC in merger control or abuse of dominance proceedings, under Articles 50 to 54 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Regulation (EC) No 139/2004, as an alternative to prohibition of the transaction or a fine.

CON-037.titulo_en: Distribution in the Motor Vehicle Sector — Analysis under Regulation 461/2010
CON-037.descricao_en: Analyses motor vehicle distribution and after-sales contracts under Commission Regulation (EU) No 461/2010 and the supplementary guidelines, identifying problematic clauses and ensuring compliance with the sector-specific regime for motor vehicles.

CON-038.titulo_en: Digital Platforms and Compliance with the Digital Markets Act (DMA)
CON-038.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations applicable to digital platform operators under Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (Digital Markets Act — DMA) and assesses the impact of gatekeeper status on business practices in Portugal, including the interaction with Article 102 TFEU and national competition law.

CON-039.titulo_en: No-Poach Agreements and Exchange of Sensitive HR Information
CON-039.descricao_en: Analyses the lawfulness of agreements not to hire each other's employees (no-poach agreements) and of exchanges of information on salaries and working conditions between competing undertakings, under Articles 9 and 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 101 TFEU, in light of emerging European guidance on labour-market agreements and competition.

CON-040.descricao_en: Prepares a competition compliance manual specifically for business associations and their meetings, under Articles 9 and 10 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 101 TFEU, identifying the most common prohibited practices in the association context and the procedures to prevent them.

CON-041.descricao_en: Assesses the compatibility of a joint venture with competition law, distinguishing between full-function joint ventures (subject to merger control) and cooperative joint ventures (analysed as horizontal agreements under Article 9 of Law No. 19/2012 and Article 101 TFEU), and identifies the clauses that require notification or individual exemption.

CON-042.titulo_en: Bid Rigging in Public Contracts — Prevention and Defence
CON-042.descricao_en: Prepares a protocol to prevent the manipulation of public tenders (bid rigging) in consortia and subcontracting, and structures the defence where a company is investigated for participating in collusive practices in public procurement procedures, under Articles 9 and 68 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 101 TFEU.

CON-043.titulo_en: Implementing a Competition Compliance Programme — Practical Guide
CON-043.descricao_en: Prepares a complete internal competition compliance programme for a company, including a competition policy, training, whistleblowing channels and incident response, based on European best practice and AdC guidance, supplementing Articles 9 to 12 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-044.titulo_en: Subcontracting in Public Procurement — Competition Compliance
CON-044.descricao_en: Analyses the competition compliance of subcontracting arrangements in public procurement procedures, distinguishing lawful subcontracting from subcontracting used as a bid-rigging mechanism, under Articles 9 and 68 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), the Public Contracts Code (CCP) and the OECD guidelines on bid rigging.

CON-045.titulo_en: Analysis of Whether a Transaction Is Subject to Merger Control — Legal Opinion
CON-045.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on whether an acquisition, merger or creation of a joint venture is subject to prior notification to the AdC and/or the European Commission, assessing the thresholds in Article 37 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Regulation (EC) No 139/2004, and identifying the European one-stop-shop regime.

CON-046.titulo_en: Appeal against an AdC Decision to the Competition Court (TCRS)
CON-046.descricao_en: Prepares the appeal against a decision in administrative offence proceedings or a merger decision of the Portuguese Competition Authority to the Competition, Regulation and Supervision Court (Santarém), under Articles 84 et seq. of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Law No. 46/2011 (Law on the Organisation and Functioning of the Courts with Extended Territorial Jurisdiction).

CON-047.titulo_en: Information Exchange between Competitors — Risk Assessment
CON-047.descricao_en: Assesses whether an exchange of information between competitors constitutes a prohibited concerted practice under Article 9 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 101 TFEU, applying the criteria of the European Commission's Horizontal Guidelines (2023) on the sensitivity, individualisation and frequency of the information exchanged.

CON-048.titulo_en: State Aid Analysis and Notification to the European Commission
CON-048.descricao_en: Assesses whether a public measure (subsidy, tax exemption, guarantee, capital injection, preferential access to infrastructure) constitutes State aid within the meaning of Article 107 TFEU, and determines whether prior notification to the European Commission is required or whether an exemption applies, under Regulation (EU) No 651/2014 (General Block Exemption Regulation — GBER/RGIC) and the de minimis rules.

CON-049.titulo_en: Response to an AdC Request for Information (Investigation Stage)
CON-049.descricao_en: Prepares the response to a request for information from the Portuguese Competition Authority in an investigation or administrative offence proceedings, ensuring that the company meets its legal duty to respond (Article 17 NRJC) without providing self-incriminating information beyond what is required, and exercising the applicable rights of defence.

CON-050.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Platform Practices and Self-Preferencing
CON-050.descricao_en: Assesses the lawfulness of self-preferencing (autoprivilégio) by platforms in a dominant position, under Article 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC), Article 102 TFEU and Article 5 of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (DMA), in light of the case law of the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) in Google Shopping and the European Commission's guidance.

CON-051.titulo_en: Formal Complaint to the European Commission about Non-Notified State Aid
CON-051.descricao_en: Prepares the formal complaint to the European Commission about the grant of unlawful State aid to a competitor, under Article 108(3) TFEU and Regulation (EU) 2015/1589 (procedural rules on State aid), including reasoning on the four criteria of Article 107 TFEU and a request for interim measures.

CON-052.titulo_en: Analysis of Horizontal Cooperation Agreements (R&D and Production)
CON-052.descricao_en: Assesses the compatibility of horizontal cooperation agreements (research and development, joint production, joint purchasing) with competition law under the European Commission's Horizontal Guidelines (2023), Block Exemption Regulations (EU) No 1217/2010 and 1218/2010 and Articles 9 and 10 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-053.titulo_en: Analysis of Ancillary Restraints in M&A Contracts
CON-053.descricao_en: Assesses non-compete, non-solicitation of customers and confidentiality clauses in contracts for the sale and purchase of businesses, determining which are 'directly related and necessary' to the transaction and therefore automatically covered by the merger clearance, under the European Commission's Guidelines on Ancillary Restraints and Article 9 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-054.titulo_en: Competition Compliance Checklist for M&A Due Diligence
CON-054.descricao_en: Carries out the competition compliance review in due diligence for the acquisition of a company, identifying competition law liabilities (ongoing investigations, past cartels, abusive practices, unlawful agreements, exposure to private enforcement) and assessing their impact on the price and terms of the deal.

CON-055.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Pricing and Parity (MFN) Practices on Platforms
CON-055.descricao_en: Assesses the lawfulness of price parity clauses (Most Favoured Nation — MFN) in contracts between online intermediation platforms and suppliers, under Article 5(3) of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (DMA), Article 4(d) of Regulation (EU) 2022/720 (VBER 2022) and Articles 9 and 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-056.titulo_en: Use of a Third-Party Funder in a Private Enforcement Action
CON-056.descricao_en: Structures the assessment of a competition private enforcement case for third-party funding (litigation finance / third party funding), analysing the eligibility criteria, the structure of the funding agreement and the relevant compliance issues under Law No. 23/2018 and emerging European regulation.

CON-057.titulo_en: Predatory Pricing Practices — Analysis and Defence
CON-057.descricao_en: Assesses whether a below-cost pricing policy constitutes a prohibited predatory practice under Article 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) and Article 102 TFEU, applying the AKZO test (prices below average variable cost vs. average total cost) and the CJEU judgments on predatory pricing.

CON-058.titulo_en: Letter Demanding Cessation of Anti-Competitive Conduct (Cease and Desist)
CON-058.descricao_en: Prepares an out-of-court notice addressed to an undertaking engaged in anti-competitive conduct (cartel, abuse of a dominant position, prohibited clause), demanding that it cease immediately and reserving the right to complain to the AdC and to bring an action for damages under Law No. 23/2018 of 5 June and Articles 9 and 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-059.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Vertical Integration and Risk of Market Foreclosure
CON-059.descricao_en: Assesses the competition risk of vertical integration (acquisition of a supplier, distributor or customer) in terms of downstream or upstream market foreclosure, under the European Commission's Non-Horizontal Merger Guidelines (2008) and Article 11 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC).

CON-060.titulo_en: Analysis of Market Practices and Economic Dependence
CON-060.descricao_en: Assesses whether a commercial practice of an undertaking with significant bargaining power amounts to exploitation of economic dependence and a restriction of trade under Article 12 of Law No. 19/2012 (NRJC) — individual restrictive trading practices — and the rules on economic dependence in B2B relationships in Portugal.

FAM-001.titulo_en: Application for Divorce by Mutual Consent (Civil Registry Office)
FAM-001.descricao_en: Generates the complete application for divorce by mutual consent to be filed with the Civil Registry Office (Conservatória do Registo Civil), including the mandatory agreements on parental responsibilities (responsabilidades parentais), maintenance and the allocation of the family home (casa de morada de família), under Articles 1775 to 1780 of the Civil Code.

FAM-002.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Divorce Action without the Other Spouse's Consent
FAM-002.descricao_en: Generates the complete statement of claim in a divorce action without consent, grounded on Articles 1781 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code, identifying the cause of action (irretrievable breakdown of the marriage), ancillary claims and the evidence to be relied on.

FAM-003.titulo_en: Agreement on the Exercise of Parental Responsibilities
FAM-003.descricao_en: Generates the complete agreement on the exercise of parental responsibilities for court approval (homologação) or approval by the Public Prosecutor's Office (Ministério Público), including clauses on habitual residence, contact arrangements, maintenance, health, education and passport, under the RGPTC (General Regime of Civil Guardianship Proceedings) and the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-004.titulo_en: Agreement on the Allocation of the Family Home
FAM-004.descricao_en: Generates the agreement on the allocation of the family home (casa de morada de família) in the context of divorce, covering allocation to one spouse, sale and division of the proceeds, or continued co-ownership, under Articles 1793 and 1793-A of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-005.descricao_en: Generates the agreement setting maintenance between spouses in the context of divorce, analysing the need/means balance (binómio necessidade/possibilidade), the conditions for termination and review, and the distinction between maintenance and a compensatory allowance, under Articles 2003 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-006.titulo_en: Application for the Regulation of Parental Responsibilities
FAM-006.descricao_en: Generates the initial application in proceedings to regulate parental responsibilities (for parents who never married or did not settle the arrangements on divorce), with a detailed proposal on residence, contact and maintenance, under the RGPTC and the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-007.titulo_en: Application to Vary the Regulation of Parental Responsibilities
FAM-007.descricao_en: Generates the application to vary an agreement or court decision on parental responsibilities, showing a subsequent change of circumstances that justifies the variation, under Article 41 of the RGPTC and the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-008.titulo_en: Application for Non-Compliance with the Regulation of Parental Responsibilities
FAM-008.descricao_en: Generates the non-compliance application (incumprimento) where one parent fails to comply with the agreement or court decision on parental responsibilities (refusal of contact, non-payment of maintenance, obstruction of contact), seeking a fine, compensation and coercive measures, under Article 41 of the RGPTC.

FAM-009.titulo_en: Calculation and Updating of Maintenance for a Minor Child
FAM-009.descricao_en: Calculates and justifies the appropriate amount of maintenance for a minor child, based on Ministerial Order (Portaria) No. 278/2013 (indicative tables), the need/means balance and the child's actual expenses, and generates the supporting text for use in a claim, agreement or application for updating.

FAM-010.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Maintenance of an Adult Child
FAM-010.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a maintenance action brought by the adult child (or on the child's behalf while still a minor) against the liable parent, on the ground of continuing academic or vocational education, under Articles 1880 and 2003 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-011.titulo_en: Application to the Guarantee Fund for Maintenance Owed to Minors (FGADM)
FAM-011.descricao_en: Generates the application for intervention by the Guarantee Fund for Maintenance Owed to Minors (Fundo de Garantia de Alimentos Devidos a Menores, FGADM) where the liable parent does not pay the maintenance set by the court and there are no viable means of enforcement, under Law No. 75/98 of 19 November.

FAM-012.titulo_en: Prenuptial Agreement (Choice of Matrimonial Property Regime)
FAM-012.descricao_en: Generates the draft prenuptial agreement (convenção antenupcial) choosing the matrimonial property regime (separation of property, general community of property or community of acquired property with special clauses), analysing the property effects of each regime, under Articles 1698 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-013.titulo_en: Cohabitation Contract / De Facto Union Agreement
FAM-013.descricao_en: Generates the cohabitation contract between partners in a de facto union (união de facto), regulating the property aspects of life together (contribution to expenses, jointly acquired assets, family home, arrangements on dissolution), under Law No. 7/2001 of 11 May (De Facto Union Law).

FAM-014.titulo_en: Declaration and Proof of a De Facto Union
FAM-014.descricao_en: Generates the documents needed to prove and declare the existence of a de facto union — an application to the parish council (Junta de Freguesia) for a certificate, and a personal declaration for legal purposes (insurance, unemployment benefit, inheritance, social housing), under Law No. 7/2001 of 11 May.

FAM-015.titulo_en: Application for Allocation of the Family Home
FAM-015.descricao_en: Generates the application for the court to allocate use of the family home to the spouse or de facto partner who wishes to remain in the property after divorce or dissolution, on the grounds of the best interests of the minor children or that person's housing needs, under Articles 1793 and 1793-A of the Civil Code.

FAM-016.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Paternity Action
FAM-016.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a paternity action (investigação de paternidade) to establish the legal parent-child relationship, with a request for DNA testing and interim maintenance, under Articles 1869 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-017.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Action to Contest Paternity
FAM-017.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to contest paternity (impugnação de paternidade) to rebut the husband's presumption of paternity (pater is est) or a voluntary acknowledgement previously made, with a request for DNA testing, under Articles 1838 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-018.titulo_en: Application for Inventory Proceedings to Divide Property on Divorce
FAM-018.descricao_en: Generates the application to open inventory proceedings (inventário) to divide the couple's property after divorce (where there is no out-of-court agreement), identifying the assets to be divided and each spouse's rights, under Articles 1688 et seq. of the Civil Code and the procedural rules on inventory proceedings.

FAM-019.titulo_en: List of Assets in Proceedings to Divide the Couple's Property
FAM-019.descricao_en: Generates a complete and technically correct list of assets (relação de bens) for inventory proceedings following divorce, distinguishing assets and liabilities, common and separate property, and calculating each spouse's half share (meação), under Articles 1689 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-020.titulo_en: Application for the Court to Supply Consent
FAM-020.descricao_en: Generates the application for the court to supply the consent (suprimento judicial do consentimento) of the other spouse or parent for acts disposing of common property, acts concerning the children, or acts of administration that require joint authorisation, under Article 1684 of the Portuguese Civil Code.

FAM-021.titulo_en: Report to the Commission for the Protection of Children and Young People (CPCJ)
FAM-021.descricao_en: Generates the formal report to the Commission for the Protection of Children and Young People (Comissão de Proteção de Crianças e Jovens, CPCJ) flagging a situation of danger or risk to a minor, under the Law on the Protection of Children and Young People in Danger (Law No. 147/99 of 1 September, as amended by Law No. 142/2015).

FAM-022.titulo_en: Application in Promotion and Protection Proceedings
FAM-022.descricao_en: Generates the initial or interlocutory application in promotion and protection proceedings (processo de promoção e proteção) concerning a minor, requesting appropriate promotion and protection measures, under the Law on the Protection of Children and Young People in Danger (Law No. 147/99 of 1 September, as amended by Law No. 142/2015).

FAM-023.titulo_en: Closing Submissions in Child Promotion and Protection Proceedings
FAM-023.descricao_en: Generates the closing submissions (alegações) in court promotion and protection proceedings concerning a minor, analysing the evidence produced, arguing for the appropriate measure and making a reasoned request, under Law No. 147/99 of 1 September.

FAM-024.descricao_en: Generates the initial application in full or restricted adoption proceedings, demonstrating the legal requirements and the best interests of the child, under Articles 1978 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code and the Legal Regime of the Adoption Process (Law No. 143/2015 of 8 September).

FAM-025.descricao_en: Generates the application to establish a civil sponsorship (apadrinhamento civil) relationship, identifying the sponsors, the sponsored child and the rights and duties established, under Law No. 103/2009 of 11 September (Civil Sponsorship Law).

FAM-026.titulo_en: Application for Support of an Adult (Supported Adult Regime)
FAM-026.descricao_en: Generates the initial application in proceedings for support of an adult (acompanhamento de maior), under Articles 138 et seq. of the Portuguese Civil Code (as worded by Law No. 49/2018 of 14 August), identifying the appropriate support measures and the proposed supporter (acompanhante).

FAM-027.titulo_en: Application to Establish Grandparents' Contact Arrangements
FAM-027.descricao_en: Generates the application for the court to establish grandparents' right of contact with their grandchildren where the parents prevent or hinder such contact, under Article 1887-A of the Portuguese Civil Code, demonstrating the best interests of the child.

FAM-028.descricao_en: Generates the agreement resulting from family mediation (or the draft agreement to be submitted to mediation) to settle parental responsibilities, maintenance and the allocation of the family home amicably, with a view to court approval or approval by the Public Prosecutor's Office, under Law No. 29/2013 of 19 April (Mediation Law).

FAM-029.titulo_en: Application concerning Use of the Spouse's Surname
FAM-029.descricao_en: Generates the application to keep or adopt the spouse's surname after divorce, under Article 1677-B of the Portuguese Civil Code, or the former spouse's application opposing use of the surname, under Article 1677-C of the Civil Code, depending on the party represented.

FAM-030.titulo_en: Application for Authorisation for a Minor to Travel Abroad
FAM-030.descricao_en: Generates the application for court authorisation for a minor to travel abroad where one parent does not consent or cannot be contacted, under Article 1906 of the Civil Code and the General Regime of Civil Guardianship Proceedings (RGPTC), as well as the parent's declaration of consent where an amicable route is possible.

FAM-031.titulo_en: Application for Deprivation of Parental Responsibilities (Inibição)
FAM-031.descricao_en: Generates the initial application in proceedings to restrict the exercise of parental responsibilities (inibição), under Article 1915 of the Civil Code and the RGPTC, where a parent engages in serious conduct that endangers the minor child's safety, health, moral development or education.

FAM-032.titulo_en: Calculation of the Division of the Couple's Common Property (Meação)
FAM-032.descricao_en: Generates a detailed calculation of the couple's half shares (meação) after divorce or dissolution of a de facto union, identifying the common property and each spouse's separate property, determining the assets and liabilities of the community, calculating the equalisation payments (tornas) due and structuring the list of assets for inventory proceedings or a deed of division, under the Civil Code and the Code of Civil Procedure.

FAM-033.titulo_en: Opinion on the Applicable Matrimonial Property Regime and its Effects
FAM-033.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned legal opinion on the matrimonial property regime applicable to the case — community of acquired property (default regime), general community of property or separation of property —, explaining the property effects of the regime chosen or imposed by law, the implications on divorce or death and the advantages and risks for each spouse.

FAM-034.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Notice Letter on Non-Payment of Maintenance
FAM-034.descricao_en: Generates an out-of-court notice letter to the parent in arrears with maintenance, requiring payment of the amounts owed and warning of the legal consequences of non-payment — including enforcement of maintenance, an application to the Guarantee Fund for Maintenance Owed to Minors (FGADM) and criminal liability for the offence of breach of the maintenance obligation — under the Portuguese Civil Code and Criminal Code.

FAM-035.titulo_en: Variation of Parental Responsibilities — Reasoned Application (RGPTC)
FAM-035.descricao_en: Drafts the initial application in proceedings to vary the exercise of parental responsibilities under Art. 182 of the OTM (as worded by Law No. 141/2015 — RGPTC) and Arts. 1906 and 1907 of the Civil Code (CC), invoking a subsequent change of circumstances that justifies modifying the approved or court-ordered arrangements.

FAM-036.titulo_en: International Parental Child Abduction — Return Application under the 1980 Hague Convention
FAM-036.descricao_en: Prepares the application for the return of a child wrongfully removed to or retained abroad, under the Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction (The Hague, 25 October 1980, approved by Decree-Law No. 316/83 of 2 July), in conjunction with Regulation (EC) No. 2201/2003 (Brussels II bis) and Art. 1906 CC.

FAM-037.titulo_en: Dissolution of a De Facto Union and Property Effects (Law No. 7/2001)
FAM-037.descricao_en: Prepares the declaration of dissolution of the de facto union and deals with the resulting property effects, under Law No. 7/2001 of 11 May (protection of de facto unions), invoking Arts. 2020 (maintenance), 1106 (tenancy) and 473 (unjust enrichment) of the CC, as well as Law No. 23/2010 of 30 August, which strengthened the protection of de facto partners.

FAM-038.descricao_en: Prepares an application or agreement on alternating residence (residência alternada) for the minor, under Art. 1906(5) CC (introduced by Law No. 65/2022 of 22 November) and Art. 44 RGPTC, setting out the best interests of the child and the proposed schedule, with criteria for school, medical and extraordinary expense matters.

FAM-039.titulo_en: Hearing the Child — Application and Notes for the Hearing (RGPTC)
FAM-039.descricao_en: Prepares the application for the child to be heard in civil guardianship proceedings or proceedings regulating parental responsibilities, under Arts. 4(1)(c) and 84 of the RGPTC and Art. 12 of the CRC (UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, 1989), and prepares guidance notes for the hearing.

FAM-040.titulo_en: Domestic Violence and Regulation of Parental Responsibilities — Combined Application
FAM-040.descricao_en: Prepares the initial application or response in proceedings regulating parental responsibilities where there is a background of domestic violence, combining Law No. 112/2009 (legal regime on domestic violence), Art. 1906(2) CC (limitation of joint exercise in cases of violence) and Arts. 29 et seq. of the RGPTC, with a request for child protection measures.

FAM-041.titulo_en: Adoption Proceedings — Application and Documentation (Law No. 143/2015)
FAM-041.descricao_en: Prepares the legal documentation for full or restricted adoption proceedings, under the Legal Regime of the Adoption Process (Law No. 143/2015 of 8 September) and Arts. 1973 to 2002-D of the CC, including the initial application, a list of documents and grounds based on the best interests of the child.

FAM-042.titulo_en: Division of Property after Divorce — List of Assets and Request for Bidding
FAM-042.descricao_en: Prepares the list of assets for inventory proceedings following divorce, under Arts. 1689 et seq. of the CC and Arts. 1082 et seq. of the CPC, identifying the common property to be divided, the equalisation payments (tornas) due and the bidding (licitação) strategy, distinguishing common property, separate property and the couple's liabilities.

FAM-043.titulo_en: Non-Payment of Maintenance — Application to the FGADM (Law No. 75/98)
FAM-043.descricao_en: Prepares the application for intervention by the Guarantee Fund for Maintenance Owed to Minors (FGADM), under Law No. 75/98 of 19 November and Decree-Law No. 164/99 of 13 May, where the maintenance debtor fails to meet the obligation set by the court, demonstrating the legal requirements of insufficient means and a prior attempt at enforcement.

FAM-044.titulo_en: Civil Sponsorship — Application and Agreement (Law No. 103/2009)
FAM-044.descricao_en: Prepares the application to establish a civil sponsorship (apadrinhamento civil) and the related agreement, under Law No. 103/2009 of 11 September (legal regime of civil sponsorship), in conjunction with the provisions of the CC and the RGPTC on court involvement and approval of the agreement.

FAM-045.titulo_en: Maintenance for Adult Children — Statement of Claim and Grounds (Art. 1880 CC)
FAM-045.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a maintenance action for adult or emancipated children who have not yet completed their education, under Art. 1880 of the CC, setting out the need for maintenance, the academic or vocational education in progress and the financial capacity of the liable parent.

FAM-046.titulo_en: Prenuptial Agreement — Choice of Matrimonial Property Regime and Special Clauses
FAM-046.descricao_en: Prepares the draft prenuptial agreement choosing the property regime applicable to the marriage, under Arts. 1698 to 1713 of the CC, including an analysis of the three statutory regimes (community of acquired property, general community of property, separation of property), the permissible special clauses and their property effects.

FAM-047.titulo_en: Medically Assisted Reproduction (PMA) and Establishment of Parentage (Law No. 32/2006)
FAM-047.descricao_en: Prepares opinions and legal documentation on establishing parentage in cases of medically assisted reproduction (procriação medicamente assistida, PMA), under Law No. 32/2006 of 26 July (PMA Law), with reference to the CC and the impact of the amendments made by Law No. 49/2016 and Law No. 58/2017 regarding access for same-sex couples and unmarried women.

FAM-048.titulo_en: Surrogacy — Legal Advice and Contract (Arts. 8 and 8-A of Law No. 32/2006)
FAM-048.descricao_en: Provides legal advice and a draft surrogacy (gestação de substituição) contract under Arts. 8 and 8-A of Law No. 32/2006 (as amended by Law No. 25/2016 and in light of Constitutional Court (TC) decisions), identifying the legal requirements, the need for authorisation from the National Council for Medically Assisted Reproduction (CNPMA) and the rules on establishing parentage.

FAM-049.titulo_en: Deprivation of Parental Responsibilities — Application for Inibição
FAM-049.descricao_en: Drafts the initial application in proceedings to restrict the exercise of parental responsibilities (inibição), under Arts. 1913 to 1920-C of the CC, where the parent's conduct endangers the minor's safety, health, moral development or education, demonstrating the requirements for total or partial restriction.

FAM-050.titulo_en: Court Authorisation for a Minor's Permanent Relocation Abroad
FAM-050.descricao_en: Prepares the application for court authorisation for a minor's permanent relocation abroad or for the court to supply the other parent's consent, under Art. 1906 CC, Art. 1887-A CC and Arts. 44 and 46 RGPTC, where one parent intends to emigrate with the children and the other refuses or cannot be contacted.

FAM-051.titulo_en: Recognition of a Foreign Divorce Judgment — Review and Confirmation (Art. 978 CPC)
FAM-051.descricao_en: Prepares the application for review and confirmation of a foreign divorce judgment so that it takes effect in Portugal, under Arts. 978 to 985 of the CPC and Regulation (EC) No. 2201/2003 (Brussels II bis) for judgments from EU Member States, with the necessary documents and evidence of the legal requirements.

FAM-052.titulo_en: Promotion and Protection Proceedings — Closing Submissions for the Child/Family
FAM-052.descricao_en: Prepares closing submissions in promotion and protection proceedings (PPP) concerning a child at risk, under the Law on the Protection of Children and Young People in Danger (Law No. 147/99 of 1 September, as amended by Law No. 23/2017), in conjunction with the RGPTC and the principles of minimum intervention and subsidiarity.

FAM-053.titulo_en: Cooperative Parenting Agreement — Detailed Parenting Plan
FAM-053.descricao_en: Prepares a detailed parenting plan for the cooperative regulation of the exercise of parental responsibilities, under Arts. 1906 and 1907 CC and Art. 44 RGPTC, aimed at minimising post-divorce conflict and setting clear rules for day-to-day, health and education decisions and for communication between the parents.

FAM-054.titulo_en: Guardianship of a Minor — Application to Appoint a Guardian (Arts. 1921 et seq. CC)
FAM-054.descricao_en: Prepares the application to establish guardianship (tutela) of a minor under Arts. 1921 to 1972 of the CC, where the minor has no legal representative owing to the death, absence or restriction (inibição) of the parents, identifying the proposed guardian, the ward's assets and the guardian's duties.

FAM-055.titulo_en: Maintenance between Spouses in Proceedings for Judicial Separation of Persons and Property
FAM-055.descricao_en: Prepares the claim for maintenance between spouses in proceedings for judicial separation of persons and property (separação judicial de pessoas e bens) or divorce without consent, under Arts. 1675 to 1677-D of the CC and Art. 2016 CC (maintenance for the divorced spouse), including the grounds of need and the criteria for setting the amount.

FAM-056.titulo_en: Parentage by Voluntary Acknowledgement — Instrument and Challenge
FAM-056.descricao_en: Prepares the instrument of voluntary acknowledgement of paternity under Arts. 1849 to 1860 of the CC and, conversely, the challenge to that acknowledgement where it was made by someone who is not the biological father or where there are doubts about its voluntary nature, with reference to the time limits and the forms of challenge.

FAM-057.titulo_en: Grandparents' Contact Arrangements — Court Application (Art. 1887-A CC)
FAM-057.descricao_en: Prepares a court application to establish or protect the grandparents' right of contact with the minor, under Art. 1887-A of the CC, where the parents prevent or hinder the minor's contact with the grandparents, based on the best interests of the child and the importance of intergenerational relationships.

FAM-058.titulo_en: Family Mediation — Mediation Agreement and Parenting Clauses
FAM-058.descricao_en: Prepares the family mediation agreement resulting from mediation conducted by a certified mediator, under the Family Mediation System (Sistema de Mediação Familiar, SMF) created by Decree-Law No. 272/2001 and Art. 44 of the RGPTC, with parenting clauses suitable for court approval.

FAM-059.titulo_en: Action to Establish Maternity — Statement of Claim (Art. 1814 CC)
FAM-059.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action to establish maternity (investigação de maternidade), under Arts. 1814 to 1823 of the CC, where maternity is not established by registration or there is doubt about the mother's identity, with the appropriate evidence and reference to the time limits (caducidade).

FAM-060.titulo_en: Prenuptial Agreements for Business Owners — Advanced Asset Protection
FAM-060.descricao_en: Prepares a specialised prenuptial agreement for business owners, partners in commercial companies or self-employed professionals with significant assets, under Arts. 1698 to 1736 of the CC, analysing the interaction between the chosen property regime and shareholdings, business debt and personal assets.

INS-001.descricao_en: Generates the complete petition (petição inicial) for a debtor (individual or legal entity) to file for insolvency under Article 18 of the CIRE (Insolvency and Corporate Recovery Code), setting out the insolvency situation, a list of liabilities, the available assets and the mandatory procedural applications.

INS-002.titulo_en: Creditor's Petition for a Declaration of Insolvency
INS-002.descricao_en: Generates the complete petition for a creditor to apply for a declaration of insolvency of a debtor, based on the indicative facts (factos-índice) of Article 20 of the CIRE, with proof of the claim and the appropriate procedural applications.

INS-003.titulo_en: Opposition to a Petition for a Declaration of Insolvency
INS-003.descricao_en: Generates the debtor's opposition to a creditor's petition for a declaration of insolvency, challenging the alleged indicative facts, disputing the existence or enforceability of the claim and seeking dismissal of the petition, under Article 30 of the CIRE.

INS-004.titulo_en: Application to Open a Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER)
INS-004.descricao_en: Generates the application to open a Special Revitalisation Procedure (Processo Especial de Revitalização — PER), with a joint declaration by the debtor and at least one creditor, grounds for economic viability and procedural applications, under Articles 17-A to 17-J of the CIRE.
