INS-005.titulo_en: Application to Open a Special Procedure for a Payment Agreement (PEAP)
INS-005.descricao_en: Generates the application to open a Special Procedure for a Payment Agreement (Processo Especial para Acordo de Pagamento — PEAP), a mechanism for individuals who do not own a business and are in imminent insolvency or economic difficulty, under Articles 222-A to 222-J of the CIRE.

INS-006.descricao_en: Generates the revitalisation plan to be submitted to creditors in a PER, including a diagnosis of the economic and financial situation, recovery measures, a debt restructuring proposal by class of creditors and a viability analysis, under Articles 195 to 228 of the CIRE as applicable by cross-reference.

INS-007.descricao_en: Generates the insolvency plan governing the effects of the insolvency in place of the general liquidation rules, proposing the recovery of the business or payment to creditors on specific terms, under Articles 192 to 228 of the CIRE.

INS-008.descricao_en: Generates the proof of claim (reclamação de créditos) to be lodged with the insolvency administrator within the period set by the court, identifying the claim, its legal classification (secured, preferential, unsecured or subordinated) and supporting documents, under Articles 128 to 134 of the CIRE.

INS-009.titulo_en: Challenge to the List of Recognised Creditors
INS-009.descricao_en: Generates the application challenging the list of recognised creditors submitted by the insolvency administrator, contesting the improper inclusion, exclusion or classification of claims, under Article 130 of the CIRE.

INS-010.titulo_en: Application for Late Verification of Claims
INS-010.descricao_en: Generates the application for late verification of claims (verificação ulterior de créditos) for creditors who missed the initial deadline for lodging claims or only learned of the proceedings after it expired, under Article 146 of the CIRE, justifying the late claim and seeking recognition of the claim.

INS-011.titulo_en: Calculation and Ranking of Claims (Secured, Preferential, Unsecured, Subordinated)
INS-011.descricao_en: Generates a full analysis of the ranking of the claims recognised in the insolvency, calculating the expected recovery percentage for each class, identifying the statutory order of payment and simulating scenarios for distribution of the proceeds of the asset liquidation, under Articles 47 to 51 and 172 to 184 of the CIRE.

INS-012.titulo_en: Application for Discharge of Remaining Liabilities
INS-012.descricao_en: Generates the application for discharge of remaining liabilities (exoneração do passivo restante — EPR), a mechanism allowing an individual debtor to be released from the debts left unpaid in the insolvency after a five-year income assignment period, under Articles 235 to 248 of the CIRE.

INS-013.titulo_en: Opposition to an Application for Discharge of Remaining Liabilities
INS-013.descricao_en: Generates the opposition to an application for discharge of remaining liabilities, lodged by a creditor or the insolvency administrator who identifies a legal impediment to the benefit, a breach of duties during the assignment period or wilful misconduct by the debtor, under Articles 238 and 241 of the CIRE.

INS-014.titulo_en: Opinion on the Classification of the Insolvency (Culpable or Fortuitous)
INS-014.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned legal opinion on whether the insolvency should be classified as culpable or fortuitous, analysing the conduct of the debtor and its directors/managers against the exhaustive criteria of Articles 186 and 187 of the CIRE, with an assessment of the risk of a culpable classification and the consequences for those affected.

INS-015.titulo_en: Avoidance of a Transaction for the Benefit of the Insolvent Estate
INS-015.descricao_en: Generates the instrument by which the insolvency administrator avoids (resolução em benefício da massa) transactions carried out by the debtor before the declaration of insolvency that prejudiced the creditors, in order to return the assets to the insolvent estate, under Articles 120 to 127 of the CIRE.

INS-016.titulo_en: Challenge to an Avoidance for the Benefit of the Estate
INS-016.descricao_en: Generates the application by which the third-party counterparty challenges the avoidance of the transaction declared by the insolvency administrator, alleging that the legal ground does not apply or that it acted in good faith, under Article 125 of the CIRE.

INS-017.titulo_en: Complaint against Acts of the Insolvency Administrator
INS-017.descricao_en: Generates the complaint to the judge against acts or omissions of the insolvency administrator that breach its statutory duties or cause unjustified harm to the estate or the creditors, under Articles 60 et seq. of the CIRE.

INS-018.titulo_en: Application for Restitution and Separation of Assets
INS-018.descricao_en: Generates the application by which a third party claims restitution of its own assets held by the insolvent debtor, or seeks the separation of assets earmarked for a specific purpose that do not form part of the insolvent estate, under Articles 141 to 145 of the CIRE.

INS-019.titulo_en: Opinion on Continuing or Closing the Debtor's Business
INS-019.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned legal and economic opinion on whether to keep the insolvent debtor's business running or close it, weighing going-concern value against liquidation value, the impact on employees and creditors, and the duties of the insolvency administrator under Article 55 of the CIRE.

INS-020.descricao_en: Generates the application for seizure (apreensão) of the insolvent debtor's assets for inclusion in the insolvent estate, including assets not yet identified or that the debtor has tried to conceal, under Articles 149 to 155 of the CIRE and the protective measures of Article 31 of the CIRE.

INS-021.descricao_en: Generates the out-of-court debt restructuring agreement between the debtor and its main creditors, proposing a moratorium, debt reduction or debt conversion, as an alternative to a PER or insolvency, without immediate court involvement.

INS-022.descricao_en: Generates a formal letter to a creditor proposing a standstill period (voluntary suspension of collection actions) while the parties negotiate a restructuring agreement, setting out the financial situation, the intention to pay and the basis of the proposed agreement.

INS-023.titulo_en: Checklist of Documents for an Insolvency Filing
INS-023.descricao_en: Generates a detailed checklist of all the documents required for an insolvency filing (Article 24 of the CIRE), tailored to the type of debtor (individual, commercial company, sole trader), stating how long each document takes to obtain and the issuing body.

INS-024.titulo_en: Application for Court Approval of an Agreement Reached in a PER
INS-024.descricao_en: Generates the application for court approval (homologação) of the revitalisation agreement approved by the creditors in a Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER), demonstrating compliance with the statutory approval requirements and seeking binding effect on all creditors, under Article 17-F of the CIRE.

INS-025.titulo_en: Opinion on Directors' Liability in Culpable Insolvency
INS-025.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned legal opinion on the civil liability and legal consequences for directors, managers and members of corporate bodies declared to be affected by the classification of the insolvency as culpable, under Articles 186 to 191 of the CIRE and the Commercial Companies Code (CSC).

INS-026.titulo_en: Application for Waiver / Termination of Proceedings
INS-026.descricao_en: Generates the application to close insolvency proceedings because the insolvent estate is insufficient to cover the costs and expenses of the proceedings (Article 39 CIRE) or there are no assets to liquidate (Article 230 CIRE), seeking termination of the proceedings and setting out the consequences for the debtor.

INS-027.titulo_en: Economic Viability Analysis for Choosing between a PER and Insolvency
INS-027.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned comparative analysis to help the debtor choose between a Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER) and insolvency, weighing the economic viability of the business, the restructurable liabilities, the recovery prospects and the consequences of each route for the debtor and the creditors.

INS-028.titulo_en: Proof of Employment Claims in the Employer's Insolvency
INS-028.descricao_en: Generates the proof of employment claims to be lodged by the employee with the insolvency administrator of the employer, itemising wage claims, compensation and other employment claims, identifying the applicable creditor privileges and seeking recognition with the correct classification, under Articles 128 to 134 of the CIRE and Articles 333 and 334 of the Labour Code (Código do Trabalho).

INS-029.titulo_en: Manager's Defence in Proceedings to Classify the Insolvency as Culpable
INS-029.descricao_en: Prepares the defence (contestação) of the affected manager or director in the incidental proceedings to classify the insolvency as culpable, under Articles 186 to 189 of the CIRE (Insolvency and Corporate Recovery Code, approved by Decree-Law No. 53/2004 of 18 March), rebutting the presumption of serious fault (culpa grave) and the culpable insolvency criteria, with an analysis of the financial and personal effects of the classification.

INS-030.titulo_en: Application for Discharge of Remaining Liabilities — Initial Application and Follow-Up
INS-030.descricao_en: Prepares the initial application for discharge of remaining liabilities (EPR) made by an individual debtor in insolvency proceedings, under Articles 235 to 248 of the CIRE, including the statement of economic circumstances, the request to fix the available income and the response to creditors' opposition during the assignment period.

INS-031.titulo_en: Avoidance for the Benefit of the Estate — Notice and Grounds by the Administrator
INS-031.descricao_en: Prepares the notice avoiding transactions for the benefit of the insolvent estate (resolução em benefício da massa), under Articles 120 to 127 of the CIRE, identifying the requirements of the right of avoidance (prejudice and bad faith), the time limits and the restitutionary effects, intended for the insolvency administrator or the lawyer advising them.

INS-032.titulo_en: Challenge to the List of Recognised Creditors — Creditor's Application
INS-032.descricao_en: Prepares the application challenging the list of recognised creditors drawn up by the insolvency administrator, under Articles 130 to 140 of the CIRE, contesting the non-inclusion of a claim, the ranking assigned or the verification of a third party's claim, with an analysis of the statutory categories of claims and the applicable creditor privileges.

INS-033.titulo_en: Insolvency Plan — Preparation and Proposal to Creditors
INS-033.descricao_en: Prepares the insolvency plan to be submitted to the creditors' meeting, under Articles 195 to 234 of the CIRE, structuring the recovery or orderly liquidation measures, voting by class, the equal treatment criteria and the application for court approval.

INS-034.titulo_en: Closure of Proceedings for Insufficiency of the Insolvent Estate
INS-034.descricao_en: Prepares the insolvency administrator's application to close the proceedings for insufficiency of the estate, under Article 232 of the CIRE, and analyses the consequences for a debtor that is a legal entity (extinction), for the creditors (declaration of non-satisfaction) and any financial liability of third parties.

INS-035.titulo_en: Insolvency of a Non-Trader Individual — Petition and Strategy
INS-035.descricao_en: Prepares the petition for an individual who is not a trader (consumer) to file for insolvency, under Articles 249 to 263 of the CIRE, analysing the simplified regime applicable, the particular features of the proceedings and the link with the application for discharge of remaining liabilities.

INS-036.titulo_en: Set-Off of Claims in Insolvency — Analysis and Opposition
INS-036.descricao_en: Analyses the admissibility of set-off of claims invoked by a creditor in insolvency proceedings, under Articles 99 and 100 of the CIRE and Articles 847 to 856 of the Civil Code, identifying the requirements, the limits and the cases in which set-off is inadmissible or should be contested by the estate.

INS-037.titulo_en: Subsidiary Tax Liability of the Insolvency Administrator
INS-037.descricao_en: Analyses the requirements and limits of the insolvency administrator's subsidiary tax liability for the tax obligations of the insolvent estate, under Article 24 of the General Tax Law (LGT) and Article 59 of the CIRE, and prepares a defence in tax reversion proceedings (reversão fiscal).

INS-038.titulo_en: Sale of Assets of the Insolvent Estate — Challenge and Creditors' Rights
INS-038.descricao_en: Analyses the rights of the creditors and of the debtor in relation to sales of assets forming part of the insolvent estate, under Articles 158 to 168 of the CIRE, including challenges to sales for procedural irregularity, the exercise of preemption rights and disputes over the sale price.

INS-039.descricao_en: Analyses international jurisdiction to open main and secondary insolvency proceedings, the determination of the debtor's centre of main interests (COMI) and the cross-border effects of the proceedings, under Regulation (EU) 2015/848 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 May 2015 on insolvency proceedings.

INS-040.titulo_en: PER — Special Revitalisation Procedure: Conduct and Challenges
INS-040.descricao_en: Prepares the strategy and court filings for a Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER), under Articles 17-A to 17-J of the CIRE, including negotiation with creditors, challenges to claims in the PER, the vote on the plan and the application for approval or for a declaration of insolvency if it fails.

INS-041.titulo_en: PEAP — Special Procedure for a Payment Agreement: Non-Trader Individual
INS-041.descricao_en: Prepares the strategy and court filings for a Special Procedure for a Payment Agreement (PEAP), under Articles 222-A to 222-J of the CIRE, intended for individuals who are not traders and are insolvent or in a difficult economic situation, as an alternative to a declaration of insolvency.

INS-042.titulo_en: Civil Liability of Directors in Insolvency — Action for Damages
INS-042.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for civil liability of managers or directors for conduct that contributed to the insolvency or increased the company's liabilities, under Articles 78 and 79 of the CSC (Commercial Companies Code) and Article 189 of the CIRE, analysing the loss, the causal link and the interplay with the classification proceedings.

INS-043.titulo_en: Court Approval of an Agreement Reached in a PER — Application and Opposition
INS-043.descricao_en: Prepares the application for court approval of the revitalisation agreement reached in a Special Revitalisation Procedure (PER), under Article 17-F of the CIRE, and a dissenting creditor's reasoned opposition to approval, analysing the grounds for judicial refusal and the cramdown mechanism.

INS-044.titulo_en: Effects of a Declaration of Insolvency on Ongoing Contracts
INS-044.descricao_en: Analyses the effects of a declaration of insolvency on contracts being performed between the debtor and third parties, under Articles 102 to 119 of the CIRE, including the insolvency administrator's choice between performance and refusal to perform, employment contracts, leases and special regimes.

INS-045.titulo_en: Restitution and Separation of Third-Party Assets in the Insolvent Estate
INS-045.descricao_en: Prepares the application for restitution or separation of assets belonging to third parties that are held by the insolvent debtor, under Articles 141 to 150 of the CIRE, distinguishing rights of restitution (assets wrongfully held) from rights of separation (creditor's assets incorporated into the estate).

INS-046.titulo_en: Secured vs. Unsecured Claims — Strategy for Proof and Ranking
INS-046.descricao_en: Prepares the strategy for lodging claims in insolvency, differentiating the statutory categories — secured, preferential, unsecured and subordinated — under Articles 47 to 59 and 172 to 184 of the CIRE, with an analysis of general and special creditor privileges and the order of payment in the liquidation of the estate.

INS-047.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Debt Restructuring Agreement — Negotiation and Documentation
INS-047.descricao_en: Prepares the out-of-court debt restructuring agreement between a debtor in economic difficulty and its creditors, under Portuguese contract law and the Banco de Portugal (Bank of Portugal) guidelines for default situations, as an alternative to a PER, a PEAP and insolvency proceedings.

INS-048.titulo_en: Proof of Employment Claims in Insolvency — Employees and Wage Guarantee Fund
INS-048.descricao_en: Prepares the proof of employment claims in the employer's insolvency, under Articles 128 et seq. of the CIRE and Article 336 of the Labour Code, including the application to the Wage Guarantee Fund (Fundo de Garantia Salarial — FGS) for advance payment of wage arrears, and the defence of employees in the verification proceedings.

INS-049.titulo_en: Late Verification of Claims — Application and Strategy
INS-049.descricao_en: Prepares the application for late verification of a claim under Article 146 of the CIRE, for a creditor who did not lodge a claim within the general 30-day period, analysing the procedural costs of late verification and the possible subordination of the claim, and developing arguments to avoid subordination.

INS-050.titulo_en: Insolvency Petition — Debtor that is a Legal Entity
INS-050.descricao_en: Prepares the petition for the voluntary insolvency filing of a debtor that is a legal entity, under Articles 18, 23 and 24 of the CIRE, analysing the duty to file, the mandatory documents (Article 24 CIRE) and the procedural strategy in light of the risk of the insolvency being classified as culpable.

INS-051.titulo_en: Petition for a Declaration of Insolvency by a Creditor
INS-051.descricao_en: Prepares the petition for a declaration of insolvency filed by a creditor, under Articles 20 and 25 of the CIRE, analysing the indicative facts supporting the petition, the standing of the petitioning creditor and the interim measures that may be requested at the same time.

INS-052.titulo_en: Proof of Claim in Insolvency — Form and Strategy
INS-052.descricao_en: Prepares the proof of claim to be lodged by the creditor with the insolvency administrator, under Articles 128 and 129 of the CIRE, identifying the nature, amount and security of the claim, with an analysis of the ranking sought and the consequences of failing to lodge the claim within the period set in the judgment declaring insolvency.

INS-053.titulo_en: Challenge to an Avoidance for the Benefit of the Estate — Third-Party Opposition
INS-053.descricao_en: Prepares the court challenge by a third party notified of an avoidance for the benefit of the insolvent estate, under Article 125 of the CIRE, disputing the existence of the requirements for avoidance (conditional or unconditional), asserting the third party's good faith and contesting the restitutionary effects claimed by the insolvency administrator.

INS-054.titulo_en: Court Complaint against Acts of the Insolvency Administrator
INS-054.descricao_en: Prepares the court complaint against acts of the insolvency administrator before the judge in charge of the proceedings, under Article 68 of the CIRE, challenging management decisions, liquidation acts, material omissions or breaches of the duty of impartiality, and seeking annulment or the adoption of a specific measure.

INS-055.titulo_en: Letter Negotiating with Creditors — Standstill and Out-of-Court Restructuring Agreement
INS-055.descricao_en: Prepares the negotiation letter addressed to the main creditors proposing a standstill (informal moratorium) and the basis for an out-of-court debt restructuring agreement, within the preventive restructuring framework of Directive (EU) 2019/1023 as transposed into Portuguese law, as an alternative to a PER or formal insolvency.

INS-056.titulo_en: Economic Viability Analysis — Choosing between PER, PEAP and Insolvency
INS-056.descricao_en: Prepares a comparative analysis of the restructuring alternatives available to a debtor in difficulty — PER (Articles 17-A to 17-J CIRE), PEAP (Articles 222-A to 222-J CIRE), voluntary insolvency with a plan (Articles 195 et seq. CIRE) or out-of-court negotiation — identifying the option best suited to the debtor's specific situation.

INS-057.titulo_en: Application for Seizure of Assets in Insolvency
INS-057.descricao_en: Prepares the application by the insolvency administrator or the petitioning creditor for the immediate seizure of the debtor's assets after the declaration of insolvency, under Articles 36(1)(h) and 149 of the CIRE, and for interim measures to preserve assets before the declaration, under Articles 31 and 32 of the CIRE.

SAU-001.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Medical Malpractice (against a Doctor/Private Clinic)
SAU-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of claim (petição inicial) for a civil liability action against a doctor and/or private clinic, with identification of the parties, statement of facts, legal grounds in contractual and non-contractual (tortious) civil liability, and claims for compensation for pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage.

SAU-002.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for State Civil Liability for Acts of the National Health Service (SNS)
SAU-002.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for a non-contractual civil liability action against the State/public entities of the National Health Service (SNS), based on the special regime of the RRCEE (Law No. 67/2007) and the users' rights established in the Basic Health Law (Lei de Bases da Saúde).

SAU-003.titulo_en: Prior Complaint / Submission to a Healthcare Establishment
SAU-003.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint addressed to the healthcare establishment (public or private), describing the facts, invoking the patient's rights and making specific requests — including explanations, clinical records, redress for damage or reimbursement.

SAU-004.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation for Personal Injury (Tables and Biological Damage)
SAU-004.descricao_en: Structures the calculation of compensation for personal injury according to the criteria of Portuguese case law, including biological damage (dano biológico), future pecuniary loss due to incapacity, non-pecuniary damage (pain, suffering, aesthetic damage and loss of amenity (dano à vida de relação)) and the financial tables used by the higher courts.

SAU-005.titulo_en: Calculation of Future Pecuniary Loss Due to Incapacity
SAU-005.descricao_en: Calculates in detail the future pecuniary loss resulting from permanent incapacity for work, applying the actuarial formulae recognised by the Portuguese courts, distinguishing between partial and total incapacity and adjusting to the injured party's personal circumstances.

SAU-006.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Causal Link between a Medical Act and the Damage
SAU-006.descricao_en: Drafts a structured legal opinion on the existence and extent of the causal link between a specific medical act and the alleged damage, applying the theory of adequate causation to the facts of the case and the available medical data.

SAU-007.descricao_en: Generates a complete template informed consent form for medical or surgical procedures, adapted to the procedure in question, with the mandatory elements laid down in Law No. 15/2014 and the guidance of the Portuguese Medical Association (Ordem dos Médicos) and the Directorate-General of Health (DGS).

SAU-008.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Validity of Informed Consent in a Specific Case
SAU-008.descricao_en: Analyses whether the informed consent obtained in a specific clinical case is legally valid, identifying any formal or substantive defects and assessing the consequences for the liability of the doctor or the healthcare establishment.

SAU-009.titulo_en: Extrajudicial Notice to a Healthcare Establishment for Access to Clinical Records
SAU-009.descricao_en: Drafts a formal extrajudicial notice addressed to a public or private healthcare establishment, demanding immediate access to the patient's complete clinical file, with legal grounds in the user's rights and a warning of the legal consequences of refusal or delay.

SAU-010.titulo_en: Request for Access to the Patient's Health Information
SAU-010.descricao_en: Drafts a formal request to the controller of health data (hospital, clinic, family doctor, laboratory), invoking the right of access under the GDPR and Law No. 12/2005, to obtain a copy of the clinical file, test results or other health information.

SAU-011.titulo_en: Complaint to the Health Regulatory Authority (ERS)
SAU-011.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint to the Health Regulatory Authority (Entidade Reguladora da Saúde, ERS), based on its regulatory remit, describing the facts, invoking the provisions breached and setting out specific requests for regulatory intervention.

SAU-012.titulo_en: Complaint to the Medical Association / Nursing Association
SAU-012.descricao_en: Drafts a formal report/complaint to the Portuguese Medical Association (Ordem dos Médicos) or the Portuguese Nursing Association (Ordem dos Enfermeiros), based on a breach of ethical duties by the health professional, describing the facts, invoking the applicable provisions of the Code of Ethics and requesting the opening of disciplinary proceedings.

SAU-013.titulo_en: Claim Notification Letter to a Professional Liability Insurer
SAU-013.descricao_en: Drafts the letter notifying a claim under the professional civil liability insurance of the doctor or healthcare establishment, describing the facts, identifying the damage and setting out the claim for compensation against the insurer, under the insurance contract and the Civil Code.

SAU-014.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Liability of the Institution vs. the Health Professional
SAU-014.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion analysing the allocation of liability between the individual health professional and the institution where they practise (hospital, clinic or SNS), determining who should be sued and on what terms there may be joint and several or cumulative liability.

SAU-015.titulo_en: Analysis of a Forensic Medical Expert Report
SAU-015.descricao_en: Critically analyses a forensic medical expert report (from the National Institute of Legal Medicine (INML) or from an expert appointed by the court), identifying its strengths and weaknesses for litigation purposes, assessing the completeness of its conclusions and preparing questions or challenges to be raised in court proceedings.

SAU-016.titulo_en: Application for a Forensic Medical Examination in Court Proceedings
SAU-016.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a forensic medical examination to be filed in medical liability court proceedings, precisely framing the questions to be put to the expert, identifying the subject matter of the examination and justifying why it is needed to decide the case.

SAU-017.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Breach of the Duty to Inform the Patient
SAU-017.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for a civil liability action based exclusively (or cumulatively) on breach of the duty to inform the patient — where the doctor performed the procedure without valid consent or without providing sufficient information about the specific risks that materialised.

SAU-018.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Advance Healthcare Directives / Living Will
SAU-018.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the validity, scope and effects of advance healthcare directives (diretivas antecipadas de vontade, or living will) in Portugal, including their drafting, the validity requirements, registration with RENTEV (National Living Will Register) and the consequences of their disregard by health professionals.

SAU-019.descricao_en: Generates an agreement for the provision of medical or clinical services between a doctor or clinic and the patient (or funding entity), with clauses defining the scope of services, fees, professional liability, confidentiality and dispute resolution.

SAU-020.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Liability for Hospital-Acquired Infection
SAU-020.descricao_en: Analyses the legal liability of the hospital or healthcare establishment for a healthcare-associated infection (HAI; IACS in Portuguese) contracted by the patient during admission or a procedure, identifying the organisational failures and the infection prevention and control rules breached.

SAU-021.titulo_en: Request for a Medical Board and Challenge to a Disability Certificate
SAU-021.descricao_en: Drafts the request to convene a medical board (junta médica) and/or the challenge to a disability certificate (atestado de incapacidade) issued by a doctor or by the National Institute for Rehabilitation (INR), on the grounds of disagreement with the degree of disability assigned or the methodology used.

SAU-022.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Medically Assisted Reproduction (Legal Framework)
SAU-022.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the legal framework of medically assisted reproduction (procriação medicamente assistida, PMA) in Portugal, covering the access requirements, the rights of those involved, parentage, gamete and embryo donation, surrogacy and the responsibilities of PMA centres.

SAU-023.titulo_en: Legal Compliance Checklist for a Private Clinic
SAU-023.descricao_en: Generates a detailed legal compliance checklist for private healthcare clinics in Portugal, covering licensing, registration with the ERS, staffing requirements, mandatory documentation, data protection, liability insurance and regulatory obligations.

SAU-024.titulo_en: Letter of Complaint for Negligence in Long-Term Care or a Care Home
SAU-024.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter of complaint addressed to an integrated long-term care unit (UCCI), a care home for the elderly or another facility supporting dependent persons, for negligence or breach of the resident's rights, based on users' rights and the applicable regulatory rules.

SAU-025.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Disciplinary Liability of a Health Professional
SAU-025.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the disciplinary liability of a health professional (doctor, nurse, pharmacist or other), identifying the ethical breaches, the applicable regime, the possible sanctions and the interplay with civil and criminal liability.

SAU-026.titulo_en: Defective Informed Consent — Analysis and Litigation Strategy
SAU-026.descricao_en: Analyses the validity of the informed consent given by the patient in light of Law No. 15/2014 of 21 March (rights and duties of healthcare users), notably Articles 3, 5 and 6, Article 157 of the Criminal Code and Articles 38 to 44 of the Code of Ethics of the Portuguese Medical Association (CDOM). It identifies defects (insufficient information, generic form, patient's incapacity, emergency improperly invoked) and outlines a strategy for establishing liability.

SAU-027.titulo_en: Civil Liability of a Public Hospital — Administrative Action (Law 67/2007)
SAU-027.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an administrative action for the State's non-contractual civil liability for damage caused by a medical act performed in an SNS establishment, under Law No. 67/2007 of 31 December (regime of non-contractual civil liability of the State), with subsidiary application of Articles 483 et seq. of the Civil Code. It distinguishes attribution of liability to the State/public hospital from personal attribution to the doctor.

SAU-028.titulo_en: Civil Liability of a Private Clinic — Civil Action (Contract and Tort)
SAU-028.descricao_en: Prepares the strategy and the statement of claim in a civil action against a private clinic or hospital for medical malpractice or damage resulting from healthcare, under the contractual liability regime (Articles 798 et seq. CC) and, in the alternative, the tort regime (Articles 483 et seq. CC). It addresses the obligation of means versus the obligation of result, the burden of proof and the interplay with professional civil liability insurance.

SAU-029.titulo_en: Loss of a Chance of Recovery or a Better Prognosis — Grounds and Calculation
SAU-029.descricao_en: Drafts an opinion and structures the compensation claim based on the loss-of-chance doctrine (perte d'une chance) in medical liability: situations in which the health professional's error or omission eliminated a real probability of recovery, survival or a better prognosis, without it being possible to establish direct causation between the act and the final damage. It sets out the grounds in light of Articles 562 and 563 CC and the development of Portuguese case law.

SAU-030.titulo_en: ERS Proceedings — Complaint and Regulatory Follow-Up
SAU-030.descricao_en: Prepares the complaint to the Health Regulatory Authority (ERS), under the ERS Statute (approved by Decree-Law No. 126/2014 of 22 August) and Law No. 15/2014 of 21 March, for breach of users' rights in a public or private healthcare establishment. It addresses the scope of the ERS's intervention, its sanctioning powers and the interplay with other routes (the courts, the Medical Association, the Inspectorate-General of Health Activities (IGAS)).

SAU-031.titulo_en: Access to Clinical Records — Request and Challenge to Refusal
SAU-031.descricao_en: Prepares the request for access to the clinical file under Articles 4 et seq. of Law No. 15/2014 of 21 March and Law No. 26/2016 of 22 August (access to administrative documents — LADA), and structures the legal response in the event of refusal, partial disclosure or informal refusal. It includes recourse to the CADA (Commission for Access to Administrative Documents) and to the courts.

SAU-032.titulo_en: Advance Healthcare Directives — Drafting and Registration with RENTEV
SAU-032.descricao_en: Drafts the advance healthcare directives document (DAV / living will) and the appointment of a healthcare proxy (procurador de cuidados de saúde), under Law No. 25/2012 of 16 July, Decree-Law No. 100/2019 of 6 August (RENTEV — National Living Will Register) and Articles 5 to 7 of Law 15/2014. It addresses capacity to execute, formal requirements, admissible content and the registration and revocation procedure.

SAU-033.titulo_en: Compulsory Admission — Mental Health Law (Law 36/1998, as amended)
SAU-033.descricao_en: Guides the lawyer and the patient/family through compulsory admission proceedings and the defence of the detained person's rights, under Law No. 36/1998 of 24 July (Mental Health Law, LSM), as amended by Law No. 49/2018 of 14 August, and the accompanied adult regime (maior acompanhado; Law 49/2018). It addresses the requirements, the court proceedings, the right of defence and the means of challenge.

SAU-034.titulo_en: Telemedicine — Legal Framework and Services Agreements
SAU-034.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of telemedicine in Portugal, in light of Ministerial Order (Portaria) No. 196/2014 of 9 October, Articles 3 and 6 of Law No. 15/2014, the CDOM and the GDPR, and drafts the telemedicine services agreement between the clinic/doctor and the platform or patient. It addresses liability, consent in a digital context, retention of clinical records and protection of health data.

SAU-035.titulo_en: Clinical Trials — Participants' Rights and Civil Liability
SAU-035.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of clinical trials in Portugal, under Regulation (EU) No. 536/2014, Law No. 21/2014 of 16 April (Clinical Research Law, LIC) and Law No. 15/2014, and provides guidance on defending injured participants, including the civil liability regime and access to the compensation provided under the mandatory insurance policy.

SAU-036.descricao_en: Analyses the civil liability of the healthcare establishment for infections acquired during admission or a procedure (hospital infection / IACS), including bloodstream infections, ventilator-associated pneumonia, surgical wound infections and infections by multidrug-resistant microorganisms. It grounds the claim in Law 67/2007 (SNS), the contractual liability regime (private clinics) and the DGS guidelines.

SAU-037.titulo_en: Diagnostic Error — Legal Strategy and Statement of Claim
SAU-037.descricao_en: Prepares the legal strategy and the statement of claim in cases of medical diagnostic error (wrong diagnosis, late diagnosis, diagnosis missed through omission of tests), based on breach of the leges artis, Law No. 15/2014, the CDOM and Articles 483 or 798 of the Civil Code (depending on the public or private context). It addresses causation, expert evidence and the interplay with the loss-of-chance doctrine.

SAU-038.titulo_en: Disciplinary Complaint to the Medical Association — Procedure and Strategy
SAU-038.descricao_en: Prepares the disciplinary complaint to the Portuguese Medical Association (Ordem dos Médicos) for breach of its Code of Ethics (CDOM), under the Statute of the Medical Association (Decree-Law 282/77, as subsequently amended) and the Disciplinary Regulation. It addresses the ethical duties most frequently breached, the disciplinary procedure, time limits, sanctions and the interplay with court action and with the complaint to the ERS.

SAU-039.titulo_en: Cosmetic Surgery — Obligation of Result and Civil Liability
SAU-039.descricao_en: Analyses the specific civil liability regime for cosmetic surgery and aesthetic medicine in Portugal, focusing on the characterisation of the obligation as an obligation of result (the prevailing view for purely cosmetic surgery), the enhanced duties to inform (Law 15/2014, Articles 5 and 6; CDOM, Articles 38 to 40) and the licensing requirements for aesthetic medicine clinics (Ministerial Order No. 153/2017 and Decree-Law No. 76/2013).

SAU-040.titulo_en: Health Insurance — Exclusions, Refusal of Cover and Challenge
SAU-040.descricao_en: Analyses the general and special conditions of health insurance policies, identifies exclusion clauses that are potentially unfair or void under the Standard Contract Terms Law (Decree-Law 446/85) and Decree-Law 72/2008 (Legal Regime of the Insurance Contract), and prepares the complaint to the insurer and the court action or the complaint to the ASF (Insurance and Pension Funds Supervisory Authority) for unjustified refusal of cover.

SAU-041.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of medically assisted death (morte medicamente assistida, MMA) in Portugal, under Law No. 22/2023 of 25 May, which regulates the conditions in which euthanasia and medically assisted suicide are permitted. It guides lawyers and citizens on the requirements, the clinical and ethical process, the rights of the patient and of the conscientious objector doctor, and the legal consequences of breaches of the regime.

SAU-042.titulo_en: Pharmacovigilance — Liability for Defective Medicinal Products
SAU-042.descricao_en: Analyses the civil liability of the marketing authorisation (AIM) holder and the producer for damage caused by a defective medicinal product, under Decree-Law No. 176/2006 (Medicines Statute), the producer liability regime (Decree-Law No. 383/89, transposing Directive 85/374/EEC) and the pharmacovigilance obligations towards INFARMED (National Authority of Medicines and Health Products). It includes the reporting of adverse reactions and the defence of the injured patient.

SAU-043.titulo_en: Negligence in Long-Term Care and Care Homes — Complaint and Action
SAU-043.descricao_en: Prepares the legal strategy and pleadings for cases of negligence in long-term care units (RNCCI) and care homes for the elderly (public or private), including falls, pressure ulcers, dehydration, improper restraint and breaches of Law No. 15/2014. It links civil liability, the complaint to the ERS, the complaint to the Ministry of Labour (IGASS) and the criminal regime (ill-treatment of the elderly, Article 152-A of the Criminal Code (CP)).

SAU-044.titulo_en: Medically Assisted Reproduction — Legal Framework and Litigation
SAU-044.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of medically assisted reproduction (PMA) in Portugal, under Law No. 32/2006 of 26 July (PMA Law) and its amendments, including the rights of beneficiaries, the legal limits, the civil liability of clinics and doctors, and children's access to the donor's identity. It also addresses breaches of the PMA contract.

SAU-045.titulo_en: Legal Compliance of a Private Clinic — Checklist and Audit
SAU-045.descricao_en: Carries out a full legal compliance audit of a private clinic or diagnostic centre, checking licensing (ERS, Decree-Law 76/2013 / Ministerial Order 153/2017), the requirements of Law No. 15/2014 (users' rights), GDPR obligations in healthcare, the CDOM, professional civil liability insurance and employment contracts with health professionals. It produces a non-compliance report and an action plan.

SAU-046.titulo_en: Voluntary Psychiatric Admission — Rights and Protection
SAU-046.descricao_en: Guides the patient and family on their rights during a voluntary psychiatric admission, distinguishing it from compulsory admission, under Law No. 36/1998 (LSM), Law No. 15/2014 and the CDOM. It addresses the right to voluntary discharge, the limits on restraint, consent to treatment and the complaint routes when rights are breached.

SAU-047.titulo_en: Liability for Nursing Acts — Regime and Distinction from Doctors
SAU-047.descricao_en: Analyses the specific civil and disciplinary liability of nurses for acts performed in the exercise of their profession, distinguishing it from the doctor's liability and from institutional liability, under the Statute of the Nursing Association (Decree-Law 104/98, as amended), the Nurses' Code of Ethics (CDE) and Articles 483 et seq. CC. It addresses cases of medication administration errors, monitoring failures and delegation of tasks.

SAU-048.titulo_en: Rights of Cancer Patients — Access to Treatment and Litigation with the SNS
SAU-048.descricao_en: Guides cancer patients and their families in defending the right to timely access to treatment, under Law No. 15/2014, Law No. 95/2019 (Basic Health Law) and the DGS National Cancer Control Programmes. It addresses access to cancer medicines outside the LNFCM, maximum waiting times, second opinions and administrative litigation over refusal or delay of treatment.

SAU-049.titulo_en: Organ Transplantation — Legal Framework and Litigation
SAU-049.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for organ retrieval and transplantation in Portugal, under Law No. 22/2007 of 29 June (Transplantation Law) and Decree-Law No. 244/94 of 26 September, and provides guidance in conflict situations: refusal of retrieval from a deceased donor, access to transplantation, civil liability in transplantation and the rights of the living donor.

SAU-050.titulo_en: Premature Clinical Discharge — Challenge and Liability
SAU-050.descricao_en: Analyses situations in which a patient is discharged from hospital prematurely, before adequate clinical stabilisation, with subsequent damage, under Law No. 15/2014, the leges artis and Law No. 67/2007 (SNS) or the contractual liability regime (private hospitals). It addresses refusal of discharge, second-level mechanisms and liability for emergency readmission.

SAU-051.titulo_en: Liability in Urgent and Emergency Care — Triage and Delay
SAU-051.descricao_en: Analyses civil and institutional liability for damage caused in accident and emergency services, in particular through incorrect triage (Manchester Triage System), delay in treatment, lack of reassessment and diagnostic errors in an emergency setting, under Law No. 67/2007 (SNS) and the CC (private hospitals). It addresses the obligation to provide emergency care and liability for refusal.

SAU-052.titulo_en: Rights of the Sick Child — Legal Representation and Family Disputes
SAU-052.descricao_en: Guides parents, legal representatives or lawyers in defending the rights of the sick child, including informed consent by representatives, conflict between parental refusal and the best interests of the child, the minor's access to information appropriate to their maturity, and the rights of the hospitalised minor (Law No. 15/2014, the Juvenile Guardianship Law (Lei Tutelar de Menores) and the CDOM). It addresses cases of refusal of treatment by the parents.

SAU-053.titulo_en: Liability for Delay on a Surgical Waiting List
SAU-053.descricao_en: Analyses the liability of the State and the SNS for damage caused to a patient who waited for surgery beyond the Maximum Guaranteed Response Times (TMRG) and suffered avoidable deterioration while waiting, under Law No. 67/2007, the Ministerial Order on TMRG and Law No. 15/2014. It addresses the right to transfer to the contracted or private sector once the TMRG has been exceeded.

SAU-054.titulo_en: Forensic Medical Examination — Application and Challenge to the Report
SAU-054.descricao_en: Guides the lawyer in applying for a forensic medical examination in medical liability proceedings, in critically analysing the expert report and in challenging it when its conclusions are unfavourable to the client, under Articles 467 et seq. CPC, Articles 151 et seq. of the CPTA (Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts) and the Regulation of the National Institute of Legal Medicine and Forensic Sciences (INMLCF).

SAU-055.titulo_en: Breach of Medical Confidentiality — Civil, Disciplinary and Criminal Liability
SAU-055.descricao_en: Analyses the legal consequences of breaching medical confidentiality (health professional secrecy), under Article 195 of the Criminal Code, Article 85 CDOM, Articles 17 and 18 of Law No. 15/2014 and Article 9 GDPR (health data as a special category), and prepares the pleadings for all three routes: criminal, disciplinary and civil.

SAU-056.titulo_en: Regulation of Healthcare Advertising — Compliance for Clinics and Professionals
SAU-056.descricao_en: Analyses the rules governing the advertising of health services and health professionals in Portugal, under the Advertising Code (Decree-Law 330/90), the CDOM (Articles 120 et seq.), the ERS rules on healthcare advertising and the European Code of Medical Ethics, and prepares compliance assessments of clinics' and doctors' campaigns, websites and social media.

SAU-057.titulo_en: Health Data Protection — Clinic Compliance and Incident Management
SAU-057.descricao_en: Prepares the health data protection policy of a private clinic or medical practice, under Article 9 GDPR (special category of data) and the guidance of the CNPD and the EDPB, and provides guidance on managing health data breaches (notification to the CNPD and communication to data subjects under Articles 33 and 34 GDPR).

SAU-058.titulo_en: Liability of Family Doctors and Primary Healthcare
SAU-058.descricao_en: Analyses the specific civil and disciplinary liability of family doctors (general and family medicine, MGF) and SNS health centres for failures in primary healthcare, including failure to refer to hospital, inappropriate prescribing, late diagnosis in an MGF consultation and the management of chronic patients. It frames these under Law 67/2007, the CDOM, Law 15/2014 and the DGS standards for MGF.

SAU-059.titulo_en: Occupational Health — Occupational Diseases and Workplace Accidents with a Medical Component
SAU-059.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for occupational diseases and workplace accidents with a complex medical component, under Law No. 98/2009 of 4 September (Legal Regime for Workplace Accidents and Occupational Diseases), Decree-Law No. 76/2007 (occupational health services) and the DGS standards. It addresses the classification of an occupational disease, the challenge to the insurance company's medical decision and access to SNS treatment when the insurer refuses.

SAU-060.titulo_en: Mental Health and Work — Burnout, Harassment and Employer Liability
SAU-060.descricao_en: Analyses the employer's civil and employment-law liability for damage to an employee's mental health resulting from workplace bullying (assédio moral), severe burnout or working conditions that give rise to psychiatric illness, under the Labour Code (Articles 25, 29 and 127), Law No. 98/2009, the DGS guidance on mental health at work and Portuguese employment case law. It links employment law with health law.

UE-001.titulo_en: Request for a Preliminary Reference to the Court of Justice of the EU
UE-001.descricao_en: Prepares the draft questions for a preliminary ruling (reenvio prejudicial) to be referred to the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) under Article 267 TFEU, with the required legal and factual reasoning, including a statement of the national dispute, the relevance of the questions to the decision of the case and the precise wording of each question.

UE-002.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Direct Effect and Primacy of an EU Law Provision
UE-002.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing whether a provision of EU law (Treaty provision, regulation or directive article) has direct effect in the domestic legal order and whether the principle of primacy requires the national court or authority to disapply a conflicting national rule, with reference to the foundational case law of the CJEU.

UE-003.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Conformity of a National Rule with EU Law
UE-003.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion assessing whether a provision of Portuguese domestic law is compatible with primary and/or secondary European Union law, identifying the points of conflict, the EU rules breached and the legal consequences, including any obligation to disapply the rule or to make a preliminary reference.

UE-004.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Transposition (or Non-Transposition) of a Directive
UE-004.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion assessing whether an EU directive has been correctly transposed into Portuguese law, identifying gaps or incorrect transposition and analysing the legal consequences, namely the possibility of direct effect, the duty of consistent interpretation and State liability for failure to transpose or defective transposition.

UE-005.titulo_en: Statement of Claim Invoking State Liability for Breach of EU Law
UE-005.descricao_en: Prepares a statement of claim (or claim for compensation) establishing the non-contractual civil liability of the Portuguese State for breach of European Union law, based on the criteria laid down by the CJEU (Francovich/Brasserie du Pêcheur), setting out the conditions for liability, the damage caused and the claim for compensation.

UE-006.titulo_en: Complaint to the European Commission for Infringement of EU Law
UE-006.descricao_en: Prepares a formal complaint to the European Commission, using the CHAP form (Complaints Handling — Accueil des Plaintes) or in letter form, about an alleged failure by a Member State to comply with EU law, identifying the infringement, the applicable rules, the facts and the legal basis under Article 258 TFEU.

UE-007.descricao_en: Prepares a formal petition to the European Parliament's Committee on Petitions, under Article 227 TFEU and Article 44 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, concerning a breach of or failure to comply with European Union law, identifying the petitioner, the subject matter, the provision breached and the request.

UE-008.descricao_en: Prepares a formal complaint to the European Ombudsman about maladministration by an institution, body, office or agency of the European Union, under Article 228 TFEU and Article 43 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, identifying the problem, the institution concerned and the request for an inquiry.

UE-009.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Application of the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights
UE-009.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing whether the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union (CDFUE) applies to a given situation and, if so, whether a national or EU act is compatible with the rights guaranteed by the Charter, including analysis of the scope of application (Article 51), the nature of the rights at stake (rights vs. principles) and permissible limitations (Article 52).

UE-010.titulo_en: Analysis of the Applicability of an EU Regulation to a Specific Case
UE-010.descricao_en: Prepares a legal analysis determining whether a specific EU regulation applies to a given situation, identifying its material and territorial scope, the exemptions and exclusions provided for, the resulting obligations for the client and the risks of non-compliance.

UE-011.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Free Movement of Goods / Services / Persons / Capital
UE-011.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing whether a national measure or practice unlawfully restricts one of the four fundamental freedoms of the EU single market — free movement of goods (Articles 34-36 TFEU), services (Articles 56-62 TFEU), persons/workers (Articles 45-55 TFEU) or capital (Articles 63-66 TFEU) — and whether that restriction can be justified.

UE-012.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Recognition of Professional Qualifications in the EU
UE-012.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion and/or assists in preparing an application for recognition of professional qualifications obtained in another EU Member State, under Directive 2005/36/EC (Professional Qualifications Directive), analysing the applicable regime (automatic, general or European professional recognition), the procedures, the time limits and any compensation measures.

UE-013.titulo_en: Application for Recognition and Enforcement of a Foreign Judgment (Brussels I bis Regulation)
UE-013.descricao_en: Prepares an application for recognition and/or enforcement of a civil or commercial judgment given by a court of another EU Member State, under Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 (Brussels I bis), including analysis of the grounds for refusal and preparation of the documents required by the Portuguese court.

UE-014.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on International Jurisdiction and Applicable Law (Rome I and Rome II Regulations)
UE-014.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion determining: (a) the court with international jurisdiction over a dispute with a foreign element (under the Brussels I bis Regulation), (b) the law applicable to contractual obligations (Rome I Regulation — Regulation (EC) No 593/2008) and (c) the law applicable to non-contractual obligations (Rome II Regulation — Regulation (EC) No 864/2007), in cross-border contracts or disputes within the EU.

UE-015.titulo_en: Request for Cross-Border Service of Documents (Service Regulation)
UE-015.descricao_en: Prepares the request and the documents for service of process or notification of a procedural document (citação ou notificação) on an addressee in another EU Member State, under Regulation (EU) 2020/1784 (Service Regulation — recast), including the standard form, the documents to be transmitted and the instructions for the transmitting and receiving agencies.

UE-016.titulo_en: Request for the Taking of Evidence in Another Member State
UE-016.descricao_en: Prepares the request and the documents for taking evidence (examination of a witness, expert examination, inspection, request for documents) located in another EU Member State, under Regulation (EU) 2020/1783 (Taking of Evidence Regulation — recast), including the standard forms and the procedural reasoning.

UE-017.titulo_en: Application for a European Order for Payment
UE-017.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a European order for payment (IPE) under Regulation (EC) No 1896/2006, completing Form A and preparing the grounds of the claim in order to recover liquidated debts in cross-border disputes within the EU, without the need for contested proceedings if the debtor does not lodge a statement of opposition.

UE-018.titulo_en: Claim Form for the European Small Claims Procedure
UE-018.descricao_en: Prepares the claim form (Form A) for the European Small Claims Procedure (AEPM), under Regulation (EC) No 861/2007 (as amended by Regulation (EU) 2015/2421, which raised the threshold to €5,000), designed for low-value cross-border disputes in civil and commercial matters, including the grounds for the claim and the indication of evidence.

UE-019.titulo_en: Application for a European Account Preservation Order
UE-019.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a European Account Preservation Order (DEAC) under Regulation (EU) No 655/2014, designed to freeze a debtor's bank accounts in another EU Member State as a precautionary measure before or during court proceedings, including demonstration of the requirements (fumus boni iuris and periculum in mora) and the standard form.

UE-020.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the European Arrest Warrant
UE-020.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the European Arrest Warrant (EAW, MDE), under Council Framework Decision 2002/584/JHA and Law No. 65/2003 (the Portuguese transposing law), analysing the grounds for issuing it or refusing its execution, the mandatory and optional grounds for refusal, and the defence of the requested person (arguido) in surrender proceedings.

UE-021.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Application of a Directive between Private Parties (Horizontal Effect)
UE-021.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing the extent to which an EU directive produces effects in legal relationships between private parties (horizontal direct effect), the alternatives where horizontal direct effect is denied by CJEU case law (consistent interpretation, State liability, general principles of EU law with horizontal effect) and the most appropriate litigation strategy.

UE-022.titulo_en: Analysis of the Compatibility of Public Aid with the Internal Market
UE-022.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing whether a public measure (subsidy, tax exemption, State guarantee, equity participation, etc.) constitutes 'State aid' within the meaning of Article 107 TFEU and, if so, whether it is compatible with the internal market or must be notified to the European Commission, analysing the block exemptions and the risks of recovery.

UE-023.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on EU Citizenship and Associated Rights
UE-023.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion analysing the rights associated with citizenship of the European Union (Articles 20-25 TFEU) in a specific case, including the right of residence and free movement, the right to vote and stand for election, consular protection, the right to petition and to complain to the Ombudsman, and enhanced protection against expulsion, with particular attention to CJEU case law on the substance of citizenship (Ruiz Zambrano and subsequent cases).

UE-024.titulo_en: Application for Certification as a European Enforcement Order
UE-024.descricao_en: Prepares the application to certify a Portuguese court decision as a European Enforcement Order (TEE) under Regulation (EC) No 805/2004, allowing its direct enforcement in another Member State without the need for exequatur. It covers uncontested claims in civil and commercial matters.

UE-025.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Posting of Workers in the EU (Directives 96/71/EC and 2018/957/EU)
UE-025.descricao_en: Analyses the legal position of workers posted to or from Portugal under EU law, under Directive 96/71/EC (as amended by Directive 2018/957/EU) and the Labour Code. It covers the applicable working conditions, notification obligations, the law applicable to the contract and social security rules.

UE-026.titulo_en: Defence against a Decision Ordering Repayment of PT2030 / PRR Funds
UE-026.descricao_en: Prepares the defence of a beneficiary of PT2030 or PRR (Recovery and Resilience Plan) support against a decision ordering total or partial repayment of the funding, including the administrative challenge and, if necessary, the appeal to the courts. It covers the rules of Regulation (EU) 2021/1060 (Common Provisions) and national law on fund management.

UE-027.titulo_en: Compliance with the Digital Services Act (DSA — Regulation (EU) 2022/2065)
UE-027.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations of a digital platform or intermediary service provider under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act — DSA), and drafts the notice-and-takedown policy for illegal content, compliant terms of service and the transparency report.

UE-028.titulo_en: Compliance with the Digital Markets Act (DMA — Regulation (EU) 2022/1925)
UE-028.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations of an undertaking designated as a 'gatekeeper' under Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 (Digital Markets Act — DMA) and drafts the compliance report or the defence against a European Commission investigation for breach of the digital competition rules.

UE-029.titulo_en: Analysis of the Compatibility of Public Aid with the Internal Market — Block Exemption (GBER)
UE-029.descricao_en: Analyses whether public support (subsidy, tax exemption, guarantee, loan on favourable terms) benefits from the block exemption under the General Block Exemption Regulation (GBER, RGIC — Regulation (EU) No 651/2014, revised in 2023), removing the need for prior notification to the European Commission.

UE-030.titulo_en: Request for Access to Documents of the EU Institutions (Regulation 1049/2001)
UE-030.descricao_en: Prepares the request for access to documents of the institutions, bodies, offices and agencies of the European Union (Commission, Council, Parliament, agencies) under Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001, including the confirmatory application in the event of refusal and any judicial challenge before the General Court.

UE-031.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on EU International Sanctions and Their Impact on Contracts and Transactions
UE-031.descricao_en: Analyses the impact of sanctions imposed by the EU (Council Regulations under Article 215 TFEU) on contracts, business relationships and financial transactions of Portuguese companies or companies established in Portugal, including screening against lists of sanctioned persons and entities, compliance obligations and requests for authorisation/derogation.

UE-032.titulo_en: Challenge to an Award Decision in EU-Funded Public Procurement (European Pre-Contractual Litigation)
UE-032.descricao_en: Prepares the pre-contractual litigation challenge (contencioso pré-contratual) to an award decision in a public procurement procedure financed by European funds (PT2030, PRR), combining the national rules of the Public Contracts Code (CCP) with Directives 2014/24/EU and 2014/25/EU and the obligations of equal treatment and transparency arising from EU law.

UE-033.titulo_en: Defence in European Commission Infringement Proceedings (Article 258 TFEU) — Portuguese State's Perspective
UE-033.descricao_en: Prepares the Portuguese State's defence in response to a letter of formal notice from the European Commission in infringement proceedings for failure to comply with EU law (Article 258 TFEU), including the response to the reasoned opinion and the line of argument before the Court of Justice of the EU.

UE-034.titulo_en: Analysis of Applicable Law and Jurisdiction in Cross-Border Family Disputes (Brussels II ter Regulation)
UE-034.descricao_en: Analyses international jurisdiction and the applicable law in family disputes with a European connection (divorce, parental responsibilities (responsabilidades parentais), international child abduction), under Regulation (EU) 2019/1111 (Brussels II ter) and the applicable Hague Conventions, and drafts the appropriate application or defence.

UE-035.titulo_en: Compliance Analysis under the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act — Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
UE-035.descricao_en: Analyses the classification of an artificial intelligence system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), determines the compliance obligations applicable according to the risk category (unacceptable, high, limited, minimal) and drafts the required technical documentation and declaration of conformity.

UE-036.titulo_en: Merger Notification to the European Commission (Regulation (EC) 139/2004)
UE-036.descricao_en: Analyses whether a merger, acquisition or creation of a joint venture is subject to prior notification to the European Commission under Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 (EU Merger Regulation), and drafts Form CO or the Short Form (FS).

UE-037.titulo_en: Action for Annulment before the General Court of the EU (Article 263 TFEU)
UE-037.descricao_en: Prepares the action for annulment of an EU act (Commission decision, regulation, directive) before the General Court of the European Union under Article 263 TFEU, including analysis of the standing of private parties (the Plaumann criteria and subsequent developments), the grounds of illegality and the application for interim measures.

UE-038.titulo_en: Analysis of the Cross-Border Insolvency Regime in the EU (Regulation (EU) 2015/848)
UE-038.descricao_en: Analyses international jurisdiction, the applicable law and the effects of insolvency proceedings with a cross-border dimension in the EU under Regulation (EU) 2015/848 (Recast Insolvency Regulation), including the concept of 'centre of main interests' (COMI), automatic recognition and coordination between main and secondary proceedings.

UE-039.titulo_en: Protection of Portuguese Geographical Indications in the EU and Third Countries (Regulation (EU) 2024/1143)
UE-039.descricao_en: Analyses the protection regime for geographical indications (GIs) and protected designations of origin (PDOs) of Portuguese products under Regulation (EU) 2024/1143 (the new Regulation on GIs for agricultural and food products) and the GI chapters of EU free trade agreements, and drafts oppositions to applications to register conflicting GIs and actions for infringement of a protected GI.

UE-040.titulo_en: Analysis of Conflict of Laws in International Successions (Regulation (EU) 650/2012 — Substance)
UE-040.descricao_en: Analyses the law applicable to an international succession with connections to Portugal and to other Member States or third countries, under Regulation (EU) 650/2012, determining the law applicable to the succession as a whole, the possibilities for choice of law and the public policy limits, as distinct from the mere European Certificate of Succession.

UE-041.titulo_en: European Request for the Taking of Evidence (Regulation (EU) 2020/1783) and Civil Judicial Cooperation
UE-041.descricao_en: Prepares the European request for the taking of evidence under Regulation (EU) 2020/1783 (recast of Regulation 1206/2001) to obtain witness testimony, expert evidence, documents or inspections located in another EU Member State, and analyses the applicable forms and time limits.

UE-042.titulo_en: Non-Contractual Liability of the European Union (Article 340 TFEU) — Action for Damages
UE-042.descricao_en: Prepares the action for damages based on the non-contractual liability of the European Union under Article 340 TFEU, before the General Court of the EU, for damage caused by unlawful acts of EU institutions or servants in the performance of their duties.

UE-043.titulo_en: Request for Arbitration on International Double Taxation (EU Arbitration Convention and Directive 2017/1852)
UE-043.descricao_en: Prepares the request for resolution of a double taxation dispute between Portugal and another EU Member State under Directive (EU) 2017/1852 on tax dispute resolution mechanisms in the EU and Arbitration Convention 90/436/EEC (transfer pricing).

UE-044.titulo_en: Analysis of the Compatibility of a National Measure with the Freedom to Provide Services (Article 56 TFEU) and the Services Directive
UE-044.descricao_en: Analyses whether a national measure (authorisation, mandatory registration, restriction on the exercise of an activity) that conditions access to the Portuguese market by service providers from other Member States is compatible with Article 56 TFEU and Directive 2006/123/EC (Services Directive), and drafts the legal opinion or the complaint to the European Commission.

UE-045.titulo_en: Service Level Agreement and EU Regulatory Compliance Clauses in Cloud Computing Contracts
UE-045.descricao_en: Drafts the EU law compliance clauses for cloud computing contracts, covering the DORA Regulation (Digital Operational Resilience Act), the GDPR (RGPD), the AI Act (where applicable), the Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers and the requirements of the Data Act (Regulation (EU) 2023/2854).

UE-046.titulo_en: Public-Private Partnership and Infrastructure Financing with EU Funds — Legal Compliance
UE-046.descricao_en: Analyses the legal framework of a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) co-financed by European structural funds (PT2030/ERDF (FEDER)/Cohesion Fund (FC)), checking compliance with the expenditure eligibility rules, compatibility with competition law (State aid) and the transparency and public procurement requirements.

UE-047.titulo_en: Analysis of Workers' Rights in Restructurings with a European Dimension (Directive 2002/14/EC and European Works Council)
UE-047.descricao_en: Analyses employees' information and consultation rights and the mandatory collective bargaining procedures in restructurings of companies present in several EU Member States, under Directive 2002/14/EC (general framework for informing and consulting employees) and Directive 2009/38/EC (European Works Council — EWC).

UE-048.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Customs Protection and Import Duties in the EU (Customs Union and Union Customs Code)
UE-048.descricao_en: Analyses the tariff classification of goods imported into or exported from the EU, the calculation of customs duties under the Union Customs Code (UCC, CAU — Regulation (EU) No 952/2013), challenges to customs decisions and the application of anti-dumping and safeguard measures.

UE-049.titulo_en: Enhanced Cooperation — Analysis and Participation of Portugal (Article 20 TEU and Articles 326-334 TFEU)
UE-049.descricao_en: Analyses the requirements and legal implications for Portugal of participating in an enhanced cooperation already authorised by the Council, or of joining a group of States seeking to launch a new enhanced cooperation, under Article 20 TEU and Articles 326-334 TFEU.

UE-050.titulo_en: Defence in European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) Proceedings — Offences Affecting the EU's Financial Interests
UE-050.descricao_en: Prepares the defence strategy and pleadings in criminal proceedings conducted by the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) under Regulation (EU) 2017/1939, for alleged criminal offences affecting the financial interests of the EU (fraud involving European funds, related money laundering, active corruption of EU officials).

UE-051.titulo_en: Analysis of the Application of the Data Act (Regulation (EU) 2023/2854) to Connected Products and Related Services
UE-051.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations to give access to and share data generated by connected products (IoT) or related services under Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 (Data Act), drafts the contractual clauses on data access and analyses the mandatory access interfaces for users and public authorities.

UE-052.titulo_en: Complaint about a Breach of Charter Fundamental Rights (Article 41 — Right to Good Administration) in an EU Procedure
UE-052.descricao_en: Prepares the complaint to the European Ombudsman for breach of the right to good administration (Article 41 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU) in a procedure of an institution, body, office or agency of the European Union, including the strategy for a friendly solution and any subsequent recourse to the Court of Justice.

UE-053.titulo_en: Recognition of Regulated Professional Qualifications in the EU (Directive 2005/36/EC)
UE-053.descricao_en: Analyses the recognition procedure for the professional qualifications of a citizen of another EU Member State wishing to practise a regulated profession in Portugal, or of a Portuguese professional wishing to practise in another Member State, under Directive 2005/36/EC and the European Professional Services Regulation, including challenges to refusals and compensation measures.

UE-054.titulo_en: Consumer Protection in Cross-Border Disputes in the EU — ADR/ODR and European Representative Actions
UE-054.descricao_en: Analyses the means of resolving cross-border consumer disputes in the EU, including Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR, RAL — Directive 2013/11/EU), the Online Dispute Resolution platform (ODR — Regulation (EU) 524/2013) and the new Representative Actions Directive (Directive (EU) 2020/1828) for collective consumer disputes.

UE-055.titulo_en: Subsidiarity Review — Reasoned Opinion of a National Parliament or Assembly (Article 5 TEU and Protocol No 2)
UE-055.descricao_en: Prepares the reasoned opinion of a national parliament (the Assembly of the Republic, Assembleia da República) on the breach of the principle of subsidiarity by an EU legislative proposal, under Protocol No 2 on the application of the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality annexed to the TEU and the TFEU, within the early warning mechanism.

UE-056.titulo_en: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM — Regulation (EU) 2023/956) — Obligations and Defence
UE-056.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations of a Portuguese importer under Regulation (EU) 2023/956 (CBAM — Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), including registration as an authorised declarant, quarterly CBAM reports during the transitional phase, calculation of CBAM certificates in the definitive phase and challenges to decisions of the national competent authority.

UE-057.titulo_en: Analysis of EU Association Agreements and Free Trade Agreements — Application to Portuguese Contracts and Exports
UE-057.descricao_en: Analyses the benefits and obligations of the Association Agreements and Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) concluded by the EU with third countries as applied to exports or imports by Portuguese companies, including preferential rules of origin, dispute resolution mechanisms and investment protection clauses.

UE-058.titulo_en: REACH Regulation — Registration, Evaluation and Restriction of Chemical Substances in the EU (Regulation (EC) 1907/2006)
UE-058.descricao_en: Analyses a company's obligations under Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH), including the duty to register substances with the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA), communication of information in the supply chain (safety data sheets), restrictions and authorisations for substances of very high concern (SVHC), and the defence in proceedings for breaches of REACH legislation in Portugal.

UE-059.titulo_en: Compliance Analysis under the European Health Data Space Regulation (EHDS — Regulation (EU) 2025/327)
UE-059.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations of healthcare providers, health data holders and health data users under Regulation (EU) 2025/327 (European Health Data Space — EHDS), including portability of the electronic health record, the regime for secondary use of health data and GDPR (RGPD) compliance in the health context.

UE-060.titulo_en: Compliance Analysis under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA — Regulation (EU) 2023/1114)
UE-060.descricao_en: Analyses the obligations of crypto-asset issuers and crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) under Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 (MiCA — Markets in Crypto-Assets), including the authorisation process with the Banco de Portugal/Securities Market Commission (CMVM), the white paper obligations and the reserve requirements for issuers of asset-referenced tokens.

SUC-001.titulo_en: Draft Public Will (Instructions for the Notary)
SUC-001.descricao_en: Generates a detailed draft setting out the instructions and provisions to be given to the notary for drawing up a public will (testamento público), covering legacies, appointment of heirs, conditions, charges and any specific clauses the testator wishes to include.

SUC-002.descricao_en: Generates the complete draft of a closed will (testamento cerrado) — a document written and signed by the testator (or by another person at the testator's request), then delivered to the notary for approval and formal sealing, under Articles 2206 to 2210 of the Civil Code.

SUC-003.titulo_en: Testamentary Clause for a Specific Legacy
SUC-003.descricao_en: Drafts testamentary clauses for a specific legacy — disposition of a particular asset in favour of a named person (legatee) — precisely identifying the subject matter, conditions, charges and effects on the disposable portion, under Articles 2249 et seq. of the Civil Code.

SUC-004.descricao_en: Drafts clauses of direct (ordinary) substitution and fideicommissary substitution for wills, precisely defining the fiduciary, the fideicommissary, the time of transfer and the legal limits — with attention to Articles 2286 to 2295 of the Civil Code.

SUC-005.titulo_en: Declaration of Acceptance of an Inheritance
SUC-005.descricao_en: Generates the declaration of acceptance of an inheritance — unconditional (pura e simples) or with the benefit of inventory (a benefício de inventário) — with the correct legal grounds and identification of the declarant and the known assets, for submission in inventory proceedings or to any entity requiring formal acceptance.

SUC-006.titulo_en: Declaration of Renunciation of an Inheritance
SUC-006.descricao_en: Generates the formal declaration of renunciation (repúdio) of an inheritance, with the legal grounds, the effects on the subsequent devolution of the estate and the tax consequences, under Articles 2062 to 2067 of the Civil Code.

SUC-007.descricao_en: Drafts the application or the draft deed of qualification of heirs (habilitação de herdeiros) — the document proving who the deceased's successors are, needed to register assets, withdraw bank balances, transfer vehicles and carry out other post-mortem acts.

SUC-008.titulo_en: Application for Inventory Proceedings (Division of an Estate)
SUC-008.descricao_en: Generates the initial application to open notarial inventory proceedings (inventário), identifying the interested parties, giving a summary list of assets and requesting urgent measures, under Law No. 23/2013 of 5 March (as amended by Law No. 117/2019 of 13 September).

SUC-009.descricao_en: Generates the complete list of assets (relação de bens) for submission in inventory proceedings, itemising the estate's assets, liabilities and advances on account of the forced heirship share (collation — colação), with the structure required by the Civil Code and the Notarial Inventory Law.

SUC-010.titulo_en: Challenge to the List of Assets
SUC-010.descricao_en: Generates the application challenging the list of assets submitted by the estate administrator (cabeça-de-casal) in inventory proceedings, alleging omitted or incorrect items, with legal grounds and requests for evidential steps.

SUC-011.titulo_en: Objection to the Division / Opposition to the Division Map
SUC-011.descricao_en: Drafts the formal objection to the division map (mapa da partilha) prepared by the notary in inventory proceedings, alleging breach of the forced heirship share (quota legitimária), errors in the valuation of items, unjustified inequality in the distribution or failure to observe testamentary provisions.

SUC-012.titulo_en: Calculation of the Forced Heirship Share and the Disposable Portion
