SUC-012.descricao_en: Calculates with arithmetical and legal rigour the testator's forced heirship share (legítima) and disposable portion (quota disponível), based on the family composition and the value of the estate, with a detailed calculation note and warnings on inofficious gifts — under Articles 2156 to 2178 of the Civil Code.

SUC-013.titulo_en: Calculation of Collation of Gifts and Bringing Values into Account
SUC-013.descricao_en: Calculates the collation (colação) of lifetime gifts made to forced heirs, determining the value each donee must bring into account in the inventory, with a detailed calculation note and identification of the effects on the division — under Articles 2104 to 2122 of the Civil Code.

SUC-014.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Reduction of Inofficious Liberalities
SUC-014.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to reduce inofficious liberalities (redução de liberalidades inoficiosas) — where testamentary provisions or lifetime gifts by the deceased encroach on the forced heirs' reserved share — with a calculation of the excess, legal grounds and specific requests, under Articles 2168 to 2178 of the Civil Code.

SUC-015.titulo_en: Statement of Claim to Recover an Inheritance (Petição de Herança)
SUC-015.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to recover an inheritance (petição de herança) — brought by an heir excluded from possession of the estate assets by a third party claiming to be an heir or holding no title at all — with legal grounds and claims for delivery and compensation, under Articles 2075 to 2078 of the Civil Code.

SUC-016.titulo_en: Statement of Claim to Annul a Will
SUC-016.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to annul a will (or have it declared void), alleging formal defects or defects of consent — incapacity of the testator, mistake, fraud, duress or simulation — based on Articles 2186 to 2201 of the Civil Code.

SUC-017.descricao_en: Generates the out-of-court division agreement among all the heirs, itemising the assets allocated to each, the equalisation payments (tornas) due and the declarations needed for registration and tax purposes, replacing inventory proceedings where all interested parties agree.

SUC-018.titulo_en: Application to Appoint / Remove the Estate Administrator (Cabeça-de-Casal)
SUC-018.descricao_en: Generates the application to appoint an alternative estate administrator (cabeça-de-casal) or to remove the acting one where they breach their duties or do not meet the legal requirements, under Articles 2079 to 2093 of the Civil Code and the Notarial Inventory Law.

SUC-019.titulo_en: Rendering of Accounts by the Estate Administrator
SUC-019.descricao_en: Generates the statement of accounts rendered by the estate administrator (cabeça-de-casal) in inventory proceedings, itemising income, expenses, acts of administration of the estate assets and the balance to be transferred to the estate, under Articles 2085 and 2091 to 2093 of the Civil Code.

SUC-020.titulo_en: Calculation of Stamp Duty on Gratuitous Transfers (Inheritance and Gifts)
SUC-020.descricao_en: Calculates the Stamp Duty (Imposto do Selo) due on gratuitous transfers on death (inheritance) and lifetime gifts, identifying the applicable exemptions, the rate, the taxable base and the assessment deadline — under the Stamp Duty Code (CIS) and the General Stamp Duty Table (TGIS).

SUC-021.titulo_en: Opinion on the Surviving Spouse's Succession Rights alongside Descendants
SUC-021.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the succession rights of the surviving spouse concurring with descendants — share of the estate, right of residence in the family home, half share (meação) and the specific features of the property regime — under Articles 2103-A and 2139 et seq. of the Civil Code.

SUC-022.titulo_en: Application concerning Concealment of Estate Assets (Sonegação)
SUC-022.descricao_en: Drafts the application alleging concealment of estate assets (sonegação) against the heir who omitted assets from the list of assets or hid them, requesting the sanction provided for in Article 2096 of the Civil Code — loss of the right to the concealed assets.

SUC-023.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Division of Jointly Owned Property between Heirs
SUC-023.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action for division of jointly owned property (divisão de coisa comum) between co-heirs where they cannot agree on the division of undivided assets — notably real estate — and one heir wishes to end the co-ownership, under Articles 1412 et seq. of the Civil Code and Articles 925 et seq. of the Code of Civil Procedure.

SUC-024.titulo_en: Declaration of Assignment of a Hereditary Share
SUC-024.descricao_en: Drafts the declaration/contract assigning a hereditary share (cessão de quinhão hereditário) — the instrument by which an heir assigns their share (quinhão) in the undivided estate to another heir or a third party before the final division — identifying the parties, the price or basis of the assignment and the formalities required, under Articles 2124 et seq. of the Civil Code.

SUC-025.titulo_en: Notice to Exercise the Pre-Emption Right on Assignment of a Hereditary Share
SUC-025.descricao_en: Generates the formal notice sent by the assigning heir to the co-heirs so that they may exercise their pre-emption right (direito de preferência) before the hereditary share is assigned for value to a third party, under Article 2130 of the Civil Code.

SUC-026.titulo_en: Inventory to Separate the Spouses' Half Shares before Division of the Estate
SUC-026.descricao_en: Generates the application and structure of proceedings to separate the half shares (separação de meações) within inventory proceedings following the death of a spouse married under a community regime, identifying the common property and each spouse's separate property and determining the surviving spouse's half share before the estate is divided.

SUC-027.titulo_en: Opinion on International Succession (EU Succession Regulation / Regulation 650/2012)
SUC-027.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the applicable law and international jurisdiction in succession matters with a cross-border element, under Regulation (EU) No. 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council (European Succession Regulation), analysing habitual residence, choice of law and the European Certificate of Succession.

SUC-028.titulo_en: Application for a European Certificate of Succession
SUC-028.descricao_en: Generates the application for issue of the European Certificate of Succession (Certificado Sucessório Europeu, CSE), the document enabling an heir, legatee or executor to prove their status and rights in any Member State of the European Union, under Articles 62 to 73 of Regulation (EU) No. 650/2012.

SUC-029.titulo_en: Checklist of Documents for Opening a Succession
SUC-029.descricao_en: Generates a complete, tailored checklist of the documents needed to open a succession in Portugal — qualification of heirs, notarial inventory or out-of-court division — adapted to the deceased's specific family and asset situation.

SUC-030.titulo_en: Notice Letter to Co-Heirs for an Amicable Division
SUC-030.descricao_en: Generates the out-of-court notice letter sent by one heir to the other co-heirs, proposing an amicable division of the estate with a deadline for reply and warning that court or notarial inventory proceedings will follow if no agreement is reached — as a first step before starting formal proceedings.

SUC-031.titulo_en: Disinheritance — Testamentary Clause and Legal Grounds
SUC-031.descricao_en: Drafts the testamentary clause disinheriting a forced heir (deserdação), identifying the legal ground, the specific cause and the effect on the estate, under Articles 2166 to 2170 of the Civil Code (Book V — Law of Succession) and the case law of the Courts of Appeal (Tribunais da Relação).

SUC-032.titulo_en: Unworthiness to Inherit — Statement of Claim for a Court Declaration
SUC-032.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action for a declaration of unworthiness to inherit (indignidade sucessória), based on Articles 2034 to 2038 of the Civil Code (Book V), identifying the ground of unworthiness, its effects and the rules on rehabilitation of the unworthy heir.

SUC-033.titulo_en: Estate Pending Acceptance (Herança Jacente) — Appointment of a Curator and Administration
SUC-033.descricao_en: Drafts the application to appoint a curator of an estate pending acceptance (herança jacente) and the set of interim acts of administration, under Articles 2046 to 2049 of the Civil Code (Book V) and Articles 1072 to 1085 of the Code of Civil Procedure.

SUC-034.titulo_en: Lifetime Division — Gift with Reserved Usufruct and Imputation to the Forced Heirship Share
SUC-034.descricao_en: Drafts a lifetime gift with reservation of usufruct and a clause imputing it to the forced heirship share (advance on the legítima), under Articles 2104 to 2118 of the Civil Code (Book V — collation) and Articles 940 et seq. CC (gifts), including the Stamp Duty implications.

SUC-035.titulo_en: Reciprocal Renunciation by Spouses — Agreement to Renounce an Inheritance ("Pacto Corvina")
SUC-035.descricao_en: Analyses the lawfulness and limits of agreements on future succession, focusing on the prohibition of the pacto corvina (Art. 2028 CC), and advises on the lawful mechanisms spouses can use to achieve similar effects, including the mutual will and gifts mortis causa, under the Civil Code (Book V) and Law No. 117/2019.

SUC-036.titulo_en: Succession to Shareholdings — Quotas and Shares on a Shareholder's Death
SUC-036.descricao_en: Analyses the rules on the transfer of quotas and shares on a shareholder's death, under Articles 225 et seq. of the Commercial Companies Code (CSC) and Articles 328 et seq. CSC for public limited companies (SA), in conjunction with the rules of the Civil Code (Book V) and the company's articles of association.

SUC-037.titulo_en: Widow's Usufruct and the Surviving Spouse's Real Right of Residence
SUC-037.descricao_en: Analyses and calculates the specific rights of a surviving spouse concurring with descendants — statutory widow's usufruct (usufruto vidual) over a share of the estate and a real right of residence in the family home —, under Articles 2103-A and 2103-B of the Civil Code, introduced by Law No. 48/2021 of 6 July.

SUC-038.titulo_en: Appointment of an Executor — Testamentary Clause and Powers
SUC-038.descricao_en: Drafts the testamentary clause appointing an executor (testamenteiro), defining their powers and duties, under Articles 2320 to 2334 of the Civil Code (Book V — execution of wills), including the rules on rendering accounts and coordination with the estate administrator (cabeça-de-casal).

SUC-039.titulo_en: Reversion Clause in a Gift — Rules and Drafting
SUC-039.descricao_en: Drafts a reversion clause in a gift for the case where the donee predeceases the donor without descendants, under Articles 959 and 960 of the Civil Code, analysing the limits of this condition subsequent and its interplay with the Land Registry and Stamp Duty.

SUC-040.titulo_en: Special Curator for an Incapacitated Heir — Appointment and Role in Inventory Proceedings
SUC-040.descricao_en: Drafts the application to appoint a special curator (curador especial) to represent a minor heir or a supported adult (maior acompanhado) in inventory proceedings, under Articles 18 et seq. of the Civil Code, the supported adult regime (Law No. 49/2018) and the notarial inventory regime (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-041.titulo_en: Representation in Succession and Right of Accrual — Analysis and Application
SUC-041.descricao_en: Analyses and applies the doctrines of representation in succession (representação sucessória, Articles 2039 to 2045 CC) and the right of accrual (direito de acrescer, Articles 2137 to 2142 CC), distinguishing the requirements of each and calculating the resulting hereditary shares.

SUC-042.titulo_en: Transfer of a Business on Death — Rules and Continuity
SUC-042.descricao_en: Analyses the legal rules on the transfer of a commercial or industrial business (estabelecimento comercial) on the owner's death, combining the Civil Code (Book V), the Commercial Companies Code and the Labour Code (Arts. 285 et seq. CT), with a focus on continuity of operations during inventory proceedings.

SUC-043.titulo_en: Succession Planning for a Family Business — Protocol and Strategy
SUC-043.descricao_en: Drafts the family business protocol as an instrument of integrated succession planning, combining the Civil Code (Book V), the Commercial Companies Code and the prenuptial agreement, to ensure the continuity and preservation of the business in the next generation.

SUC-044.titulo_en: Conflict between a Will and a Prenuptial Agreement — Analysis and Resolution
SUC-044.descricao_en: Analyses conflicts between testamentary provisions and clauses of a prenuptial agreement, determining which prevails and the effects of each instrument, under Articles 1700 to 1707 of the Civil Code (prenuptial agreements) and Book V CC (Law of Succession).

SUC-045.titulo_en: De Facto Division — Court Recognition and Regularisation
SUC-045.descricao_en: Analyses de facto division (heirs who have informally divided the assets without formalising the division) and the mechanisms to regularise that situation legally, under the Civil Code (Book V), the Land Registry Code and the notarial inventory regime (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-046.titulo_en: Concealment of Estate Assets — Application and Sanction
SUC-046.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a declaration of concealment of estate assets (sonegação) and analyses its legal consequences (loss of the right to the concealed asset and a fine), under Articles 2096 to 2099 of the Civil Code and the notarial inventory regime (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-047.titulo_en: Stamp Duty on Inheritance Transfers — Calculation and Return
SUC-047.descricao_en: Calculates Stamp Duty (Imposto do Selo) on transfers on death (inheritance and legacies) under the Stamp Duty Code (CIS), item 1.2 of the TGIS, analysing the exemptions for the spouse and descendants/ascendants, and explains the filing obligation (Model 1 IS) and the payment deadline.

SUC-048.titulo_en: Declaration of Absence and Succession Effects — Rules and Procedure
SUC-048.descricao_en: Analyses the rules on declared absence (Articles 89 to 121 CC) and their effects in the law of succession, notably the provisional opening of the succession, the provisional division of the assets and the reversal mechanisms if the absent person returns, in conjunction with the notarial inventory regime.

SUC-049.titulo_en: Residuary Fideicommissum — Rules and Testamentary Clause
SUC-049.descricao_en: Drafts the testamentary clause for a residuary fideicommissum (fideicomisso de resíduo — a variant in which the fiduciary may consume the assets, owing the remainder to the fideicommissary), under Articles 2286 to 2295 of the Civil Code (Book V — fideicommissum) and the case law of the Supreme Court of Justice (Supremo Tribunal de Justiça).

SUC-050.titulo_en: Family Agreement Resolving an Inheritance Dispute — Mediation and Agreement
SUC-050.descricao_en: Structures the out-of-court agreement resolving a dispute between heirs, combining family mediation (Law No. 29/2013 of 19 April) with a court-approved division agreement, under the Civil Code (Book V) and the notarial inventory regime (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-051.titulo_en: Acknowledgement of Paternity and Succession Effects — Late Recognition of Paternity
SUC-051.descricao_en: Analyses the succession effects of an acknowledgement of paternity (perfilhação) made after the father's death or after a division has already taken place, under Articles 1847 et seq. of the Civil Code and Articles 2033 and 2071 CC, including the action to recover an inheritance (petição de herança) by the acknowledged child.

SUC-052.titulo_en: Acceptance of an Inheritance with the Benefit of Inventory — Procedure and Advantages
SUC-052.descricao_en: Advises on accepting an inheritance with the benefit of inventory (a benefício de inventário) as a way of limiting the heir's liability to the value of the estate, under Articles 2052 to 2070 of the Civil Code (Book V), distinguishing it from unconditional acceptance and from renunciation.

SUC-053.titulo_en: Notice for an Amicable Division — Time Limit and Mechanism
SUC-053.descricao_en: Drafts the judicial or out-of-court notice to co-heirs to proceed with the division of the estate, under Articles 2101 and 2102 of the Civil Code, and analyses the means of compelling an heir who refuses to divide, including recourse to notarial inventory proceedings (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-054.titulo_en: European Certificate of Succession — Application and Cross-Border Use
SUC-054.descricao_en: Guides the application for and use of the European Certificate of Succession (CSE), an instrument of Regulation (EU) No. 650/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council, to prove status as heir, legatee, executor or administrator of the estate in the EU Member States.

SUC-055.titulo_en: Interim Protection of the Estate — Listing and Preservation of Estate Assets (Arrolamento)
SUC-055.descricao_en: Drafts the application for an interim measure (providência cautelar) of arrolamento (court-ordered listing and preservation) of estate assets to preserve the estate during inventory proceedings or before they are opened, under Articles 403 and 421 of the Code of Civil Procedure and Articles 2079 et seq. of the Civil Code.

SUC-056.titulo_en: Inventory to Separate Half Shares — Division of the Couple's Property before the Estate
SUC-056.descricao_en: Guides the procedure for separating the half shares (separação de meações) as a step prior to dividing the estate, identifying the couple's common property and each spouse's separate property, under Articles 1790 et seq. of the Civil Code (property regime) in conjunction with notarial inventory proceedings (Law No. 117/2019).

SUC-057.titulo_en: Legacies in a Will — Execution and Delivery to the Legatee
SUC-057.descricao_en: Guides the execution of testamentary legacies — specific, generic and periodic payments — under Articles 2249 to 2285 of the Civil Code (Book V), including the legatee's request for delivery, imputation to the disposable portion and reduction for inofficiousness.

SUC-058.titulo_en: Registration of a Will with the IRN — Registration and Search Procedure
SUC-058.descricao_en: Explains the procedure for registering a will in the National Register of Wills and Codicils (RNTC) of the Institute of Registries and Notary (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado, IRN), under Decree-Law No. 47/2013 of 5 April, including the search for wills after death and coordination with the qualification of heirs.

SUC-059.titulo_en: Ordinary Testamentary Substitution — Clause and Rules
SUC-059.descricao_en: Drafts the clause of ordinary testamentary substitution (substituição vulgar), by which the testator appoints a substitute in case the heir or legatee cannot or will not accept the inheritance, under Articles 2281 to 2285 of the Civil Code (Book V).

SUC-060.titulo_en: Reduction of Inofficious Liberalities — Statement of Claim
SUC-060.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action to reduce inofficious liberalities (gifts or wills exceeding the disposable portion), under Articles 2168 to 2181 of the Civil Code (Book V), including the calculation of the excess and the order of reduction.

DES-001.titulo_en: Sports Employment Contract for a Professional Athlete
DES-001.descricao_en: Drafts a complete sports employment contract for a professional athlete (praticante desportivo profissional) under Law No. 54/2017 of 14 July (Sports Employment Contract Law — LCTD), with mandatory clauses, remuneration, duties of the parties, image rights, the disciplinary regime and termination with compensation for breach without just cause.

DES-002.titulo_en: Sports Training Contract for a Young Athlete
DES-002.descricao_en: Drafts a sports training contract (contrato de formação desportiva) for a young athlete under Articles 32 to 36 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), including training clauses, the club's option right, training compensation in the event of a transfer, protection of minors and authorisation by the legal representatives.

DES-003.descricao_en: Drafts a representation agreement between an athlete and their sports agent (empresário desportivo), defining the scope of the mandate, commission, exclusivity, duties of loyalty, conflicts of interest and termination. It falls within the general mandate regime of the Civil Code and the applicable regulations of the international federations (FIFA, FIBA, etc.).

DES-004.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the temporary loan of an athlete between two clubs under Article 24 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and Article 38 of the Labour Code (Código do Trabalho), governing the temporary transfer of the employment relationship, each club's responsibilities during the loan, remuneration, injuries and reintegration into the lending club.

DES-005.descricao_en: Drafts a permanent transfer agreement for an athlete between clubs, structuring payment of the transfer fee, sell-on fee clauses, solidarity percentages, deferred payment obligations, conditions precedent and subsequent, and compliance with FIFA and national federation regulations.

DES-006.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the assignment and exploitation of an athlete's image rights in favour of a club, brand or commercial partner, defining the scope of the assignment, authorised uses, financial consideration, exclusivities, protection of moral image and termination conditions, within the framework of personality rights under the Portuguese Civil Code.

DES-007.descricao_en: Drafts a sports sponsorship agreement between a club/athlete and a sponsor, structuring the consideration (visibility, advertising, hospitality), the sponsored party's obligations, category exclusivity, naming rights, penalties for sporting or disciplinary conduct, and the tax treatment of the transaction in Portugal.

DES-008.titulo_en: Agreement Terminating a Sports Employment Contract
DES-008.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement terminating a sports employment contract by mutual consent under Article 23 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and Article 349 of the Labour Code, structuring the compensation due, mutual discharge, remaining obligations (image rights, transfer of documents) and registration with the federation.

DES-009.descricao_en: Drafts the defence of an athlete or club in sports disciplinary proceedings brought by the federation or professional league, contesting the charge, invoking procedural guarantees, submitting evidence and setting out mitigating circumstances, based on the applicable disciplinary regulations and the general principles of sanctioning law.

DES-010.titulo_en: Appeal against a Disciplinary Decision to the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD)
DES-010.descricao_en: Drafts the appeal against a sports disciplinary decision to the Sports Arbitration Court (Tribunal Arbitral do Desporto — TAD) under Law No. 74/2013 of 6 September, invoking the grounds for annulment or amendment of the decision under appeal and its formal and substantive defects, and formulating requests appropriate to the scope of the TAD's review.

DES-011.titulo_en: Request for Arbitration before the Sports Arbitration Court
DES-011.descricao_en: Drafts the request to commence arbitration proceedings before the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD) for disputes arising from sports contracts or sports legal relationships under Law No. 74/2013, structuring the statement of facts, the relief sought, the legal grounds and the amount in dispute.

DES-012.titulo_en: Application Challenging a Sports Federation Resolution
DES-012.descricao_en: Drafts the application challenging a resolution of a sports federation before the TAD or the administrative courts, invoking the grounds of invalidity (lack of competence, procedural defect, breach of law, misuse of power) and the applicable constitutional and administrative principles, and formulating the appropriate requests.

DES-013.titulo_en: Opinion on Just Cause for Termination of a Sports Contract
DES-013.descricao_en: Issues a reasoned legal opinion on whether certain facts constitute just cause for termination of a sports employment contract by the athlete or the club, assessing the risk of an order to pay compensation, the prospects before the TAD and the most appropriate strategy (termination, negotiation or seeing the contract through to its end).

DES-014.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation for Termination of a Sports Contract
DES-014.descricao_en: Calculates the compensation due on early termination of a sports employment contract, with or without just cause, under Articles 26 to 29 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), itemising each component (remaining salaries, employment claims, contractual penalty) and presenting the total amount to be claimed before the TAD.

DES-015.titulo_en: Opinion on Training Compensation / Solidarity Mechanism
DES-015.descricao_en: Issues an opinion on the right to training compensation owed to the training club and on the solidarity mechanism applicable to athlete transfers, under Article 34 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and FIFA and national federation regulations, calculating the estimated amounts and each party's obligations.

DES-016.titulo_en: Appeal against a Decision of the Disciplinary Committee / Justice Council
DES-016.descricao_en: Drafts the internal hierarchical appeal against a disciplinary decision issued by the Disciplinary Committee or equivalent body, addressed to the Justice Council (Conselho de Justiça) or a higher body of the federation, prior to the exhaustion of internal remedies required to appeal to the TAD, invoking the defects of the decision and the disproportionality of the sanction.

DES-017.titulo_en: Complaint against a Refusal to Register an Athlete
DES-017.descricao_en: Drafts the complaint or challenge against a refusal by the sports federation or professional league to register an athlete, invoking the legal and regulatory registration requirements, the deficient reasoning of the refusal and the rights of the athlete and the club to take part in the competition, and seeking immediate registration or suspension of the effects of the refusal.

DES-018.titulo_en: Opinion on Injury Rules and Sports Insurance
DES-018.descricao_en: Issues an opinion on the athlete's rights in the event of an injury sustained during sporting activity, analysing whether the contract and remuneration continue during incapacity, the club's sports insurance obligations, the applicable Social Security (Segurança Social) regime and the situations in which the athlete may terminate for just cause owing to failures in health and safety obligations.

DES-019.titulo_en: Analysis of Competition Regulations and Club Rights
DES-019.descricao_en: Analyses sports competition regulations to identify the rights and obligations of participating clubs, potentially unlawful or disproportionate clauses, the dispute resolution mechanisms provided for, broadcasting rights and revenues, and the conditions for relegation, exclusion or non-participation, with recommendations for negotiation or challenge.

DES-020.titulo_en: Opinion on Sports Integrity and Match-Fixing
DES-020.descricao_en: Issues a legal opinion on suspicions or charges of match-fixing and sports corruption, analysing the criminal framework (offence of sports corruption), the sporting disciplinary consequences, the obligations to report to the authorities, the defence rights of the accused (arguido) and recommendations for immediate conduct for the athletes, clubs and officials involved.

DES-021.titulo_en: Termination of a Sports Contract by the Athlete for Just Cause
DES-021.descricao_en: Drafts a reasoned letter terminating the sports employment contract at the initiative of the professional athlete for just cause, under Article 26 of Law No. 54/2017 of 14 July (Sports Employment Contract Law — LCTD), with reference to Article 394 of the Labour Code as applicable on a subsidiary basis. Analyses the facts that may be invoked (non-payment of remuneration, undignified working conditions, breach of guarantees), calculates the notice waived and identifies the right to compensation from the club.

DES-022.titulo_en: Negotiating and Drafting a Release Clause in a Sports Contract
DES-022.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts a release clause (buy-out clause) in a sports employment contract for a professional athlete, under Article 23 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and the FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players (RSTP). Assesses the proportionality of the amount, the activation mechanism, the payment deadlines and the tax and regulatory implications.

DES-023.descricao_en: Prepares a services agreement for sports intermediation between an athlete (or club) and a registered intermediary, in compliance with the FIFA Football Agent Regulations (FFAR, 2023), the Intermediaries Regulations of the FPF (Portuguese Football Federation) and Articles 17 to 22 of the said regulations, which set commission caps, registration duties and incompatibilities.

DES-024.titulo_en: Sports Disciplinary Proceedings — Defence of the Athlete or Club
DES-024.descricao_en: Prepares the defence in sports disciplinary proceedings brought against an athlete, coach or club under the FPF Disciplinary Regulations, the Disciplinary Regulations of the LPFP (Portuguese Professional Football League) or the UEFA/FIFA Disciplinary Code, invoking the guarantees of Article 32 of the Constitution of the Portuguese Republic, Article 7 of Law No. 74/2013 (TAD Statute) and the principles of prior hearing and proportionality.

DES-025.titulo_en: Appeal against a Disciplinary Decision to the TAD — Petition in Mandatory Arbitration
DES-025.descricao_en: Prepares the appeal petition against a sports disciplinary decision to the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD), under Article 4 of Law No. 74/2013 of 6 September (TAD Statute) and Articles 5 et seq. of the same law, invoking the grounds for annulment (formal defects, lack of competence, breach of the principle of proportionality and of the rights of defence).

DES-026.titulo_en: Employment Contract for a Professional Coach
DES-026.descricao_en: Drafts a sports employment contract for a professional coach under Articles 35 et seq. of Law No. 54/2017 of 14 July (LCTD) and the FPF/LPFP Coaches Regulations, including base remuneration, performance bonuses, a release clause, assignment of image rights and regulatory obligations (coaching card, insurance).

DES-027.titulo_en: Opinion on Sports Insurance and Liability for Athlete Injury
DES-027.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of mandatory sports insurance under Article 41 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and Article 25 of Law No. 5/2007 (Basic Law on Physical Activity and Sport — LBAFD), assesses the policy coverage, identifies gaps and prepares an opinion on the liability of the club/SAD (sports public limited company) where the athlete is injured during sporting activity or training.

DES-028.titulo_en: Temporary Loan of an Athlete — Analysis and Contract
DES-028.descricao_en: Prepares a temporary transfer (loan) agreement for a professional athlete between clubs, under Article 32 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and the FPF and FIFA Registration and Transfer Regulations (RSTP, Article 10), defining the allocation of costs, the return arrangements, the purchase option and each club's obligations during the loan period.

DES-029.titulo_en: FIFA Solidarity Mechanism — Calculation and Claim
DES-029.descricao_en: Calculates and prepares a claim under the FIFA solidarity mechanism provided for in Article 21 of the RSTP (Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players, 2022 edition), which ensures that 5% of the fee for any permanent transfer is distributed among the clubs that contributed to the athlete's training between the ages of 12 and 23, in proportion to the full years of training at each club.

DES-030.titulo_en: Athlete Image Rights Exploitation Agreement (Interposed Company)
DES-030.descricao_en: Prepares a licence and exploitation agreement for the image rights of a professional athlete, structured through the athlete's own company (image rights company), in compliance with Article 8 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), the Personal Income Tax Code (Código do IRS) and the guidance of the Tax and Customs Authority (Autoridade Tributária) on the distinction between employment income and image income.

DES-031.titulo_en: Sports Sponsorship Agreement — Club or Athlete
DES-031.descricao_en: Prepares a sports sponsorship agreement between a sponsor and a sports entity (club, SAD, athlete or federation), defining the visibility consideration, image obligations, product-category exclusivities, the termination regime and the interplay with the Advertising Code (approved by Decree-Law No. 330/90) and the FPF/LPFP Advertising Regulations.

DES-032.titulo_en: Television and Audiovisual Broadcasting Rights — Contract and Analysis
DES-032.descricao_en: Analyses and prepares licence agreements for television and audiovisual broadcasting rights in sports competitions or events, in compliance with Article 28 of Law No. 5/2007 (LBAFD), Decree-Law No. 339-A/99 (Television Law) and the LPFP regulations on the collective distribution of television revenue, distinguishing individual club rights from collective rights managed by the league.

DES-033.titulo_en: Incorporation and Governance of a Sports Public Limited Company (SAD)
DES-033.descricao_en: Prepares the legal documentation for the incorporation of a Sports Public Limited Company (Sociedade Anónima Desportiva — SAD) under Law No. 10/2013 of 28 January (Legal Regime for Sports Companies) and Decree-Law No. 67/1997 of 3 April, including articles of association, shareholder structure, minimum share capital requirements and the governance rules applicable to clubs taking part in professional competitions.

DES-034.titulo_en: Club Liability for Supporter Behaviour — Defence and Prevention Plan
DES-034.descricao_en: Prepares the defence in disciplinary proceedings brought against a club for supporter behaviour (violence, racism, pyrotechnics) under the FPF/LPFP Disciplinary Regulations, Decree-Law No. 216/2012 (Violence in Sport Law) and Law No. 39/2009 of 30 July (liability regime), and prepares a prevention plan to reduce future risks.

DES-035.titulo_en: Legal Protection of Minor Athletes — Training Contract and Regulatory Limits
DES-035.descricao_en: Analyses and prepares a sports training contract for an athlete under 18, under Article 13 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), Article 19 of the FIFA RSTP (special protection of minors in international transfers) and Article 38 of the Legal Regime on the Employment of Minors (Decree-Law No. 396/91), ensuring compliance with working-hour limits, compulsory schooling and transfer conditions.

DES-036.titulo_en: Sports Integrity and Betting — Complaint and Defence in Match-Fixing Proceedings
DES-036.descricao_en: Prepares a formal complaint or defence in match-fixing proceedings under Article 6 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), Articles 284 et seq. of the Criminal Code (sports corruption — Law No. 50/2007 of 31 August), the FPF/UEFA Integrity Regulations and the Council of Europe Macolin Convention on the Manipulation of Sports Competitions (approved by Assembly of the Republic Resolution No. 9/2020).

DES-037.titulo_en: E-Sports — Professional Player Contract and Applicable Legal Regime
DES-037.descricao_en: Prepares a services or employment contract for a professional e-sports (electronic sports) player, analysing the legal framework in Portugal in light of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), the Labour Code and the recognition of electronic sport as a sporting discipline by the FPD (Portuguese Electronic Sports Federation), including clauses on team exclusivity, personal streaming, image rights and transfer rules.

DES-038.titulo_en: Doping — Defence in Anti-Doping Proceedings and TAS/CAS Appeals
DES-038.descricao_en: Prepares an athlete's defence in anti-doping proceedings brought under the World Anti-Doping Code (WADA Code 2021), Law No. 38/2012 of 28 August (Anti-Doping Law — LAD) and the regulations of the Portuguese Anti-Doping Authority (ADoP), invoking procedural guarantees, the reversal of the burden of proof, the grounds for exemption from liability (contamination, therapeutic medication) and the right of appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport (TAS/CAS).

DES-039.titulo_en: Sports Training Contract with a Training Compensation Clause (FPF)
DES-039.descricao_en: Prepares a sports training contract that includes a training compensation clause in compliance with the FPF Regulations on the Registration and Transfer of Players and Annex 4 of the FIFA RSTP (training compensation), calculating the amounts due according to the club's training category and the years of training provided, and setting out the claims procedure when the athlete signs their first professional contract with another club.

DES-040.titulo_en: Application to Register an Athlete and Challenge to a Refusal by the FPF/LPFP
DES-040.descricao_en: Prepares the application to register an athlete with the FPF or LPFP and, if it is refused, an administrative challenge and, where necessary, a petition to the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD), under Articles 4 and 5 of Law No. 74/2013 (TAD Statute), invoking the athlete's right to practise sport and the federation's duty to register.

DES-041.titulo_en: Opinion on UEFA Financial Fair Play and Club Financial Sustainability
DES-041.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on a club's compliance with the UEFA Football Sustainability Regulations (FSR, 2023, replacing the former FFP), analysing the break-even requirement, the permitted deficit limits, the applicable sanctions and the corrective measures available to non-compliant clubs.

DES-042.titulo_en: Challenge to a Sports Federation Resolution before the TAD
DES-042.descricao_en: Prepares the application challenging a resolution of a sports federation body before the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD), under Articles 4 and 5 of Law No. 74/2013 (TAD Statute), Law No. 5/2007 (LBAFD) and the principles of the democratic rule of law, covering procedural defects, lack of competence, misuse of power and breach of fundamental rights.

DES-043.titulo_en: Agreement Terminating a Sports Employment Contract by Mutual Agreement
DES-043.descricao_en: Prepares an agreement terminating the sports employment contract by mutual consent between club/SAD and professional athlete, under Article 28 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), settling all the athlete's claims, establishing free agent status and coordinating with FPF and FIFA transfer rules to release the player's registration.

DES-044.titulo_en: Analysis of Competition Regulations — Club Rights and Obligations
DES-044.descricao_en: Systematically analyses sports competition regulations (league, cup or tournament), identifying the participating club's obligations and rights regarding registrations, mandatory costs, revenue distribution, eligibility rules, financial fair play, disciplinary proceedings and exclusion conditions, with reference to the applicable FPF, LPFP and UEFA rules.

DES-045.titulo_en: Stadium or Sports Venue Naming Rights Agreement
DES-045.descricao_en: Prepares an agreement granting naming rights (the right to assign a commercial name) to a stadium or sports venue, setting the term, price, visibility consideration, the club's obligations to use the name, termination conditions in the event of an image crisis and coordination with the FPF, LPFP and UEFA regulatory requirements on venue names.

DES-046.titulo_en: Opinion on International Transfer Compensation — Calculation and Strategy
DES-046.descricao_en: Prepares a legal and financial opinion on the compensation due on the international transfer of a professional athlete, analysing the criteria of Article 17 of the FIFA RSTP (termination without just cause), the calculation method adopted by the FIFA DRC (Dispute Resolution Chamber) and the CAS (Matuzalém and Webster criteria), and strategies to minimise or maximise the exposure of the paying or receiving club.

DES-047.titulo_en: Partnership Agreement between Sports Clubs (Multi-Club Ownership)
DES-047.descricao_en: Prepares a strategic partnership agreement between two or more sports clubs within multi-club ownership (MCO) structures, analysing the limits imposed by FIFA, UEFA and FPF regulations on conflicts of interest and cross-shareholdings, and setting the terms for sharing rights, loaning athletes, coordinating youth training and governance.

DES-048.titulo_en: Protecting Athletes against Unauthorised Advertising and Exploitation of their Image
DES-048.descricao_en: Prepares an out-of-court notice and, where necessary, an application for an interim measure (providência cautelar) against the unauthorised use by third parties (brands, media, digital platforms) of a professional athlete's image, name, voice or record of achievements, under Articles 72 and 73 of the Civil Code (right to one's image), Article 8 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and Law No. 27/2007 (Television Law).

DES-049.titulo_en: Legal Due Diligence on the Acquisition of a Sports Club or SAD
DES-049.descricao_en: Prepares a legal due diligence checklist and report for the acquisition of a majority stake in, or control of, a sports club or SAD, covering the corporate structure, contracts with athletes and coaches, pending disputes (FIFA DRC, TAD, labour court), federation licences, real estate assets (stadium, training centre) and financial compliance (FSR/FFP).

DES-050.titulo_en: UEFA/FPF Club Licensing — Preparing the Application
DES-050.descricao_en: Prepares the preparation plan and supporting documentation for the application for a UEFA club licence (UEFA Club Licensing and Financial Fair Play Regulations) and an FPF/LPFP licence, covering the sporting, infrastructure, personnel and administrative, financial and legal criteria, and identifying the mandatory documents and submission deadlines.

DES-051.titulo_en: Management Agreement for an Academy / High-Performance Sports Centre
DES-051.descricao_en: Prepares a management and operation agreement for a sports academy or high-performance centre between a sports entity and an external manager, defining the scope of management, performance indicators (sporting KPIs), rights over trained athletes, certified training obligations and the termination regime, in compliance with Law No. 5/2007 (LBAFD) and the regulations of the IPDJ (Portuguese Institute for Sport and Youth).

DES-052.titulo_en: TAD Arbitration Agreement — Voluntary Arbitration in a Sports Dispute
DES-052.descricao_en: Prepares an arbitration agreement (arbitration clause or submission agreement) to refer a sports dispute of a voluntary nature to the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD), under Article 3 of Law No. 74/2013 (TAD Statute) and Law No. 63/2011 (Voluntary Arbitration Law), setting the arbitrators, the procedure and the applicable law.

DES-053.titulo_en: Medical and Sports Health Services Agreement — Club Doctor
DES-053.descricao_en: Prepares a medical and sports health services agreement between a club or SAD and the club doctor (or partner clinic), defining clinical responsibilities, access to athletes' medical records, confidentiality obligations, the anti-doping protocol and coordination with mandatory insurance, in compliance with Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD), the Code of Ethics of the Ordem dos Médicos (Portuguese Medical Association) and the GDPR (RGPD).

DES-054.titulo_en: Internal Regulations of a Sports Club — Discipline and Conduct
DES-054.descricao_en: Prepares internal disciplinary and conduct regulations for a professional sports club, in compliance with Article 99 of the Labour Code, Article 17 of Law No. 54/2017 (LCTD) and the FPF/LPFP disciplinary regulations, defining the offences, the applicable sanctions, the internal disciplinary procedure and the defence guarantees of athletes and other sports staff.

DES-055.titulo_en: Contract for a Paralympic and Adapted Sports Athlete — Legal Specificities
DES-055.descricao_en: Prepares a sports employment and/or support contract for a Paralympic or adapted sports athlete, analysing the specific features of Law No. 5/2007 (LBAFD), Articles 30 et seq., Decree-Law No. 164/2019 (support for high performance) and the regulations of the Paralympic Committee of Portugal (CPP) and the International Paralympic Committee (IPC), including eligibility rules by functional class and adapted anti-doping conditions.

DES-056.titulo_en: Criminal Complaint for Corruption in Sport — Offence under Art. 1 of Law 50/2007
DES-056.descricao_en: Prepares a criminal complaint (queixa-crime) for passive or active corruption in sport under Law No. 50/2007 of 31 August (which establishes the criminal liability regime for conduct liable to fraudulently alter the results of sports competitions), in conjunction with Article 374 of the Criminal Code and the obligation to report integrity breaches under FIFA and FPF regulations.

DES-057.titulo_en: Assignment of an Athlete's Economic Rights to a Third Party (TPO) — Analysis and Risk
DES-057.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the assignment of an athlete's economic rights to a third party (Third Party Ownership — TPO), analysing the express prohibition in Article 18bis of the FIFA RSTP and Article 18ter of the RSTP (prohibition of third-party influence), and assessing the legality of contracts already concluded and the disciplinary risks for the club and the athlete.

DES-058.titulo_en: Preemption Clause and Athlete Buy-Back Right (Buy-Back Clause)
DES-058.descricao_en: Prepares a preemption clause (direito de preferência) and a buy-back clause in a permanent transfer agreement for a professional athlete, setting the conditions of exercise, the buy-back price, the term, the activation mechanism and coordination with FPF and FIFA registration and transfer regulations.

DES-059.titulo_en: Sports Kit Sponsorship and Naming Agreement (Kit Sponsor)
DES-059.descricao_en: Prepares a supply and sponsorship agreement for sports kit (shirt, shorts, socks) between a sports club and a sportswear brand, defining supply exclusivity, co-branding, minimum kit volumes, royalty amounts, image rights associated with the kit and termination conditions for poor sporting performance.

DES-060.titulo_en: Agreement Terminating a Representation Agreement with a Sports Agent
DES-060.descricao_en: Prepares an agreement for the early termination of a representation agreement between an athlete and an intermediary/sports agent, under the FIFA Football Agent Regulations (FFAR, 2023) and the general principles of the Civil Code on termination of mandate, settling the commissions due, the transfer of information and the intermediary's post-termination non-compete duties.

DES-061.titulo_en: Integrity and Conflict-of-Interest Prevention Protocol for a Sports Club
DES-061.descricao_en: Prepares an internal integrity and conflict-of-interest prevention protocol for a professional sports club, in compliance with FPF, LPFP and UEFA integrity regulations, Law No. 93/2021 (whistleblower protection) and the corporate governance obligations of Law No. 10/2013 (sports companies), covering officials' conflicts of interest, dealings with intermediaries, betting and access to inside information.

DES-062.titulo_en: Opinion on an Athlete's Eligibility for the Portuguese National Team
DES-062.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on an athlete's eligibility to represent the Portuguese national team, under Article 5 of the FIFA Eligibility Regulations (Statutes, Annex 1), Portuguese nationality legislation (Law No. 37/1981 — Nationality Law) and the FPF's specific eligibility regulations, analysing the nationality and residence criteria, previous appearances for another national team and special authorisation procedures.

DES-063.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure Suspending a Sports Sanction
DES-063.descricao_en: Prepares an application for an interim measure (providência cautelar) suspending enforcement of a sports disciplinary sanction, addressed to the Sports Arbitration Court (TAD), under Articles 4 and 5 of Law No. 74/2013 (TAD Statute) and Article 342 of the Code of Civil Procedure (CPC), applicable on a subsidiary basis, invoking periculum in mora (irreparable harm to the athlete's career or to the club's competition) and fumus boni iuris.

AMB-001.descricao_en: Drafts the application for an environmental licence addressed to the Portuguese Environment Agency (APA) or the competent licensing authority, identifying the activity, describing the project, setting out the legal framework under the Environmental Licensing Regime (Decree-Law No. 127/2013 of 30 August) and requesting the grant, renewal or amendment of the licence.

AMB-002.titulo_en: Application for a Single Environmental Permit (TUA)
AMB-002.descricao_en: Drafts the application for the grant or renewal of the Single Environmental Permit (Título Único Ambiental, TUA), the instrument provided for in Decree-Law No. 75/2015 of 11 May, which brings together in a single act the authorisations and licences for environmental components (water, air, waste, noise, etc.) for establishments not subject to an IPPC (PCIP) Environmental Licence, including the framework under the Responsible Industry System (SIR).

AMB-003.titulo_en: Participation in an Environmental Impact Assessment Procedure
AMB-003.descricao_en: Drafts the technical and legal submission in an environmental impact assessment (AIA) procedure, whether in the public consultation on the Environmental Impact Study (EIA), in comments on the draft Environmental Impact Statement (DIA), or in a reasoned statement of opposition or support, under Decree-Law No. 151-B/2013, as amended.

AMB-004.titulo_en: Objection / Submission in an Environmental Public Consultation
AMB-004.descricao_en: Drafts submissions, objections and contributions to general environmental public consultations — spatial plans, action programmes, reviews of river basin management plans, waste management plans and other environmental planning instruments subject to public participation under Law No. 19/2014 (Environment Framework Law, LBA) and the Aarhus Convention.

AMB-005.titulo_en: Defence in Environmental Administrative Offence Proceedings
AMB-005.descricao_en: Drafts the written defence in environmental administrative offence proceedings (contraordenação), addressed to the enforcing authority (the Portuguese Environment Agency (APA), IGAMAOT, CCDR, etc.), analysing the elements of the offence, procedural defects and mitigating factors, under the General Regime for Administrative Offences (Decree-Law No. 433/82) and the sectoral environmental regimes.

AMB-006.titulo_en: Appeal against an Environmental Administrative Offence Decision
AMB-006.descricao_en: Drafts the court appeal against a decision imposing a penalty in environmental administrative offence proceedings, addressed to the competent court of first instance, under Articles 59 et seq. of the General Regime for Administrative Offences (Decree-Law No. 433/82). It analyses defects in the decision, challenges the findings of fact and law, and seeks acquittal or a reduction of the fine.

AMB-007.titulo_en: Challenge to a Fine for an Environmental Offence
AMB-007.descricao_en: Drafts a challenge focused on the unlawfulness or disproportionality of the fine (coima) imposed in environmental administrative offence proceedings, analysing the statutory range, the criteria of Article 18 RGCO and the constitutional principle of proportionality; it can be used both at the administrative stage (prior defence) and at the judicial stage (appeal to the court).

AMB-008.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Liability for Environmental Damage
AMB-008.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on civil liability for environmental damage under the Environmental Liability Regime (Decree-Law No. 147/2008 of 29 July, transposing Directive 2004/35/EC), analysing attribution, causation, prevention and remediation obligations, and the applicable strict or fault-based liability regime.

AMB-009.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Liability for Ecological Damage
AMB-009.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a civil liability action for ecological damage, either under the Environmental Liability Regime (Decree-Law No. 147/2008) by way of a challenge to APA decisions, or under civil liability (Articles 483 et seq. of the Civil Code) for damage caused to private parties as a result of pollution or environmental degradation.

AMB-010.titulo_en: Extrajudicial Notice for Pollution / Nuisance (Noise, Smoke, Odours)
AMB-010.descricao_en: Drafts an extrajudicial notice addressed to the person responsible for intolerable emissions (imissões: excessive noise, smoke, odours, vibrations, dust) affecting the health or well-being of neighbours or third parties, under Articles 1346 and 1347 of the Civil Code (neighbour relations), the General Noise Regulation and public health legislation, demanding that they cease and warning of legal action.

AMB-011.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for an Injunction against Nuisance between Neighbours
AMB-011.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action for an injunction (ação inibitória) to stop intolerable emissions (excessive noise, smoke, odours, vibrations, dust) affecting the normal use of a property, under Articles 1346 and 1347 of the Civil Code and the General Noise Regulation (Decree-Law No. 9/2007), including a claim for damages and, if urgent, a prior interim measure (providência cautelar).

AMB-012.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation for Environmental Damage and Restoration
AMB-012.descricao_en: Structures the methodology for quantifying environmental damage for compensation purposes, distinguishing pure ecological damage (covered by the RRA), consequential private damage (civil liability), the costs of primary, complementary and compensatory remediation (Annex IV to Decree-Law 147/2008) and the possible application of environmental economic valuation criteria, with guidance for the pleading or out-of-court negotiation.

AMB-013.titulo_en: Application for a Water Resources Use Licence
AMB-013.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a licence or permit to use water resources (water abstraction, effluent discharge, occupation of the bed or bank, works in the adjacent zone) addressed to the Portuguese Environment Agency or the competent River Basin District Administration (ARH), under Law No. 58/2005 (Water Law), Decree-Law No. 226-A/2007 (TURH) and the EU rules of the Water Framework Directive.

AMB-014.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Waste Management and Producer Responsibility
AMB-014.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on waste management obligations under the General Waste Management Regime (Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020), analysing waste classification, producer responsibility, registration and reporting obligations on SILIAMB, contracts with licensed operators and the administrative offences applicable in the event of non-compliance.

AMB-015.descricao_en: Drafts the services agreement for the collection, transport and treatment/recovery of waste between the waste producer/holder and the licensed waste management operator, including clauses on compliance with the RGGR, eGTR waste transport guide obligations, final destination declarations and the allocation of responsibilities.

AMB-016.titulo_en: Application for Licensing of a Renewable Energy Production Unit
AMB-016.descricao_en: Drafts the application for licensing of a unit producing energy from renewable sources (solar photovoltaic, wind, hydro, biomass, biogas) with the Directorate-General for Energy and Geology (DGEG) and REN/EDP Distribuição, under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 (legal regime for renewable energy), including the grid connection request and the interplay with other procedures (AIA, environmental licence, planning permission).

AMB-017.descricao_en: Drafts the agreement for the purchase and sale of electricity from renewable sources (Power Purchase Agreement — PPA) between producer and consumer (corporate PPA) or between producer and energy supplier (merchant PPA), including clauses on price, volume, guarantees of origin, liability and risk management, under the Portuguese legal framework and the sectoral regulation of the Energy Services Regulatory Authority (ERSE).

AMB-018.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Self-Consumption and Renewable Energy Communities
AMB-018.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the renewable energy self-consumption regime (UPAC) and Renewable Energy Communities (CER), analysing the legal requirements, the registration process, the rights and obligations of members/participants, the energy-sharing rules and the conditions for joining and leaving, under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 and ERSE regulations.

AMB-019.titulo_en: Compliance Analysis under the Emissions Trading System (EU Layer)
AMB-019.descricao_en: Drafts a legal compliance analysis of an industrial installation under the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), under Directive 2003/87/EC as reformed and its Portuguese transposition (Decree-Law No. 38/2013), including verification of the scope of application, monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) obligations, allocation of allowances and documentary compliance.

AMB-020.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Environmental Popular Action
AMB-020.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a popular action (ação popular) for the protection of the environment, under Law No. 83/95 (Popular Action Law) and Article 66 of the Constitution of the Portuguese Republic, to protect goods for collective use (air quality, water, soil, biodiversity, landscape) against unlawful acts of public or private entities, seeking cessation, remediation and compensation.

AMB-021.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Environmental Easements and Restrictions on Land
AMB-021.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the administrative easements (servidões administrativas) and public-interest restrictions of an environmental nature burdening a plot of land — RAN (National Agricultural Reserve), REN (National Ecological Reserve), the Natura 2000 network, protection zones for beds and banks of watercourses, protected landscapes — analysing the impact on the possibilities for use, building on and transacting the property.

AMB-022.titulo_en: Environmental Compliance Checklist for an Industrial Activity
AMB-022.descricao_en: Generates a tailored legal environmental compliance checklist for an industrial or commercial activity, covering the main applicable legal obligations (licensing, waste management, emissions, water, noise, EU ETS, SEQE, process safety), identifying the applicable legislation, the competent authorities and the consequences of non-compliance.

AMB-023.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint/report addressed to the Inspectorate-General for Agriculture, the Sea, the Environment and Spatial Planning (IGAMAOT) or the Portuguese Environment Agency (APA) reporting environmental offences — pollution, illegal waste management, irregular licensing, damage to protected habitats — with appropriate legal grounds and a request for inspection and enforcement action.

AMB-024.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Environmental Liabilities in a Real Estate or M&A Transaction
AMB-024.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the environmental liabilities of a property, company or industrial installation in the context of a transaction (sale of property, acquisition of a company, merger, demerger), analysing liability for soil contamination, licensing liabilities, environmental offence risks and buyer-protection mechanisms (representations and warranties, indemnity clauses, price retention).

AMB-025.titulo_en: Application for Waste Management Operator Status
AMB-025.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a waste management operator licence — collection, transport, storage, sorting, treatment, recovery or disposal — addressed to the Portuguese Environment Agency (APA) or the competent Regional Coordination and Development Commission (CCDR), under the General Waste Management Regime (Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020) and the applicable sectoral rules.

AMB-026.titulo_en: Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings for Breach of Environmental Noise Rules (RGR)
AMB-026.descricao_en: Drafts the written defence in administrative offence proceedings for breach of the General Noise Regulation (RGR), approved by Decree-Law No. 9/2007 of 17 January and amended by Decree-Law No. 278/2007 of 1 August, including analysis of the exposure limit values (VLE), a challenge to the measurements taken by the authorities and arguments of procedural or substantive defects.

AMB-027.titulo_en: Application for a Waste Management Operation Licence (LORR)
AMB-027.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a licence for the collection, transport, storage, sorting, recovery or disposal of waste, under the General Waste Management Regime (RGGR), approved by Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020 of 10 December, and Decree-Law No. 178/2006 of 5 September (to the extent still in force), including identification of the LER (European Waste List) codes, D/R operations and the environmental security deposit (caução).

AMB-028.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Environmental Liabilities in the Acquisition of Industrial Property
AMB-028.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the existence of environmental liabilities (soil and groundwater contamination) at an industrial property being transacted, under Decree-Law No. 147/2008 of 29 July (environmental liability), the LBA (Law No. 19/2014 of 14 April) and Decree-Law 276/2009 (soil protection), analysing the allocation of liability between seller and buyer and the recommended contractual protection clauses.

AMB-029.titulo_en: Judicial Challenge to an APA Decision in an AIA Procedure
AMB-029.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in a special administrative action challenging an unfavourable Environmental Impact Statement (DIA) or the APA's decision in an environmental impact assessment (AIA) procedure, under the Legal Regime for Environmental Impact Assessment (RJAIA, Decree-Law No. 151-B/2013 of 31 October, as currently worded) and the Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts (CPTA).

AMB-030.descricao_en: Drafts a template power purchase agreement (PPA) between a solar photovoltaic producer and a consumer (company), under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 of 14 January (RJAERE), Decree-Law No. 162/2019 (self-consumption) and ERSE regulation, setting the price, term, delivery point, guarantee-of-origin mechanism and force majeure and termination clauses.

AMB-031.titulo_en: Application for an Offshore Wind Energy Production Licence
AMB-031.descricao_en: Drafts the application for the grant of a production permit for an offshore wind energy project, under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 of 14 January (RJAERE), Decree-Law No. 38/2015 (framework for maritime spatial planning and management policy) and the National Maritime Space Regulation, identifying the components of the marine AIA, the licence for private use of maritime space (TUPEM) and coordination with the Directorate-General for Maritime Policy (DGPM) and the APA.

AMB-032.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Collective Self-Consumption and Renewable Energy Communities
AMB-032.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the formation and operation of a renewable energy community (CER) or a collective self-consumption unit, under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 of 14 January (RJAERE), Decree-Law No. 162/2019 of 25 October and ERSE regulations, including energy-sharing requirements, the CER governance model and obligations towards the DGEG and the distribution system operator.

AMB-033.titulo_en: Challenge to a Fine for Breach of Air Emission Rules (DL 39/2018)
AMB-033.descricao_en: Drafts the written defence and, in the alternative, the judicial appeal against the fine imposed for breach of Decree-Law No. 39/2018 of 11 June (regime for integrated prevention and control of air pollution — PCIP), including analysis of the emission limit values (VLE), the validity of the sampling and a challenge to the attribution of fault.

AMB-034.titulo_en: Environmental Audit and Compliance Services Agreement (ESG)
AMB-034.descricao_en: Drafts a services agreement between an environmental consultancy and a business client for an environmental compliance audit, the preparation of an ESG report and follow-up of the corrective action plan, under Portuguese civil law and the obligations arising from Regulation (EU) 2020/852 (Taxonomy) and the CSRD (Directive (EU) 2022/2464).

AMB-035.titulo_en: Complaint to IGAMAOT about a Third Party's Environmental Offence
AMB-035.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint to the Inspectorate-General for Agriculture, the Sea, the Environment and Spatial Planning (IGAMAOT) about an environmental offence committed by a third party (company or individual), under Law No. 50/2006 of 29 August (Framework Law on Environmental Administrative Offences, LQCA), Law No. 19/2014 (LBA) and the applicable sectoral legislation (waste, noise, emissions, water resources), including a request for an inspection and the adoption of precautionary measures.

AMB-036.titulo_en: Challenge to a Single Environmental Permit (TUA) with Excessive Conditions
AMB-036.descricao_en: Drafts the administrative complaint (reclamação) and, in the alternative, the statement of claim in an administrative action to challenge the conditions laid down in a Single Environmental Permit (TUA) issued under Decree-Law No. 75/2015 of 11 May, where they are disproportionate, unlawful or unreasoned, including a challenge to monitoring requirements, waste management plans and noise conditions.

AMB-037.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Environmental Public-Interest Easements and Restrictions on Land
AMB-037.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the easements and public-interest restrictions of an environmental nature burdening a plot of land (REN, RAN, Natura 2000 Network, DPH (public water domain), APL), under Decree-Law No. 166/2008 (REN), Decree-Law No. 73/2009 (RAN), Law No. 76/2017 (DPH) and the Habitats and Birds Directives, analysing the impact on development potential and the means of challenge.

AMB-038.titulo_en: Application for a Water Resources Use Permit (TURH) for Groundwater Abstraction
AMB-038.descricao_en: Drafts the application for a Water Resources Use Permit (Título de Utilização dos Recursos Hídricos, TURH) for groundwater abstraction for industrial or agricultural use, under the Water Law (Law No. 58/2005 of 29 December), Decree-Law No. 226-A/2007 of 31 May and the regulations of the River Basin District Administrations (ARH), including analysis of abstraction limits and flow conditions.

AMB-039.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the EU Emissions Trading System (CELE) — Compliance and Defence in Infringement Proceedings
AMB-039.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the compliance obligations of an industrial installation under the EU Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading System (CELE/ETS), under Directive 2003/87/EC (ETS Directive) and Decree-Law No. 38/2013 of 15 March (transposition), including analysis of an allowance shortfall, the strategy for purchasing on the market and the defence in infringement proceedings for failure to surrender allowances.

AMB-040.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Environmental Popular Action for Diffuse Ecological Damage
AMB-040.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an environmental popular action to protect diffuse environmental interests and seek remediation of ecological damage, under Law No. 83/95 of 31 August (right of procedural participation and popular action), the Environment Framework Law (LBA, Law No. 19/2014) and Decree-Law No. 147/2008 (environmental liability), including a request for interim measures and primary remediation of the damage to the ecosystem.

AMB-041.titulo_en: Extrajudicial Notice to a Company for Greenwashing — Misleading Environmental Claims
AMB-041.descricao_en: Drafts an extrajudicial notice to a company disseminating commercial communications containing misleading or unverifiable environmental claims (greenwashing), under Directive (EU) 2024/825 (Empowering Consumers Directive), Decree-Law No. 57/2008 (unfair commercial practices) and the Advertising Code (Decree-Law 330/90), demanding that the claims cease and be corrected and warning of the applicable sanctions.

AMB-042.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Environmental Liability of Company Directors (Duty of Care)
AMB-042.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the personal liability of directors and managers of commercial companies for environmental offences committed by the company, under the Commercial Companies Code (CSC), Law No. 50/2006 (LQCA), Decree-Law No. 147/2008 (environmental liability) and Directive (EU) 2024/1760 (Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive — CSDDD), analysing environmental due diligence duties and the consequences of non-compliance.

AMB-043.titulo_en: Application for the Release of a Parcel from the National Ecological Reserve (REN)
AMB-043.descricao_en: Drafts the application for authorisation of a use or action in a National Ecological Reserve (REN) area that does not constitute formal release (desafetação), or the request for a delimitation/exclusion procedure, under Decree-Law No. 166/2008 of 22 August (legal regime of the REN) and the powers of the CCDRs, including the descriptive report, the justification of compatibility with the REN's ecological functions and the framework under the Municipal Master Plan (PDM).

AMB-044.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Sustainability Reporting Obligations (CSRD/ESRS) for a Medium-Sized Company
AMB-044.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the sustainability reporting obligations arising from the CSRD (Directive (EU) 2022/2464) and the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), including determination of the scope of application, the timetable for entry into force, the mandatory topics (E1 climate, E2 pollution, E3 water, E4 biodiversity, E5 resources) and the consequences of non-compliance in Portugal.

AMB-045.titulo_en: Application for Recognition of a Waste Management System Operator (SGRU)
AMB-045.descricao_en: Drafts the application to the APA for recognition of an individual or collective management system for packaging waste or other specific waste streams (WEEE (REEE), end-of-life vehicles (VFV), batteries, tyres), under Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020 of 10 December and the applicable waste-stream legislation, including the management plan, recycling targets and the funding model.

AMB-046.titulo_en: Application for Authorisation of a Project in a Special Area of Conservation (ZEC/Natura 2000)
AMB-046.descricao_en: Drafts the application for authorisation of a project or plan in a Special Area of Conservation (ZEC) or Special Protection Area (ZPE), subject to an assessment of environmental effects (AIncA), under Decree-Law No. 49/2005 of 24 February (transposing the Habitats and Birds Directives), including the effects report, the analysis of alternatives and the request for derogation on imperative reasons of overriding public interest (RIPR).

AMB-047.titulo_en: Compliance Analysis of an Industrial Activity with its Environmental Licence (PCIP/RJAIA)
AMB-047.descricao_en: Drafts a legal and technical-legal analysis of an industrial installation's compliance with the conditions of its environmental licence, under Decree-Law No. 127/2013 of 30 August (PRIP — Integrated Pollution Prevention and Control), Decree-Law No. 39/2018 and the Single Environmental Permit (TUA, Decree-Law 75/2015), identifying non-conformities, risks of licence suspension and a regularisation plan.

AMB-048.titulo_en: Application for Membership of a Producer Organisation under the Packaging Extended Producer Responsibility (RAP) Scheme
AMB-048.descricao_en: Drafts a producer's/importer's application to join a collective packaging waste management scheme operator recognised by the APA (Valormed, Sociedade Ponto Verde, Novo Verde), analysing reporting obligations, the calculation of the eco-fee (eco-valor) and compliance audit mechanisms, under Decree-Law No. 152-D/2017 of 11 December and the RGGR (Decree-Law 102-D/2020).

AMB-049.titulo_en: Concession Agreement for the Operation of a Wastewater Treatment Plant (ETAR)
AMB-049.descricao_en: Drafts a template concession agreement for the operation and maintenance of a Wastewater Treatment Plant (ETAR) by a private entity, under Decree-Law No. 152/97 (wastewater treatment), Law No. 23/96 (essential public services), Decree-Law No. 194/2009 (legal regime for municipal sanitation services) and the Public Contracts Code (CCP), including discharge parameters, contractual penalties and the monitoring plan.

AMB-050.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Civil Liability for Environmental Nuisance between Neighbours (Imissões)
AMB-050.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on civil liability and the remedies available to an owner affected by environmental emissions from neighbouring property (noise, vibrations, odours, smoke, dust, light pollution), under Articles 1346 and 1347 of the Civil Code, the General Noise Regulation (Decree-Law 9/2007) and Decree-Law No. 147/2008, including analysis of normal neighbourly tolerance and the possibility of an injunction action.

AMB-051.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Environmental Taxation and Carbon Charges for an Industrial Company (ISP, CELE, CBAM)
AMB-051.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the main environmental taxation instruments applicable to a Portuguese industrial company, including the Tax on Petroleum Products (ISP) with its carbon component, the company's position under the CELE/ETS, the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM, Regulation (EU) 2023/956) and the available tax exemptions and benefits, under the Excise Duties Code (CIEC) and EU legislation.

AMB-052.titulo_en: Application for an Operating Licence for an Upper-Tier SEVESO Establishment (DL 150/2015)
AMB-052.descricao_en: Drafts the application and supporting documentation for the licensing of an establishment covered by Decree-Law No. 150/2015 of 5 August (SEVESO III — prevention of major industrial accidents involving dangerous substances), including the notification to the APA, the Safety Report, the Internal Emergency Plan and coordination with IGAMAOT and Civil Protection.

AMB-053.titulo_en: Application for an Installation Licence for a Biogas / Biomethane Unit
AMB-053.descricao_en: Drafts the application for an installation and operating licence for a unit producing biogas or biomethane from organic waste or agricultural and livestock effluents, under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 of 14 January (RJAERE), Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020 (RGGR — energy recovery from waste) and Decree-Law No. 39/2018 (air emissions), coordinating energy licensing with environmental licensing.

AMB-054.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Strategic Environmental Assessment (AAE) of Plans and Programmes
AMB-054.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on whether a Strategic Environmental Assessment (AAE) is mandatory for sectoral or spatial planning plans and programmes, and on its procedure, under Decree-Law No. 232/2007 of 15 June (legal regime of AAE), Directive 2001/42/EC and the RJIGT (Decree-Law 80/2015), including the scope, the screening criteria, the Environmental Report and the consultation of environmental authorities.

AMB-055.titulo_en: Request for Access to Environmental Information (LAIA / Directive 2003/4/EC)
AMB-055.descricao_en: Drafts a request for access to environmental information held by a public authority, under Law No. 26/2016 of 22 August (regime for access to administrative and environmental information), Law No. 19/2014 (LBA) and Directive 2003/4/EC, including an appeal against refusal and a judicial challenge before the Administrative Court, setting out the grounds of the duty to grant access and the permissible exceptions.

AMB-056.titulo_en: Energy Efficiency Measurement and Verification (M&V) Services Agreement with an Energy Services Company (ESCO)
AMB-056.descricao_en: Drafts an energy efficiency services agreement between an Energy Services Company (ESE/ESCO) and a client (company or public building), with results-based financing (EPC — Energy Performance Contract), under Decree-Law No. 68-A/2015 (legal regime for ESEs), Decree-Law No. 118/2013 (SCE — Energy Certification System) and Directive 2012/27/EU (Energy Efficiency), including the IPMVP measurement and verification methodology.

AMB-057.titulo_en: Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings for Illegal Waste Management (DL 102-D/2020)
AMB-057.descricao_en: Drafts the written defence in administrative offence proceedings for the deposit, storage, transport or treatment of waste without a valid permit, under Decree-Law No. 102-D/2020 of 10 December (RGGR) and Law No. 50/2006 of 29 August (LQCA), including analysis of the waste classification, a challenge to the allegation of illegal management and a regularisation proposal.

AMB-058.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Licensing Regime for Large-Scale Solar Plants (RJAERE)
AMB-058.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the complete licensing process for a large-scale photovoltaic plant (>1 MW), under Decree-Law No. 15/2022 of 14 January (RJAERE), Decree-Law No. 151-B/2013 (RJAIA), the DGEG procedural ministerial orders and the ERSE/REN regulations, detailing the stages, time limits, competent authorities and regulatory risks.

AMB-059.titulo_en: Environmental Legal Compliance Checklist for an M&A Transaction with an Industrial Target
AMB-059.descricao_en: Drafts an environmental legal due diligence checklist for the acquisition of an industrial company or asset, checking environmental licences, offence history, environmental liabilities, monitoring obligations, CELE compliance, waste management and ESG obligations, under the Portuguese and EU environmental legislation applicable to the target's sector.

AMB-060.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Forest Management Plans and Liability for Forest Fires (Forest Policy Framework Law)
AMB-060.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the forest owner's legal obligations regarding fuel management, fuel management strips (FGC), the forest management plan (PGF) and civil and administrative-offence liability for forest fires, under Law No. 76/2017 (Forest Policy Framework Law), Decree-Law No. 124/2006 (forest fire defence system — SDFCI) and Decree-Law No. 10/2018.

CNS-001.titulo_en: Complaint to the Trader about Lack of Conformity of Goods
CNS-001.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter of complaint addressed to the seller/trader invoking the lack of conformity of goods purchased, based on Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (which transposed Directive (EU) 2019/771) and the Consumer Protection Law (Law No. 24/96). It identifies the defect and the applicable guarantee period and demands the exercise of the rights in their legal order of priority: repair, replacement, price reduction or termination of the contract.

CNS-002.titulo_en: Letter Exercising the Right to Repair, Replacement, Price Reduction or Termination
CNS-002.descricao_en: Generates a formal letter for the staged exercise of the consumer remedies provided for in Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (guarantees on goods) or Decree-Law No. 83/2021 (digital content and services).
