It distinguishes the four available remedies, respects their legal hierarchy and states the precise grounds for the specific request, including the deadline for compliance and the consequences of non-compliance.

CNS-003.titulo_en: Letter Exercising the Right of Withdrawal from a Distance Contract
CNS-003.descricao_en: Drafts the letter or form exercising the right of withdrawal (livre resolução, or cooling-off right) in contracts concluded at a distance (online, by telephone, by catalogue) or off-premises, under Decree-Law No. 24/2014 (which transposed Directive 2011/83/EU) as revised by Decree-Law No. 109-G/2021 (Omnibus Directive / Directive 2019/2161/EU). The general period is 14 days — extendable up to 12 months if the trader did not provide information on the right of withdrawal.

CNS-004.titulo_en: Complaint about an Unfair Commercial Practice or Misleading Advertising
CNS-004.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint invoking Decree-Law No. 57/2008 (which transposed Directive 2005/29/EC on unfair commercial practices) and the Advertising Code (Decree-Law No. 330/90), addressed to the infringing trader and/or the Directorate-General for Consumers (DGC) or the Food and Economic Safety Authority (ASAE). It identifies the unfair practice — misleading (by action or omission) or aggressive — and sets out the grounds for the request for cessation and compensation.

CNS-005.titulo_en: Complaint to the Directorate-General for Consumers
CNS-005.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint addressed to the Directorate-General for Consumers (DGC), the consumer protection supervisory body in Portugal, describing the infringement, setting out its legal characterisation and requesting the opening of administrative offence proceedings against the trader and supervisory action by the DGC. The complaint may also be sent to the ASAE or to the competent sector regulator (ERSE, ANACOM, Banco de Portugal, etc.) depending on the sector.

CNS-006.titulo_en: Complaint in the Electronic Complaints Book (Follow-Up)
CNS-006.descricao_en: Drafts the text of the complaint to be entered in the Electronic Complaints Book (Livro de Reclamações Eletrónico — LRE, portal www.livroreclamacoes.pt), generates a covering letter to the trader invoking the legal response period (15 working days), and prepares a reply to the trader if its response is unsatisfactory or does not arrive. The LRE is governed by Decree-Law No. 156/2005, as successively amended.

CNS-007.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Consumer Declaratory Action
CNS-007.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim for a declaratory action before the judicial court (or small claims court) in consumer disputes between a consumer and a trader, based on Law No. 24/96, Decree-Law No. 84/2021, Decree-Law No. 24/2014 or the applicable sector legislation. It structures the claims for an order to perform, compensation and/or a declaration of nullity of unfair contract terms, in accordance with the Code of Civil Procedure.

CNS-008.titulo_en: Application for Alternative Resolution of a Consumer Dispute (Arbitration Centre)
CNS-008.descricao_en: Drafts the application to open consumer Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR, RAL) proceedings, to be filed with the competent arbitration centre (CIMAAL, CNIACC, CICAP, TRIAVE, CACCL, CACCBRAGA, etc.), under Law No. 144/2015 (which transposed Directive 2013/11/EU on ADR for consumer disputes). ADR is free of charge for the consumer and generally binding where the trader has adhered to it.

CNS-009.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Injunction Action against Unfair Standard Contract Terms
CNS-009.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim for an injunction action (ação inibitória) to prohibit the future use of unfair standard contract terms (cláusulas contratuais gerais — CCG), with erga omnes effect (not merely inter partes), under Decree-Law No. 446/85 (LCCG) and Directive 93/13/EEC. The injunction action may be brought by consumer associations, by the Public Prosecutor's Office (Ministério Público) or by any person with standing who shows a legitimate interest; a judgment upholding the claim has a preventive effect and may be published.

CNS-010.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Validity of Standard Contract Terms (Content Review)
CNS-010.descricao_en: Produces a legal opinion on the validity of standard contract terms (CCG) under Decree-Law No. 446/85 (LCCG) and Directive 93/13/EEC, analysing the two-tier review: (1) incorporation/communication and (2) content (absolute and relative prohibitions). It identifies the terms that are void, those that need clarification and those that are valid, giving reasons for each conclusion.

CNS-011.titulo_en: Analysis of a Standard-Form Contract and Identification of Unfair Terms
CNS-011.descricao_en: Analyses a specific standard-form contract (gym, telecommunications, digital subscription, energy, insurance, etc.) and identifies the specific unfair terms, classifying them under Decree-Law No. 446/85 (LCCG) and Directive 93/13/EEC, in language the client can understand. It produces a risk report with practical recommendations on what to contest, what to negotiate and what to accept.

CNS-012.titulo_en: Complaint about Undue Charges for an Essential Public Service
CNS-012.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint about undue charges for essential public services (water, electricity, gas, telecommunications and municipal waste), under Law No. 23/96 (Essential Public Services Law), addressed to the service provider and, where applicable, to the sector regulator (ERSE, ANACOM, ERSAR). It includes invoking the right, specific to this law, to suspend payment of the disputed invoice.

CNS-013.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter disputing an invoice, addressed to the telecommunications operator, invoking Law No. 23/96 (SPE), the Electronic Communications Law [VERIFY: Decree-Law No. 151-A/2020 or the statute currently in force] and the rights of users of communications services, requesting suspension of payment of the disputed amount and a report to the National Communications Authority (ANACOM) if the matter is not resolved in time.

CNS-014.titulo_en: Complaint concerning an Unlawful Lock-In Period (Fidelização)
CNS-014.descricao_en: Drafts a letter of complaint for situations in which the company imposes a lock-in period (fidelização) longer than the law allows, charges an excessive early termination penalty or refuses to accept termination for just cause (deterioration of the service, price increase). It applies mainly to telecommunications (Electronic Communications Law) but also to gyms, insurance and other continuing-performance contracts.

CNS-015.titulo_en: Analysis of a Consumer Credit Agreement (APR, Information Duties)
CNS-015.descricao_en: Analyses a consumer credit agreement under Decree-Law No. 133/2009 (which transposed Directive 2008/48/EC on consumer credit) and Banco de Portugal guidance, checking compliance with the pre-contractual duties (Standard European Consumer Credit Information — FINE), the accuracy of the stated APR (TAEG), the presence of all mandatory elements and the validity of the clauses. For mortgage credit, a different regime applies (Decree-Law No. 74-A/2017).

CNS-016.titulo_en: Letter Exercising the Right of Withdrawal from a Credit Agreement
CNS-016.descricao_en: Drafts the letter exercising the right of withdrawal (revogação) from a consumer credit agreement within 14 calendar days of signature, under Article 14 of Decree-Law No. 133/2009. This right requires no reasons and allows the consumer to back out of a personal loan, car loan or credit card without penalty, repaying only the capital drawn plus the interest for the corresponding period.

CNS-017.descricao_en: Drafts a letter of complaint about mandatory tied selling (venda associada) — a practice in which the trader makes the sale of a product or service conditional on the purchase of another product or service the consumer does not want. In the banking sector, Decree-Law No. 133/2009 and Banco de Portugal rules prohibit imposing insurance as a condition for credit (although it may be a pricing requirement); in general trade, Decree-Law No. 57/2008 and Law No. 24/96 protect the consumer.

CNS-018.titulo_en: Claim against an Unfair Price Adjustment Clause
CNS-018.descricao_en: Drafts a claim or formal letter contesting automatic or unilateral price adjustment clauses in continuing-performance contracts (telecommunications, gyms, insurance, subscriptions, etc.), invoking Decree-Law No. 446/85 (nullity of clauses allowing unilateral changes without just cause), Directive 93/13/EEC and, in the telecommunications sector, the sector legislation requiring minimum advance notice and a right to terminate without penalty.

CNS-019.titulo_en: Letter of Complaint for Flight Delay or Cancellation (Regulation 261/2004)
CNS-019.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter of complaint to the air carrier and/or the National Civil Aviation Authority (ANAC), invoking Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 on air passenger rights. It calculates the compensation due, invokes the right to reimbursement or re-routing and includes a claim for reimbursement of additional expenses (meals, accommodation, transport); it applies to flights departing from Portugal and to flights arriving in Portugal operated by EU carriers.

CNS-020.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensation for Flight Cancellation / Overbooking
CNS-020.descricao_en: Performs a detailed calculation of the compensation due to the passenger under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, taking into account the fixed compensation per passenger (distance table), reductions for alternative re-routing, accumulation with additional expenses (Article 9), the limitation period and the possibility of cost-effective litigation. Useful for assessing whether the claim is economically viable and for preparing the complaint with the correct amounts.

CNS-021.titulo_en: Complaint about Lack of Conformity of Digital Content and Services
CNS-021.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint about lack of conformity of digital content (films, music, e-books, games, software) or digital services (streaming, SaaS platforms, cloud storage), under Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (Articles 43 to 72, which transposed Directive (EU) 2019/770). The regime is distinct from that for physical goods and covers long-term supply, mandatory updates and the provision of personal data as counter-performance.

CNS-022.titulo_en: Letter Terminating a Gym Contract / Continuing-Performance Services
CNS-022.descricao_en: Drafts the formal letter terminating (denúncia) a gym, fitness club, subscription service or any continuing-performance contract, invoking the legal notice period, the prohibition of disproportionate penalties and the rights arising from supervening circumstances (change of residence, medical reasons). It applies Law No. 24/96, Decree-Law No. 446/85 and the applicable sector legislation.

CNS-023.titulo_en: Complaint about a Defect in Goods Bought Online
CNS-023.descricao_en: Drafts a complaint about lack of conformity of goods bought through an e-commerce platform (online shop, marketplace such as Amazon, FNAC, Worten, etc.), combining the regime of Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (guarantees) with Decree-Law No. 24/2014 (distance contracts). It identifies the party liable (direct seller vs. marketplace), the return period and the available remedies, including a chargeback through the bank when the seller does not respond.

CNS-024.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Producer Liability for Defective Products
CNS-024.descricao_en: Produces a legal opinion on the producer's liability for damage caused by a defective product, under Decree-Law No. 383/89 (which transposed Directive 85/374/EEC and will be replaced by the new Directive (EU) 2024/2853). This regime is strict — it does not require fault on the part of the producer — and makes the manufacturer, the EU importer and the supplier (down the chain) liable for physical and property damage caused by a defect in the product.

CNS-025.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in a Popular Action (Ação Popular) in Defence of Consumers
CNS-025.descricao_en: Drafts a statement of claim in a popular action (ação popular) (Law No. 83/95 of 31 August) to defend the collective or diffuse interests of consumers, alleging harm to a large group of people from a trader's unlawful practice. The popular action allows any citizen, association or local authority to represent all those harmed, with res judicata effects extending to all of them, and may include a claim for compensation, cessation of the practice and publication of the judgment.

CNS-026.titulo_en: Complaint against a Company for Abusive Debt Collection Practices
CNS-026.descricao_en: Drafts a letter of complaint about abusive collection practices by debt recovery companies or by the creditor itself, invoking Law No. 24/96 (consumer protection), the legal limits on contact for collection purposes and protection against intimidating or misleading practices in the collection process. It includes a request that the practices cease and a report to the DGC or Banco de Portugal depending on the sector.

CNS-027.titulo_en: Letter Responding to Collection of a Time-Barred Consumer Debt
CNS-027.descricao_en: Drafts a formal letter pleading limitation (prescrição) in response to attempts to collect sums that are no longer enforceable because the legal limitation period has elapsed. It explains the limitation periods applicable to different types of consumer debt (services, credit, telecommunications, energy), informs the consumer of the effect of pleading limitation and warns of the risks of any partial payment (interruption of the limitation period).

CNS-028.titulo_en: Consumer Law Compliance Checklist for an Online Shop
CNS-028.descricao_en: Produces a legal compliance checklist for Portuguese online shops (e-commerce), checking compliance with Decree-Law No. 24/2014 (distance contracts), Decree-Law No. 7/2004 (electronic commerce), the GDPR (RGPD), Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (guarantees), the Omnibus Directive (Decree-Law No. 109-G/2021) and the legislation on consumer reviews and prices. Useful both for advising businesses that want to check their compliance and for identifying infringements by a shop that has harmed a consumer.

CNS-029.titulo_en: Complaint about a Commercial Guarantee Not Honoured
CNS-029.descricao_en: Drafts a formal complaint about failure to honour a commercial guarantee (voluntary guarantee from the manufacturer or seller going beyond the legal guarantee), invoking the terms of the contractual guarantee, Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (which regulates commercial guarantees) and the consumer's rights when the guarantor fails to comply with the terms it advertised. It clearly distinguishes the commercial guarantee (voluntary, more favourable) from the legal guarantee (mandatory, minimum of 2 or 3 years).

CNS-030.titulo_en: Analysis of a Package Travel Contract and the Traveller's Rights
CNS-030.descricao_en: Analyses a package travel contract under Decree-Law No. 17/2018 (which transposed Directive (EU) 2015/2302) and identifies the traveller's rights in the event of a price change, significant alteration, non-performance or insolvency of the organiser, supplemented by the rights under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 (delay/cancellation of a flight included in the package) and Law No. 24/96. It distinguishes package travel (maximum protection) from separate travel services (lesser protection).

CNS-031.titulo_en: Legal Guarantee for Goods: Exercising Rights within the 3-Year Period (Decree-Law 84/2021)
CNS-031.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts a formal communication to exercise conformity rights in respect of tangible movable goods under Decree-Law No. 84/2021 of 18 October, which transposed Directive 2019/771/EU. It covers the extended 3-year period for new goods, the reversal of the burden of proof in the first 2 years and the hierarchy of remedies (repair, replacement, price reduction, termination).

CNS-032.titulo_en: Defective Digital Content and Services: Remedies under Decree-Law 84/2021
CNS-032.descricao_en: Analyses lack of conformity in digital content and services (apps, streaming platforms, software, games, e-books) under Articles 42 to 61 of Decree-Law No. 84/2021, which transposed Directive 2019/770/EU. It covers the obligation to maintain conformity throughout the supply, the special two-year period and the available remedies.

CNS-033.titulo_en: Aggressive Doorstep Selling and Telemarketing: Annulment and Cooling-Off Right
CNS-033.descricao_en: Drafts a communication to annul contracts concluded following home visits, fairs or unsolicited telephone calls, invoking the 14-day right of withdrawal under Decree-Law No. 24/2014 of 14 February (off-premises contracts) and the rules on aggressive commercial practices in Law No. 24/96 and Decree-Law No. 57/2008.

CNS-034.titulo_en: Marketplaces and Liability: Complaint to the Seller and the Platform
CNS-034.descricao_en: Analyses the liability of the third-party seller and of the marketplace platform (Amazon, OLX, FNAC Marketplace, etc.) for lack of conformity or misleading practices, under Decree-Law No. 84/2021, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act), Decree-Law No. 24/2014 and Law No. 24/96. It identifies the chain of liability and directs the complaint to the correct party.

CNS-035.titulo_en: Subscriptions and Automatic Renewal: Cancellation and Refund
CNS-035.descricao_en: Drafts a communication to cancel automatically renewing subscriptions (gyms, digital magazines, software, online services) and to demand a refund of undue charges after cancellation, under Decree-Law No. 24/2014, Law No. 24/96 and Decree-Law No. 57/2008 (unfair commercial practices), with reference to the obligations under Regulation (EU) 2023/2673 (Digital Fairness Act, where applicable).

CNS-036.titulo_en: Mandatory Consumer Arbitration for Essential Services: Application to CACCL/CARC
CNS-036.descricao_en: Prepares the arbitration application to the consumer dispute arbitration centres with mandatory jurisdiction over essential services (electricity, gas, water, electronic communications, transport), under Law No. 144/2015 (ADR), Law No. 23/96 (essential public services) and the rules of the recognised arbitration centres.

CNS-037.titulo_en: Consumer Credit: Right of Early Repayment and Reduction of Charges (Decree-Law 133/2009)
CNS-037.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts a communication exercising the right of full or partial early repayment of consumer credit, calculating the reduction in the total cost of credit and the maximum compensation due to the creditor, under Decree-Law No. 133/2009 of 2 June, which transposed Directive 2008/48/EC.

CNS-038.titulo_en: Package Travel: Termination of the Contract and Refund for the Organiser's Non-Performance
CNS-038.descricao_en: Prepares the communication terminating the package travel contract and demanding a full refund, under Decree-Law No. 17/2018 of 8 March (which transposed Directive 2015/2302/EU on package travel), in the event of a significant alteration, cancellation by the organiser or non-performance of services included in the package.

CNS-039.titulo_en: Undue Billing for Electricity or Gas: Dispute and Correction
CNS-039.descricao_en: Drafts a reasoned complaint about undue charges on electricity or natural gas bills (accumulated estimated readings, retroactive adjustments, meter reading errors, meter tampering), under Law No. 23/96 of 26 July, the regulations of the Energy Services Regulatory Authority (ERSE) and the general terms of the supply contracts.

CNS-040.titulo_en: Overbooking and Flight Delay: Compensation under Regulation (EC) 261/2004
CNS-040.descricao_en: Calculates and claims compensation for denied boarding (overbooking), flight cancellation or a delay of more than 3 hours, under Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 February 2004. It also covers the right to care (meals, accommodation, communication) and the alternatives of re-routing or reimbursement.

CNS-041.titulo_en: Telecommunications Contracts: Termination for an Unlawful Lock-In Period and Number Portability
CNS-041.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts a communication to terminate a telecommunications contract with excessive or unlawful lock-in periods (fidelização), to demand a reduction of the exit penalty and to invoke the right to number portability, under Law No. 23/96, Law No. 5/2004 (Electronic Communications Law) and the decisions of the National Communications Authority (ANACOM).

CNS-042.titulo_en: Unfair Commercial Practices: Report to ASAE and Claim for Compensation
CNS-042.descricao_en: Drafts a report to the Food and Economic Safety Authority (ASAE) and/or the Directorate-General for Consumers about unfair commercial practices (misleading or aggressive), under Decree-Law No. 57/2008 of 26 March, which transposed Directive 2005/29/EC. It includes the claim against the trader for compensation for the damage caused by the unfair practice.

CNS-043.titulo_en: Unfair Terms in Standard-Form Contracts: Analysis and Injunction Action
CNS-043.descricao_en: Analyses standard-form contracts and identifies unfair terms under Decree-Law No. 446/85 of 25 October (Standard Contract Terms Regime — RCCG). It prepares a letter invoking the nullity of the terms and the grounds for an injunction action (ação inibitória) or for a defence in litigation where the trader seeks to enforce the term.

CNS-044.titulo_en: Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Guide to Choosing the Centre and Filing Online
CNS-044.descricao_en: Identifies the consumer arbitration centre competent for the specific dispute, prepares the ADR (RAL) application and guides the consumer through online filing via the European Commission's ODR platform or the national centres recognised by the Ministry of Justice, under Law No. 144/2015 of 8 September.

CNS-045.titulo_en: Producer Liability for Defective Products: Claim for Compensation (Decree-Law 383/89)
CNS-045.descricao_en: Prepares the claim for compensation against the producer or importer for damage caused by a defective product, under Decree-Law No. 383/89 of 6 November (producer's strict liability), calculating pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage and identifying the grounds of exclusion the producer may invoke.

CNS-046.titulo_en: Consumer Credit Agreement: Analysis of Breach of Information Duties (Decree-Law 133/2009)
CNS-046.descricao_en: Analyses whether the consumer credit agreement complies with the mandatory pre-contractual (FINE) and contractual information duties under Decree-Law No. 133/2009, identifying the consequences of breach (nullity of clauses, reduction of the APR (TAEG)) and preparing the consumer's defence in the event of court collection proceedings.

CNS-047.titulo_en: Electronic Complaints Book: Follow-Up and Escalation of the Complaint
CNS-047.descricao_en: Guides the consumer in following up a complaint submitted in the Electronic Complaints Book (LRE), assesses the trader's response and prepares the escalation to the competent authority (DGC, ASAE, ANACOM, Banco de Portugal, ERSE, etc.) where the response is unsatisfactory or is not given within the legal time limit, under Decree-Law No. 74/2017 and Decree-Law No. 156/2005.

CNS-048.titulo_en: Purchase of a Used Car: Guarantee, Latent Defects and Termination
CNS-048.descricao_en: Analyses the rights of the buyer of a used vehicle purchased from a trader (dealership), combining the guarantee regime of Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (minimum period of 1 year for used goods) with the Civil Code regime on latent defects (Articles 913 et seq.), and prepares the appropriate strategy and communication.

CNS-049.titulo_en: Tourist Accommodation: Complaint about Breach of a Booking and Hotel Overbooking
CNS-049.descricao_en: Drafts a complaint and claim for compensation for refusal of check-in at a hotel (overbooking) or lack of conformity of the booked accommodation (room different from the one contracted, unavailable facilities, hygiene), under Decree-Law No. 17/2018 (if part of a package holiday), Law No. 24/96 and Decree-Law No. 128/2014 (local accommodation, alojamento local).

CNS-050.titulo_en: Protection of Over-Indebted Consumers: Rights in Negotiations with Creditors
CNS-050.descricao_en: Analyses the over-indebtedness of a consumer who is a natural person and prepares the strategy for negotiating with creditors under Law No. 57/2020 (PARI applied to consumers), Decree-Law No. 227/2012 (mortgage credit), Decree-Law No. 133/2009 (consumer credit) and Law No. 58/2012 (extraordinary protection regime). It includes the consumer's rights in the face of abusive collection practices.

CNS-051.titulo_en: Mandatory Tied Selling: Challenge and Unbundling of Products and Services
CNS-051.descricao_en: Analyses and challenges the practice of mandatory tied selling — where the trader makes the purchase of a product or service conditional on the compulsory purchase of another — under Decree-Law No. 57/2008 (unfair commercial practices), Law No. 24/96, Decree-Law No. 133/2009 (for consumer credit) and the sector rules of ANACOM and the Insurance and Pension Funds Supervisory Authority (ASF) for telecommunications and insurance.

CNS-052.titulo_en: Cancelling a Gym or Sports Club Contract: Termination for Just Cause
CNS-052.descricao_en: Prepares the communication terminating a contract with a gym, sports club or fitness studio, invoking just cause (change of residence, illness, unemployment, closure of the premises) or termination with prior notice, under Law No. 24/96, Decree-Law No. 24/2014 and the specific terms of continuing-performance contracts, and contests unlawful penalties.

CNS-053.titulo_en: Repair Services by a Trader: Binding Quote, Final Price and Refusal of Undue Payment
CNS-053.descricao_en: Analyses the consumer's rights when engaging repair services (car repair shops, electronics technicians, plumbers, electricians), demands compliance with the obligation to provide a binding prior quote and contests charges above the agreed amount, under Law No. 24/96, Decree-Law No. 138/90 (prices) and the applicable sector rules.

CNS-054.titulo_en: Automatic Price Adjustment Clause in a Continuing-Performance Contract: Challenge
CNS-054.descricao_en: Analyses and challenges automatic price adjustment clauses in continuing-performance contracts (insurance, gyms, subscription software, telecommunications services), assessing their validity under Decree-Law No. 446/85 (standard contract terms), Decree-Law No. 24/2014 and the sector rules, and prepares the communication contesting the clause or terminating the contract without penalty.

CNS-055.titulo_en: Online Purchase (E-Commerce): Non-Delivery, Delay and Right of Withdrawal
CNS-055.descricao_en: Analyses and drafts a communication to exercise the 14-day right of withdrawal for online purchases, to demand delivery within the agreed or legal time limit and to obtain a full refund in the event of non-delivery, under Decree-Law No. 24/2014 of 14 February (distance contracts), Decree-Law No. 7/2004 (electronic commerce) and Law No. 24/96.

CNS-056.titulo_en: Access to Personal Data and Portability in a Consumer Context: Request to the Trader
CNS-056.descricao_en: Prepares the formal request for access to, rectification, erasure and portability of personal data processed by the trader in a consumer relationship, under Articles 15 to 20 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR (RGPD)) and Law No. 58/2019 (implementation of the GDPR in Portugal), combining data protection rights with consumer rights.

CNS-057.titulo_en: Private Health Services: Complaint about Undue Charges and the Right to Price Information
CNS-057.descricao_en: Analyses and contests undue charges for private health services (clinics, hospitals, dentists, diagnostic imaging), demands compliance with the obligation to provide prior price information and prepares the complaint to the Health Regulatory Authority (ERS), under Law No. 24/96, Law No. 27/2002 (general bases of health policy) and the ERS regulations.

CNS-058.titulo_en: Complaint about a Defect in Goods Bought Online: Return, Refund and Logistics Company
CNS-058.descricao_en: Prepares the strategy and communication for returning goods bought online that are non-conforming or defective, combining the guarantee regime of Decree-Law No. 84/2021 with the right of withdrawal under Decree-Law No. 24/2014, and identifies the consumer's rights where the logistics company damaged the goods during delivery.

CNS-059.titulo_en: Commercial Guarantee: Demanding Performance and the Difference from the Legal Guarantee
CNS-059.descricao_en: Analyses the commercial guarantee offered by the producer or seller (manufacturer's guarantee) and demands that it be honoured where the trader invokes conditions not provided for in the guarantee, refuses service during the coverage period or unlawfully tries to replace it with the legal guarantee, under Decree-Law No. 84/2021 and Law No. 24/96.

CNS-060.titulo_en: Compliance Checklist for an Online Shop under Portuguese Consumer Law
CNS-060.descricao_en: Audits an online shop's legal compliance with the obligations under Decree-Law No. 24/2014 (distance contracts), Decree-Law No. 7/2004 (electronic commerce), Decree-Law No. 84/2021 (guarantees), the GDPR (RGPD) and Law No. 24/96. It identifies non-conformities, legal risks and the corrections needed to comply with Portuguese and European consumer law.

TRA-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete open-ended (sem termo) employment contract, with mandatory and optional clauses, adapted to the Portuguese Labour Code and the legal regime applicable to the employment relationship in question, including the particulars required by law.

TRA-002.titulo_en: Fixed-Term Employment Contract (with Grounds for the Term)
TRA-002.descricao_en: Generates a fixed-term (termo certo) employment contract stating the legal grounds that justify the term, complying with the formal requirements and duration limits laid down in the Portuguese Labour Code, and preventing the term from being void for missing or insufficient grounds.

TRA-003.titulo_en: Employment Contract for an Uncertain Term
TRA-003.descricao_en: Generates an employment contract for an uncertain term (termo incerto), suitable where the duration of the relationship cannot be precisely anticipated because it depends on a future and uncertain event, with proper grounds for the term and a termination clause adapted to the nature of the contract.

TRA-004.titulo_en: Employment Contract under the Comissão de Serviço Regime
TRA-004.descricao_en: Generates an employment contract under the comissão de serviço regime (appointment to a position of trust) for management, director or high-level supervisory posts, with clauses on remuneration, termination without just cause and possible reinstatement, in compliance with the special regime of Articles 161 to 164 of the Labour Code.

TRA-005.descricao_en: Generates a part-time employment contract expressly stating the weekly working hours, the pro rata calculation of pay and the other conditions, in accordance with Articles 150 to 160 of the Labour Code and the principle of proportionality.

TRA-006.descricao_en: Generates the addendum to an employment contract moving the employee to teleworking or drafts a teleworking employment contract, defining the place of work, equipment, expenses, privacy, monitoring and reversibility, in accordance with Articles 165 to 171 of the Labour Code (as amended by Law No. 83/2021).

TRA-007.descricao_en: Drafts a legally valid post-contractual non-compete clause, defining the scope of the prohibited activity, the maximum duration, adequate compensation and the consequences of breach, in accordance with Article 136 of the Labour Code.

TRA-008.descricao_en: Drafts a valid retention agreement (pacto de permanência) requiring the employee to remain in employment for a minimum period after training or special investment by the employer, defining the value of the investment, the duration of the mandatory stay and the proportional compensation payable in case of breach, under Article 137 of the Labour Code.

TRA-009.titulo_en: Agreement Terminating the Employment Contract by Mutual Consent
TRA-009.descricao_en: Generates an agreement terminating the employment contract by mutual consent (revogação), setting the termination date and the negotiated financial terms (compensation, pro rata allowances, etc.), and including the mandatory legal safeguards, under Article 349 of the Labour Code.

TRA-010.titulo_en: Notice of Termination during the Probationary Period
TRA-010.descricao_en: Generates the written notice terminating the employment contract during the probationary period, with prior notice calculated according to the length of the period already elapsed, in accordance with Article 114 of the Labour Code, whether termination is by the employer or by the employee.

TRA-011.titulo_en: Statement of Charges (Nota de Culpa) in Disciplinary Proceedings
TRA-011.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of charges (nota de culpa) for disciplinary proceedings, with an objective and detailed description of the facts alleged, their classification as disciplinary offences and an indication of the sanction the employer is considering, meeting the formal requirements of Articles 329 and 353 of the Labour Code.

TRA-012.titulo_en: Final Decision in Disciplinary Proceedings Imposing a Conservative Sanction
TRA-012.descricao_en: Generates the final decision in disciplinary proceedings imposing a conservative (non-dismissal) sanction on the employee (warning, written reprimand, suspension without pay or loss of holiday days), with grounds based on the statement of charges, an assessment of the defence submitted and the proportionality of the sanction, meeting the requirements of Articles 357 and 358 of the Labour Code.

TRA-013.titulo_en: Decision of Dismissal for Just Cause
TRA-013.descricao_en: Generates the final decision of dismissal for just cause, with the facts established, an assessment of the employee's defence, classification under the specific subparagraph of Article 351 of the Labour Code and the reasons why the employment relationship cannot continue, meeting the requirements of Articles 357 and 358 CT.

TRA-014.titulo_en: Notice of Intended Dismissal for Redundancy of the Post
TRA-014.descricao_en: Generates the formal notice of intended dismissal for redundancy of the post (extinção do posto de trabalho), setting out the economic or structural reasons behind it and the formal requirements of Articles 367 to 372 of the Labour Code, including the required notice to the employee, to the Commission for Equality in Labour and Employment (CITE) where protected employees are involved and to the process manager (if applicable).

TRA-015.descricao_en: Generates the set of notices and documentation needed for a collective dismissal procedure, including the notice of intention to the employees' representative structures and to the public employment service, the opening of the negotiation period and the final notice to the employees concerned, under Articles 359 to 366 of the Labour Code.

TRA-016.titulo_en: Letter Responding to Termination of the Contract by the Employee
TRA-016.descricao_en: Generates the employer's formal reply to the employee's letter terminating the contract for just cause (under Article 394 CT), contesting the grounds invoked, disputing the facts alleged and guarding against the legal consequences of a termination found to be justified (compensation equivalent to that for unlawful dismissal).

TRA-017.titulo_en: Statement of Claim Challenging the Regularity and Lawfulness of a Dismissal
TRA-017.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of claim challenging in court the formal regularity and/or lawfulness of a dismissal, identifying the procedural defects, contesting the grounds invoked by the employer and seeking reinstatement or compensation in lieu, under Articles 387 to 392 of the Labour Code, for filing with the competent labour court.

TRA-018.titulo_en: Employer's Defence in an Action Challenging a Dismissal
TRA-018.descricao_en: Generates the employer's defence (contestação) in an action challenging a dismissal, responding to the grounds in the statement of claim, raising procedural defences (expiry of the time limit, lack of standing) and disputing the facts and the legal characterisation of the dismissal, including a request to extend the scope of the proceedings where relevant.

TRA-019.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure Suspending a Dismissal
TRA-019.descricao_en: Generates the application for an interim measure (providência cautelar) suspending the effects of a dismissal, to be filed with the labour courts, demonstrating fumus boni iuris (apparent unlawfulness of the dismissal) and periculum in mora (urgency due to loss of income), under Article 386 of the Labour Code and the Code of Labour Procedure.

TRA-020.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Recognition of an Employment Contract
TRA-020.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim seeking recognition of an employment contract where employment is disguised as a contract for services ("false green receipts" — falso recibo verde), demonstrating the indications of legal and economic subordination and seeking recognition of the relationship, payment of outstanding employment credits and regularisation of the social security contribution position, under Article 12 of the Labour Code.

TRA-021.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Ordinary Labour Action for Employment Credits
TRA-021.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of claim for outstanding employment credits (salary arrears, holidays, allowances, overtime, termination compensation), with a detailed calculation of the amounts, legal grounds and itemised claims, for filing with the competent labour court.

TRA-022.titulo_en: Calculation of Employment Credits on Termination (Holidays, Allowances, Pro Rata Amounts)
TRA-022.descricao_en: Calculates in detail all the employment credits owed to the employee on the termination date, including untaken holidays, pro rata holiday allowance, pro rata Christmas allowance, pro rata pay, seniority increments (diuturnidades) and other credits, showing formulas and itemised amounts, under the Portuguese Labour Code.

TRA-023.titulo_en: Calculation of Severance Compensation and Seniority-Based Compensation
TRA-023.descricao_en: Calculates precisely the severance compensation and the compensation for unlawful dismissal, distinguishing the applicable regimes according to the employee's hiring date (before and after the 2012 reform), the type of termination and whether or not the dismissal was unlawful, under Articles 366, 391 and 392 of the Labour Code.

TRA-024.descricao_en: Calculates the value of overtime (trabalho suplementar) worked beyond normal working hours, applying the statutory premiums according to when it was worked (first premium, subsequent premiums, work on a weekly rest day or public holiday), and states the total owed to the employee, under Articles 226 to 231 of the Labour Code.

TRA-025.titulo_en: Termination of the Contract by the Employee for Just Cause (Reasoned Letter)
TRA-025.descricao_en: Generates the employee's letter terminating the employment contract for just cause, precisely identifying the legal grounds, objectively describing the employer's conduct that makes continuation of the relationship untenable and giving notice of termination with an indication of the credits due, under Articles 394 and 395 of the Labour Code.

TRA-026.titulo_en: Reply to a Request for Information from the ACT (Working Conditions Authority)
TRA-026.descricao_en: Generates a company's formal reply to a request for information, clarification or documents from the Working Conditions Authority (Autoridade para as Condições do Trabalho, ACT), whether in an inspection, following an employee complaint or in a compliance check, organising the facts and defending the regularity of the company's employment practices.

TRA-027.titulo_en: Defence against an Official Report / Labour Administrative Offence
TRA-027.descricao_en: Generates the company's written defence in response to an official report (auto de notícia) or a notice of charges in labour administrative offence (contraordenação) proceedings, disputing the facts, invoking mitigating circumstances, contesting the legal classification of the offence and arguing for a proportionate fine, under the Labour Code and the General Regime of Administrative Offences.

TRA-028.titulo_en: Workplace Accident Report and Follow-Up of the Process
TRA-028.descricao_en: Generates the formal report of a workplace accident to the insurer and to the ACT, with an objective description of the accident, identification of the parties and witnesses, and guidance on following up the compensation process, under Law No. 98/2009 (legal regime for workplace accidents and occupational diseases) and Law No. 7/2009 (Labour Code).

TRA-029.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in Workplace Accident Proceedings
TRA-029.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in proceedings arising from a workplace accident, to challenge the insurer's decision, obtain recognition of the causal link between the accident and the injuries, set the degree of incapacity and calculate the benefits due (treatment, allowances, lump sum or pension), under Law No. 98/2009 and the Code of Labour Procedure.

TRA-030.descricao_en: Generates complete and legally valid internal company regulations (regulamento interno), setting rules on operations, conduct, working hours, use of equipment, intellectual property, confidentiality, discipline and safety, in accordance with the Labour Code and the GDPR (RGPD), and providing a mechanism for publication and entry into force.

TRA-031.descricao_en: Generates a complete and legally appropriate policy for preventing and combating workplace harassment (psychological and sexual), defining the concept, reporting mechanisms, the investigation procedure, applicable sanctions and victim protection measures, in accordance with Articles 29 and 30 of the Labour Code and the legal obligation to adopt such a policy.

TRA-032.titulo_en: Agreement for the Occasional Assignment of an Employee
TRA-032.descricao_en: Generates the tripartite agreement for the occasional assignment of an employee (cedência ocasional) between the assigning employer, the user company and the employee, setting the conditions of assignment, pay, responsibilities and duration, under Articles 288 to 293 of the Labour Code, distinguishing it from temporary agency work governed by special legislation.

TRA-033.titulo_en: Notice to Employees of a Transfer of Undertaking
TRA-033.descricao_en: Generates the mandatory notice to employees of the transfer of the undertaking (transfer of business, merger, demerger or other), informing them of the date, the new employer, the conditions maintained and the employees' rights, under Articles 285 to 287 of the Labour Code and Directive 2001/23/EC.

TRA-034.titulo_en: Holiday Schedule and Notice of Holiday Dates
TRA-034.descricao_en: Generates the company's annual holiday schedule (mapa de férias) and the individual notices to employees setting their holiday dates, meeting the legal deadlines for publication and notification and respecting employees' priority of choice and rotation criteria, under Articles 237 to 243 of the Labour Code.

TRA-035.titulo_en: Opinion on the Classification of a Working Relationship (Employment vs. Contract for Services)
TRA-035.descricao_en: Analyses the legal relationship between a company and a service provider (or "recibo verde" self-employed worker) and gives a reasoned opinion on whether the relationship is a genuine contract for services (Art. 1154 CC) or disguised subordinate employment (Arts. 11 and 12 CT), identifying the decisive indicators and the risk of reclassification by the ACT or the courts.

TRA-036.descricao_en: Generates the appeal submissions (alegações) against a labour court judgment to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação), identifying the errors of fact and/or law, specifying the grounds of appeal under the Code of Labour Procedure and the Code of Civil Procedure, and setting out the mandatory conclusions.

TRA-037.titulo_en: Complaint of Discrimination at Work (Gender Equality / EU Layer)
TRA-037.descricao_en: Generates a formal complaint of discrimination at work — notably on grounds of gender, pregnancy, maternity, parenthood or another protected characteristic — for submission to the Commission for Equality in Labour and Employment (Comissão para a Igualdade no Trabalho e no Emprego, CITE) and/or as a statement of claim in a labour action, under Articles 23 to 32 of the Labour Code and Directive 2006/54/EC.

TRA-038.titulo_en: Contract Addendum for a Change of Category or Pay
TRA-038.descricao_en: Generates the addendum to the employment contract formalising agreed changes to occupational category, pay, function or other essential terms of the contract, in accordance with the principle of freedom of contract and the limits of Article 129 of the Labour Code, ensuring that any change favourable to the employee is formalised and binding.

TRA-039.titulo_en: Reply to a Statement of Charges in Disciplinary Proceedings (Employee's Defence)
TRA-039.descricao_en: Generates the employee's written reply to the statement of charges (nota de culpa) issued by the employer in disciplinary proceedings, under Arts. 355 et seq. of the Labour Code. The document sets out the factual and legal defence, disputes the facts alleged and, where applicable, raises procedural defects that render the proceedings void.

TRA-040.titulo_en: Internal Complaint of Workplace Harassment (Report to the Employer)
TRA-040.descricao_en: Generates the employee's written report to the employer of psychological (moral) or sexual harassment at work, under Arts. 29 and 163 of the Labour Code and Law No. 73/2017 of 16 August. The document triggers the employer's obligation to open an inquiry and may serve as the basis for termination for just cause by the employee.

TRA-041.titulo_en: Hours Bank Agreement by Collective or Individual Arrangement
TRA-041.descricao_en: Generates the instrument establishing an hours bank (banco de horas) at company level or for an individual employee, under Arts. 208 and 208-A of the Labour Code. The document sets the regime for compensating hours, the accumulation limits, the management method and the consequences of failing to exercise the right to compensation.

TRA-042.titulo_en: Agreement on Exemption from Working Hours
TRA-042.descricao_en: Generates the agreement between employer and employee on exemption from working hours (isenção de horário de trabalho), under Art. 218 of the Labour Code, defining the type of exemption, the additional pay and the termination conditions. The document ensures the formal validity of the agreement and compliance with the legal restrictions on exemption.

TRA-043.titulo_en: Notice of Posting of an Employee Abroad (Directive 96/71/EC and National Regime)
TRA-043.descricao_en: Generates the notice and documentation needed for the transnational posting of Portuguese employees to another EU Member State, under Directive 96/71/EC (as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/957), transposed by Decree-Law No. 136/2015 of 28 July, and Regulation (EC) No. 883/2004 on social security. Covers the notification to the host country's authorities and the contract addendum.

TRA-044.descricao_en: Generates the pre-retirement (pré-reforma) agreement between employer and employee, under Arts. 318 to 321 of the Labour Code, setting the regime for progressive reduction of working time, pay during pre-retirement and the termination conditions. The document ensures compliance with the legal requirements of eligibility and form.

TRA-045.titulo_en: Digital Disconnection Policy and Right Not to Be Disturbed
TRA-045.descricao_en: Generates the internal digital disconnection policy under Art. 199-A of the Labour Code (added by Law No. 83/2021 of 6 December), defining no-contact hours, permissible exceptions and implementation measures. The document meets the legal obligation of companies with more than 10 employees to adopt rules on disconnection.

TRA-046.descricao_en: Generates the contract or addendum establishing shift work, under Arts. 220 to 222 of the Labour Code, defining the type of shift, rotation, mandatory compensation and the conditions for leaving the regime. The document meets the formal requirements and the mandatory rules applicable to shift work.

TRA-047.titulo_en: Claim to Protect the Employee's Personality Rights (Personality Rights in the Employment Contract)
TRA-047.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to protect the employee's personality rights in the employment relationship, under Arts. 14 to 22 of the Labour Code and Art. 70 of the Civil Code, notably to protect private life, physical and moral integrity, honour and image against abusive conduct by the employer.

TRA-048.titulo_en: Defence in Inquiry Proceedings following a Whistleblowing Report (Law No. 93/2021)
TRA-048.descricao_en: Generates the legal response of an employee subjected to retaliation after reporting irregularities under Law No. 93/2021 of 20 December (transposing Directive (EU) 2019/1937 — whistleblower protection). The document sets out the legal protection against retaliation, the reversal of the burden of proof and the claims for cessation and compensation.

TRA-049.titulo_en: Application for a Work Permit for a Third-Country National (Type D Visa and Residence Permit for Work)
TRA-049.descricao_en: Generates the supporting documentation and application for a work and residence permit for a third-country national employee in Portugal, under Law No. 23/2007 of 4 July (Foreigners Act), Decree-Law No. 84/2007 and the Labour Code rules on hiring foreign workers. Covers the expression of interest (manifestação de interesse) and the procedure before the Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA).

TRA-050.titulo_en: Temporary Worker Assignment Agreement with a Temporary Work Agency (Contrato de Utilização)
TRA-050.descricao_en: Generates the contract for the use of temporary work between the user company and the temporary work agency (empresa de trabalho temporário, ETT), under Law No. 19/2007 of 22 May (Temporary Work Law, as amended by Law No. 28/2016) and Arts. 172 to 192 of the Labour Code. The document meets the mandatory formal requirements and the statutory duration limits.

TRA-051.titulo_en: Opinion on the Application of a Collective Labour Regulation Instrument (IRCT) to a Company
TRA-051.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion determining which collective labour regulation instrument (collective bargaining agreement, company-level agreement or working conditions order — portaria de condições de trabalho) applies to a company and its employees, under Arts. 476 et seq. of the Labour Code and the Contributory Regimes Code. The opinion identifies the minimum rights under the agreement and the applicable occupational categories.

TRA-052.titulo_en: Application for Parental Leave, Adoption Leave and Parenthood Rights
TRA-052.descricao_en: Generates the application to exercise parenthood rights — including initial parental leave, extended parental leave, adoption leave and leave to care for a child — under Arts. 33 to 103 of the Labour Code and Decree-Law No. 91/2009 of 9 April (social security parenthood benefits). The document ensures that all deadlines for notifying the employer are met.

TRA-053.titulo_en: Gender Equality Plan for Companies with 50 or More Employees
TRA-053.descricao_en: Generates the mandatory gender equality plan for companies with 50 or more employees, under Law No. 62/2017 of 1 August (balanced representation on companies' management and supervisory bodies) and Decree-Law No. 76/2021 of 18 September, which transposed Directive 2006/54/EC. The document includes a diagnosis of the situation, equality objectives, measures and monitoring indicators.

TRA-054.titulo_en: Notice and Procedure for Dismissal for Redundancy of the Post with Selection Criteria
TRA-054.descricao_en: Generates the complete documentation for the procedure of dismissal for redundancy of the post, under Arts. 367 to 372 of the Labour Code, with particular attention to defining and applying the legal selection criteria between employees in comparable positions, which are the most litigated element of this type of dismissal.

TRA-055.titulo_en: Employee Non-Disclosure Agreement for Confidential Information (Employment NDA)
TRA-055.descricao_en: Generates the contractual clause or stand-alone confidentiality and non-disclosure agreement in an employment context, under Arts. 128(1)(f) and 129(1)(g) of the Labour Code, supplemented by the trade secrets regime (Law No. 93/2017 of 23 August, which transposed Directive (EU) 2016/943). The document differs from a post-contractual non-compete agreement in that it protects information rather than prohibiting an activity.

TRA-056.titulo_en: Notice of Transfer of Undertaking and Protection of Employees (Art. 285 CT)
TRA-056.descricao_en: Generates the complete documentation for the transfer of an undertaking or business, under Arts. 285 to 288 of the Labour Code (transposing Directive 2001/23/EC), including the mandatory notice to works councils and trade union representatives, the individual notice to each employee and an analysis of the right to object to the transfer.

TRA-057.titulo_en: Professional Traineeship Contract and Traineeship Grant (IEFP and Private Regime)
TRA-057.descricao_en: Generates the professional traineeship contract and supporting documents, distinguishing a traineeship under the programme of the Institute of Employment and Vocational Training (IEFP), governed by Decree-Law No. 66/2011 of 1 June, from a private traineeship in a company (civil/employment contract regime), defining the learning objectives, the grant, the trainee's rights and the conditions for conversion into an employment contract.

TRA-058.titulo_en: Defence against an ACT Official Report — Administrative Offence for Breach of Working Time Rules
TRA-058.descricao_en: Generates the employer's written defence in labour administrative offence proceedings brought by the Working Conditions Authority (ACT) for an alleged breach of the rules on working time, overtime or time recording, under the Labour Code, the General Regime of Labour Administrative Offences (Law No. 107/2009 of 14 September) and the applicable special rules. The document is more specific and detailed than the generic labour administrative offence defence already in the product.

TRA-059.titulo_en: Calculation and Claim of Time-Barred Employment Credits — Limitation Period and Recovery Strategy
TRA-059.descricao_en: Generates the opinion and out-of-court notice for claiming the employee's employment credits, with a detailed calculation of the amounts owed, an analysis of the limitation periods (Art. 337 and Arts. 306 to 311 of the Labour Code and the Civil Code) and the best recovery route (out-of-court notice, action in the Labour Court or claim in insolvency proceedings).

TRA-060.titulo_en: Appeal Submissions in Labour Proceedings to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação)
TRA-060.descricao_en: Generates the appeal submissions in labour proceedings to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação), under Arts. 79 et seq. of the Code of Labour Procedure (CPT) and Arts. 635 et seq. of the Code of Civil Procedure (CPC), applicable by virtue of (ex vi) Art. 1 CPT, including the mandatory conclusions and a challenge to the findings of fact where applicable.

URB-001.titulo_en: Application for a Building Licence / Urban Development Operation
URB-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete application for a building licence or a licence for another urban development operation (operação urbanística) addressed to the competent municipal council (câmara municipal), under the RJUE (Legal Regime for Urbanisation and Building), with identification of the applicant, a description of the operation, the legal framework and a list of supporting documents.

URB-002.descricao_en: Generates the prior notification (comunicação prévia) for carrying out urbanisation or building works subject to this simplified procedure under the RJUE, with identification of the applicant, a description of the operation, a declaration of legal compliance and the required supporting documents.

URB-003.descricao_en: Generates the application for a use authorisation (autorização de utilização, commonly known as the 'alvará de utilização') to be submitted to the municipal council after completion of building works, under Articles 62 to 65 of the RJUE, stating the intended use and listing the supporting documents.

URB-004.descricao_en: Generates the complete application for a subdivision licence (licença de loteamento) and urbanisation works to be submitted to the municipal council, under Articles 57 et seq. of the RJUE, identifying the property, describing the subdivision operation, framing it within the territorial management instruments and listing the supporting documents.

URB-005.titulo_en: Request for Prior Information on an Urban Development Operation
URB-005.descricao_en: Generates the request for prior information (pedido de informação prévia — RIP) to be submitted to the municipal council in order to ascertain in advance the planning parameters applicable to a property and the feasibility of an urban development operation, under Article 14 of the RJUE, before investing in an architectural design.

URB-006.titulo_en: Prior Hearing Submission in a Planning Licensing Procedure
URB-006.descricao_en: Generates the submission in the prior hearing (audiência prévia) under Article 100 of the Code of Administrative Procedure (CPA), when the municipal council notifies the applicant that it intends to refuse the planning licence application or to make it subject to onerous conditions, allowing the grounds of the draft decision to be rebutted before the final decision.

URB-007.titulo_en: Complaint against the Refusal of a Licence Application
URB-007.descricao_en: Generates the administrative complaint (reclamação) to the same body (mayor or municipal council) against the decision refusing a planning licence, under Articles 191 et seq. of the CPA, on grounds of unlawfulness or merits, as a step prior or alternative to a hierarchical appeal.

URB-008.titulo_en: Hierarchical Appeal against a Municipal Planning Decision
URB-008.descricao_en: Generates the hierarchical appeal (recurso hierárquico) to the mayor (or to the member of the government with oversight powers, in the cases provided for by law) against municipal decisions on planning licensing, under Articles 193 et seq. of the CPA.

URB-009.titulo_en: Court Challenge to a Works Embargo Order
URB-009.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a special administrative action (ação administrativa especial) challenging the works embargo (stop-work order) issued by the municipal council, under Articles 112 et seq. of the Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts (CPTA), disputing the lawfulness of the embargo and seeking its annulment with immediate lifting or interim suspension.

URB-010.titulo_en: Court Challenge to a Demolition Order
URB-010.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a special administrative action challenging a municipal order to demolish works or part of works, under the CPTA, disputing its legal grounds and seeking annulment of the act with interim suspensive effect, given the irreversible nature of demolition.

URB-011.titulo_en: Defence in Planning Administrative Offence Proceedings
URB-011.descricao_en: Generates the written defence (Article 50 of the General Regime for Administrative Offences — RGCO) in planning administrative offence proceedings (contraordenação) brought by the municipal council under the RJUE, contesting the attribution of the offence, its requirements and the proportionality of the fine (coima), or requesting that the case be closed.

URB-012.titulo_en: Claim Challenging the Refusal of a Building Licence
URB-012.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a special administrative action before the Administrative Circuit Court (Tribunal Administrativo de Círculo) challenging the decision refusing a building licence, once administrative remedies have been exhausted, under the CPTA, seeking annulment and an order requiring the municipal council to issue the licence.

URB-013.titulo_en: Application to Regularise Works Carried Out without a Licence
URB-013.descricao_en: Generates the application for regularisation (legalização) of works carried out without a licence or not in conformity with the existing licence, under Article 102(4) et seq. of the RJUE, asking the municipal council to consider the possibility of regularisation by granting a licence or accepting a prior notification based on the works as they currently stand.

URB-014.titulo_en: Opinion on a Project's Conformity with the Municipal Master Plan
URB-014.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on whether an architectural or urbanisation project conforms to the provisions of the applicable Municipal Master Plan (Plano Diretor Municipal — PDM), analysing the planning parameters (site coverage ratio — COS, floor area ratio — CUS, height, setbacks), the land qualification and the legal constraints, to support the licensing application or ground the defence in a challenge.

URB-015.titulo_en: Opinion on the Building Potential of a Plot of Land
URB-015.descricao_en: Generates an integrated legal opinion on the building potential (viabilidade construtiva) of a plot of land, analysing land classification and qualification, the PDM planning parameters, constraints (National Ecological Reserve — REN, National Agricultural Reserve — RAN, easements, protection zones) and the intended building operation, to support a purchase or real estate investment decision.

URB-016.titulo_en: Submission / Participation in the Public Consultation on a Municipal Plan
URB-016.descricao_en: Generates a written submission during the public consultation period (discussão pública) on a municipal spatial plan (PDM, urbanisation plan — PU, detailed plan — PP, or amendments thereto), under the RJIGT (Legal Regime for Territorial Management Instruments), challenging planning choices, requesting changes in land classification or making reasoned technical and legal observations.

URB-017.titulo_en: Challenge to a Provision of a Spatial Plan
URB-017.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a special administrative action challenging a provision of a municipal spatial plan (PDM, PU or PP) before the competent Central Administrative Court (Tribunal Central Administrativo), under Articles 72 et seq. of the CPTA, contesting the lawfulness of a plan provision that adversely affects property rights or the building potential of a property.

URB-018.titulo_en: Application for Detachment of a Plot (Destaque)
URB-018.descricao_en: Generates the application for detachment (destaque) of a plot from a rural property, under Article 6 of the RJUE, as a simplified form of land division that does not require a subdivision licence, where the legal requirements are met (property with access to a public road, plot with a minimum area, existence of a building).

URB-019.titulo_en: Application in the Context of an Urban Rehabilitation Operation
URB-019.descricao_en: Generates the licence application or prior notification for urban rehabilitation works in an Urban Rehabilitation Area (Área de Reabilitação Urbana — ARU), under the Legal Regime for Urban Rehabilitation (RJRU — Decree-Law No. 307/2009 of 23 October, as amended) and the RJUE, taking advantage of the special regimes and tax benefits applicable to rehabilitation operations.

URB-020.titulo_en: Application for Exemption from or Reduction of Planning Fees
URB-020.descricao_en: Generates the application for exemption from or reduction of the planning fees payable in licensing, prior notification or use authorisation procedures, based on the exemption regimes provided for in the RJUE, the Local Authorities Financial Regime (RFALEI) and municipal fee regulations.

URB-021.descricao_en: Generates a structured analysis of the calculation of the planning fees payable in a licensing or prior notification procedure, including the Municipal Urbanisation Fee (Taxa Municipal de Urbanização — TMU), compensation for insufficient land transfers (cedências) and assessment fees, identifying the formulas applicable under the relevant municipal regulation and checking for possible calculation errors.

URB-022.titulo_en: Opinion on the Lapse of a Building Licence
URB-022.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the lapse (caducidade — extinction through expiry of the time limit) of a building licence or prior notification, analysing the statutory time limits, the grounds for extension and suspension provided for in the RJUE, and the consequences of lapse for the developer, including the possibility of a new application.

URB-023.titulo_en: Application to Extend the Time Limit of a Licence or Works
URB-023.descricao_en: Generates the application to extend the time limit of a building licence or prior notification, under Article 72 of the RJUE, justifying the need for additional time to complete the works and demonstrating that the requirements for granting the extension are met.

URB-024.titulo_en: Analysis of a Location and Boundaries Certificate
URB-024.descricao_en: Generates a legal analysis of the location and boundaries certificate (certidão de localização e confrontações) issued by the municipal council (or of the property tax record — caderneta predial — and the Land Registry certificate), identifying possible discrepancies, risks of encroachment on neighbouring property, undeclared easements and inconsistencies between the registry documents and the physical reality of the property.

URB-025.titulo_en: Opinion on Administrative Easements and Public Utility Restrictions
URB-025.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the administrative easements and public utility restrictions encumbering a given property, identifying the limitations on building rights and land use arising from the REN, the RAN, road easements, the public water domain, listed heritage, high-voltage lines and other constraints, with an assessment of the impact on building potential.

URB-026.titulo_en: Challenge to a Resolution Creating an Urban Rehabilitation Area
URB-026.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in a special administrative action challenging a municipal resolution creating or delimiting an Urban Rehabilitation Area (ARU), under the CPTA and the RJRU, contesting the lawfulness of the delimitation where it adversely affects owners included in the area or subjects them to disproportionate rehabilitation obligations.

URB-027.descricao_en: Generates the application for a municipal inspection (vistoria) of a building or works, under the RJUE, whether to obtain a use authorisation after completion of works, to certify the habitability conditions of an existing building, to ascertain the state of repair of a property in a dispute with the owner or tenant, or to support a request for compulsory maintenance works.

URB-028.titulo_en: Opinion on the Land Use Regime (REN / RAN)
URB-028.descricao_en: Generates a specialist legal opinion on the impact of the National Ecological Reserve (REN) and the National Agricultural Reserve (RAN) on the use and buildability of a property, identifying the applicable categories of constraint, prohibited uses and actions, compatible uses and actions, and the possibilities of applying for an exception, with an analysis of the compensation regime where applicable.

URB-029.titulo_en: Prior Notification vs. Licensing after the Planning Simplex: Choosing the Procedure
URB-029.descricao_en: Analyses which procedure applies — prior notification (Article 35 RJUE, Decree-Law 555/99) or licensing (Article 20 RJUE) — following the amendments introduced by the Planning Simplex (Simplex Urbanístico, Decree-Law 10/2024 of 9 January), determining the correct procedure for the urban development operation concerned.

URB-030.titulo_en: Tacit Approval in a Planning Procedure: Proof and Protection
URB-030.descricao_en: Determines whether tacit approval (deferimento tácito) has occurred in a licensing or prior notification procedure (Articles 111 and 36 RJUE — Decree-Law 555/99), identifies how to prove it and how to respond before the municipal council or the court when the administration refuses to recognise it.

URB-031.titulo_en: Regularisation of Works Carried Out without Title (Art. 102-A RJUE)
URB-031.descricao_en: Structures the application for regularisation of works carried out without a licence or prior notification under Article 102-A of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), analysing the requirements of conformity with the provisions in force at the date of the application and the strategy for overcoming any non-conformities.

URB-032.titulo_en: Works Embargo: Challenge and Lifting (Arts. 102 and 103 RJUE)
URB-032.descricao_en: Structures the judicial or administrative challenge to an embargo report (auto de embargo) drawn up under Articles 102 and 103 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), analysing the grounds of unlawfulness, the available procedural means and the conditions for lifting the embargo.

URB-033.titulo_en: Challenge to a Demolition Order (Art. 106 RJUE)
URB-033.descricao_en: Analyses and structures the challenge to an order for demolition or restoration of the previous situation issued under Article 106 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), examining the grounds of unlawfulness, the proportionality of the measure and the alternatives to demolition (regularisation, compensation).

URB-034.titulo_en: Amendment of a Subdivision Permit (Art. 27 RJUE)
URB-034.descricao_en: Structures the application to amend a subdivision permit (alvará de loteamento) under Article 27 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), distinguishing simple amendments, amendments requiring a hearing of the plot owners and amendments subject to revision of the PDM, and analysing the rights of the owners (condóminos) and of the municipality.

URB-035.titulo_en: Land Transfers and Compensation in Subdivisions (Arts. 43 and 44 RJUE)
URB-035.descricao_en: Analyses the regime for the transfer of plots for green spaces, facilities and infrastructure in subdivision operations (Article 43 RJUE — Decree-Law 555/99) and the regime of compensation in cash or in kind where such transfers are not possible (Article 44 RJUE), including the calculation and challenge of excessive amounts.

URB-036.titulo_en: Release of Land from the RAN (National Agricultural Reserve)
URB-036.descricao_en: Structures the application for release (desafetação) or exceptional authorisation for the use of land within the National Agricultural Reserve (RAN — Decree-Law 73/2009 of 31 March, as amended) for planning purposes, analysing the legal requirements, the competence of the DGADR (Directorate-General for Agriculture and Rural Development) and the means of challenge in the event of refusal.

URB-037.titulo_en: Release of Land from the REN (National Ecological Reserve)
URB-037.descricao_en: Structures the application for authorisation of a compatible use or for exclusion of land within the National Ecological Reserve (REN — Decree-Law 166/2008 of 22 August, as amended) to enable urban development operations, identifying the competent body (CCDR — Regional Coordination and Development Commission), the requirements and the means of challenge.

URB-038.titulo_en: AUGI — Urban Areas of Illegal Origin: Reconversion and Titling
URB-038.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for Urban Areas of Illegal Origin (Áreas Urbanas de Génese Ilegal — AUGI, Law 91/95 of 2 September, as amended) for the purposes of urban reconversion and titling of the plots, including the setting up of an administration committee, approval of a detailed plan and issue of construction recognition titles.

URB-039.titulo_en: Urban Rehabilitation Operations: ARU, ORU and Legal Regime (Decree-Law 307/2009)
URB-039.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for urban rehabilitation (RJRU — Decree-Law 307/2009 of 23 October, as amended) regarding the delimitation of Urban Rehabilitation Areas (ARU), the approval of Urban Rehabilitation Operations (ORU) and the simplified licensing procedures for works within an ARU.

URB-040.titulo_en: Use Authorisation: Application, Refusal and Challenge (Arts. 62 to 67 RJUE)
URB-040.descricao_en: Structures the application for a use authorisation for completed buildings or units (Articles 62 to 67 RJUE — Decree-Law 555/99) and analyses the grounds for refusal, the means of challenge and the consequences of use without authorisation (Article 98 RJUE).

URB-041.titulo_en: Establishing Horizontal Property by Constitutive Title (Art. 1417 CC)
URB-041.descricao_en: Drafts and analyses the constitutive title of horizontal property (propriedade horizontal, i.e. condominium ownership) for a building under Articles 1414 et seq. of the Civil Code and Article 59 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), including the description of the units, the common parts, the relative value and the condominium regulations.

URB-042.titulo_en: Challenge to Planning Fees — TRIU (Art. 116 RJUE and Law 53-E/2006)
URB-042.descricao_en: Analyses and structures the challenge to planning fees (TRIU — Fee for the Provision, Reinforcement and Maintenance of Urban Infrastructure, and other municipal fees) charged in planning procedures, on the grounds of unlawfulness of the municipal regulation or calculation error, under Article 116 RJUE and Law 53-E/2006 (General Regime for Local Authority Fees — RGTAL).

URB-043.titulo_en: Detachment of a Plot from a Rural Property (Art. 6 RJUE)
URB-043.descricao_en: Analyses the requirements and procedure for detaching a plot from a rural property in order to build a dwelling under Article 6 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), checking the conditions of access to a public road, the minimum area of the original property and conformity with the PDM.

URB-044.titulo_en: Local Accommodation in a PDM Containment Zone: Feasibility and Challenge to Refusal
URB-044.descricao_en: Analyses the feasibility of setting up local accommodation (alojamento local — AL, short-term rentals) in containment zones delimited by municipalities under Article 15-A of Decree-Law 128/2014 (AL regime, as amended by Law 56/2023), checking conformity with the PDM and structuring the challenge to decisions refusing or revoking existing registrations.

URB-045.titulo_en: Expropriation in the Public Interest: Challenge and Maximising Compensation
URB-045.descricao_en: Analyses the regime of expropriation in the public interest (Expropriations Code — Law 168/99 of 18 September, as amended) regarding challenges to the declaration of public utility, disputes over the amount of compensation and the judicial remedies available to expropriated owners.

URB-046.titulo_en: Location and Boundaries Certificate: Legal Analysis and Dispute Resolution
URB-046.descricao_en: Analyses the content and legal effects of a location and boundaries certificate issued by the municipal council (Article 82 RJUE — Decree-Law 555/99), identifying discrepancies with the land register and the means of resolving boundary disputes between adjoining properties.

URB-047.titulo_en: Participation in the Public Consultation on a PDM Revision
URB-047.descricao_en: Structures the participation of owners and investors in the public consultation on the preparation or revision of Municipal Master Plans (PDM), under the RJIGT (Decree-Law 80/2015 of 14 May), to defend land interests, maximise land classification and contest harmful proposals.

URB-048.titulo_en: Lapse of a Building Licence and Extension of Time (Arts. 71-A and 72 RJUE)
URB-048.descricao_en: Analyses the rules on the lapse of building licences and prior notifications (Articles 71-A to 73 of the RJUE — Decree-Law 555/99, as amended by Decree-Law 10/2024) and structures applications for extension of time to prevent lapse, including the remedies available when the municipal council refuses.

URB-049.titulo_en: Application for a Municipal Inspection to Verify Sanitary and Habitability Conditions
URB-049.descricao_en: Structures the application for a municipal inspection to verify the sanitary, safety and habitability conditions of a building under the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99) and the RGEU (General Building Regulations — Decree-Law 38382/51), identifying the situations in which the municipal council has a duty to act and the remedies when it refuses.

URB-050.titulo_en: Administrative Planning Easements: Identification, Impact and Challenge
URB-050.descricao_en: Identifies and analyses the administrative easements and public utility restrictions affecting land and buildings (REN, RAN, water domain, infrastructure, protection zones for listed buildings, aerodromes), assessing the impact on buildability and the means of contesting unlawful or wrongly delimited easements.

URB-051.titulo_en: Challenge to a Provision of a Spatial Plan (Art. 72 CPTA)
URB-051.descricao_en: Structures the action challenging provisions of municipal spatial plans (PDM, PU, PP) under Article 72 of the CPTA and Article 73 (declaration of unlawfulness with general binding effect), analysing the grounds of unlawfulness and the standing of interested parties.

URB-052.titulo_en: Works in a Leased Property: Landlord's Rights and Obligations (NRAU + RJUE)
URB-052.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for works in a leased property, combining the landlord's maintenance obligations (Articles 1031 and 1074 CC and the NRAU — Law 6/2006), the licensing procedures under the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99) and the tenant's rights in the face of works that disturb the enjoyment of the property.

URB-053.titulo_en: Planning Reconciliation: Land Register vs. Physical Reality of the Property
URB-053.descricao_en: Analyses and resolves discrepancies between the land register description, the property tax record (caderneta matricial) and the physical reality of a property (built area, use, number of floors, units), through procedures to rectify the register, update the tax record and, where appropriate, regularise undeclared works.

URB-054.titulo_en: Civil Liability of the Municipal Council for Unlawful Planning Acts (Law 67/2007 — RRCEE)
URB-054.descricao_en: Analyses and structures the action for non-contractual civil liability of the State and local authorities for damage caused by unlawful planning acts (wrongly granted licences, unlawful embargoes, wrongful demolition orders, unrecognised tacit approvals), under Law 67/2007 (Regime of Non-Contractual Civil Liability of the State and Other Public Entities — RRCEE).

URB-055.titulo_en: Analysis of the Building Potential of Land for Investment Purposes
URB-055.descricao_en: Carries out a complete legal and planning analysis of the building potential of a plot of land for real estate investment purposes, checking land classification, the PDM planning parameters, easements, the necessary procedures and the legal risks, under the RJIGT (Decree-Law 80/2015) and the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99).

URB-056.titulo_en: Subdivision Licence: Preparing the Application and Defence in the Event of Refusal
