URB-056.descricao_en: Structures the application for a subdivision licence under Articles 22 to 26 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), including full preparation of the application file, analysis of the mandatory land transfers and compensation, and the means of defence in the event of refusal or disproportionate conditions.

URB-057.titulo_en: Planning Due Diligence Checklist for the Acquisition of Land or Property for Construction
URB-057.descricao_en: A comprehensive legal and planning due diligence checklist for the acquisition of land or property intended for construction or rehabilitation, covering the land register, state of repair, easements, conformity with the PDM, existing licences, administrative offences and specific risks under the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99) and the RJIGT (Decree-Law 80/2015).

URB-058.titulo_en: Defence in Planning Administrative Offence Proceedings (Art. 98 RJUE)
URB-058.descricao_en: Structures the defence in planning administrative offence proceedings brought under Article 98 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), analysing the grounds for challenging the offence report (auto de notícia), the grading of fines and the means of appeal, including a judicial challenge under the RGCO (Decree-Law 433/82).

URB-059.titulo_en: Request for Prior Information on an Urban Development Operation (Art. 14 RJUE)
URB-059.descricao_en: Structures the request for prior information on the feasibility of an urban development operation under Article 14 of the RJUE (Decree-Law 555/99), analysing the binding effects of a favourable decision, its period of validity and the means of challenging unfavourable decisions.

URB-060.titulo_en: Co-Ownership in Planning: Division of Property and Exit from Co-Ownership
URB-060.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime of co-ownership of urban and rural properties with building potential (Articles 1403 to 1413 CC), the means of exiting co-ownership (amicable division, action for division of jointly owned property — Article 925 CPC) and the planning implications of the division before the municipal council and the land registry office.

EST-001.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned application for a residence visa to be submitted at the competent Portuguese consulate, identifying the type of visa, setting out the legal framework under the Foreigners Act (Law No. 23/2007 of 4 July, as currently in force) and listing all the documentation required.

EST-002.titulo_en: Application for a Residence Permit (General Regime, AIMA)
EST-002.descricao_en: Generates a complete application for a residence permit (autorização de residência) to be submitted to the Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA), grounded in Law No. 23/2007, identifying the applicable requirements, listing the documentation and providing arguments for cases where difficulties may arise.

EST-003.titulo_en: Application for a Residence Permit for the Exercise of a Professional Activity
EST-003.descricao_en: Generates a specialised application for a residence permit for employed work (employment contract) or self-employment (recibos verdes / registration of activity), grounded in Articles 88 and 89 of Law No. 23/2007, identifying the specific requirements and the documentation required by AIMA.

EST-004.titulo_en: Application for a Residence Permit for Study
EST-004.descricao_en: Generates an application for a residence permit to attend a higher education or vocational course in Portugal, grounded in Articles 91 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007 and Directive (EU) 2016/801 (students and researchers), with a document checklist and arguments to include in the AIMA file.

EST-005.titulo_en: Application for a Residence Permit for Investment (ARI / Golden Visa)
EST-005.descricao_en: Generates an application for a Residence Permit for Investment (ARI), known as the Golden Visa, grounded in Article 90-A of Law No. 23/2007 and the applicable implementing ministerial orders, identifying the investment route used, the maintenance requirements and the documentation required by AIMA.

EST-006.titulo_en: Application for a Residence Permit for Entrepreneurs / Startups
EST-006.descricao_en: Generates an application for a residence permit for entrepreneurs and startup founders, grounded in Article 89 of Law No. 23/2007 (self-employed/entrepreneurial activity) and the special Startup Portugal / Tech Visa regime, identifying the required innovation and economic potential criteria.

EST-007.descricao_en: Generates an application for family reunification (reagrupamento familiar) to reunite a foreign national residing in Portugal with their family members (spouse, minor children, dependent ascendants), grounded in Articles 98 to 107 of Law No. 23/2007 and Directive 2003/86/EC, identifying the eligible family relationships and the documentation required.

EST-008.titulo_en: Application for a Permanent Residence Permit
EST-008.descricao_en: Generates an application for a permanent residence permit, grounded in Article 80 of Law No. 23/2007, checking compliance with the requirement of 5 years' legal residence in Portugal, the absence of serious criminal convictions and the other requirements, with complete documentation for submission to AIMA.

EST-009.titulo_en: Application for Renewal of a Residence Permit
EST-009.descricao_en: Generates an application for renewal of a temporary residence permit to be submitted to AIMA, checking compliance with the renewal conditions laid down in Article 78 of Law No. 23/2007, with an updated documentation checklist and arguments for cases where the client's situation may have changed.

EST-010.titulo_en: Appeal / Challenge against Refusal of a Residence Application
EST-010.descricao_en: Generates an administrative appeal (recurso hierárquico) or complaint (reclamação graciosa) against AIMA's refusal of a residence permit application, identifying formal and substantive defects, analysing the proportionality of the decision, and relying on the general principles of administrative procedure (CPA) and the rights guaranteed by Law No. 23/2007.

EST-011.titulo_en: Judicial Challenge to an AIMA Decision
EST-011.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim in a special administrative action for judicial review of an AIMA decision (refusal of a residence permit, expulsion, cancellation of a permit) before the competent Administrative and Tax Court, grounded in the Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts (CPTA) and Law No. 23/2007.

EST-012.titulo_en: Application for Portuguese Nationality by Naturalisation
EST-012.descricao_en: Generates an application for naturalisation to be submitted to the Central Registry Office (Conservatória dos Registos Centrais), grounded in Article 6 of Law No. 37/81 (Nationality Law), checking compliance with the requirements: 5 years' legal residence, knowledge of Portuguese, civic good character and no convictions.

EST-013.titulo_en: Application for Nationality by Marriage or De Facto Union
EST-013.descricao_en: Generates an application for the acquisition of Portuguese nationality by marriage to, or a de facto union (união de facto) with, a Portuguese citizen, grounded in Article 3 of Law No. 37/81 (marriage) and Article 3-A (de facto union), identifying the requirements as to the length of the relationship and an effective connection to the national community.

EST-014.titulo_en: Application for Attribution of Portuguese Nationality of Origin to a Child of Foreign Nationals
EST-014.descricao_en: Generates an application for attribution of Portuguese nationality of origin (nacionalidade originária) to a child of foreign nationals born in Portugal, grounded in Article 1(1)(f) of Law No. 37/81 (as worded by Organic Law No. 2/2020), checking the requirements as to the parents' legal residence and effective connection to the country.

EST-015.titulo_en: Application for Nationality by Length of Residence (Special Cases)
EST-015.descricao_en: Generates an application for naturalisation with reduced periods for the special cases provided for in Article 6 of Law No. 37/81: descendants of Portuguese nationals (3 years), spouses and de facto partners (3 years), recognised refugees (3 years) and recognised stateless persons. It checks the specific requirements of each case and grounds the application in the applicable legislation.

EST-016.titulo_en: Appeal against Refusal of a Nationality Application
EST-016.descricao_en: Generates a judicial appeal against the refusal of an application for Portuguese nationality (naturalisation or acquisition by marriage), to be filed with the competent Administrative and Tax Court, grounded in the CPTA and Law No. 37/81, identifying the defects in the decision and the elements of effective connection to the national community.

EST-017.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Requirements and Time Frames for Acquiring Nationality
EST-017.descricao_en: Generates a structured legal opinion on the requirements and time frames for acquiring Portuguese nationality, analysing the client's specific situation and identifying the most suitable route (naturalisation, marriage, ancestry, birth in Portugal), with a clear recommendation and a preparation plan.

EST-018.titulo_en: Document Checklist for a Nationality Application
EST-018.descricao_en: Generates a complete, tailored checklist of the documents required for a Portuguese nationality application, adapted to the client's specific route of acquisition (naturalisation, marriage, ancestry), indicating the time needed to obtain them, the issuing bodies, and apostille and translation requirements.

EST-019.titulo_en: Application for an EU Citizen Registration Certificate
EST-019.descricao_en: Generates an application for an EU citizen registration certificate to be submitted to the Municipal Council (Câmara Municipal) of the area of residence, grounded in Decree-Law No. 3/2008 (transposing Directive 2004/38/EC), identifying the applicable requirements and the necessary documentation.

EST-020.titulo_en: Application for Residence Status as a Family Member of an EU Citizen (Third-Country National)
EST-020.descricao_en: Generates an application for a residence card for a family member of an EU citizen who is a third-country national, grounded in Articles 19 et seq. of Decree-Law No. 3/2008, identifying the eligible family relationship and the documentation to be submitted to AIMA.

EST-021.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned statement to accompany the application for international protection (asylum or subsidiary protection) submitted to AIMA, with a structured narrative of the facts of persecution, the legal framework under the Geneva Convention and Law No. 27/2008, and guidance on the individual interview with the eligibility officer.

EST-022.titulo_en: Appeal against Refusal of an Asylum Application
EST-022.descricao_en: Generates a judicial appeal against the refusal of an application for international protection (asylum or subsidiary protection) before the competent Administrative and Tax Court, grounded in the CPTA, Law No. 27/2008 and the Geneva Convention, with a request for automatic suspensive effect and an urgent interim measure where there is a risk of imminent expulsion.

EST-023.titulo_en: Opposition to Forced Removal / Expulsion Proceedings
EST-023.descricao_en: Generates a statement of opposition in forced removal (afastamento coercivo) or expulsion proceedings, grounded in Articles 134 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007, the principles of proportionality and non-refoulement, and the fundamental rights protected by the ECHR (Articles 3 and 8), to be submitted to AIMA or the competent administrative court.

EST-024.titulo_en: Challenge to a Removal Decision and Request for Suspensive Effect
EST-024.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim for judicial review of a forced removal decision, with a request for suspensive effect or an urgent interim measure (providência cautelar), before the competent Administrative and Tax Court, grounded in the CPTA, Law No. 23/2007 and the fundamental rights under the ECHR.

EST-025.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Regularisation of a Foreign National's Stay
EST-025.descricao_en: Generates a structured legal opinion on the routes for regularising the immigration status of a foreign national staying irregularly in Portugal, identifying all available options (expression of interest (manifestação de interesse), exceptional regularisation, asylum application, family reunification, residence permit) and the advantages and risks of each route.

EST-026.descricao_en: Generates an application for long-term resident status in Portugal, grounded in Articles 125 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007 and Directive 2003/109/EC, checking compliance with the requirement of 5 years' legal residence and the rights conferred by this status throughout the European Union.

EST-027.titulo_en: Application for a Job Seeker Visa
EST-027.descricao_en: Generates an application for a job seeker visa to be submitted at the competent Portuguese consulate, grounded in the applicable legislation, identifying the requirements as to professional qualifications, means of subsistence for the period of stay and a job search plan.

EST-028.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on the Expression of Interest and Regularisation Routes
EST-028.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion assessing the routes for regularising a foreign national's situation in Portugal, analysing the expression of interest (manifestação de interesse; Articles 88 and 89 of Law No. 23/2007), the applicable legal requirements and the available alternatives, guiding the lawyer and the client on the route best suited to the specific case.

EST-029.descricao_en: Generates an application for recognition of stateless status in Portugal, grounded in the 1954 New York Convention relating to the Status of Stateless Persons, the 1961 Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness and the applicable Portuguese legislation, demonstrating that the applicant is not considered a national by any State under the operation of its law, and requesting recognition and the resulting rights.

EST-030.titulo_en: Cover Letter and Humanitarian Case Statement to AIMA
EST-030.descricao_en: Drafts a cover letter and humanitarian case statement addressed to AIMA (Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum), based on exceptional humanitarian circumstances, under Article 123 of Law No. 23/2007 (residence permit on humanitarian grounds) or other protection grounds, with a view to obtaining priority treatment, the grant or renewal of a residence permit, or the suspension of a removal measure.

EST-031.titulo_en: D7 Visa Application — Passive Income and Retirement
EST-031.descricao_en: Prepares the consular application for a D7 visa (Residence Visa for Persons with Own Income), under Article 58 of Law No. 23/2007 of 4 July (Foreigners Act), as amended by Law No. 18/2022 and subsequent legislation. It covers proof of sufficient income, means of subsistence, health insurance and the intention to reside habitually in Portugal.

EST-032.descricao_en: Prepares the application for the D8 Visa (Residence Visa for Remote Workers / Digital Nomads), introduced by Law No. 18/2022 of 24 August, which added Article 58-B to Law No. 23/2007. It covers proof of a relationship with a foreign employer or clients, sufficient income and the other requirements.

EST-033.titulo_en: D2 Residence Permit Application — Entrepreneur and Startup
EST-033.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a Residence Permit for Entrepreneurs (D2), under Article 60 of Law No. 23/2007 and the entrepreneur visa regime set out in Ministerial Order No. 199/2018 of 13 July, in conjunction with the StartUP Portugal Programme and AIMA's requirements for recognising an entrepreneurial activity of economic interest to Portugal.

EST-034.titulo_en: Family Reunification Application — Spouse and Minor Children
EST-034.descricao_en: Prepares the application for family reunification for the spouse and minor children of a holder of a valid residence permit in Portugal, under Articles 98 to 107 of Law No. 23/2007 of 4 July, as amended by Law No. 18/2022. It covers the sponsor's legal residence requirements, means of subsistence, adequate accommodation and the family members' civil status documents.

EST-035.titulo_en: CPLP Residence Permit Application — National of a Portuguese-Speaking Country
EST-035.descricao_en: Prepares the residence permit application under the special regime for nationals of member states of the Community of Portuguese-Speaking Countries (CPLP), provided for in Article 88-A of Law No. 23/2007, added by Law No. 18/2022. This regime allows the regularisation of CPLP nationals already in Portugal, with simplified requirements compared with the general regime.

EST-036.titulo_en: Golden Visa Application — Investment Fund and Support for Culture
EST-036.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a Residence Permit for Investment Activity (ARI / Golden Visa) under the routes currently admissible following Law No. 56/2023 (which abolished direct real estate investment), namely: holdings in investment funds (Article 3(1)(d) of Ministerial Order 306-A/2012) and support for artistic production or cultural heritage (Article 3(1)(e)). Minimum: EUR 500,000 (funds) and EUR 250,000 (culture/arts).

EST-037.titulo_en: Application for Naturalisation Based on Legal Residence (5 Years)
EST-037.descricao_en: Prepares the application for acquisition of Portuguese nationality by naturalisation based on 5 years' legal residence in Portugal, under Article 6(1) of Law No. 37/81 of 3 October (Nationality Law), as amended by Organic Law No. 2/2018 and Organic Law No. 9/2022. It includes analysis of the requirements as to the Portuguese language, absence of convictions and an effective connection to the national community.

EST-038.titulo_en: Sephardic Naturalisation Application — Transitional Regime (Organic Law 1/2013)
EST-038.descricao_en: Prepares the naturalisation application under the special regime for descendants of Sephardic Jews expelled from Portugal, provided for in Article 6(7) of Law No. 37/81, introduced by Organic Law No. 1/2013 of 29 July, with the significant amendments made by Organic Law No. 1/2022 of 27 June (which created a transitional period). It includes analysis of the requirement of a connection to the Portuguese Sephardic community and of the genealogical documentation required.

EST-039.titulo_en: Administrative Appeal against Refusal of a Residence Permit Application (AIMA)
EST-039.descricao_en: Prepares the administrative appeal (recurso hierárquico) against AIMA's decision refusing a residence permit application, under Articles 193 et seq. of the Code of Administrative Procedure (CPA), in conjunction with Articles 149 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007 on the means of challenging decisions concerning foreign nationals.

EST-040.titulo_en: Action for an Order Compelling AIMA to Act (Intimação) against Administrative Silence
EST-040.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in a summary action for the protection of rights, freedoms and guarantees (intimação, Article 109 CPTA) or an administrative action for an order to perform a legally due act (Articles 66 et seq. CPTA), to be brought before the competent Administrative Court against AIMA's failure or delay in deciding a residence permit application, under Article 130 of Law No. 23/2007 and the Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts.

EST-041.titulo_en: Opposition to Forced Removal Proceedings — Defence and Request for Suspensive Effect
EST-041.descricao_en: Prepares the administrative opposition and the request for automatic or judicial suspensive effect against a forced removal (expulsion) decision issued by AIMA, under Articles 134 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007, Article 186 CPTA and Directive 2008/115/EC (Return Directive), including the guarantee of a prior hearing and the invocation of fundamental rights.

EST-042.titulo_en: Application for International Protection — Asylum and Subsidiary Protection
EST-042.descricao_en: Prepares the application for international protection (asylum or subsidiary protection) under Law No. 27/2008 of 30 June (Asylum Law), as amended by Law No. 26/2014 of 5 May, in conjunction with Directive 2011/95/EU (Qualification Directive) and Directive 2013/32/EU (Procedures Directive). It includes analysis of the individual risk, the framework under the Geneva Convention and the supporting evidence.

EST-043.titulo_en: Application for EU Long-Term Resident Status
EST-043.descricao_en: Prepares the application for EU Long-Term Resident (RLD) status, under Articles 125 et seq. of Law No. 23/2007, which transposes Directive 2003/109/EC (Long-Term Residents Directive). This status, obtained after 5 years of continuous legal residence in Portugal, confers enhanced rights and facilitates mobility to other EU Member States.

EST-044.titulo_en: Equivalence of a Foreign Driving Licence in Portugal
EST-044.descricao_en: Prepares the application for equivalence or recognition in Portugal of a driving licence issued by a third country (non-EU/EEA), under the Highway Code (Código da Estrada, Decree-Law No. 114/94, as amended) and the bilateral equivalence agreements concluded by Portugal, analysing the regime applicable to nationals of countries with and without an equivalence agreement.

EST-045.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Counting Periods of Legal Residence — Naturalisation and Permanent Residence
EST-045.descricao_en: Drafts a detailed legal opinion on how periods of legal residence are counted for the purposes of naturalisation (Article 6 of Law 37/81) and a permanent residence permit (Article 80 of Law 23/2007), including analysis of gaps, interruptions, periods of temporary protection, periods with precarious documentation and the impact of prolonged absences from the territory.

EST-046.titulo_en: Appeal against Refusal of a Portuguese Nationality Application (IRN Litigation)
EST-046.descricao_en: Prepares the judicial appeal against the decision refusing an application for Portuguese nationality (naturalisation, acquisition by marriage or by ancestry), to be filed with the Lisbon Administrative Circuit Court (exclusive jurisdiction), under Article 26 of Law No. 37/81, Decree-Law No. 237-A/2006 and the Code of Procedure in the Administrative Courts.

EST-047.titulo_en: Job Seeker Visa Application — Highly Qualified Candidates
EST-047.descricao_en: Prepares the application for the Visa for Job Seeking or Professional Internship (Article 58-A of Law No. 23/2007, added by Law No. 18/2022), intended for third-country nationals holding a degree or postgraduate qualification who wish to enter Portugal to seek qualified employment, valid for up to 120 days.

EST-048.titulo_en: Application for Recognition of Stateless Status
EST-048.descricao_en: Prepares the application for recognition of stateless status under the 1954 Convention relating to the Status of Stateless Persons (ratified by Portugal), Decree-Law No. 67/2004 of 25 March (legal regime for stateless persons in Portugal) and Law No. 27/2008 (on a subsidiary basis). It includes analysis of the evidentiary requirements, the advantages of the status and its interplay with the possible acquisition of Portuguese nationality.

EST-049.titulo_en: Application for a Registration Certificate for a Family Member of an EU Citizen (Third-Country National)
EST-049.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a residence document for a family member of an EU citizen who is a third-country national, under Article 3 of Decree-Law No. 14-A/2021 (transposing Directive 2004/38/EC), including analysis of the derived free movement rights and the documents required by AIMA.

EST-050.titulo_en: Humanitarian Statement and Cover Letter to AIMA — Case of Particular Vulnerability
EST-050.descricao_en: Prepares a reasoned statement addressed to AIMA invoking exceptional humanitarian reasons for granting a residence permit application or regularising an irregular situation, under Article 123 of Law No. 23/2007 (humanitarian reasons) and the constitutional principle of human dignity (Article 1 CRP), including the interplay with the rights protected by the ECHR.

EST-051.titulo_en: Appeal against Refusal of a Consular Visa — Letter of Appeal to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
EST-051.descricao_en: Prepares the administrative appeal against a Portuguese consulate's decision to refuse a visa, addressed to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Directorate-General for Consular Affairs and Portuguese Communities), under Article 21 of Law No. 23/2007 and Article 193 CPA, analysing the defects in the refusal and the supplementary documents to be submitted.

EST-052.titulo_en: Employment Contract with Clauses for a Foreign Worker — Visa Sponsorship and Employer Obligations
EST-052.descricao_en: Prepares an employment contract adapted for a Portuguese employer hiring a third-country national who needs a residence permit to work, including clauses on sponsorship of the visa/residence permit, the employer's obligations towards AIMA, and the interplay with Law No. 23/2007 and the Labour Code.

EST-053.titulo_en: Family Reunification Procedure for Dependent Ascendants
EST-053.descricao_en: Prepares the application for family reunification of ascendants (parents or grandparents) of a residence permit holder in Portugal, under Article 99(1)(d) of Law No. 23/2007, with a specific analysis of the additional requirements applicable to ascendants (economic dependence, absence of children in the country of origin able to support them), distinguishing it from the regime applicable to spouses and minor children.

EST-054.titulo_en: Residence Permit Application for Researchers or Higher Education Teaching Staff
EST-054.descricao_en: Prepares the residence permit application for scientific researchers and higher education teaching staff, under Article 90 of Law No. 23/2007 and Directive (EU) 2016/801 (Students and Researchers Directive), which, as transposed by Decree-Law 84/2021, creates a specific regime with an accelerated decision period and intra-EU mobility.

EST-055.titulo_en: Application to Regularise a Stay — Evidence of Precarious Employment (Seasonal Workers)
EST-055.descricao_en: Prepares the application to regularise the situation of seasonal workers or workers in irregular activity (agriculture, construction, hospitality) who are in Portugal without a valid residence permit but with documented employment relationships, under Article 88 of Law No. 23/2007 (promise of employment contract / employment contract) and the alternative regularisation routes provided for by law.

EST-056.titulo_en: Post-Brexit Residence Document Application — British Nationals in Portugal
EST-056.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a residence document for a British national in Portugal under the EU-UK Withdrawal Agreement (Brexit), implemented by Decree-Law 55-A/2020, for those who resided in Portugal before 31 December 2020 (end of the transition period) and have not yet regularised their situation, or who wish to change their residence status.

EST-057.titulo_en: Study Visa and Student Residence Permit Application
EST-057.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a study visa and the subsequent residence permit application for a higher education student, under Articles 91 and 92 of Law No. 23/2007 and Directive (EU) 2016/801 (transposed by Decree-Law 84/2021), including the conditions for part-time work during studies and the regime for converting the residence permit into one for work after completion of the course.

EST-058.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Dual Nationality — Compatibility with the Law of the Country of Origin
EST-058.descricao_en: Drafts a legal opinion on the implications of acquiring Portuguese nationality for a client who already holds another nationality, analysing whether the country of origin allows dual nationality, the risks of losing the original nationality and the applicable preventive measures, under Law No. 37/81 and private international law.

EST-059.titulo_en: EU Blue Card Application — Highly Qualified Worker
EST-059.descricao_en: Prepares the application for the EU Blue Card (Cartão Azul UE) for highly qualified third-country nationals, under Directive (EU) 2021/1883, transposed into Portuguese law by Decree-Law 84/2021, which replaced Directive 2009/50/EC. This specific residence permit requires an employment contract with a minimum salary set by law and a higher education degree or equivalent, and confers accelerated intra-EU mobility rights.

EST-060.titulo_en: Immigration Due Diligence Checklist for Employers Hiring Foreign Workers
EST-060.descricao_en: Drafts a comprehensive legal checklist for Portuguese employers hiring third-country nationals, including verification of residence permits and work authorisations, reporting obligations towards AIMA, risks of administrative offences for irregular employment and good practice in immigration compliance, under Law No. 23/2007, Law No. 113/2009 and the Labour Code.

FIS-001.titulo_en: Administrative Tax Complaint (Reclamação Graciosa) against a Tax Act
FIS-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) addressed to the competent tax office, contesting the lawfulness of a tax assessment, under Articles 68 et seq. of the CPPT, identifying the defects invoked and requesting annulment or correction.

FIS-002.descricao_en: Generates a complete hierarchical appeal (recurso hierárquico) addressed to the hierarchical superior of the author of the tax act, invoking the unlawfulness or inexpediency of the act appealed against, under Articles 66 and 67 of the CPPT, and requesting its revocation or replacement.

FIS-003.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for a Judicial Challenge to a Tax Assessment
FIS-003.descricao_en: Generates a complete statement of claim for a judicial challenge (impugnação judicial), addressed to the competent tax court, contesting the lawfulness of a tax assessment, under Articles 99 et seq. of the CPPT, setting out the facts, the legal grounds and a request for annulment.

FIS-004.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Administrative Action in Tax Matters
FIS-004.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim in a tax administrative action addressed to the tax court, to challenge acts in tax matters other than assessments, namely refusals of applications, acts recognising tax benefits, acts fixing property values and other non-assessment tax acts, under Article 97(2) of the CPPT.

FIS-005.titulo_en: Request for Ex Officio Review of a Tax Act
FIS-005.descricao_en: Generates a request for ex officio review (revisão oficiosa) of a tax act addressed to the Tax and Customs Authority (AT), under Article 78 of the LGT, to obtain the annulment or correction of unlawful tax acts outside the normal time limit for an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa), on the grounds of an error attributable to the tax services or of serious or manifest injustice.

FIS-006.titulo_en: Exercise of the Right to Be Heard in a Tax Inspection Procedure
FIS-006.descricao_en: Generates a response to the draft tax inspection report in exercise of the right to be heard (direito de audição), under Article 60 of the LGT and Article 60 of the RCPIT (Supplementary Regime for Tax and Customs Inspection Procedures), contesting the corrections proposed by the inspection services before they become final.

FIS-007.titulo_en: Response to a Draft Tax Inspection Report
FIS-007.descricao_en: Generates a technical response to the draft tax inspection report, focusing on methodological defects and substantive errors in the proposed corrections, and preparing arguments that, if not accepted at the hearing, will ground the subsequent administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) and judicial challenge.

FIS-008.descricao_en: Generates a complete petition of opposition to tax enforcement proceedings (oposição à execução fiscal), under Articles 203 et seq. of the CPPT, contesting the lawfulness or enforceability of the debt being enforced, setting out the legally admissible grounds and requesting the termination or suspension of the enforcement proceedings.

FIS-009.titulo_en: Complaint against Acts of the Tax Enforcement Body
FIS-009.descricao_en: Generates a complaint to the tax court against acts of the tax enforcement body, under Articles 276 et seq. of the CPPT, to contest acts performed in tax enforcement proceedings that harm the rights of the enforcement debtor or of third parties, such as the attachment of exempt assets, unlawful ranking of claims or a sale at less than the legal price.

FIS-010.titulo_en: Application to Pay a Tax Debt in Instalments
FIS-010.descricao_en: Generates an application to pay tax debts in instalments, under Articles 196 et seq. of the CPPT, with the proposed payment plan, the grounds of financial hardship and the proposed guarantee, allowing the taxpayer to regularise their tax position in stages.

FIS-011.titulo_en: Application for Payment in Kind (Dação em Pagamento)
FIS-011.descricao_en: Generates an application for payment in kind (dação em pagamento) with immovable property to extinguish tax debts, under Article 201 of the CPPT, identifying the assets offered, demonstrating that their value is equivalent to the debt and requesting acceptance by the Tax and Customs Authority.

FIS-012.titulo_en: Request to Set Up a Tax Arbitral Tribunal (CAAD)
FIS-012.descricao_en: Generates a request to set up a tax arbitral tribunal at the CAAD (Administrative Arbitration Centre), under Decree-Law No. 10/2011 (RJAT), as an alternative to a judicial challenge, for faster resolution of tax disputes concerning the unlawfulness of assessments or the refusal of refunds.

FIS-013.titulo_en: Arbitral Statement of Claim at the CAAD
FIS-013.descricao_en: Generates the complete arbitral statement of claim filed with the CAAD tax arbitral tribunal after it has been constituted, with a detailed statement of the facts, legal grounds, evidence and claims, in tax arbitration proceedings governed by the RJAT (Decree-Law No. 10/2011).

FIS-014.descricao_en: Produces an indicative Personal Income Tax (IRS) calculation for individuals, including aggregation (englobamento) of income from the various categories, specific deductions, deductions from tax due (deduções à coleta), application of general and special rates and determination of the tax payable or refundable, with reference to the applicable provisions of the CIRS.

FIS-015.titulo_en: Calculation of Real Estate Capital Gains for IRS
FIS-015.descricao_en: Produces an indicative calculation of the taxable capital gain arising from the sale of real estate, including monetary adjustment, deductible expenses, exclusions and exemptions (reinvestment in own permanent home, 50% exclusion, etc.), with reference to the provisions of the CIRS (Articles 9, 10, 43 and 51).

FIS-016.titulo_en: Calculation of IRC and the Surcharge (Derrama)
FIS-016.descricao_en: Produces an indicative calculation of Corporate Income Tax (IRC) and of the Municipal and State Surcharges (derrama), starting from the net accounting profit and working through the tax adjustments, deductions, rates and limitations provided for in the CIRC, identifying the applicable provisions.

FIS-017.titulo_en: Calculation of IMT and Stamp Duty on an Acquisition
FIS-017.descricao_en: Produces an indicative calculation of the Municipal Property Transfer Tax (IMT) and Stamp Duty (IS) payable on the acquisition of real estate, identifying the applicable rates, exemptions and exceptions, in accordance with the CIMT and the Stamp Duty Code.

FIS-018.titulo_en: Calculation of AIMI (Additional Municipal Property Tax)
FIS-018.descricao_en: Produces an indicative calculation of the Additional Municipal Property Tax (AIMI), the annual tax on the taxable property value of residential property and building land above the exemption thresholds, identifying the rates, deductions and specific rules for individuals and legal entities, under Articles 135-A et seq. of the CIMI.

FIS-019.titulo_en: Calculation of Compensatory and Default Interest on Tax
FIS-019.descricao_en: Calculates compensatory interest (owed by the taxpayer for a delay in assessment attributable to the taxpayer) and default interest (owed on overdue tax debts), as well as compensation interest (juros indemnizatórios, owed by the AT to the taxpayer for an error attributable to the tax services), identifying the applicable rates and legal provisions.

FIS-020.titulo_en: Request for a Binding Ruling from the Tax and Customs Authority
FIS-020.descricao_en: Generates a request for a binding ruling (informação vinculativa) addressed to the Tax and Customs Authority, under Article 68 of the LGT, on the interpretation or application of tax law to the taxpayer's specific tax situation, obtaining a response that binds the AT and protects the taxpayer who acts in accordance with it.

FIS-021.titulo_en: Complaint against the Valuation of Taxable Property Value (VPT)
FIS-021.descricao_en: Generates a complaint against the valuation of the Taxable Property Value (VPT) of real estate, under Articles 76 et seq. of the CIMI, contesting the valuation factors used and requesting their correction, with a direct impact on IMI, AIMI and the transfer taxes (IMT, IS).

FIS-022.titulo_en: Application for a Tax Benefit (RFAI, SIFIDE, Patronage)
FIS-022.descricao_en: Generates the application and supporting opinion for the recognition or use of tax benefits, namely the RFAI (Tax Regime for Investment Support), SIFIDE (Tax Incentive System for Business Research and Development) and the patronage (mecenato) regime, based on the Tax Benefits Statute (EBF) and the respective codes.

FIS-023.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Tax Residence and Double Taxation
FIS-023.descricao_en: Produces a legal opinion on determining the tax residence of an individual or legal entity, analysing dual residence situations and the framework of the Double Taxation Conventions (CDT) concluded by Portugal, identifying the tiebreaker rules and the specific tax implications.

FIS-024.titulo_en: Analysis of a Double Taxation Convention (Specific Case)
FIS-024.descricao_en: Produces a detailed analysis of the application of a specific double taxation convention (CDT) to a specific international tax case, identifying the article applicable to each type of income, the taxing rights of the State of residence and of the State of source, the maximum withholding tax rates and the method for eliminating double taxation to be applied in Portugal.

FIS-025.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Tax Planning for a Corporate Transaction
FIS-025.descricao_en: Produces a legal opinion on the tax implications of corporate transactions — mergers, demergers, transfers of assets, exchanges of shares, dissolution and liquidation of companies — identifying the tax-neutral regimes (tax neutrality) available under the CIRC and analysing the risks relating to economic substance and anti-abuse clauses.

FIS-026.descricao_en: Generates an application for a VAT refund (accumulated VAT credit) addressed to the Tax and Customs Authority, under Articles 22 and 78 of the CIVA, with the basis of the credit, the justification for the request and supporting documents, to obtain the refund faster than through the ordinary carry-forward to the following period.

FIS-027.titulo_en: Defence in Tax Administrative Offence Proceedings (RGIT)
FIS-027.descricao_en: Generates a defence in tax administrative offence proceedings under the General Regime for Tax Offences (RGIT — Law No. 15/2001), contesting the commission of the offence, invoking grounds excluding liability or requesting reduction of the fine to the legal minimum, with full legal reasoning.

FIS-028.titulo_en: Request for Reduction of a Fine and Voluntary Regularisation
FIS-028.descricao_en: Generates a request for reduction of a tax fine and/or voluntary regularisation of the tax position, under Articles 29 and 30 of the RGIT and Article 128 of the CPPT, setting out the mitigating circumstances, with voluntary payment of the tax due and a request for the case to be closed or for a reduced fine.

FIS-029.titulo_en: Application to Suspend Tax Enforcement Proceedings by Providing a Guarantee
FIS-029.descricao_en: Generates an application to suspend tax enforcement proceedings by providing a suitable guarantee, under Article 52 of the LGT and Article 169 of the CPPT, allowing the taxpayer to suspend enforced collection while contesting the lawfulness of the debt through administrative or judicial channels.

FIS-030.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Expiry of the Right to Assess and Limitation of the Tax Debt
FIS-030.descricao_en: Produces a legal opinion on whether the right to assess tax has expired (caducidade, Article 45 LGT) and/or the tax debt is time-barred (prescrição, Articles 48 and 49 LGT), calculating the time limits, identifying the causes of interruption and suspension and concluding whether the tax can still be assessed or collected.

FIS-031.titulo_en: Application for Waiver of the Guarantee Requirement
FIS-031.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned application for waiver of the requirement to provide a guarantee in order to suspend tax enforcement proceedings, under Article 52(4) of the LGT, demonstrating that providing a guarantee would cause irreparable harm to the taxpayer or that the taxpayer is in proven economic difficulty.

FIS-032.titulo_en: Complaint against the Ranking of Claims in Tax Enforcement Proceedings
FIS-032.descricao_en: Generates a complaint against the ranking of claims established by the tax enforcement body, contesting the position given to the tax claim or to competing claims, on the basis of Articles 240 et seq. of the CPPT and the rules of priority in the LGT and the Civil Code, with a view to changing the order of payment from the proceeds of the sales or the rents attached.

FIS-033.titulo_en: Application for the Non-Habitual Resident Regime / Tax Incentive
FIS-033.descricao_en: Generates an application for registration under the Tax Incentive for Scientific Research and Innovation (IFICI+, formerly RNH) or, in transitional cases, under the former Non-Habitual Resident (RNH) regime, analysing the eligibility requirements, the income covered and the associated reporting obligations, under Article 16(11) et seq. of the CIRS and Article 58-A of the EBF.

FIS-034.titulo_en: Checklist of a Company's Tax Reporting Obligations
FIS-034.descricao_en: Generates a complete, tailored checklist of a company's tax reporting and payment obligations in Portugal, organised by tax and frequency (monthly, quarterly, annual), with deadlines, legal references and alerts for the critical deadlines of the year under review, under the IRC, VAT, IRS (withholding tax) and Stamp Duty codes and supplementary legislation.

FIS-035.titulo_en: Judicial Challenge to an Additional IRC Assessment
FIS-035.descricao_en: Prepares a statement of claim for a judicial challenge (impugnação judicial) to an additional IRC assessment, based on the unlawfulness of the technical correction or of the tax inspection that gave rise to it, under Articles 99 et seq. of the CPPT and Article 100 of the LGT.

FIS-036.titulo_en: Tax Arbitration at the CAAD — Request to Set Up an Arbitral Tribunal in a Complex Case
FIS-036.descricao_en: Prepares the request to set up a collective arbitral tribunal at the Administrative Arbitration Centre (CAAD), for disputes worth more than €10,000, with full legal reasoning under Decree-Law No. 10/2011 of 20 January (RJAT) and the Ministerial Orders binding the AT to arbitration (Portarias de vinculação).

FIS-037.titulo_en: Non-Habitual Resident (RNH) / IFICI Tax Regime — Application for Registration and Defence in the Event of Refusal
FIS-037.descricao_en: Prepares the application for registration under the non-habitual resident tax regime (historical RNH — Article 16 CIRS) or under the new Tax Incentive for Scientific Research and Innovation (IFICI — Article 58-A EBF, Law No. 82-A/2014 and Law No. 24/2024), and the response to a draft refusal by the AT.

FIS-038.titulo_en: Transfer Pricing — Policy Report and Defence in an Inspection
FIS-038.descricao_en: Prepares the transfer pricing documentation (Transfer Pricing Tax File, Dossier Fiscal) required by Article 63 of the CIRC and Ministerial Order (Portaria) No. 1446-C/2001 of 21 December, and the response to the AT in a tax inspection concerning corrections to the prices charged between related entities.

FIS-039.titulo_en: Intra-Community VAT — Complaint against an Assessment on an Intra-Community Acquisition and Defence of the Exemption for Supplies
FIS-039.descricao_en: Prepares an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) and legal reasoning to contest VAT assessments on intra-Community acquisitions of goods (Article 2(1)(d) of the CIVA and Article 8 of the RITI) and to defend the exemption for intra-Community supplies of goods (Articles 14 and 29 of the RITI), including the VIES regime.

FIS-040.titulo_en: Withholding Tax on Non-Residents — Refund Claim and Application of a Double Taxation Convention (CDT)
FIS-040.descricao_en: Prepares the claim for a refund of excess withholding tax suffered by entities not resident in Portugal, on the basis of a double taxation convention (CDT) or the European directives (Interest and Royalties Directive, Parent-Subsidiary Directive), under Articles 94 to 98 of the CIRC and Articles 71 and 101 of the CIRS.

FIS-041.titulo_en: Tax Benefits — RFAI and SIFIDE Application and Defence in an Inspection
FIS-041.descricao_en: Prepares the application for recognition of, and the defence in an inspection of, the RFAI (Tax Regime for Investment Support, Articles 22 to 26 of the CFI) and SIFIDE II (Tax Incentive System for Business Research and Development, Articles 35 to 42 of the CFI) tax benefits, under the Investment Tax Code (Decree-Law No. 162/2014).

FIS-042.titulo_en: State and Municipal Surcharge (Derrama) — Complaint and Tax Optimisation
FIS-042.descricao_en: Prepares an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) and a tax optimisation analysis concerning the state surcharge on taxable profit (Article 87-A of the CIRC) and the municipal surcharge (Article 18 of the Local Finance Law — Law No. 73/2013), including analysis of deductions, exemptions and special regimes.

FIS-043.titulo_en: Autonomous Taxation in IRC — Complaint and Planning
FIS-043.descricao_en: Prepares an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) against an assessment of autonomous taxation (tributações autónomas) in IRC (Article 88 of the CIRC) and an analysis to optimise the expenses subject to autonomous taxation, including entertainment expenses, light passenger vehicles, per diem allowances and compensation for use of a private vehicle.

FIS-044.titulo_en: Tax Liability Transferred to Managers (Reversão) — Opposition to Enforcement and Defence against Secondary Liability
FIS-044.descricao_en: Prepares the opposition to tax enforcement proceedings lodged by the manager or director to whom liability has been transferred (reversão), based on Articles 23 and 24 of the LGT, contesting secondary liability for the company's tax debts, including proof that the manager did not hold office during the period in which the debt arose or that the insufficiency of assets is not attributable to them.

FIS-045.titulo_en: Expiry of the Right to Assess and Limitation of the Tax Debt — Plea and Objection
FIS-045.descricao_en: Prepares the plea of expiry of the right to assess (caducidade, Article 45 of the LGT) and of limitation of the tax debt (prescrição, Article 48 of the LGT) in an administrative tax complaint, a judicial challenge, an opposition to tax enforcement proceedings or a standalone application to the AT.

FIS-046.titulo_en: Succession Tax Planning — Structuring the Transfer of a Family Business
FIS-046.descricao_en: Prepares an opinion and a tax structuring plan for the transfer of a family business (quota/shares/business establishment), optimising the Stamp Duty burden on gratuitous transfers (Article 1 and the General Table of the CIS), taking advantage of the EBF exemptions (Article 60 EBF — transfer of a family business) and coordinating with the IRS capital gains regime (Article 10 CIRS).

FIS-047.titulo_en: Crypto-Assets in IRS — Reporting, Capital Gains and Defence against an AT Notice
FIS-047.descricao_en: Prepares comprehensive guidance on reporting crypto-asset income for IRS purposes (category G, Articles 10 and 10-A of the CIRS, introduced by Law No. 24-D/2022) and the defence against an AT notice or additional assessment for omission or error in reporting crypto-asset capital gains.

FIS-048.titulo_en: Ex Officio Review of a Tax Act — Reasoned Request for Error Attributable to the Tax Services
FIS-048.descricao_en: Prepares the request for ex officio review (revisão oficiosa) of a tax act under Article 78 of the LGT, on the grounds of an error attributable to the tax services (4-year time limit) or of serious and manifest injustice (3-year time limit), where the time limit for an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) has already expired but annulment of the assessment can still be obtained.

FIS-049.titulo_en: VAT — Refund of VAT Incurred in Portugal by a Taxable Person Established in Another Member State
FIS-049.descricao_en: Prepares the claim for a refund of VAT incurred in Portugal by a taxable person established in another EU Member State, under Directive 2008/9/EC and Article 97 of the CIVA, and the response to an AT request for additional information in the refund procedure.

FIS-050.titulo_en: Tax Transparency Regime — Attribution of Income and Defence against an Assessment
FIS-050.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and defence concerning the attribution of income under the tax transparency regime (Article 6 of the CIRC), applicable to civil-law companies not incorporated in commercial form, professional companies and companies merely managing assets, with an impact on the partners' IRS assessment.

FIS-051.titulo_en: AIMI — Complaint against the Additional Municipal Property Tax and Exclusion for Commercial Use
FIS-051.descricao_en: Prepares an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) against the Additional Municipal Property Tax (AIMI) assessment, contesting the undue inclusion in the tax base of urban properties used for commercial, industrial or service activities (Article 135-B(2) of the CIMI), or contesting the taxable property value used as the basis of calculation.

FIS-052.titulo_en: Suspension of Tax Enforcement Proceedings by Providing a Guarantee
FIS-052.descricao_en: Prepares the application to suspend tax enforcement proceedings by providing a suitable guarantee (bank guarantee, surety insurance, mortgage or personal guarantee), under Articles 169 and 199 of the CPPT, coordinated with the pending administrative tax complaint or judicial challenge.

FIS-053.titulo_en: Stamp Duty on Intra-Group Financing — Analysis and Defence of the Exemption
FIS-053.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and defence of the Stamp Duty exemption on intra-group financing (item 17.1 of the General Stamp Duty Table (TGIS) and Article 7(g) of the CIS), including challenges to additional Stamp Duty assessments on loans, shareholder loans (suprimentos) and current accounts between companies in a control or group relationship.

FIS-054.titulo_en: Defence in Tax Administrative Offence Proceedings (RGIT) — Reply to the Offence Report (Auto de Notícia)
FIS-054.descricao_en: Prepares the defence in tax administrative offence proceedings brought under the General Regime for Tax Offences (RGIT — Law No. 15/2001 of 5 June), contesting the fine for failure to file, late payment of tax or a related offence, including a request for reduction of the fine for voluntary regularisation.

FIS-055.titulo_en: IMT — Complaint against an Assessment for Error in Classifying the Transaction or Calculating the Rate
FIS-055.descricao_en: Prepares an administrative tax complaint (reclamação graciosa) against a Municipal Property Transfer Tax (IMT) assessment, contesting the classification of the transfer, the rate applied, the taxable value or the refusal of an exemption (Articles 9 and 17 to 23 of the CIMT), including the exemptions for own permanent home and for real estate management entities.

FIS-056.titulo_en: Tax Regime for SGPS — Participation Exemption, Capital Gains and Deductibility of Expenses
FIS-056.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and defence of the tax regime for holding companies (Sociedades Gestoras de Participações Sociais — SGPS), including the application of the participation exemption to dividends and capital gains (Articles 51 and 51-C of the CIRC), the deductibility of financial expenses and challenges to tax corrections made by the AT.

FIS-057.titulo_en: IRS Category F — Rental Income, Deductions and Defence against an Additional Assessment
FIS-057.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and defence against an additional IRS assessment on category F (rental income), contesting the refusal to deduct repair and maintenance expenses (Article 41 of the CIRS), the application of the 28% flat final rate (taxa liberatória) or mandatory aggregation (englobamento) following a tax inspection.

FIS-058.titulo_en: Tax Planning for Corporate Restructuring — Tax Neutrality and the Merger Regime
FIS-058.descricao_en: Prepares an analysis and a request for recognition of the tax neutrality regime in mergers, demergers, transfers of assets and exchanges of shares (Articles 73 to 78 of the CIRC), including verification of the conditions of application and the defence before the AT if it is challenged.

FIS-059.titulo_en: IRC — Exercise of the Right to Be Heard in a Tax Inspection
FIS-059.descricao_en: Prepares the response to the draft tax inspection report concerning IRC, exercising the right to a prior hearing under Article 60 of the LGT and Article 60 of the Supplementary Regime for Tax and Customs Inspection Procedures (RCPITA — Decree-Law No. 413/98), contesting the technical corrections proposed by the AT.

IMO-001.titulo_en: Promissory Contract for the Purchase and Sale of Property
IMO-001.descricao_en: Drafts a complete promissory contract for the purchase and sale of property (contrato-promessa de compra e venda), identifying the parties, describing the property, the price and method of payment, the deposit (sinal — earnest money), delivery of possession, the deadline for executing the final deed and default clauses.

IMO-002.titulo_en: Draft Deed of Purchase and Sale of Property
IMO-002.descricao_en: Prepares the instructions and draft for the public deed of purchase and sale of property, including a checklist of documents to present to the notary, verification of charges and encumbrances, calculation of the taxes due (IMT — Municipal Property Transfer Tax — and Stamp Duty) and the structure of the purchase and sale declaration for reading by the notary.

IMO-003.descricao_en: Drafts a complete urban lease agreement for residential purposes, in accordance with the NRAU (New Urban Lease Regime — Law No. 6/2006, as amended by Decree-Law No. 1/2013 and subsequent legislation), including identification of the parties, description of the leased property, term, rent, conditions for updating it, the parties' rights and obligations and termination clauses.

IMO-004.descricao_en: Drafts an urban lease agreement for commercial, industrial or service (non-residential) purposes, under the NRAU and the Civil Code, with the specific features of the non-residential regime: freedom to set the term, transfer of the business (trespasse), assignment of operation (cessão de exploração) and protection of goodwill.

IMO-005.descricao_en: Drafts a residential lease agreement for a fixed term (with a stipulated end date), with the specific features of the fixed-term regime under the NRAU: minimum terms, opposition to renewal, notice periods for communications and early termination by the tenant.

IMO-006.descricao_en: Drafts short-term residential lease agreements (less than 1 year) and student lease agreements, with the special regimes provided for in the NRAU and Decree-Law No. 128/2014 (Local Accommodation vs. student letting), including the formal requirements, communications and early termination.

IMO-007.descricao_en: Drafts an addendum to an existing lease agreement to formalise changes agreed between the parties: rent update outside the annual coefficient, extension of the term, change of parties (a new tenant or spouse joining), inclusion of charges, amendment of clauses or regularisation of irregular situations.

IMO-008.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice of the annual rent update under the update coefficient published by the Government, stating the current amount, the new amount, the coefficient applied, the effective date and the legal basis, ensuring compliance with the mandatory notice periods.

IMO-009.titulo_en: Notice of Opposition to Renewal of the Lease Agreement
IMO-009.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice opposing the automatic renewal of the lease agreement, by either the landlord or the tenant, stating the notice periods required by law, the legal basis and a valid method of delivery.

IMO-010.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of the Lease by the Landlord
IMO-010.descricao_en: Drafts the landlord's notice terminating the lease agreement (denúncia) for the landlord's own permanent residence or that of a first-degree descendant (Art. 1101 CC), including the formal requirements, the mandatory notice period (2 years), the compensation due to the tenant and the consequences of failing to comply with the obligation of actual occupation.

IMO-011.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of the Lease by the Tenant
IMO-011.descricao_en: Drafts the tenant's formal notice terminating the lease agreement, whether for non-renewal at the end of the term (60 days' notice) or for early termination during the term (with compensation, if applicable), in accordance with Art. 1098 CC and the NRAU.

IMO-012.titulo_en: Notice for Payment of Rent Arrears
IMO-012.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice demanding payment of rent arrears, stating the amount owed, default interest, the deadline for regularisation and a warning of the consequences of non-payment (termination of the contract and eviction), in accordance with Art. 1048 CC and the NRAU.

IMO-013.titulo_en: Notice of Termination of the Lease for Breach
IMO-013.descricao_en: Drafts the landlord's formal notice terminating the lease agreement (resolução) on the grounds of the tenant's breach (non-payment of rent, use for a different purpose, unauthorised works, unlawful subletting), with the NRAU's formal and time requirements and the legal effects of termination.

IMO-014.titulo_en: Initial Application to the National Tenancy Office (BNA)
IMO-014.descricao_en: Prepares the initial application for the special eviction procedure before the National Tenancy Office (Balcão Nacional do Arrendamento, BNA), under Decree-Law No. 1/2013 of 7 January, including identification of the parties, the grounds of the request, the documents required, the eviction request and, where applicable, a claim for payment of rent arrears.

IMO-015.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Eviction Action
IMO-015.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an eviction action (ação de despejo) before the courts, on the grounds of expiry or termination of the lease agreement, including the court addressed, description of the parties, facts, legal grounds, a claim for return of the property and, where applicable, claims for rent arrears and compensation for occupation.

IMO-016.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Recovery of Rent
IMO-016.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action to recover rent arrears, default interest and any compensation, where the landlord does not wish to (or cannot yet) terminate the contract but intends to recover the overdue unpaid instalments through the courts.

IMO-017.titulo_en: Calculation of Rent Arrears, Compensation and Interest
IMO-017.descricao_en: Performs a detailed calculation of the total amount owed in a lease context: rent arrears month by month, default interest at the statutory rate, compensation for unlawful occupation after termination of the contract (Art. 1045 CC) and compensation for termination for the landlord's own residence (Art. 1102 CC), with a clear itemised schedule.

IMO-018.descricao_en: Drafts a real estate brokerage agreement for a sale or lease, under Law No. 15/2013 (legal regime of real estate brokerage) and the Civil Code, including the mandatory clauses on exclusivity or non-exclusivity, commission, term and termination conditions.

IMO-019.titulo_en: Inspection Report and Inventory of the Leased Property
IMO-019.descricao_en: Drafts an inspection report and inventory of the condition of the leased property to be signed on handover of the keys (at the start and end of the lease), describing the condition of each room, equipment, existing furniture and any defects, so as to prevent disputes about damage at the end of the contract.

IMO-020.descricao_en: Drafts the instrument constituting horizontal property (propriedade horizontal) (or instructions to the notary on its mandatory content), in accordance with Arts. 1417 et seq. of the Civil Code, including identification of the autonomous units, the common parts, the permillage shares, the rules of use and the basis of the condominium regulations.

IMO-021.descricao_en: Drafts the condominium regulations, mandatory for buildings with more than 4 autonomous units, setting the rules on administration, use of the common parts, condominium fees, works, meetings, the administrator and dispute resolution, in accordance with Arts. 1418 et seq. CC and Decree-Law No. 268/94 (regime of condominium owners' meetings).

IMO-022.titulo_en: Minutes of a Condominium Owners' Meeting
IMO-022.descricao_en: Drafts the minutes of a condominium owners' meeting, recording the resolutions passed on the items on the agenda — approval of accounts, annual budget, election of the administrator, works on the common parts, amendments to the regulations — stating the quorum, the votes and the effectiveness of the resolutions.

IMO-023.titulo_en: Notice Convening a Condominium Owners' Meeting
IMO-023.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice convening the condominium owners' meeting (ordinary or extraordinary), with the agenda, date, time and place, and indicating the second call, in accordance with Art. 1432 CC and Decree-Law No. 268/94.

IMO-024.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Recovery of Overdue Condominium Fees
IMO-024.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action to recover overdue condominium fees, default interest and costs, in accordance with Art. 1424 CC and Decree-Law No. 268/94, including the condominium's standing to sue (represented by the administrator) and the meeting resolutions as an enforceable title.

IMO-025.titulo_en: Challenge to a Resolution of the Condominium Owners' Meeting
IMO-025.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action to annul or declare void a resolution of the condominium owners' meeting, under Art. 1433 CC, identifying the defects in the notice, lack of quorum, procedural irregularities or substantive defects that justify the challenge.

IMO-026.descricao_en: Prepares the application for entry or annotation in the land register for the most common facts subject to mandatory registration: acquisition by purchase, mortgage, constitution of horizontal property, promise with real effect, cancellation of a mortgage and transfer by inheritance, in accordance with the Land Registry Code (CRPredial).

IMO-027.titulo_en: Application for Rectification of the Land Register
IMO-027.descricao_en: Drafts the application to rectify the land register to correct inaccuracies or omissions in existing entries — errors of area, designation, ownership, description, confusion with an adjoining property — in accordance with Arts. 120 et seq. of the Land Registry Code.

IMO-028.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Judicial Justification / Adverse Possession (Usucapião)
IMO-028.descricao_en: Drafts the statement of claim in an action for judicial justification or for recognition of adverse possession (usucapião), to obtain court recognition of ownership based on public, peaceful, good-faith possession for a sufficient period, in accordance with Arts. 1287 to 1301 CC and Arts. 1094 et seq. CPC.

IMO-029.descricao_en: Prepares the instructions for executing a notarial deed of justification (escritura de justificação notarial) to acquire property by adverse possession or under an undocumented title, under Decree-Law No. 273/2001 and the Notarial Code, including the requirements, the documents required, the publication and challenge process and the limitations compared with court proceedings.

IMO-030.titulo_en: Opinion on Charges and Encumbrances on a Property
IMO-030.descricao_en: Analyses a property's land registry certificate and prepares a legal opinion on the registered charges and encumbrances (mortgages, attachments, easements, usufruct, promises with real effect, real burdens), assessing the risks for the buyer and the steps needed to clear them before the deed.

IMO-031.titulo_en: Real Estate Due Diligence Checklist for an Acquisition
IMO-031.descricao_en: Produces a complete legal due diligence checklist for acquiring a property in Portugal, covering title and registration, charges and encumbrances, licences and planning compliance, tax position, condominium position and the documents mandatory for the deed.

IMO-032.titulo_en: Calculation of IMT and Stamp Duty on a Property Purchase
IMO-032.descricao_en: Prepares an estimated calculation of the Municipal Property Transfer Tax (Imposto Municipal sobre as Transmissões Onerosas de Imóveis, IMT) and the Stamp Duty due on buying a property in Portugal, based on the purchase price or the Tax Asset Value (Valor Patrimonial Tributário, VPT), identifying the applicable rate, the bracket, exemptions and the total payable.

IMO-033.titulo_en: Agreement for the Assignment of Operation of a Commercial Establishment
IMO-033.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the assignment of operation of a commercial establishment (cessão de exploração), by which the owner temporarily transfers to another person the right to operate the establishment, identifying the parties, describing the establishment, the term, the consideration, the inventory of items assigned and liability clauses.

IMO-034.titulo_en: Notice Exercising the Tenant's Pre-Emption Right
IMO-034.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice by which the tenant exercises the pre-emption right (direito de preferência) to buy the leased property, in response to the landlord's notification, declaring the intention to acquire the property on exactly the terms notified, stating the legal grounds, the time limit for exercise and the consequences of non-compliance by the landlord.

IMO-035.titulo_en: Agreement for Voluntary Surrender of the Leased Property
IMO-035.descricao_en: Drafts an agreement for the voluntary surrender of the leased property, by which the tenant and the landlord set the terms and conditions on which the tenant returns the property, including the handover date, the required state of repair, settlement of rent and mutual obligations, avoiding recourse to court eviction or the BNA.

IMO-036.titulo_en: Notice of Works on the Leased Property
IMO-036.descricao_en: Drafts the formal notice to the tenant about works on the leased property, whether by the landlord (mandatory maintenance works, rehabilitation works) or by the tenant (minor repairs, authorised improvements), identifying the type of works, the period of execution, the impact on the use of the property and the legal basis, in accordance with the NRAU and the Civil Code.

IMO-037.titulo_en: Promissory Purchase and Sale Contract with Deposit and Top-Up
IMO-037.descricao_en: Drafts a complete promissory purchase and sale contract (CPCV) under the Civil Code (Arts. 410 to 413), with clauses on the deposit (sinal, Art. 442 CC), top-up of the deposit (reforço do sinal), the deadline for the deed, registration of the promise and the consequences of breach. Distinguishes the regime with real effect (eficácia real, Art. 413 CC) from the general regime.

IMO-038.titulo_en: Registration and Licensing of Local Accommodation
IMO-038.descricao_en: Guides the process of registering a local accommodation (alojamento local, AL) establishment under Decree-Law No. 128/2014 of 29 August (RJAL), as amended by Decree-Law 24/2021 and Law 56/2023, including the restrictions in Containment Areas and the effects of opposition by condominium owners.

IMO-039.titulo_en: Commercial Lease Agreement with Rent Review Clauses
IMO-039.descricao_en: Drafts an urban lease agreement for non-residential purposes (commercial lease) under the NRAU (Law No. 6/2006 of 27 February) and the Civil Code, with the term, the rent update regime, works to be borne by the tenant, and clauses on assignment and subletting.

IMO-040.titulo_en: Termination of and Opposition to Renewal of the Lease by the Landlord
IMO-040.descricao_en: Prepares the landlord's notice of termination (denúncia) or of opposition to renewal of the lease agreement, under Arts. 1097 and 1098 of the Civil Code and the NRAU, with the notice periods required by law according to the duration of the contract.

IMO-041.titulo_en: Authorisation and Regime for Works in a Leased Building
IMO-041.descricao_en: Prepares a written authorisation for works by the tenant or a demand to the landlord regarding necessary works under Arts. 1074, 1078 and 1081 of the Civil Code, defining the compensation regime, deduction from rent and the fate of improvements at the end of the contract.

IMO-042.titulo_en: Creation of a Surface Right over Urban or Rural Property
IMO-042.descricao_en: Prepares a contract or clause creating a surface right (direito de superfície) under Arts. 1524 to 1542 of the Civil Code, defining the subject matter, term, ground rent (cânon superficiário), building regime and the fate of the works at the end of the term.

IMO-043.descricao_en: Drafts a property exchange (permuta) agreement under Art. 939 of the Civil Code (subsidiary application of the rules on purchase and sale), identifying the properties, the equalisation payment (tornas) regime, warranties against defects and tax obligations (IMT calculated on each transfer).

IMO-044.titulo_en: Real Estate Capital Gains — IRS Treatment and Simulation
IMO-044.descricao_en: Analyses the tax regime for capital gains on the disposal of property under IRS (personal income tax, category G), pursuant to Arts. 10, 43, 44 and 50 of the CIRS, calculating the realisation value, the acquisition value adjusted by the currency devaluation coefficient, allowable deductions and the exclusion from taxation for reinvestment.

IMO-045.titulo_en: Planning Permission — Application for a Building Licence
IMO-045.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a building licence or prior notification under the RJUE (Legal Regime of Urbanisation and Building, Decree-Law No. 555/99 of 16 December, as amended), including the mandatory supporting documents, the time limits for tacit approval and the response to a refusal or conditional approval.

IMO-046.titulo_en: AIMI — Calculation, Complaint and Exemption from the Additional IMI
IMO-046.descricao_en: Analyses liability for the Additional Municipal Property Tax (Adicional ao IMI, AIMI) under Arts. 135-A to 135-I of the CIMI (Law No. 75-B/2015), calculates the tax due, identifies exemptions and prepares an administrative complaint (reclamação graciosa) against the assessment or an exemption request.

IMO-047.titulo_en: Condominium Owners' Meeting — Notice, Minutes and Resolutions on Works
IMO-047.descricao_en: Prepares the notice and minutes of a condominium owners' meeting under Arts. 1430 to 1438-A of the Civil Code, with resolutions on maintenance and innovation works and approval of the annual budget, and a reply to a condominium owner who challenges a resolution.

IMO-048.descricao_en: Prepares a draft creating a voluntary mortgage over a property under Arts. 686 to 732 of the Civil Code, identifying the secured debt and the mortgage ranking, and prepares the process for cancelling the mortgage at the Land Registry Office (Conservatória do Registo Predial).

IMO-049.titulo_en: Real Estate Leasing — Contract Analysis and Negotiation
IMO-049.descricao_en: Analyses the real estate finance lease (leasing) agreement under Decree-Law No. 149/95 of 24 June, as revised by Decree-Law No. 285/2001, identifies critical clauses (residual value, purchase option, costs of works and insurance), and prepares a negotiation letter to the lessor.

IMO-050.titulo_en: Residence Permit for Investment (ARI) — Real Estate Golden Visa
IMO-050.descricao_en: Guides the application for a Residence Permit for Investment (Autorização de Residência para Investimento, ARI) based on real estate investment activity under Law No. 23/2007 (as amended by Law 56/2023), analysing the current requirements, the permitted types of investment and the procedure before the Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA).

IMO-051.titulo_en: Construction Defects and Statutory Guarantees for the Buyer
IMO-051.descricao_en: Prepares an out-of-court notice to the builder or property developer for construction defects, under Arts. 1225 and 916 of the Civil Code and the RJUE, invoking the guarantee periods (5 years for structural defects, 1 year for others) and requesting repair, a price reduction or termination.

IMO-052.titulo_en: Real Estate Due Diligence — Opinion on Charges, Encumbrances and Licences
IMO-052.descricao_en: Prepares a complete real estate due diligence opinion before acquiring a property, analysing the permanent land registry certificate, the urban property tax record (caderneta predial urbana), the occupancy licence (licença de utilização), the planning status and any pending disputes, under the CRP (Land Registry Code) and the RJUE.

IMO-053.titulo_en: Adverse Possession (Usucapião) — Court Claim or Notarial Justification
IMO-053.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for judicial justification (usucapião) or prepares the process for a notarial deed of justification to acquire ownership through prolonged possession, under Arts. 1287 to 1301 of the Civil Code and Decree-Law No. 263-A/2007.

IMO-054.titulo_en: Real Estate Brokerage Agreement — Review and Negotiation
IMO-054.descricao_en: Analyses and negotiates the real estate brokerage agreement under Law No. 15/2013 (Legal Regime of Real Estate Brokerage), checking exclusivity, the term, the broker's remuneration conditions and the circumstances of expiry and revocation.

IMO-055.titulo_en: Instrument Constituting Horizontal Property — Drafting and Amendment
IMO-055.descricao_en: Prepares or analyses the instrument constituting horizontal property under Arts. 1414 to 1438-A of the Civil Code and Decree-Law No. 268/94, defining the autonomous units, the common parts, the permillage shares and the condominium regulations.

IMO-056.titulo_en: Urban Rehabilitation — Legal Framework and Tax Incentives
IMO-056.descricao_en: Analyses the legal regime for urban rehabilitation (Decree-Law No. 307/2009, as currently worded) and the tax incentives for rehabilitation (IMI, IMT and IRS/IRC exemptions and VAT reduced to 6%), guiding the owner in obtaining the benefits and meeting the requirements.

IMO-057.titulo_en: Termination of the Lease for Non-Payment of Rent
IMO-057.descricao_en: Prepares the notice terminating the lease agreement for non-payment of rent under Arts. 1083 and 1084 of the Civil Code and the NRAU, with a calculation of the rent owed, interest and compensation, and the initial application to the National Tenancy Office (BNA).

IMO-058.titulo_en: Purchase and Sale Contract with Retention of Title over an Autonomous Unit
IMO-058.descricao_en: Prepares a draft deed of purchase and sale of an autonomous unit in horizontal property with a retention of title clause (Art. 409 CC) or prepares the acquisition of a property under construction ("off-plan" — em planta), analysing the buyer's guarantees under Decree-Law No. 255/93.

IMO-059.descricao_en: Analyses and formalises the creation of easements (servidões prediais — right of way, aqueduct, drainage, views) under Arts. 1543 to 1576 of the Civil Code, including easements by destination of the owner (destino de pai de família), by adverse possession and statutory rights of way, as well as extinction by merger, non-use or redemption.

IMO-060.titulo_en: Deed of Gift of Property — Tax Framework and Reversion Clauses
IMO-060.descricao_en: Prepares a draft deed of gift of property under Arts. 940 to 979 of the Civil Code, analysing Stamp Duty on gratuitous transfers (CITS), reversion and inalienability clauses, and the regime of gifts subject to a charge.

PEN-001.titulo_en: Criminal Complaint with Application to Be Admitted as Assistente
PEN-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete criminal complaint (queixa-crime), with a narrative of the facts constituting the offence, identification of the accused (arguido), the legal grounds and a simultaneous application to be admitted as assistente (auxiliary prosecutor), enabling the victim to take an active part in the criminal proceedings.

PEN-002.titulo_en: Application to Be Admitted as Assistente
PEN-002.descricao_en: Generates a standalone application to be admitted as assistente (auxiliary prosecutor) in pending criminal proceedings, based on Article 68 of the CPP (Code of Criminal Procedure), identifying the applicant's standing, the appropriate procedural stage and the powers that admission confers.

PEN-003.titulo_en: Request to Open the Instrução Stage (Judicial Pre-Trial Review)
PEN-003.descricao_en: Generates a request to open the instrução stage (requerimento de abertura de instrução — RAI) submitted by the assistente after the Public Prosecutor's Office (Ministério Público) has closed the inquiry, challenging the decision not to indict and asking the Criminal Investigation Judge (Juiz de Instrução Criminal) to commit the accused for trial on the facts investigated.

PEN-004.titulo_en: Criminal Defence (Response to the Indictment / Committal Order)
PEN-004.descricao_en: Generates the defence (contestação — response to the public or private indictment) in Portuguese criminal proceedings, challenging the facts, raising procedural objections, presenting a legal defence and listing the defence evidence, under Articles 315 et seq. of the CPP.

PEN-005.titulo_en: Submission of a List of Witnesses and Evidence
PEN-005.descricao_en: Generates an application for evidence for the trial stage of criminal proceedings, with a detailed list of witnesses and documentary, expert and other evidence, justifying the relevance and necessity of each item of evidence.

PEN-006.titulo_en: Civil Compensation Claim in Criminal Proceedings (Civil Party)
PEN-006.descricao_en: Generates the civil compensation claim lodged in criminal proceedings by the injured party (victim or harmed third party), including quantification of pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage, the grounds for civil liability and the link with the criminal matters, under Articles 71 et seq. of the CPP.

PEN-007.titulo_en: Appeal against a Criminal Judgment to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação)
