PEN-007.descricao_en: Generates the grounds of appeal (motivação) against a criminal judgment to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação), invoking defects in the judgment (Article 410 CPP), errors in the assessment of the facts, errors of law and a challenge to the sentence, structured in accordance with Articles 412 and 413 of the CPP.

PEN-008.titulo_en: Appeal against the Committal Decision (Decisão Instrutória de Pronúncia)
PEN-008.descricao_en: Generates the grounds of appeal against the committal order (despacho de pronúncia) issued by the Criminal Investigation Judge, to be lodged by the accused with the Court of Appeal, contesting the existence of sufficient evidence to justify sending the case to trial.

PEN-009.titulo_en: Application for Provisional Suspension of Proceedings
PEN-009.descricao_en: Generates the application for provisional suspension of criminal proceedings (suspensão provisória do processo — SPP), a diversion mechanism that allows the Public Prosecutor's Office, with the agreement of the investigating judge (JIC) and the accused, to suspend the proceedings subject to compliance with injunctions and rules of conduct, avoiding a formal indictment, under Article 281 of the CPP.

PEN-010.descricao_en: Generates the application (or section of the defence/closing submissions) asking the court to impose a substitute sentence instead of actual imprisonment, including a suspended sentence, a substitute fine, probation and community service, based on Articles 43 to 60 of the Criminal Code (Código Penal).

PEN-011.titulo_en: Challenge to a Coercive Measure (Appeal against Pre-Trial Detention)
PEN-011.descricao_en: Generates the appeal against the order imposing or maintaining pre-trial detention (prisão preventiva), contesting whether the general and specific requirements of the CPP are met, and seeking replacement with a less severe coercive measure (medida de coação) or revocation of the measure.

PEN-012.titulo_en: Application to Modify or Revoke a Coercive Measure
PEN-012.descricao_en: Generates the application to the investigating judge (JIC) or the court to modify or revoke the coercive measure imposed, based on new supervening circumstances that justify its review, under Article 212 of the CPP.

PEN-013.titulo_en: Oral Closing Submissions / Defence Memorandum for Trial
PEN-013.descricao_en: Generates a complete defence memorandum to guide the oral closing submissions at a criminal trial, with analysis of the evidence produced, legal argument, a request for acquittal and, in the alternative, for the minimum sentence and a substitute penalty, under Article 360 of the CPP.

PEN-014.titulo_en: Judicial Challenge to an Administrative Offence Decision
PEN-014.descricao_en: Generates the judicial challenge (impugnação judicial) to the administrative decision imposing a fine (coima) for an administrative offence (contraordenação), to be filed with the competent court, under Article 59 of the General Regime for Administrative Offences (RGCO — Decree-Law No. 433/82 of 27 October).

PEN-015.titulo_en: Written Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings (Response to the Offence Report)
PEN-015.descricao_en: Generates the written defence submitted to the administrative authority after notification of the offence report (auto de notícia) or administrative offence charge, in exercise of the right to a prior hearing guaranteed by Article 50 of the RGCO, before the decision imposing the fine is issued.

PEN-016.titulo_en: Appeal against an Administrative Offence Decision to the Court
PEN-016.descricao_en: Generates the grounds of appeal to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação) against the judgment handed down by the court in administrative offence proceedings, contesting errors in the assessment of the facts, errors of law and the disproportionality of the fine, under Articles 73 et seq. of the RGCO.

PEN-017.titulo_en: Application for Voluntary Payment of a Fine with Reduction
PEN-017.descricao_en: Generates the application for voluntary payment of a fine with the benefit of a reduction in administrative offence proceedings, taking advantage of the discount mechanisms provided for in the RGCO and in special sectoral regimes that encourage early settlement.

PEN-018.titulo_en: Opinion on Limitation of Criminal Proceedings
PEN-018.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive legal opinion on the limitation (prescrição) of criminal proceedings, calculating the limitation period and the grounds for suspension and interruption, and concluding whether the State's right to punish has been extinguished or subsists, under Articles 118 to 121 of the Portuguese Criminal Code (CP).

PEN-019.titulo_en: Calculation of the Specific Sentence (Range, Mitigation, Aggravation)
PEN-019.descricao_en: Generates a detailed analysis of the determination of the specific sentence in Portuguese criminal proceedings, identifying the abstract sentencing range, the aggravating and mitigating modifying circumstances, the calculation of the substitute penalty and the justification for the choice of sanction, under Articles 40 to 80 of the Criminal Code.

PEN-020.descricao_en: Generates the application for parole (liberdade condicional) submitted by the prisoner or their defence counsel to the Sentence Enforcement Court (Tribunal de Execução de Penas — TEP), demonstrating that the legal requirements are met and a favourable prognosis for social reintegration, under Article 61 of the Portuguese Criminal Code.

PEN-021.titulo_en: Application to Replace Imprisonment with Community Service
PEN-021.descricao_en: Generates the application to replace a prison sentence with community service (trabalho a favor da comunidade — TFC), including a demonstration of the legal requirements, the consent of the accused and a proposal of the host entity and number of hours, under Article 58 of the Portuguese Criminal Code.

PEN-022.titulo_en: Application for Rehabilitation / Cancellation of Criminal Record Entries
PEN-022.descricao_en: Generates the application for cancellation of criminal record entries (commonly known as 'rehabilitation') after the statutory periods have elapsed, so that the conviction no longer appears on the criminal record certificate, under Law No. 37/2015 (Criminal Identification Law) and Articles 9 et seq. of the Criminal Code.

PEN-023.titulo_en: Petition for Pardon or Commutation of Sentence
PEN-023.descricao_en: Generates the petition for a pardon (indulto) or commutation of sentence to be submitted to the President of the Republic (via the Ministry of Justice), on humanitarian, health, social reintegration or equity grounds, under the power of clemency provided for in the Constitution of the Portuguese Republic.

PEN-024.descricao_en: Generates a criminal complaint for fraud (burla, Article 217 CP) or aggravated fraud (Article 218 CP), with a narrative of the facts, identification of the trick or deception used by the accused, quantification of the financial loss and an application to be admitted as assistente and for civil compensation.

PEN-025.titulo_en: Criminal Complaint for Defamation or Insult
PEN-025.descricao_en: Generates the criminal complaint for defamation (difamação, Article 180 CP) or insult (injúria, Article 181 CP), a private offence (crime particular) requiring a complaint by the victim and the filing of a private indictment, including analysis of the distinction between the two offences, timeliness and the civil compensation claim.

PEN-026.descricao_en: Generates the criminal complaint for domestic violence (Article 152 CP), a public offence (crime público) that does not require a complaint but benefits from a well-founded report, including the narrative of the facts, the legal classification, a request for urgent protective measures and admission as assistente.

PEN-027.titulo_en: Criminal Complaint for Criminal Breach of Trust (Abuso de Confiança)
PEN-027.descricao_en: Generates the criminal complaint for criminal breach of trust (abuso de confiança, Article 205 CP), an offence committed when someone unlawfully appropriates a thing delivered to them under a title that does not transfer ownership (deposit, mandate, gratuitous loan, administration), with a narrative of the facts, the legal classification and a civil compensation claim.

PEN-028.titulo_en: Criminal Complaint for Tax Offences (Tax Fraud and Tax Breach of Trust)
PEN-028.descricao_en: Generates the report/complaint for tax offences — tax fraud (Article 103 RGIT) and tax breach of trust (abuso de confiança fiscal, Article 105 RGIT) — to be submitted to the Tax and Customs Authority (AT) or the Public Prosecutor's Office, identifying the facts, the provisions of the General Regime for Tax Offences (RGIT) and the necessary investigative steps.

PEN-029.titulo_en: Defence in Proceedings for Economic Offences (Fraudulent Insolvency, Forgery)
PEN-029.descricao_en: Generates the defence strategy and filings for accused persons in proceedings for economic and financial offences — fraudulent insolvency (Article 228 CP), negligent insolvency (Article 229 CP), forgery of documents (Article 256 CP) and corporate offences — analysing the elements of the offence and building the technical defence.

PEN-030.titulo_en: Application to Close the Inquiry (Response to the Public Prosecutor)
PEN-030.descricao_en: Generates the application addressed to the Public Prosecutor's Office during the inquiry (inquérito) asking it to close the case for absence of an offence, insufficient evidence or limitation, with factual and legal arguments that anticipate and prevent a formal indictment.

PEN-031.titulo_en: Application for Return of Seized Property
PEN-031.descricao_en: Generates the application for return of property seized in criminal proceedings, where the seizure has become unnecessary for the purposes of the proceedings or the property belongs to a third party who is not responsible, under Articles 186 et seq. of the CPP.

PEN-032.titulo_en: Opinion on Self-Defence and Grounds Excluding Unlawfulness
PEN-032.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive legal opinion on whether grounds excluding unlawfulness apply — in particular self-defence, necessity and conflict of duties — analysing the requirements and limits of each ground and the impact on the criminal liability of the accused, under Articles 31 to 36 of the Portuguese Criminal Code.

PEN-033.titulo_en: Defence in Road Traffic Administrative Offence Proceedings
PEN-033.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned defence in road traffic administrative offence proceedings, challenging the offence report drawn up by the police or the ANSR (National Road Safety Authority), identifying formal defects, raising nullities and presenting a defence on the merits, under the Highway Code (Código da Estrada) and the General Regime for Administrative Offences (Decree-Law No. 433/82 of 27 October).

PEN-034.titulo_en: Application for Access to and Inspection of the Case File
PEN-034.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned application for access to and inspection of the criminal case file, whether by the accused, the assistente or their lawyer, invoking the rights of defence and the adversarial principle, under Articles 86, 89 and 194 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure.

PEN-035.titulo_en: Opinion on Arguido Status and Defence Rights
PEN-035.descricao_en: Generates a comprehensive legal opinion on the rights and duties arising from being made a formal suspect (constituição de arguido), the timing and requirements of the mandatory notification, the rights the arguido enjoys from that moment and the nullities resulting from their breach, under Articles 57 to 67 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure.

PEN-036.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned habeas corpus petition, invoking the unlawfulness of the arrest or pre-trial detention and requesting that the accused be brought immediately before the court for review of the lawfulness of the deprivation of liberty, under Article 31 of the Constitution of the Portuguese Republic and Articles 220 to 224 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

PEN-037.descricao_en: Prepares the defence (contestação) or defence submissions of an accused charged with computer offences under the Cybercrime Law (Law No. 109/2009 of 15 September): unlawful access (Article 6), unlawful interception (Article 7), damage to programs or other computer data (Article 4), computer sabotage (Article 5) and computer forgery (Article 3). Links with the Portuguese Criminal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure.

PEN-038.titulo_en: Application for a Declaration of Forfeiture of Assets to the State
PEN-038.descricao_en: Drafts or contests the application for forfeiture (perda de bens) of assets (instruments, proceeds or benefits of the offence) to the State, under Articles 109 to 112-A of the Portuguese Criminal Code and Law No. 5/2002 of 11 January (regime for combating organised crime), including extended confiscation and the judicial challenge to a preventive attachment (arresto preventivo).

PEN-039.titulo_en: Defence in Money Laundering Proceedings (Art. 368-A CP)
PEN-039.descricao_en: Prepares the defence of an accused charged with money laundering under Article 368-A of the Portuguese Criminal Code, in conjunction with Law No. 83/2017 of 18 August (prevention and suppression of money laundering) and the specific evidentiary requirements of this offence, including the question of the underlying (predicate) offence.

PEN-040.titulo_en: Defence in Domestic Violence Proceedings — Victim Status and Defence Strategy
PEN-040.descricao_en: Prepares the defence strategy for an accused charged with domestic violence (Article 152 CP), taking into account the status of particularly vulnerable victim (Law No. 112/2009 of 16 September), the specific coercive measures (no-contact order, removal from the residence — Articles 31 and 52 of Law 112/2009) and the special procedural rules, including remote assistance (teleassistência) and risk assessment.

PEN-041.titulo_en: Application for Aggregation of Sentences (Arts. 77 and 78 CP)
PEN-041.descricao_en: Drafts the application for the legal aggregation of sentences (cúmulo jurídico — supervening or in the same proceedings) under Articles 77 and 78 of the Portuguese Criminal Code, including the calculation statement for the single sentence, the assertion that the previous judgments are final (res judicata) and the criteria for the court's determination of the single sentence.

PEN-042.titulo_en: Execution of a European Arrest Warrant — Defence of the Requested Person
PEN-042.descricao_en: Prepares the opposition to the execution of a European Arrest Warrant (Mandado de Detenção Europeu — MDE) in Portugal, under Law No. 65/2003 of 23 August (transposing Framework Decision 2002/584/JHA), invoking the mandatory and optional grounds for refusal, the fundamental rights of the requested person and fair trial guarantees.

PEN-043.titulo_en: Defence in Tax Crime Proceedings — RGIT (Tax Fraud and Tax Breach of Trust)
PEN-043.descricao_en: Prepares the full defence of an accused in criminal proceedings for tax offences under the General Regime for Tax Offences (RGIT — Law No. 15/2001 of 5 June): simple and aggravated tax fraud (Articles 103 and 104 RGIT), tax breach of trust (Article 105 RGIT) and subsidy fraud (Article 36 RGIT), together with the mechanisms for extinguishing criminal liability through payment.

PEN-044.titulo_en: Application concerning the Criminal Liability of a Legal Person (Arts. 11 and 90-A CP)
PEN-044.descricao_en: Prepares an application or defence concerning the criminal liability of legal persons under Article 11 of the Portuguese Criminal Code (as worded by Law No. 59/2007), including the requirements for attribution, the penalties applicable to legal persons (Articles 90-A et seq. CP) and the interplay with the individual liability of representatives and corporate bodies.

PEN-045.titulo_en: Challenge to a Decision to Close the Case — Assistente's Request to Open Instrução
PEN-045.descricao_en: Drafts the request to open the instrução stage submitted by the assistente (Article 287 CPP) following the Public Prosecutor's decision to close the case (Article 277 CPP), including the legal grounds for sufficient evidence, identification of the facts and the evidentiary steps required.

PEN-046.titulo_en: Appeal against a Criminal Judgment to the Supreme Court of Justice
PEN-046.descricao_en: Prepares the appeal against a criminal judgment to the Supreme Court of Justice (Supremo Tribunal de Justiça — STJ) under Articles 432 and 433 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure, in cases where an appeal from the Court of Appeal lies directly to the STJ or where the Court of Appeal has upheld the conviction and the appeal is based on conflicting case law or a point of law of particular complexity.

PEN-047.titulo_en: Application for an Agreement on Sentence in Criminal Proceedings (Art. 344-A CPP)
PEN-047.descricao_en: Drafts the application to negotiate and agree on the sentence (the Portuguese conformity procedure or 'plea agreement'), under Article 344-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, introduced by Law No. 94/2021, including the proposed sentence, the admissibility requirements and the binding effect on the court.

PEN-048.titulo_en: Application for Witness Protection and Procedural Anonymity
PEN-048.descricao_en: Prepares the application for witness protection under Law No. 93/99 of 14 July (protection of witnesses in criminal proceedings), including the admissibility requirements, the protective measures available (anonymity, concealment of image, videoconference) and the interplay with the defence rights of the accused.

PEN-049.titulo_en: Application for Preventive Attachment of Assets in Criminal Proceedings (Art. 228 CPP)
PEN-049.descricao_en: Drafts the application for preventive attachment (arresto preventivo) of the accused's assets in criminal proceedings, under Article 228 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure, including demonstration of the requirements (fumus boni iuris and periculum in mora), precise identification of the assets and the link with the civil compensation claim or future forfeiture of assets to the State.

PEN-050.titulo_en: Adversarial Instrução — Submissions of the Accused and the Assistente
PEN-050.descricao_en: Prepares the final written submissions (or oral submissions reduced to writing) of the accused or the assistente at the criminal instrução stage (Article 301 CPP), after the pre-trial hearing (debate instrutório), with a view to influencing the investigating judge's decision to commit or not to commit for trial (Articles 307 and 308 CPP).

PEN-051.titulo_en: Reporting an Offence to the Public Prosecutor's Office — Crime Report
PEN-051.descricao_en: Drafts the crime report (participação de notícia de crime) addressed to the Public Prosecutor's Office (DIAP — Department of Investigation and Prosecution) or the police authorities under Articles 241 et seq. of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure, including a statement of the facts, the legal classification and the available evidence, for public and semi-public offences.

PEN-052.titulo_en: Opinion on Grounds Excluding Guilt and Unlawfulness in a Specific Offence
PEN-052.descricao_en: Prepares a reasoned legal opinion on the applicability of grounds excluding unlawfulness (Articles 31 to 36 CP) and guilt (Articles 17, 19 and 35 CP) to a specific criminal case, including self-defence, necessity, due obedience, lack of criminal capacity (inimputabilidade) and mistake, analysing the objective and subjective requirements of each ground.

PEN-053.titulo_en: Standalone Civil Compensation Claim in Criminal Proceedings — Pleading
PEN-053.descricao_en: Prepares the civil compensation claim lodged in criminal proceedings (Articles 71 to 84 CPP), including the pleading of facts, quantification of pecuniary and non-pecuniary damage under the Portuguese Civil Code, and the interplay with the principle of mandatory joinder (adesão obrigatória, Article 71 CPP) and the exceptions provided for in Article 72 CPP.

PEN-054.titulo_en: Application to Revoke a Coercive Measure Owing to a Supervening New Fact
PEN-054.descricao_en: Drafts the application to revoke or replace a coercive measure (including pre-trial detention) owing to a supervening new fact or a change in the circumstances on which it was based, under Articles 212 and 213 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure, relying on the principles of proportionality, necessity and adequacy.

PEN-055.titulo_en: Defence in Drug Trafficking Proceedings — Strategy and Defence Pleading
PEN-055.descricao_en: Prepares the defence (contestação) and full defence strategy in drug trafficking proceedings under Decree-Law No. 15/93 of 22 January, setting out the differences between serious trafficking (Article 21), lesser trafficking (Article 25) and consumption (Article 40, Law 30/2000), including challenges to the evidence and the criteria for distinguishing between the offence types.

PEN-056.titulo_en: Application for Rehabilitation and Cancellation of Criminal Record Entries
PEN-056.descricao_en: Prepares the application for cancellation of convictions in the criminal record under Law No. 37/2015 of 5 May (Criminal Identification Law), including verification of the automatic cancellation periods and the application for early cancellation based on the convicted person's effective rehabilitation.

PEN-057.titulo_en: Challenge to a Committal Order — Accused's Appeal to the Court of Appeal
PEN-057.descricao_en: Prepares the accused's appeal to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação) against the committal order issued by the criminal investigation judge (Article 307 CPP), on the grounds of insufficient evidence, an error in legal classification or nullities in the pre-trial hearing, under Articles 308 to 310 CPP.

PEN-058.titulo_en: Defence in Criminal Proceedings for Aggravated Breach of Trust and Embezzlement by a Public Official (Peculato)
PEN-058.descricao_en: Prepares the defence and defence strategy of an accused charged with aggravated criminal breach of trust (Article 205(4) CP) or embezzlement by a public official (peculato, Article 375 CP), including the distinction between the two offences, analysis of the element of appropriation and reliance on reparation of the damage as a mitigating circumstance.

PEN-059.titulo_en: Application for Parole — Pleading and Reintegration Plan
PEN-059.descricao_en: Prepares the application for parole under Articles 61 to 64 of the Portuguese Criminal Code and Articles 173 to 186 of the Code for the Enforcement of Custodial Sentences and Measures (CEPMPL — Law No. 115/2009 of 12 October), including the social reintegration plan and analysis of the legal requirements.

PEN-060.titulo_en: Application for Access to the Case File — Accused and Assistente
PEN-060.descricao_en: Prepares the application for access to the criminal case file, inspection of the file and obtaining certificates or copies, under Articles 89 and 90 of the Portuguese Code of Criminal Procedure, including the differentiated regime for the accused, the assistente, the victim and defence counsel, and challenges to refusals or restrictions on access.

PRC-001.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in an Ordinary Declaratory Action
PRC-001.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim (petição inicial) in an ordinary declaratory action (ação declarativa comum) in the standard form of the Portuguese Code of Civil Procedure, correctly addressed to the competent court, with identification of the parties, statement of facts, legal grounds, relief sought and value of the claim, including an indication of the evidence.

PRC-002.titulo_en: Defence in an Ordinary Declaratory Action
PRC-002.descricao_en: Generates a complete defence (contestação) in an ordinary declaratory action, under Article 572 CPC, including dilatory exceptions (procedural objections), peremptory exceptions (substantive defences), denial of facts, and defence by way of exception and by way of denial, with an indication of the evidence and a list of witnesses.

PRC-003.descricao_en: Generates a defence that includes a counterclaim (reconvenção), under Articles 583 to 585 CPC, combining defence by way of exception and denial with an independent claim by the defendant against the claimant within the same proceedings.

PRC-004.descricao_en: Generates the claimant's reply (réplica), under Article 584 CPC, responding to the exceptions raised by the defendant in the defence and, where there is a counterclaim, contesting the counterclaim. It includes a challenge to the exceptions, rebuttal evidence and a request that they be dismissed.

PRC-005.descricao_en: Generates a supervening pleading (articulado superveniente), under Article 588 CPC, to allege constitutive, modifying or extinguishing facts that occurred, or of which the applicant only became aware, after the close of the ordinary pleadings, with an application for admission and the corresponding evidence.

PRC-006.titulo_en: Application for a General Interim Measure
PRC-006.descricao_en: Generates an application for an unspecified (general) interim measure (providência cautelar comum), under Articles 362 to 376 CPC, demonstrating the fumus boni iuris (serious probability of the right) and the periculum in mora (fear of serious or hardly reparable harm), and framing the measure appropriate to the specific situation.

PRC-007.descricao_en: Generates an application for preventive attachment (arresto), under Articles 391 to 396 CPC, for the judicial seizure of the debtor's assets where there is a justified fear of losing the asset security for the claim, identifying the assets to be attached and demonstrating the legal requirements.

PRC-008.descricao_en: Generates an application for an inventory order (arrolamento), under Articles 403 to 409 CPC, for the description, valuation and deposit or preservation of assets in which the applicant has a right or legitimate interest, notably in divorce, company dissolution, inheritance or irregular management of third-party assets.

PRC-009.titulo_en: Application for Provisional Restoration of Possession
PRC-009.descricao_en: Generates an application for provisional restoration of possession (restituição provisória de posse), under Article 378 CPC, for the immediate recovery of possession lost through violent or clandestine dispossession, demonstrating prior possession, the dispossession and the urgency of the relief.

PRC-010.titulo_en: Application for an Embargo on New Works (Embargo de Obra Nova)
PRC-010.descricao_en: Generates an application for an embargo on new works (embargo de obra nova), under Articles 397 to 402 CPC, for the judicial suspension of works or services that infringe the applicant's rights, including the prior extrajudicial embargo where applicable and the application to the court for judicial confirmation.

PRC-011.descricao_en: Generates an opposition to an interim measure that has been ordered, under Articles 372 and 373 CPC, contesting the requirements of fumus boni iuris and periculum in mora, raising exceptions and seeking the lifting of the measure or the provision of alternative security.

PRC-012.titulo_en: Appeal to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação)
PRC-012.descricao_en: Generates the appeal submissions (alegações) to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação), under Articles 627 to 651 CPC, structuring the notice of appeal, the submissions with legal grounds and/or a challenge to the findings of fact, and the conclusions (an essential element, failing which the appeal is rejected — Article 641(2)(b) CPC).

PRC-013.descricao_en: Generates the respondent's submissions (contra-alegações) in an appeal, under Article 638(5) CPC, refuting the appellant's grounds, defending the correctness of the judgment under appeal and setting out its own conclusions seeking dismissal of the appeal.

PRC-014.titulo_en: Appeal on Points of Law to the Supreme Court of Justice (Revista)
PRC-014.descricao_en: Generates the submissions in an appeal on points of law (recurso de revista) to the Supreme Court of Justice, under Articles 671 to 685 CPC, identifying the questions of law under review, demonstrating admissibility (double conformity (dupla conforme), value and jurisdictional threshold (alçada)), structuring the submissions and drafting the mandatory conclusions.

PRC-015.titulo_en: Exceptional Appeal on Points of Law (Grounds for Admissibility)
PRC-015.descricao_en: Generates the specific grounds for the admissibility of an exceptional appeal on points of law (revista excecional), under Article 672 CPC, demonstrating one of the three alternative requirements: legal relevance of fundamental importance, the need for a better application of the law, or conflict with a judgment (acórdão) of the Supreme Court of Justice (STJ) or of the Court of Appeal on the same question of law.

PRC-016.titulo_en: Complaint against an Order Refusing to Admit an Appeal
PRC-016.descricao_en: Generates the complaint (reclamação) to the panel (conferência) of the Court of Appeal, under Article 643 CPC, against the rapporteur's order refusing to admit an appeal to the Court of Appeal or an appeal on points of law, demonstrating the admissibility requirements and the errors in the single-judge decision rejecting it.

PRC-017.titulo_en: Enforcement Application (Enforcement Action for Payment of a Sum Certain)
PRC-017.descricao_en: Generates the enforcement application (requerimento executivo) for the compulsory recovery of a sum certain, under Articles 703 et seq. CPC, identifying the enforceable title, calculating the amount to be enforced (principal, interest, fees) and requesting the attachment (penhora) of the debtor's assets.

PRC-018.titulo_en: Debtor's Opposition to Enforcement (Embargos de Executado)
PRC-018.descricao_en: Generates the debtor's opposition to enforcement (embargos de executado), under Articles 728 to 733 CPC, opposing enforcement on grounds of non-existence, nullity or extinction of the enforceable title, payment, limitation (prescrição), set-off or other defences permitted by law.

PRC-019.descricao_en: Generates a third-party opposition (embargos de terceiro), under Articles 342 to 349 CPC, to protect the assets of a third party wrongly attached or seized in proceedings to which it is not a party, demonstrating its right to or possession of the assets and seeking the release of the attachment.

PRC-020.descricao_en: Generates the application opposing an attachment (oposição à penhora), under Article 784 CPC, to challenge attachments that are unlawful, excessive or that fall on assets exempt from attachment, seeking their release or reduction to the appropriate amount.

PRC-021.titulo_en: Application for an Order for Payment (Injunção Procedure)
PRC-021.descricao_en: Generates the application for an order for payment (injunção) to recover pecuniary claims arising from contracts, under Decree-Law No. 269/98 of 1 September and Ministerial Order No. 809/99 (electronic form), including identification of the claim, the interest and the minimum grounds required to obtain the enforcement formula (fórmula executória).

PRC-022.titulo_en: Opposition to an Order for Payment Application
PRC-022.descricao_en: Generates the opposition to an order for payment application (injunção), under Article 10 of Decree-Law No. 269/98, to contest the applicant's claim and prevent the enforcement formula from being affixed, with factual and legal grounds to be considered in a declaratory action after conversion of the proceedings.

PRC-023.titulo_en: Application for Substitution of Heirs (Habilitação de Herdeiros)
PRC-023.descricao_en: Generates the application for substitution of heirs (habilitação de herdeiros), under Articles 351 to 357 CPC, for the procedural substitution of a deceased party by their successors in pending proceedings, allowing the litigation to continue.

PRC-024.descricao_en: Generates the application for third-party intervention — voluntary (Article 311 CPC) or compelled (Articles 316 to 325 CPC) — to bring a third party into the proceedings because it has an interest in the case or in order to exercise a right of recourse, a guarantee or joint and several liability, setting out the legal requirements.

PRC-025.descricao_en: Generates the application for legal protection (legal aid — apoio judiciário), under Law No. 34/2004 of 29 July, to obtain the appointment of a lawyer, exemption from costs or waiver of the court fee (taxa de justiça), demonstrating the applicant's lack of financial means and the type of protection sought.

PRC-026.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in Special Eviction Proceedings
PRC-026.descricao_en: Generates the application to the National Tenancy Office (Balcão Nacional do Arrendamento, BNA) or the statement of claim in special eviction proceedings (PED), under Law No. 31/2012 and Ministerial Order No. 1057-A/2011, to obtain the eviction of a tenant in breach of the lease, identifying the ground and seeking delivery of possession of the property.

PRC-027.titulo_en: Initial Application to the National Tenancy Office (BNA)
PRC-027.descricao_en: Generates the initial application to the National Tenancy Office (BNA), under Ministerial Order No. 9/2013 of 10 January and Law No. 31/2012, for the procedures for notifying termination of the lease, rent updates and other mandatory formal notices handled through the BNA.

PRC-028.titulo_en: Itemised and Justified Statement of Party Costs
PRC-028.descricao_en: Generates the itemised and justified statement of party costs (nota discriminativa e justificativa de custas de parte), under Article 25 of the Court Costs Regulation (RCP — Decree-Law No. 34/2008), to settle the expenses borne by the successful party, including lawyer's fees, court fees, expenses and other charges, to be submitted to the court for reimbursement by the unsuccessful party.

PRC-029.titulo_en: Complaint against the Bill of Costs
PRC-029.descricao_en: Generates the complaint (reclamação) against the bill of costs drawn up by the court registry, under Articles 31 to 34 of the Court Costs Regulation (RCP — Decree-Law No. 34/2008), to challenge calculation errors, misapplication of the table, improper inclusion of charges or other defects in the bill.

PRC-030.titulo_en: Application for Waiver of the Balance of the Court Fee
PRC-030.descricao_en: Generates the application for waiver of payment of the balance of the court fee (remanescente da taxa de justiça), under Article 6(7) of the Court Costs Regulation (RCP), demonstrating that the conduct of the parties and the complexity of the case do not justify payment of the balance, especially in high-value proceedings.

PRC-031.titulo_en: Application to File Documents and Witness Evidence
PRC-031.descricao_en: Generates the application to file documents and list witnesses, under Articles 423 to 428 and 511 CPC, setting out the grounds for admitting the documents (especially at stages after the statement of claim/defence) and listing the witnesses with an indication of the subject matter of their testimony.

PRC-032.titulo_en: Application for the Early Taking of Evidence
PRC-032.descricao_en: Generates the application for the early taking of evidence (produção antecipada de prova), under Article 419 CPC, to obtain witness testimony, expert evidence or other evidence before trial, where there is a well-founded fear that the evidence will become impossible or very difficult to obtain at the time of trial.

PRC-033.descricao_en: Generates the application raising a procedural nullity, under Articles 195 to 202 CPC, invoking procedural acts carried out irregularly that may influence the examination or decision of the case, seeking a declaration of nullity and the remedying of the defect.

PRC-034.titulo_en: Request for Clarification / Amendment of a Judgment
PRC-034.descricao_en: Generates a request for clarification or amendment (reforma) of a judgment, under Article 614 CPC, to correct obscurities, ambiguities, clerical or arithmetical errors, or omissions that the judge may correct without altering the substance of the decision, before lodging an appeal.

PRC-035.titulo_en: Application for a Stay of Proceedings
PRC-035.descricao_en: Generates the application for a stay of proceedings (suspensão da instância), under Articles 269 to 272 CPC, invoking an appropriate legal ground — agreement of the parties, dependence on other proceedings, force majeure or another ground provided for by law — and asking the court to order that the proceedings be halted for a fixed or indefinite period.

PRC-036.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in the Special Action for the Performance of Pecuniary Obligations (AECOP)
PRC-036.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the Special Action for the Performance of Pecuniary Obligations (AECOP), provided for in Articles 549 et seq. CPC (Decree-Law No. 269/98 of 1 September, as revised), intended for the simplified recovery of pecuniary obligations arising from contracts, up to the jurisdictional limits of the General or Civil Jurisdiction Court, with the debtor being notified to pay, file an opposition or declare assets for attachment.

PRC-037.descricao_en: Generates a complete arbitration agreement — either as an arbitration clause (cláusula compromissória) included in a contract or as a standalone submission agreement (compromisso arbitral) — under the Voluntary Arbitration Law (Law No. 63/2011 of 14 December), to submit present or future disputes to institutional or ad hoc voluntary arbitration, specifying the centre, seat, applicable law, number of arbitrators and language of the proceedings.

PRC-038.titulo_en: Request to Initiate Mediation and Mediation Agreement
PRC-038.descricao_en: Generates the request to initiate mediation with the public mediation systems (SMF, SMTSS or SMAL) or with private mediation providers, as well as the final mediation agreement, under Law No. 29/2013 of 19 April, with an enforceability clause where applicable.

PRC-039.descricao_en: Generates the closing legal submissions made after the trial hearing, under Article 604 CPC, structuring the analysis of the evidence produced, the legal characterisation of the facts proven, their subsumption under the applicable rule and the formulation of the argument supporting the claim, with a view to guiding the judge in drafting the judgment.

PRC-040.titulo_en: Analysis of a Judgment and Opinion on the Prospects of Success on Appeal
PRC-040.descricao_en: Analyses the first-instance judgment, identifies errors of fact and law, assesses the prospects of success of an appeal to the Court of Appeal (Tribunal da Relação) or an appeal on points of law to the Supreme Court of Justice, and issues a reasoned opinion on whether to appeal, the strongest arguments to raise and the procedural risks of the challenge.

PRC-041.titulo_en: Interim Procedure for Preventive Attachment of a Bank Balance
PRC-041.descricao_en: Generates an application for a preventive attachment (arresto) specifically directed at bank account balances, based on Articles 391 to 396 CPC (Law No. 41/2013 of 26 June) and Article 619 of the Civil Code, including the fumus boni iuris, the periculum in mora and identification of the credit institutions.

PRC-042.titulo_en: Plea of Forgery of a Document
PRC-042.descricao_en: Generates the pleading raising the incidental plea of forgery (incidente de falsidade) of a document filed in the proceedings, under Articles 444 to 447 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), distinguishing material falsity from ideological falsity, with a request for an expert examination and suspensive effect on the assessment of the evidence.

PRC-043.titulo_en: Application for Service by Public Notice (Citação Edital)
PRC-043.descricao_en: Generates the application for service by public notice (citação edital) on a defendant or respondent whose whereabouts are unknown, under Articles 240 to 245 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), indicating the prior tracing steps taken and requesting the appointment of a provisional curator (curador provisório), for use in the Citius system.

PRC-044.titulo_en: Application for a Finding of Bad-Faith Litigation and a Fine
PRC-044.descricao_en: Generates an application for the opposing party to be found liable for bad-faith litigation (litigância de má-fé), under Articles 542 to 545 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), seeking a fine and compensation, distinguishing substantive from instrumental bad faith and establishing intent or gross negligence.

PRC-045.titulo_en: Opposition to Enforcement on Grounds of Set-Off
PRC-045.descricao_en: Generates the pleading opposing enforcement based on the set-off of claims held by the debtor against the enforcing creditor, under Articles 731, 732 and 847 to 856 CPC and Article 847 of the Civil Code, seeking full or partial termination of the enforcement proceedings.

PRC-046.titulo_en: Application for Enforcement of a Foreign Judgment (Exequatur)
PRC-046.descricao_en: Generates the application for recognition and enforcement of a foreign judgment in Portugal, under Regulation (EU) No. 1215/2012 (Brussels I bis) for decisions of EU Member States, or Articles 978 et seq. CPC for decisions of third States, with a request for a declaration of enforceability on Citius.

PRC-047.titulo_en: Lodging of Claims in Inventory Proceedings (Law 117/2019)
PRC-047.descricao_en: Generates the pleading lodging claims against the estate in notarial inventory proceedings (processo de inventário), under Law No. 117/2019 of 13 September and Decree-Law No. 1/2013 (RJPI), seeking recognition of the claim and priority payment out of each heir's share.

PRC-048.titulo_en: Complaint against the Admission or Rejection of Evidence
PRC-048.descricao_en: Generates the complaint against an order admitting or rejecting evidence requested by a party, under Articles 630(2) and 151 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), on the grounds of breach of the rules on admissibility or of evidentiary rights, to be raised at the hearing itself or in a separate application.

PRC-049.titulo_en: Application for Waiver of the Balance of the Court Fee — Detailed Grounds
PRC-049.descricao_en: Generates the reasoned application for waiver of payment of the balance of the court fee under Article 6(7) of the Court Costs Regulation (RCP — Decree-Law No. 34/2008), analysing complexity and procedural conduct, to be submitted at the end of the action before the statement of costs.

PRC-050.descricao_en: Generates the application for voluntary principal intervention (intervenção espontânea principal) by a third party seeking to assert a right incompatible with or competing with that of the claimant, under Articles 311 et seq. CPC (Law No. 41/2013), analysing the requirements of standing, timeliness and procedural compatibility.

PRC-051.titulo_en: Interim Procedure for the Suspension of a Company Resolution
PRC-051.descricao_en: Generates the application for an interim measure suspending a company resolution under Article 380 of the Commercial Companies Code (CSC) and Articles 362 et seq. CPC (Law No. 41/2013), seeking immediate suspension and linking it with the main action for annulment or declaration of nullity.

PRC-052.titulo_en: Application for the Appointment of a Provisional Judicial Administrator (Removal Action)
PRC-052.descricao_en: Generates the application for an interim measure appointing a provisional judicial administrator in the context of an action for the judicial removal of a manager or director, under Article 257(5) CSC and Articles 362 et seq. CPC (Law No. 41/2013), on the grounds of serious harm to the company.

PRC-053.titulo_en: Challenge to an Arbitral Award — Action for Annulment
PRC-053.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in an action to set aside (annul) an arbitral award under Article 46 of the Voluntary Arbitration Law (LAV — Law No. 63/2011 of 14 December), on the exhaustive grounds set out in Article 46(3) and (4) LAV, to be filed with the competent State court within 60 days.

PRC-054.titulo_en: Statement of Claim in Special Proceedings for the Protection of Personality Rights
PRC-054.descricao_en: Generates the statement of claim in the special procedure for the protection of personality rights under Articles 878 to 880 CPC (Law No. 41/2013) and Articles 70 to 81 of the Civil Code, to put an immediate end to an infringement of personality rights (honour, image, privacy, name), seeking an injunction and the removal of content.

PRC-055.titulo_en: Application for Substitution by the Assignee of a Disputed Claim
PRC-055.descricao_en: Generates the application for substitution (habilitação) of the assignee of a disputed claim (crédito litigioso) in place of the assignor in pending proceedings, under Articles 356 to 358 CPC (Law No. 41/2013) and Articles 577 to 588 of the Civil Code, with notice to the parties and continuity of the proceedings.

PRC-056.titulo_en: Special Action for the Performance of Pecuniary Obligations (AECOP) — Reasoned Opposition
PRC-056.descricao_en: Generates the pleading in opposition to an AECOP filed by the defendant once served, under Articles 6 et seq. of Decree-Law No. 269/98 of 1 September (AECOP regime), with the admissible grounds of defence and a request that the case proceed under the rules of the ordinary declaratory action.

PRC-057.titulo_en: Application for the Early Taking of Expert Evidence
PRC-057.descricao_en: Generates the application for the early taking of expert evidence under Article 420 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), for situations in which the expert or the subject matter of the examination may disappear or deteriorate, or in which there is urgency in recording the current condition of an asset, before the close of the case or even before any action is brought.

PRC-058.titulo_en: Application for Review of a Final Judgment
PRC-058.descricao_en: Generates the application for review (revisão) of a final judgment (res judicata) under Articles 696 to 702 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), on grounds of false evidence, new documents, misconduct (prevaricação) of participants in the proceedings or an incompatible decision of an international court, to be filed with the Supreme Court of Justice or the Court of Appeal depending on the category of the case.

PRC-059.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure Prohibiting Changes (Proibição de Inovar)
PRC-059.descricao_en: Generates the application for an unnamed interim measure prohibiting changes (proibição de inovar) under Articles 362 and 376 CPC (Law No. 41/2013), intended to prevent changes in the factual or legal situation that could frustrate the effectiveness of the judgment to be given in the main action, seeking preservation of the status quo.

PRC-060.titulo_en: Application for the Court to Fix a Time Limit for Performance of an Obligation
PRC-060.descricao_en: Generates the application for the court to fix a time limit for performance of an obligation with no stipulated time limit or with a time limit dependent on a demand for performance (interpelação), under Articles 777 and 411 of the Civil Code and Articles 1 et seq. CPC (Law No. 41/2013), analysing the nature of the obligation and the reasonableness of the time limit to be fixed.

PI-001.titulo_en: Application for Registration of a National Trade Mark (INPI)
PI-001.descricao_en: Prepares the complete application for registration of a national trade mark with the National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI), including a description of the sign, the grounds for its distinctiveness, identification of the Nice Classification classes and a declaration of intention to use.

PI-002.titulo_en: Application for Registration of a European Union Trade Mark (EUIPO)
PI-002.descricao_en: Prepares the application for registration of a European Union trade mark (EUTM, MUE) with the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO), based in Alicante, including identification of the classes, description of the goods/services, the grounds for distinctiveness and analysis of potential grounds for refusal under Regulation (EU) 2017/1001.

PI-003.titulo_en: Complaint / Opposition to a Trade Mark Application
PI-003.descricao_en: Prepares the notice of opposition to a trade mark application, either at the INPI (national procedure) or at the EUIPO (European procedure), based on the relative grounds for refusal, with an analysis of the likelihood of confusion and an indication of the evidence needed to support the opponent's claim.

PI-004.titulo_en: Reply to an Opposition in Trade Mark Registration Proceedings
PI-004.descricao_en: Prepares the reply/defence to an opposition filed against a trade mark application, at either the INPI or the EUIPO, refuting the opponent's grounds, submitting counter-evidence and arguing that the signs are different and/or for a limitation of the list of goods and services.

PI-005.descricao_en: Prepares the hierarchical or judicial appeal against an INPI decision refusing registration of a trade mark, upholding an opposition or taking another decision unfavourable to the applicant, on the grounds of procedural or substantive defects in the decision under appeal.

PI-006.titulo_en: Application for a Patent / Utility Model
PI-006.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a patent or utility model with the INPI, including the description, the claims, the abstract and an analysis of the patentability requirements (novelty, inventive step and industrial application), under the Industrial Property Code.

PI-007.titulo_en: Application for Registration of a Design
PI-007.descricao_en: Prepares the application for registration of a design with the INPI (national protection) or the EUIPO (European protection), including a description of the visual appearance of the product, identification of the graphic representations and analysis of the requirements of novelty and individual character.

PI-008.titulo_en: Application for Registration of a Logo (Logótipo)
PI-008.descricao_en: Prepares the application for registration of a logo (logótipo) as a distinctive trade sign with the INPI, including an analysis of its registrability as a figurative or composite mark, identification of the appropriate Nice classes and the grounds for the sign's visual distinctiveness.

PI-009.descricao_en: Drafts the trade mark licence agreement, defining the scope of the authorisation granted by the owner to the licensee, the quality control conditions, the remuneration due and the means of protecting the licensed sign, under the Portuguese Industrial Property Code.

PI-010.descricao_en: Drafts the licence agreement for the exploitation of a patent and/or technological know-how, defining the scope of the authorisation to use, the royalty remuneration, the confidentiality obligations, the rights in the event of improvements to the technology and the warranties as to the validity of the licensed patent.

PI-011.titulo_en: Agreement for the Assignment of Industrial Property Rights
PI-011.descricao_en: Drafts the agreement for the outright transfer of industrial property rights (trade marks, patents, designs), including precise identification of the rights assigned, the price, the assignor's warranties as to title and validity, and the obligations to record the assignment with the INPI.

PI-012.descricao_en: Drafts the agreement for the total or partial assignment of the author's economic rights in literary, artistic or scientific works, including identification of the work, the scope of the rights assigned, the remuneration, the warranties of title and the obligations to respect the author's moral rights.

PI-013.descricao_en: Drafts the publishing contract between author and publisher, regulating the grant of publishing and distribution rights in the work, the royalty remuneration, the number of editions and print runs, the publication deadlines and the consequences of the rights lapsing through the publisher's inactivity, under the Copyright Code.

PI-014.descricao_en: Drafts the agreement under which an entity commissions the creation of a copyright-protected work (software, design, texts, images, video) from an independent creator (freelancer or company), with a clause automatically assigning the economic rights to the commissioning party and defining the deliverables, time limit and price.

PI-015.descricao_en: Drafts the software licence agreement (End User Licence Agreement — EULA), defining the scope of the authorisation to use, the restrictions on use, licence management per user/device, the support and maintenance conditions and the limits on the licensor's liability.

PI-016.titulo_en: Out-of-Court Notice to Cease Trade Mark Infringement (Cease and Desist)
PI-016.descricao_en: Drafts the out-of-court notice addressed to an infringer improperly using a registered trade mark, demanding the immediate cessation of the unauthorised use and the removal of the sign from products, packaging and digital media, and warning of the legal consequences of refusal, under the Industrial Property Code.

PI-017.descricao_en: Drafts the out-of-court notice to an infringer who reproduces, distributes or communicates to the public copyright-protected works without authorisation, demanding immediate cessation and removal of the content and warning of the civil and criminal consequences, under the Code of Copyright and Related Rights.

PI-018.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Infringement of Industrial Property Rights
PI-018.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for infringement of industrial property rights (trade mark, patent, design), seeking cessation, damages, destruction of products and publication of the decision, under the Portuguese Industrial Property Code.

PI-019.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Unfair Competition
PI-019.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for unfair competition, covering practices such as slavish imitation of products, misappropriation of trade secrets, misleading comparative advertising and free-riding on another's reputation, under the Industrial Property Code and Directive (EU) 2016/943 on trade secrets.

PI-020.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for a Declaration of Invalidity or Revocation of a Trade Mark
PI-020.descricao_en: Prepares the application for a declaration of invalidity or revocation (caducidade) of a trade mark before the INPI or the EUIPO (through administrative proceedings) or the competent court, based on the applicable legal grounds — original absolute grounds for refusal, earlier rights not invoked in opposition, or lack of genuine and serious use of the mark for 5 consecutive years.

PI-021.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure in IP Matters
PI-021.descricao_en: Prepares the application for an interim measure for the urgent cessation of an infringement of intellectual property rights (trade mark, patent, copyright), seeking seizure of products, an injunction against use and content removal orders, demonstrating the fumus boni iuris and periculum in mora required by the CPC and the CPI.

PI-022.titulo_en: Calculation of Damages for Infringement of IP Rights
PI-022.descricao_en: Prepares the calculation and legal grounds for the damages due for infringement of intellectual property rights (trade marks, patents, copyright), applying the alternative criteria laid down in the CPI and the CDADC — the right holder's lost profits, the infringer's unjust gains and a hypothetical royalty — and setting out the quantification reasoning.

PI-023.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Likelihood of Confusion between Trade Marks
PI-023.descricao_en: Prepares a reasoned legal opinion on whether there is a likelihood of confusion between two trade marks, analysing the visual, phonetic and conceptual similarity of the signs, the similarity of the goods and services and the distinctive character of the earlier mark, according to the criteria of Portuguese and European case law.

PI-024.titulo_en: Prior Rights Search and Trade Mark Registrability Opinion
PI-024.descricao_en: Structures the search for prior trade mark rights (national and EU), analyses the results and prepares a registrability opinion, identifying the main obstacles and recommending the most appropriate registration strategy.

PI-025.descricao_en: Drafts a coexistence agreement between the owners of two similar or identical trade marks, defining the terms and conditions under which both can coexist on the market without conflict, including territorial, class and goods/services delimitation and mechanisms for resolving future disputes.

PI-026.titulo_en: Confidentiality Agreement for the Protection of Trade Secrets
PI-026.descricao_en: Drafts a robust confidentiality agreement (NDA — Non-Disclosure Agreement) to protect trade secrets, adapted to the regime of Law No. 93/2021 (transposing Directive (EU) 2016/943), covering both mutual and one-way agreements in the context of negotiations, partnerships, service contracts or employment relationships.

PI-027.titulo_en: Content Removal Notice (Notice and Takedown to a Platform)
PI-027.descricao_en: Prepares a formal content removal notice (notice and takedown) addressed to digital platforms (YouTube, Instagram, Meta, Amazon, Etsy, marketplaces, web hosting, etc.) for the removal of content infringing copyright, a registered trade mark or other intellectual property rights, under Portuguese law, Directive 2001/29/EC and Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (DSA).

PI-028.titulo_en: Intellectual Property Policy for a Company
PI-028.descricao_en: Prepares an internal intellectual property policy for a company, setting the rules on ownership of staff creations, protection of IP assets, registration procedures, use of third-party software and content, and management of intellectual property conflicts.

PI-029.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Ownership of Software Developed by an Employee
PI-029.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the ownership of software (or another work) developed by an employee, analysing whether the rights belong to the employer or to the employee in light of Article 14 of the Code of Copyright and Related Rights (CDADC) and the employment contract, and recommending the measures to be taken.

PI-030.descricao_en: Drafts a technology transfer agreement between a transferor (company, university, research centre) and a transferee (company or entrepreneur), covering the assignment or licensing of patents, know-how, software, trade secrets and other associated IP rights, defining the terms of exploitation, the consideration and the confidentiality obligations.

PI-031.titulo_en: Application to Renew a Trade Mark Registration
PI-031.descricao_en: Prepares the application to renew a trade mark registration with the INPI (national) or the EUIPO (European Union trade mark), including identification of the rights to be renewed and the classes to be kept or reduced, and alerts on time limits and the consequences of the registration lapsing for failure to renew.

PI-032.titulo_en: Analysis of a Sponsorship / Merchandising Agreement
PI-032.descricao_en: Prepares a critical legal analysis of a sponsorship or merchandising agreement, identifying the IP risks (use of trade marks, image and other rights), unbalanced clauses, significant omissions and improvements to negotiate, with particular attention to ownership of the materials created, exclusivity, duration and the consequences of early termination.

PI-033.titulo_en: Opposition to a Trade Mark Application (INPI — In-Depth Grounds)
PI-033.descricao_en: Prepares a reasoned notice of opposition before the INPI against a trade mark application, under Articles 232 to 237 of the Industrial Property Code (CPI — Decree-Law No. 110/2018 of 10 December) and Article 8 of Regulation (EU) 2017/1001 (EUTMR, RMUE), invoking earlier rights, likelihood of confusion, reputation and bad faith.

PI-034.titulo_en: Opposition to a European Union Trade Mark Application (EUIPO)
PI-034.descricao_en: Prepares the opposition before the EUIPO against a European Union trade mark (EUTM) application, under Articles 46 to 71 of Regulation (EU) 2017/1001 (EUTMR) and the EUIPO Guidelines, invoking earlier national or European rights, likelihood of confusion and earlier unregistered rights.

PI-035.titulo_en: Action for Revocation of a Trade Mark for Lack of Genuine Use
PI-035.descricao_en: Prepares the application for revocation (caducidade) of a registered trade mark for lack of genuine use for five consecutive years, under Article 269 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and Article 58 of the EUTMR, to be filed with the INPI (national marks) or the EUIPO (EUTMs), or in court proceedings before the Intellectual Property Court.

PI-036.titulo_en: Trade Mark Infringement (Contrafação) Action — Statement of Claim
PI-036.descricao_en: Prepares the statement of claim in an action for infringement of trade mark rights (contrafação), to be brought before the Intellectual Property Court (TPI), under Articles 258 to 265 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), seeking cessation, damages, seizure of products and publication of the judgment.

PI-037.titulo_en: Application for an Interim Measure in Infringement (Contrafação) Matters
PI-037.descricao_en: Prepares the application for an interim injunction and seizure in proceedings for infringement of industrial property rights, under Articles 338-I to 338-M of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and Articles 362 et seq. of the CPC, seeking the urgent cessation of infringing acts before the decision on the merits.

PI-038.descricao_en: Prepares a full trade mark licence agreement, covering exclusive or non-exclusive licence, territory, field of use, royalties, quality control and grounds for termination, under Articles 31 to 35 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and the general law of contracts (Civil Code).

PI-039.titulo_en: Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement (Technology Transfer Agreement)
PI-039.descricao_en: Prepares a patent licence agreement combined with the transfer of know-how and technical assistance, under Articles 101 to 104 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), Regulation (EU) 316/2014 (block exemption for technology transfer agreements — TTBER, RECATT) and the Civil Code.

PI-040.titulo_en: Protection of Trade Secrets — Notice and Action (Law No. 93/2021)
PI-040.descricao_en: Prepares an out-of-court notice and a statement of claim for the protection of a trade secret, under Law No. 93/2021 of 20 December (transposing Directive (EU) 2016/943), demanding cessation of the unlawful misappropriation, damages and destruction of documents.

PI-041.titulo_en: Software Copyright — Legal Opinion and Commissioning Agreement
PI-041.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the ownership of copyright in software and drafts a software development commissioning agreement, under Articles 1, 2(1)(l), 36 to 39, 102 and 103 of the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85, as amended by Decree-Law No. 332/97), Directive 2009/24/EC and Articles 101 and 102 of the Labour Code.

PI-042.titulo_en: Works Created by Artificial Intelligence — Ownership Opinion and Protection Strategy
PI-042.descricao_en: Prepares a legal opinion on the protection and ownership of works generated or assisted by artificial intelligence, in light of the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85), Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), Directive 2019/790 (DSM) and the emerging position of European legal scholarship and case law.

PI-043.titulo_en: Publishing Contract (Copyright — Literary or Scientific Work)
PI-043.descricao_en: Prepares a full publishing contract between author and publisher, under Articles 83 to 103 of the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85, as amended by Decree-Law No. 334/97), regulating the temporary grant of the publishing right, print run, royalties, the obligation to publish, translation and adaptation rights and the reversion of rights.

PI-044.titulo_en: Related Rights — Protection of Performers and Phonogram Producers
PI-044.descricao_en: Prepares an opinion and draft contracts on the related rights of performers, producers of phonograms and videograms and broadcasting organisations, under Articles 176 to 184 of the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85), Directive 2011/77/EU (term of protection) and Directive (EU) 2019/790 (DSM).

PI-045.titulo_en: Design Registrations — National (INPI) and EU (EUIPO) Applications
PI-045.descricao_en: Prepares the application for registration of a design, national (INPI) and European Union (EUIPO), under Articles 173 to 213 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and Regulation (EC) No 6/2002 (Community Designs Regulation — RDMC), including analysis of novelty, individual character and the representation strategy.

PI-046.descricao_en: Prepares an arbitral complaint to recover a .pt domain name registered in bad faith or infringing trade mark rights, under the .pt Regulation of FCCN/DNS.pt and the Dispute Resolution Policies (similar to ICANN's UDRP), before ARBITRARE — Commercial Arbitration Centre.

PI-047.titulo_en: Unitary Patent and Unified Patent Court (UPC) — Legal Opinion and Strategy
PI-047.descricao_en: Prepares an opinion on the European unitary patent (Regulation (EU) No 1257/2012) and the Unified Patent Court (UPC) system, in force since June 2023, including analysis of the advantages and disadvantages compared with the classic European patent (national validation), opt-out strategy and defence in proceedings before the UPC.

PI-048.titulo_en: Intellectual Property Due Diligence in M&A
PI-048.descricao_en: Prepares the plan and report for intellectual property due diligence in a merger or acquisition (M&A), covering the mapping and valuation of trade marks, patents, copyright, trade secrets, IP contracts and third-party risks, under the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), the CDADC and Law No. 93/2021.

PI-049.titulo_en: Comparative Advertising — Legality Opinion and Notice
PI-049.descricao_en: Prepares a legality opinion on a comparative advertising campaign and, where applicable, an out-of-court notice or a statement of claim for an injunction action (ação inibitória), under Decree-Law No. 330/90 (Advertising Code, as amended by Decree-Law No. 57/2008), Directive 2006/114/EC (misleading and comparative advertising) and Directive 2005/29/EC (unfair commercial practices).

PI-050.descricao_en: Prepares a full technology transfer agreement between transferor and transferee, regulating the assignment or licensing of know-how, patents, software and other technological assets, under the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), the Civil Code and Regulation (EU) 316/2014 (TTBER, RECATT), with clauses on technical assistance, training, sub-licensing and protection of secrets.

PI-051.titulo_en: Trade Mark Coexistence Agreement (Delimitation of Use)
PI-051.descricao_en: Prepares a coexistence agreement between owners of similar trade marks to delimit their respective scopes of use, avoid disputes and allow both marks to be registered, under Article 235-A of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and the general law of contracts.

PI-052.titulo_en: Calculation of Damages for Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights
PI-052.descricao_en: Prepares a detailed calculation statement of the damages due for infringement of intellectual property rights (trade mark, patent, copyright), under Article 347 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), Article 13 of Law No. 93/2021 (trade secrets) and Article 211 of the CDADC, following the methodologies of Directive 2004/48/EC (enforcement).

PI-053.titulo_en: Content Removal Notice to Online Platforms (Notice and Takedown — DSA/DMCA)
PI-053.descricao_en: Prepares a notice requesting the removal of infringing content from hosting platforms, social networks and marketplaces, under Article 16 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (DSA — Digital Services Act), alleging infringement of copyright or of a registered trade mark, or misleading advertising.

PI-054.titulo_en: Legal Opinion on Likelihood of Confusion between Trade Marks (Structured Analysis)
PI-054.descricao_en: Prepares a structured legal opinion on the likelihood of confusion between two trade marks, following the CJEU and EUIPO methodology, under Article 231 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and Article 8(1)(b) of the EUTMR (Regulation (EU) 2017/1001), to support an opposition, a defence or an infringement action.

PI-055.titulo_en: Internal Intellectual Property Policy (IP Policy) for a Company
PI-055.descricao_en: Prepares a comprehensive internal intellectual property policy for a company, regulating ownership of creations by employees and contractors, protection of trade secrets, use of third-party IP assets and management of the IP portfolio, under the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85), Law No. 93/2021 and the Labour Code.

PI-056.titulo_en: Reply to an Opposition in Trade Mark Registration Proceedings (INPI and EUIPO)
PI-056.descricao_en: Prepares the reply to an opposition filed against a trade mark application, contesting the grounds invoked by the opponent (likelihood of confusion, reputation, bad faith), under Articles 232 to 240 of the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018) and the EUIPO Guidelines.

PI-057.titulo_en: Software Licence Agreement (End User Licence Agreement — EULA and Enterprise Licence)
PI-057.descricao_en: Prepares a full software licence agreement — an end-user EULA and an enterprise (B2B) licence — under Articles 1, 2(1)(l) and 68 of the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85), Directive 2009/24/EC and the regime for digital contracts (Directive (EU) 2019/770, transposed by Law No. 55/2023).

PI-058.titulo_en: Confidentiality Agreement for the Protection of Trade Secrets (Advanced NDA)
PI-058.descricao_en: Prepares a robust confidentiality agreement (NDA) tailored to the protection of trade secrets under Law No. 93/2021 (transposing Directive (EU) 2016/943), the Civil Code and the Labour Code, with one-way and mutual clauses, penalties for breach and specific regimes for negotiations, partnerships and due diligence.

PI-059.titulo_en: Merchandising Agreement and Character / Brand Image Licence
PI-059.descricao_en: Prepares a merchandising agreement under which the owner of a trade mark, character, artistic work or celebrity image licenses a third party to apply that element to physical or digital products, under the CPI (Decree-Law No. 110/2018), the CDADC (Decree-Law No. 63/85) and the Civil Code, including royalties, quality control and protection against unauthorised sub-licensing.

PI-060.titulo_en: Appeal against an INPI Decision (Judicial Appeal and Hierarchical Appeal)
PI-060.descricao_en: Prepares the appeal against an INPI decision on trade marks, patents or designs, either an internal hierarchical appeal (Article 37 of the CPI) or a judicial appeal to the Intellectual Property Court (Articles 38 et seq. of the CPI and Law No. 62/2011), contesting refusals of registration, opposition decisions and other administrative decisions of the INPI.

DIG-001.titulo_en: Privacy Policy for a Website / App (GDPR)
DIG-001.descricao_en: Generates a complete privacy policy compliant with the GDPR (RGPD) for websites or apps, identifying the controller, the purposes and legal bases of each processing operation, data subjects' rights, international transfers and the DPO's contact details.

DIG-002.descricao_en: Generates a complete cookie policy and consent banner text compliant with the ePrivacy Directive, Law No. 41/2004 (as amended) and the guidance of the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD), classifying cookies by category, purpose and duration, with instructions for managing them.

DIG-003.descricao_en: Generates a Data Processing Agreement (DPA — contrato de subcontratação) compliant with Article 28 of the GDPR, governing the relationship between a controller and a processor that processes personal data on its behalf.

DIG-004.descricao_en: Generates a Joint Controller Agreement (JCA) compliant with Article 26 of the GDPR, transparently setting out each party's responsibilities and the contact point for data subjects.

DIG-005.titulo_en: Standard Contractual Clauses for International Transfers (EU Layer)
DIG-005.descricao_en: Generates a legal opinion on the use of the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) adopted by the European Commission for data transfers to third countries, including the Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) required since Schrems II, and drafts the supplementary clauses needed for each specific situation.

DIG-006.descricao_en: Generates the Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) compliant with Article 30 of the GDPR, with all the mandatory entries for each processing activity, ready for internal implementation and for presentation to the CNPD in the event of an inspection.

DIG-007.descricao_en: Generates a complete Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA/AIPD) compliant with Article 35 of the GDPR, including the necessity analysis, the description of the processing, the assessment of risks to data subjects' rights and freedoms, and mitigation measures.

DIG-008.titulo_en: Response to a Data Subject Rights Request (Access, Rectification, Erasure, Portability)
DIG-008.descricao_en: Generates formal responses to data subjects' requests to exercise their rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, restriction), with correct legal grounds, within the legal deadline and in the appropriate format, for any of the rights under Arts. 15 to 22 of the GDPR.

DIG-009.titulo_en: Internal Procedure for Handling Data Subject Requests
DIG-009.descricao_en: Generates an internal standard operating procedure (SOP) for handling data subject rights requests, with workflow, responsibilities, deadlines, internal forms and compliance records, for immediate implementation in an organisation.

DIG-010.titulo_en: Personal Data Breach Notification to the CNPD
DIG-010.descricao_en: Generates the personal data breach notification to the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD) under Article 33 of the GDPR, with a risk analysis, a description of the incident, the measures taken and an assessment of whether the affected data subjects must be informed, within 72 hours.

DIG-011.titulo_en: Communication of a Data Breach to Affected Data Subjects
DIG-011.descricao_en: Generates the communication of a personal data breach to the affected data subjects under Article 34 of the GDPR, in clear language, with complete information about the incident and practical measures that data subjects can take to protect themselves.

DIG-012.titulo_en: Response to a Request for Information or Inspection by the CNPD
DIG-012.descricao_en: Generates a formal, legally reasoned response to requests for information, inquiries and inspections by the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD) in the exercise of its investigative powers (Art. 58 GDPR and Arts. 13 et seq. of Law No. 58/2019), maximising the inspected entity's position and demonstrating compliance with the GDPR.

DIG-013.titulo_en: Defence in Administrative Offence Proceedings for Breach of the GDPR
DIG-013.descricao_en: Generates the defence in administrative offence (contraordenação) proceedings brought by the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD) for breach of the GDPR, including the prior hearing, the response to the charges, the invocation of mitigating circumstances and, if necessary, a judicial appeal against the final decision.

DIG-014.titulo_en: Opinion on the Lawful Basis for Processing (Specific Case)
DIG-014.descricao_en: Generates a reasoned legal opinion on the correct lawful basis for a specific processing of personal data under Article 6 of the GDPR, including an analysis of the available alternatives and the practical implications of each option.

DIG-015.titulo_en: Privacy Notice for Employees and Job Applicants
DIG-015.descricao_en: Generates a complete privacy notice for employees and job applicants, compliant with Arts. 13 and 14 of the GDPR and the specific features of data processing in the employment context, covering all typical HR processing: recruitment, contract, payroll, occupational health, monitoring and termination.

DIG-016.titulo_en: Internal Data Protection Policy for a Company
DIG-016.descricao_en: Generates a complete internal data protection policy for implementation in a company, covering the principles, responsibilities, processes and controls that ensure ongoing compliance with the GDPR, for approval by the Board and distribution to all staff.

DIG-017.titulo_en: Letter Appointing the Data Protection Officer (DPO)
DIG-017.descricao_en: Generates the letter appointing the Data Protection Officer (EPD/DPO), the services agreement for an external DPO and the notification of the appointment to the CNPD, in accordance with Articles 37 to 39 of the GDPR and Art. 13 of Law No. 58/2019.

DIG-018.titulo_en: Complaint to the CNPD for Unlawful Processing of Personal Data
DIG-018.descricao_en: Generates a formal complaint to the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD) for breach of the GDPR, under Article 77 of the GDPR, precisely identifying the infringement, the data affected and the measures requested, for filing by the data subject or by the lawyer representing them.

DIG-019.titulo_en: Statement of Claim for Damages for Breach of the GDPR
DIG-019.descricao_en: Generates a statement of claim in an action for damages caused by breach of the GDPR, under Article 82 of the GDPR and the Portuguese Civil Code, for filing in a civil court.

DIG-020.titulo_en: Website / Platform Terms and Conditions of Use
DIG-020.descricao_en: Generates complete terms and conditions of use for a website or digital platform, covering intellectual property, liability, access conditions, user-generated content, suspension policy and dispute resolution, in accordance with Portuguese law and EU legislation (DSA, e-Commerce, GDPR).

DIG-021.descricao_en: Generates terms and conditions specific to mobile apps (iOS/Android), covering the particularities of app stores, device permissions, in-app purchases, push notifications, user-generated content and compliance with the GDPR and the DSA.

DIG-022.descricao_en: Generates a complete Software as a Service (SaaS) agreement, covering the licence to use, SLA, integrated DPA, intellectual property, confidentiality, liability and termination conditions, for B2B contracts in the Portuguese and European market.

DIG-023.descricao_en: Generates a complete software development agreement, covering scope definition, deliverables, intellectual property, confidentiality, warranties, liability, processing of personal data and termination conditions, adapted to Portuguese law and GDPR obligations.

DIG-024.titulo_en: Compliance Opinion on a Video Surveillance System
DIG-024.descricao_en: Generates a compliance opinion on a video surveillance (CCTV) system, analysing the lawfulness of the processing under the GDPR, Law No. 34/2013 (private security) and CNPD guidance, with specific recommendations for bringing it into compliance.

DIG-025.titulo_en: Acceptable Use Policy for IT Systems
DIG-025.descricao_en: Generates an acceptable use policy (AUP) for company IT systems, setting rules for staff use of equipment, networks, email, the internet and corporate data, in compliance with the GDPR and the Portuguese Labour Code.

DIG-026.titulo_en: Opinion on Direct Marketing and Unsolicited Electronic Communications
DIG-026.descricao_en: Generates an opinion on the lawfulness of direct marketing campaigns (email, SMS, WhatsApp, telephone), analysing the requirements of the GDPR, Law No. 41/2004 (ePrivacy) and the applicable Portuguese legislation, with recommendations for compliance.

DIG-027.titulo_en: Data Protection Clause for Insertion in Various Contracts
